# Greenhouse security overview

**Permissions:** —

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Our customers trust us with their sensitive data, and we take keeping it safe seriously.

This article serves as an overview of security practices on Greenhouse and can help to address questions you may have about data security or the processes we employ to maintain and grow the hiring software.

#### In this article

  * **Product**
    * How does Greenhouse protect user accounts from invalid logins?
    * Does Greenhouse support single sign-on?
    * Does Greenhouse verify user email addresses?
    * Is user activity in Greenhouse tracked for auditing purposes?
    * How does Greenhouse Technical Support access our account data?
    * Does Greenhouse scan files uploaded during the candidate application submission?
  * **Email security**
    * How does Greenhouse send emails on behalf of our domain?
    * Can we use our own SMTP servers instead of Mailgun?
  * **Data**
    * What confidential or personally identifiable information (PII) data do you collect?
    * How is data protected that is sent to and from the client?
    * Is data encrypted at rest?
    * Can I securely delete my company's data from Greenhouse?
    * Can we delete specific data, versus deleting all the data?
    * How can I remove a user from Greenhouse Recruiting?
    * Does sensitive customer data ever leave the production environment?
    * Does Greenhouse integrate with any third-party service providers?
    * How do integration partners deal with their security?
    * Will third-parties have access to my data?
    * How does Greenhouse assess security vulnerabilities?
    * What is Greenhouse's policy for notifying customers about security incidents?
    * What third-party security and privacy attestations does Greenhouse have?
    * Is Greenhouse PCI-DSS compliant?
  * **Infrastructure**
    * How does Greenhouse host application infrastructure?
    * Where is Greenhouse infrastructure hosted?
    * Is access to Greenhouse infrastructure limited to authorized personnel?
    * Which third-party services does Greenhouse use to support the application?
  * **Codebase** **and** **testing**  

    * What is Greenhouse's change management process?
    * How does Greenhouse test their changes?



### Product

#### How does Greenhouse protect user accounts from invalid logins?

All passwords are stored as a salted BCrypt hash with a large work factor that is not susceptible to offline brute-force attacks.

To protect users from online brute force attacks we have user-specific lockouts and rate-limiting in place. We have additional controls to reduce the effects of credential stuffing attacks by performing IP-based rate-limiting and blocking if an IP address is found to have too many failed login attempts against our services.

#### Does Greenhouse support single sign-on?

Yes, Greenhouse supports SAML 2.0-based single sign-on and Google Login.

Read more here: [Single sign-on overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/210259723).

#### Does Greenhouse verify user email addresses?

Yes. We verify all email addresses of Greenhouse Recruiting users by sending a verification email upon registration. The user will not have access to the hiring software until they have clicked the verification link.

Read more here: [Add email address to personal user account](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360034879332).

#### Is user activity in Greenhouse tracked for auditing purposes?

Most user activity is tracked in Greenhouse Recruiting. There are two places where you can see a list of actions performed by users:

  * on a [candidate's **Activity** **Feed**](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360037386272);
  * on the [organization-level **Change** **Log**](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360037767471) (where we log user permissions changes, configuration edits, job application updates, etc.).



Additionally, Expert tier customers can purchase the [audit log add-on](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/15074318933275) for additional records of important user activity.

#### How does Greenhouse Technical Support access our account data?

Greenhouse has an internal application that allows a carefully restricted subset of employees to log in as any user if granted access by the customer. This functionality is only used for Technical Support and Professional Services.

Read more here: [Grant Greenhouse Technical Support team temporary account access](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360053616131).

Every one of these logins are recorded in an easily accessible audit log. All users with this level of access must have received manager approval, completed a background check, and signed our production data access policy. Access to this internal dashboard is protected behind Greenhouse's Single Sign-On (SSO) and device certificates.

#### Does Greenhouse scan files uploaded during the candidate application submission?

All documents received from public users (such as resumes, cover letters, portfolios, and take home tests) are scanned for potential malware. Greenhouse Recruiting will warn the user if any document was flagged as malicious. Greenhouse Recruiting customers have the option to accept the risk and proceed to download the file.

All file attachments sent through Greenhouse Recruiting are scanned for malware. If an attachment is found to be malicious, Greenhouse will not submit the email until the attachment has been removed. This is done to ensure that we do not negatively impact Greenhouse's or our customer's email reputation.

### Email security

#### How does Greenhouse send emails on behalf of our domain?

When Greenhouse Recruiting is configured to send emails on behalf of your organization, you must version authorize ownership of the domain address. This verification process is performed with our email sub-processor Mailgun by setting SPF, DKIM, MX, and CNAME records for your domain name.

By enabling these, the organization authorizes Greenhouse and our Mailgun account to send emails on behalf of organization emails without getting marked as spam. Greenhouse performs authorization checks within the application to ensure emails are only sent by authorized users. All email addresses added to the system must first undergo verification before we allow any emails to get sent. The email verification process is performed by sending a secure link to the added email address. 

Read more here:

  * [ Email verification ](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201111684)
  * [ Mailgun ](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360023438532)



**Note** : This feature is not available in Greenhouse Onboarding.

#### Can we use our own SMTP servers instead of Mailgun?

For customers that do not want to use our Mailgun service, we provide the ability for all email to get sent using custom SMTP servers. Customers can provide Greenhouse with the hostname, port number, and login credentials to their SMTP server. Additionally, organizations will need to allowlist a set of IP addresses that we provide to allow us to connect to the SMTP server. Customer SMTP credentials are stored encrypted at the application server before being stored in our database. Access to these credentials is protected using the same security controls as all other secret data stored by our application.**  
**

Read more here: [Custom SMTP](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360002116131).

### Data

#### What confidential or personally identifiable information (PII) data do you collect?

As candidates apply, and prospects are entered by sourcers, various personally identifiable information (PII) is collected. PII stored within Greenhouse may include: full name, email address, phone number, social media usernames, gender, race, current/desired salary, offer data, answers to any custom questions you may ask in job applications, and notes taken by users during interviews.**  
**

#### How is data protected that is sent to and from the client?

HTTPS (SSL/TLS) is mandatory for in-app requests and job application form submissions. We also set the secure flag on the user session cookie to prevent session-hijacking attacks.

#### Is data encrypted at rest?

Greenhouse encrypts the database and S3 buckets at rest using Amazon Web Service's (AWS) Key Management System (KMS).

#### Can I securely delete my company's data from Greenhouse?

You are able to delete individual candidate records at any time. These are hard deletes from the production database. However, we do maintain database backups for 30 days which are not purged of deleted-candidate data. We also have 'versioning' enabled in S3, so any files deleted from S3 as a result of candidate deletion will remain as a historical version of the file for 30 days as well. 

On the 31st day after the candidate record has been deleted, it will be completely purged from our systems. At the request of a departing organization, Greenhouse will delete the entire organization's tree of data from the production database, though the aforementioned remnants will still exist in our systems after an account-level deletion until the backups have expired.

#### Can we delete specific data, versus deleting all the data?

Yes. Most data that can be created in Greenhouse can be hard-deleted by users, with the caveats listed in the previous answer (regarding database backups and versioned S3 files).

#### How can I remove a user from Greenhouse Recruiting?

While it isn't possible to delete a user, Greenhouse Recruiting does allow for users to be deactivated (and re-enabled).

Read more here: [Deactivate user](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115004791523).

If the user logs in with SSO, their SSO privileges must be deactivated from the SSO's dashboard in addition to the user account in Greenhouse Recruiting. At the request of an organization, we may be able to perform a hard delete on a user—however, we would encourage organizations against this practice, as any notes or scorecards created by that user will also be deleted if a user is hard deleted.

#### Does sensitive customer data ever leave the production environment?

Greenhouse has strict process controls regarding employee access to customer data. Personally identifiable information only persists in the production environment and in production database backups.

#### Does Greenhouse integrate with any third-party service providers?

Greenhouse has a very large number of integration partners.

Each of these integration partners has to be authorized by the customer in order to access any customer data. Customers choosing to use an integration must work with the integration partner to purchase their solution and activate the integration with Greenhouse.

Read more here: [Greenhouse > integrations](https://www.greenhouse.io/integrations).

#### How do integration partners deal with their security?

For more details, please see the security page for any integration partner that you wish to connect to Greenhouse. Greenhouse does not claim responsibility for the security of our integration partners, and customers must do their own vetting of an integration partner's security before sharing their data.

#### Will third-parties have access to my data?

Greenhouse does not sell any customer data to any third-party. Only data that you explicitly authorize and send to a third-party (such as an HRIS integration or a job board posting) will ever leave Greenhouse. Greenhouse will only share customer data with our authorized sub-processors. A full list of Greenhouse's subprocessors is available on our marketing site. [Read here](https://www.greenhouse.com/subprocessors-in-use)

#### How does Greenhouse assess security vulnerabilities?

Greenhouse performs periodic white-box security and infrastructure audits with an outside penetration testing firm. We also run a bug bounty program through HackerOne and award bounties to security researchers who find any verifiable vulnerabilities.

Read more here: [HackerOne > Greenhouse](https://hackerone.com/greenhouse).

All accepted vulnerabilities on our bug bounty follow our typical vulnerability remediation guidelines for patching.

A customer letter written by the penetration testing firm that includes the scope of the assessment and the issue counts per vulnerability severity level that were identified during the assessment can be accessed in our [Trust Portal.](https://trust.greenhouse.com/)

#### What is Greenhouse's policy for notifying customers about security incidents?

In the event of a significant security incident,__ notifications are made within the timeframe specified in your customer license agreement and are dependent upon the nature of the incident. We strive for transparency and clear communication, especially during security incidents. We will update you on the nature of the incident, what we are doing to resolve it, and an estimated resolution time.

#### What third-party security and privacy attestations does Greenhouse have?

Greenhouse undergoes annual SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001:2013, and ISO 27701:2019 audits performed by a licensed CPA firm. The audits verified the proper design and effectiveness of our controls around security, confidentiality, and availability, and that our Privacy and Information Security Management System is designed and operating within the ISO 27001:2013 and ISO 27701:2019 standards respectively.

Copies of our SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2 report, and ISO 27001:2013/ISO 27701:2019 certification are available on our [Trust Portal](https://trust.greenhouse.com).

#### Is Greenhouse PCI-DSS compliant?

Greenhouse does accept credit card data within certain features on Greenhouse Recruiting. We utilize Recurly as our credit card processor and use their SDK to prevent credit card data from passing through any Greenhouse infrastructure. Recurly is PCI DSS Level 1 compliant, which is the highest level of PCI compliance. Greenhouse is only obligated to complete a PCI Self Assessment Questionnaire (SAQ) for compliance. Our PCI SAQ is available under NDA on our [Trust Portal](https://trust.greenhouse.com).

### Infrastructure

#### How does Greenhouse host application infrastructure?

Physical infrastructure is run atop Amazon Web Services (AWS). Virtualized infrastructure runs within our AWS Virtual Private Cloud. All files (such as resumes and cover letters) are stored using Amazon S3 and are encrypted at rest.

#### Where is Greenhouse infrastructure hosted?

Greenhouse hosts its infrastructure across several availability zones within the following Amazon Web Services (AWS) datacenter regions:

  * US based silos: US-East-1 (Virginia) and US-West-2 (Oregon) for disaster recovery
  * EU based silos: EU-Central-1 (Frankfurt) and EU-West-1 (Ireland) for disaster recovery
  * APAC based silos: AP-Southeast-2 (Sydney) and AP-Southeast-4 (Melbourne) for disaster recovery 



#### Is access to Greenhouse infrastructure limited to authorized personnel?

All access to physical infrastructure is managed by AWS (Amazon Web Services) in accordance with their security policies.

Read more on AWS: [AWS Compliance](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/programs/).

A very limited subset of users such as Service Reliability Engineers (SREs) or Production Engineering Support (Prod Support) is given this level of access to our production infrastructure. They require this level of access to troubleshoot and resolve production-level incidents. Access to our production infrastructure requires manager approval, completion of a background check, and the signing of our production data access agreement.

#### Which third-party services does Greenhouse use to support the application?

A list of our data sub-processors and details of the purpose of their processing is provided to customers as part of our Data Processing Agreement (DPA). Greenhouse performs annual security reviews on all of our data sub-processors to ensure they are maintaining their security program and data privacy posture. Greenhouse also requires all of our sub-processors to sign a Data Processing Agreement. Read more: [Subprocessors in use](https://www.greenhouse.com/subprocessors-in-use), [data processing addendum](https://www.greenhouse.com/data-processing-addendum)

### Code base and testing

#### What is Greenhouse's change management process?

All requests for application or infrastructure changes are tracked and planned using our ticketing system. All code changes require a code review and approval by one additional engineer. All code changes are scanned for code quality and security issues as part of the code review process. All code changes are run through our extensive test suite to proactively identify issues prior to release. Greenhouse engineers are required to create test plans and test changes prior to releasing changes above a certain risk tier. Greenhouse utilizes feature flags to perform controlled releases for major application features.

#### How does Greenhouse test their changes?

Changes are always first tested within a non-production environment before being released to production. Major changes undergo testing and 'bake-in' periods to identify any issues before being promoted to production.

Our platform allows organizations to generate dynamic interview questions based on specific job descriptions, conduct interviews through audio responses and automatically evaluate candidate performance using advanced AI analysis. DigAÍ helps hiring teams efficiently identify the most qualified candidates through objective, data-driven insights.

  * Additional resources

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923) to retrieve your API key from your DigAÍ representative and add the assessment stage in your interview plans. 

Once you’ve set up your interview plans and configured your take-home test, you’ll be able to send the test to candidates.

# Reject a candidate

**Permissions:** Site Admin, and Job Admin who can reject candidates

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

When your organization rejects a candidate, that person is no longer considered for the role and is removed from the pipeline for that job. This article covers how to reject an individual candidate from a job, including how to schedule a rejection email. 

**Note:** You can also reject prospects or reject candidates in bulk. For more information, visit [Stop considering a prospect](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360026133091) or [Reject candidates or prospects in bulk](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025552011).

#### In this article

  * Default rejection
  * Security risk rejection



A candidate can be rejected from the **Job Dashboard** or from their candidate profile. 

On the **Job Dashboard** , you can find the candidate's information under the **Candidates** tab and use it to open their profile.

If you're already on the candidate's profile, you can choose the correct job from the right panel.

Open the **Stages** tab and click **Reject** at the top of the page.

### Default rejection

Use the default rejection for candidates who are no longer a fit or who choose to withdraw from the process.

Include a **Rejection reason** and check the **Start new prospect process after rejection** box if you'd like to add the candidate to a [prospect pool](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200670155). Select **Reject this candidate from all jobs** if you'd like to reject applications from all other jobs they're attached to.

There are some situations where you want to reject a candidate and not provide a rejection email. For example, if the candidate is being considered for multiple jobs and is receiving a single communication from your organization, or if they are still being considered for another role.

Scroll to the bottom and select **Reject and don't send email.**

However, if you want to send a rejection email, review the template and text, and choose any delay using the dropdown menu at the bottom of the rejection window. Then, click **Reject and send email.**

**Note:** Sending a rejection email improves the candidate's experience, and shows that your organization is communicative by providing timely updates about their application.

**Note:** If you selected the **Start new prospect process** box, the page will prompt you to add the prospect to a [prospect pool and stage](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360024904051). 

### Security risk rejection

This rejection type is designed for cases involving fraud, spam, or misrepresentation.

[Rejection reasons](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/207305363) for this rejection type are limited to fraud, irregular application activity, or misrepresentation. Select **Other (Add details)** to provide a custom reason.

To prevent this candidate from receiving emails or stop your team from sending emails to them, select **Mark as do not email**.

This streamlined flow excludes the option to send rejection emails.

The candidate's rejection information will be displayed at the top of the **Stages** tab and with any jobs in the right panel.

# Checkr integration

**Permissions:** Site Admin who can see private notes, private fields, salary info, manage offers, request approval, and approve jobs/offers and Job Admin who can view and edit private candidate and application fields

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Checkr allows your organization to conduct compliant and accurate background screenings that balance safety and consumer protection, with a modern experience that makes the process simpler and more efficient for both companies and applicants. You can hire faster and smarter with in-depth and accurate reports customized and scaled to your business needs.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Checkr enables your organization to order and review background checks from Checkr directly on the candidate's profile in Greenhouse Recruiting.

**Note** : If you're currently using the legacy [GoodHire by Checkr](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360059951892) integration, [reach out to Greenhouse Technical Support](https://support.greenhouse.io/direct) for help disconnecting the GoodHire integration before enabling the Checkr integration. You may need to provide a [support verification code](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022771952) to verify account access.

#### In this article

  * Enable the integration
  * Use the integration
    * Order background checks
    * View a candidate's background check status
  * Additional resources



### Enable the Checkr integration

To enable the Checkr integration, click **Integrations** on your navigation bar and search for Checkr. 

Click **Connect**.

You'll be redirected to Checkr's integration page. Follow the steps on-screen to enable the integration with your existing Checkr account or set up a new Checkr account.

Once complete, you'll be directed back to Greenhouse Recruiting where the integration will show that it's connected.

### Use the Checkr integration on Greenhouse Recruiting

Once enabled, you can order and review Checkr background checks directly from within Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### Order background checks

**Note** : Only Site Admin and Job Admin with the permission to view and edit private candidate and application fields can order background checks using the Checkr integration.

To order background checks, navigate to the candidate's profile and open the **Applications** tab on the right side of the page.

Scroll down to the **Background Checks** section to find Checkr. Click the button to start the background check process. 

In the _Checkr_ section, begin typing a work location for the candidate, then select a location from the dropdown results. A valid work location is required to ensure the correct disclosure forms are sent to the candidate based on the compliance laws in different states.

Next, select a package from the **Package** dropdown.

**Note** : All of your available background check packages, nodes, and configurations must be set up in Checkr.

When finished, click **Export** **to** **Checkr** to initiate a background check order for the candidate.

The candidate will receive an email from Checkr directing them to a Checkr-hosted website to provide the information Checkr needs to run their background check.

#### View a candidate's background check status

Once completed by the candidate, most background check results will be available within 24 hours, but the time to complete can range from a few minutes to a few weeks depending on the type of check ordered, the geographic location of the candidate, and local courthouse operations.

The candidate's background check status will be displayed in the _Background Check_ section of the **Application** tab of their profile.

Click **Checkr** **Report** to review the full background check on Checkr.

**Tip** : Check out [How do I interpret a background report?](https://help.checkr.com/hc/en-us/articles/216553188-How-do-I-interpret-a-background-report-) on the Checkr Help Center for information on background check statuses.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, check out the [Checkr Help Center](https://help.checkr.com/).

# Searchlight integration

Searchlight’s automated, gold-standard references and rich data analysis help companies hire top performers. Searchlight reimagines professional references as a better way to increase the predictive validity of your organization's hiring process.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Searchlight allows companies to initiate Searchlight’s automated reference checks from the Greenhouse application and view completed reference reports in a candidate’s Greenhouse profile. In this article, we will cover how to:

#### In this article

  * Enable the Greenhouse/Searchlight integration
  * Create a Harvest API key for the Searchlight integration
    * Credentials
    * Permissions
  * Share User ID with Searchlight
  * Add Searchlight stage to the job’s interview plan
  * Configure the Searchlight stage
  * Send and review the test
  * Additional resources



### Enable the Greenhouse/Searchlight integration

In your Searchlight workspace, navigate to your **Greenhouse Settings**. Click **Show Token** and copy your **Searchlight API Key** to provide to Greenhouse. 

Once you've received your API key, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/requests/new) to open a ticket with the Greenhouse Technical Support team.

**Note:** Do not send the API key in this initial email.

The Greenhouse Technical Support team will respond with a [SendSafely link](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/) for you to enter your API key. A notification will be sent to the Greenhouse Technical Support team after you have entered your API key, and they will email you to confirm that your API key has been set up in your account and your integration is enabled.

**Note:** To verify your identity, the Greenhouse Technical Support team might request you provide a [Support Verification Code](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022771952) before adding the API key to your organization's account.

### Create a Harvest API key for the Searchlight integration

To configure the Greenhouse Recruiting / Searchlight integration, you'll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the credentials and permissions below are selected when configuring the Searchlight integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Searchlight
  * **Description:** Searchlight Harvest API key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Searchlight integration:

**Applications**

  * Get: Retrieve Application
  * Post: Add Attachment to Application



**Candidates**

  * Get: Retrieve Candidate
  * Post: Add Attachment



**Jobs**

  * Get: Retrieve Job
  * Get: Get hiring team



**Offers**

  * Get: List Application's Offers



**Users**

  * Get: Retrieve User



**Close Reasons**

  * Get: Get close reasons



Please provide the new Harvest API to Searchlight in the **Greenhouse Settings** section.

### Share User ID with Searchlight

In order for Searchlight to send completed reference data to Greenhouse Recruiting on your behalf, Searchlight will need the user ID of an existing Greenhouse user in your organization, or the user ID for a Greenhouse Recruiting user account that is created specifically for Searchlight.

**Note** : For more information on how to create a new user, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360027077811-Add-New-User-s-).

To locate the user ID for either an existing user or the new Searchlight-specific user (if applicable), navigate to the Users configure page. (**Configure** icon  **Users**)

From the Users page, click **Export to Excel**.

A spreadsheet downloads to your computer. From the spreadsheet, navigate to the _User ID_ column and copy the **user ID** value in line with your selected user.

Please provide the **User ID** to Searchlight in the **Greenhouse Settings** section.

### Add Searchlight stage to the job’s interview plan

Once the Greenhouse Recruiting / Workvisa.io integration is enabled for your organization, you're able to add Searchlight as an Interview stage.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002194903) to add the **Searchlight** stage to your job's interview plan.

### Configure the Searchlight stage

Once the stage has been added to the job's Interview Plan, click **Edit**.

Use the provided dropdown menu to choose assessments you previously set up in the [Searchlight employer dashboard](https://app.searchlight.ai/hirer).

Select the appropriate assessment and assign at least one Greenhouse user to grade/review submitted assessments. When finished, click **Save**.

**Note** : Keep in mind that all configurations of the assessment and the email template will need to be done on the Searchlight platform.

### Send and review the test

When candidates are moved into the Searchlight interview stage, Greenhouse will display a **Send Test** link.

**Note** : When you send a test from Greenhouse, the interview instructions are actually sent by Searchlight.

The status of the assessment will be viewable in Greenhouse:

Once the candidate has submitted their test, the Interview Kit contains a link to view the submitted test on Searchlight.

After you click **View Report** within the Interview Kit on the candidate’s profile, you're taken to a page where the URL is available to view the test results on Searchlight.

### Additional resources

Searchlight can integrate with the Harvest API to attach completed reference requests directly to the candidate’s Greenhouse profile. Please contact [support@searchlight.ai](mailto:support@searchlight.ai) if you would like this additional integration.

Please contact [support@searchlight.ai](mailto:support@searchlight.ai) for troubleshooting assistance regarding the integration.

Your Harvest API key for the Greenhouse Recruiting / Gem integration is created and configured. Copy the Harvest API key to provide to Gem in the next step. 

### Enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Gem integrations

#### Enable sourcing integrations

With your newly created Harvest API key copied, head over to the [Team admin page](https://www.gem.com/admin) in Gem and paste the key in the supplied field under _Greenhouse Harvest API Key_.

**Note:** Do not send your Harvest API key to anyone. The Harvest API key should be entered only on the [Team admin page](https://www.gem.com/admin) and never sent to anyone (even the Gem team!) over email or chat.

#### Enable CRM integrations

Gem CRM uses webhooks to pull in your Greenhouse Recruiting data and monitor any changes in that data.

To set up the webhooks in Greenhouse Recruiting, click the **Configure** icon  in the upper right-hand corner and navigate to **Dev Center** on the left-hand panel. From the _Dev Center_ page, click **Web Hooks**. 

On the  _Create A New Web Hook_ page, you should see a blue button for **Automatically set up 29 Gem webhooks**. If you are comfortable going through Gem's automated setup process, simply click the button and follow the instructions.

**Note:** If you do not see the **Automatically set up 29 Gem webhooks** button, make sure you have the [Gem extension](https://help.gem.com/en/articles/2668249-installing-the-chrome-extension) installed.

Visit the [Team Admin section](https://www.gem.com/admin) in Gem and click **See setup instructions** to get detailed steps on how to configure Webhooks for Greenhouse Recruiting.

### Use the Greenhouse Recruiting / Gem integrations

#### Use sourcing integrations

**Duplicate check against candidates in Greenhouse Recruiting**

Gem makes it easy to see whether someone is in Greenhouse before sending a Sequence by showing you candidates that have the same name or email.

If Gem finds an email match, it will automatically link to the Greenhouse candidate profile.

If Gem finds a name match, it will surface a list of potential Greenhouse candidates that may be associated with the candidate you are sourcing.

**1-Click upload a candidate to Greenhouse Recruiting from Gem**

You can use Gem to 1-Click add candidates to Greenhouse right from the Gem Chrome Extension. Once you click the **Upload to Greenhouse** button, Gem creates a new candidate record in Greenhouse and auto-populates the candidate's profile information:

  * First Name
  * Last Name
  * Nickname
  * Company
  * Title
  * School



**Automate email sync**

Gem has built an integration with Greenhouse Recruiting that allows Gem to sync emails to prospects and candidates to the candidate's Activity Feed in Greenhouse Recruiting. By default, this email sync is turned off, but if you would like to enable it, reach out to your Customer Success Manager or the Gem Support team ([support@gem.com](mailto:support@gem.com)). For more details on how the email sync works, visit [this help article](https://support.gem.com/hc/en-us/articles/5352597552663-Gem-to-Greenhouse-Email-SMS-Activity-Sync).

**Optional sourcing integrations**

Gem can enable a number of optional Greenhouse integrations:

  * **[Default candidate tags](https://help.gem.com/integrations/greenhouse/adding-default-greenhouse-tags-in-gem)** : If set, a default tag will be applied to every candidate upon upload.



  * **Auto-follow prospects** : If enabled, the recruiter that uploads the prospect will be automatically added as a follower.
  * **Custom import source** : By default, Gem imports candidates to Greenhouse with the Source set to Gem, but you can change that to whatever you like in the [Team Admin section](http://www.gem.com/admin).



**Taking common Greenhouse Recruiting actions right from Gem**

You can take common Greenhouse actions directly from Gem both in [Projects](http://www.gem.com/projects) or in the Gem Chrome extension alongside LinkedIn or Gmail.

  * Converting a prospect to a candidate
  * Setting a stage
  * Merging candidate records
  * Rejecting a prospect or candidate application
  * Logging a note | call | text | InMail directly to the Greenhouse Activity Feed



#### Use CRM integrations

Gem CRM provides an even deeper integration with Greenhouse and allows Gem to pull Greenhouse data into the Gem interface so you can see things like what stage a candidate is at in the process or when their last Greenhouse activity was without having to navigate away from Gem.

**Greenhouse Recruiting data in projects and people**

Gem surfaces a Greenhouse column in Projects and People that shows you what stage a candidate is currently at in the process.

**Candidates in process**

In [ Talent Pipeline ](https://help.gem.com/en/articles/2803596-talent-pipeline-overview) , Gem pulls in all active candidates in Greenhouse for a particular job — including candidates that are not in Gem. Gem also color codes based on the last Greenhouse activity.

**Pipeline Analytics**

With [Pipeline Analytics](https://help.gem.com/crm/pipeline-stats/pipeline-stats-overview), Gem pulls in your Greenhouse Pipeline Stages and bridges them with your Gem outreach stages (Send + Reply).

**Setting prospect pool and stage during upload**

If your team has Greenhouse CRM (separate from Gem CRM), you can set the Greenhouse CRM prospect pool and stage when uploading a candidate from Gem.

Please contact Gem if you would like this feature enabled for your team.

### Additional resources

Feel free to reach out to the Gem team at [support@gem.com](mailto:support@gem.com) or click **Chat with Us** from the [Gem](http://www.gem.com/) home page.

# Sourcing Automation reports

**Permissions:** Job Admin or above with a Sourcing Automation seat

**Product tier:** Available for the Plus and Pro subscription tiers

**Learn more about Sourcing Automation**

[Overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5131929423643)

[Campaign pools](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5045604930843)

[FAQ](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5224485120411)

With [Sourcing Automation](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5131929423643) in Greenhouse Recruiting, you can easily report on key metrics to capture your team's success in reaching prospects via automated messaging.

Use sourcing automation reports to see the number of prospects added, the number of messages sent, how your campaign pool steps are performing, how your recruiting team is performing relative to one another, and more.

#### Learn more

  * [Prospects added report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9036827956635)
  * [Prospects replied report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9037882407579)
  * [Leaderboard report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9041541700251)
  * [Meetings booked report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9040492569243)
  * [Messages sent report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9041159933851)
  * [Tasks completed report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/11077481533595)
  * [Step performance report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/17739385385243)
  * [Prospect activity report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/17848047511195)



### Frequently asked questions

#### Can I build a custom report within Greenhouse Recruiting that combines Sourcing Automation reports with my other hiring reports?

Yes! You can build a custom report in [Report Builder](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000954692) to show who gets credit for adding prospects to your campaign pools. 

Add the **Credited To** column to a custom candidate report to show whether your candidate's source is a user in your organization or an external referrer.

In addition, other hiring reports can complement your sourcing automation reports. For instance, check out the [prospect conversion report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002427623) to understand and demonstrate how many of your prospects became candidates, and how far they made it in the recruiting process.

#### Does Calendly integrate with the meetings booked report?

The meetings booked report captures scheduled events that include both the campaign owner and the prospect's email address. The meetings booked report can capture events scheduled through Calendly as long as the email address associated with Calendly is the same email address associated with sourcing automation.

#### Is the meetings booked report only forward-looking? If someone has been in an interview process in the past, would those meetings count on the report?

The meetings booked report only captures events scheduled after a sourcing automation email has been sent. Historical interviews aren't counted here. 

#### Will the meetings booked report only show meetings booked due to direct activity within a campaign pool?

The meetings booked report will surface any event scheduled on the sender's calendar that includes the prospect on the invite. There isn't a way for the report to distinguish if the event was booked due to the campaign pool or not. This means that it's possible it could count a prospect filling out a Calendly link from a campaign pool email, or an event scheduled manually by the recruiter through a non-automated email.

# Permissions for managing agency recruiters  

We know that you want to have control over who can engage with new agencies, sign contracts, and invite new recruiters to your account. However, you also want flexibility so your team can add trusted agency recruiters to specific jobs.

To empower other users to share the responsibility of managing agencies, Greenhouse Recruiting uses two levels of permissions:

  * A **user-specific permission** that enables Job Admins to invite and deactivate agency recruiters to your account
  * A **job-specific permission** that enables Job Admins to add or remove agency recruiters on specific jobs where they have permission (_Advanced and Expert customers only_)



### User-specific permissions: Invite and deactivate agency recruiters

To enable users to invite and deactivate agency recruiters, click on the **Configure** tab from your Dashboard. From the left-hand panel, click on **Users** and then an individual user from the list.

From the user's list of **Permissions** , click the checkbox next to **Invite and deactivate agency recruiters.** When you have finished, click **Save**.

Note: By default, only super users will inherit this permission.

When users with this permission navigate to the **Agencies** tab from the Configure page, they can now click on the **Add Agency** and **Add Recruiter** buttons. They will also be able to deactivate individual recruiters or deactivate entire agencies.

### Job-specific permissions: Invite and deactivate agency recruiters on specific jobs

**Note:** This feature is only available for Plus and Pro subscription tiers.

To give users permission to assign agencies to specific jobs, create a custom Job Admin level. From your Dashboard, navigate to the **Configure** tab, and from the left-hand panel click **Permission Policies.** Click **Add Job Admin Level** , and under the newly created Job Admin column provide a name for the permission level name.

After creating a name for the custom permission level, click **Create** , navigate down the list to the permission stripe **Can add and remove agencies from jobs** , and check the box for the custom permission level.

Any users with this custom Job Admin level will be able to **Assign Another Agency** to a job.

Additionally, the use can click on a recruiter’s name and can assign or remove jobs assigned to the recruiter. Job Admins will only be able to assign or remove agency recruiters on jobs where they have the job admin level with this agency permission enabled.

**Note:** By default, only super users will inherit this permission.

If you are an Advanced or Expert customer and want to learn more about bulk editing permissions, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115005759286).

# 'Welcome to the team' email

**Permissions:** Owners and Coordinators  
  
**Product tier:** Available for Greenhouse Welcome and Greenhouse Onboarding subscription tiers

The 'Welcome to the team' email is an introductory email sent from Greenhouse Onboarding to a new hire after they've been assigned an [onboarding plan](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000508312). In this email, new hires receive a link to start setting up their onboarding account and a summary of their assigned manager and department.

Greenhouse Onboarding provides a default version of this email, but your organization can also add custom variations of this email to target specific new hires.

**Note:** Learn more about [setting the delivery schedule](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360026375812) for your organization's 'Welcome to the team' email.

#### In this article

  * Default 'Welcome to the team' email sections
  * Edit your default 'Welcome to the team' email
  * Add custom 'Welcome to the team' templates
  * Additional resources



### Default 'Welcome to the team' email sections

When new hires receive the default 'Welcome to the team' email, they'll see the following core sections:

Section title | Section info  
---|---  
'Get started' button | New hires can click this button to navigate to Greenhouse Onboarding  
Your manager | The new hire's assigned manager  
Your department | The new hire's assigned department  
Your location | The new hire's work location  
  
### Edit your default 'Welcome to the team' email

Learn more about editing your default 'Welcome to the team' email or variations of this template with the following resource:

  * [Edit the 'Welcome to the team' email template](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360020389612)



**Note:** The default email can't be turned off or deleted.

### Add custom 'Welcome to the team' templates

Your organization can create custom template variations of the default 'Welcome to the team' email to personalize them for new hires with different locations, departments, employment statuses, or other criteria. New hires will receive a custom 'Welcome to the team' variation instead of the default email if they match the applied filter criteria.

To create a new 'Welcome to the team' email template, navigate to **Settings** > **Onboarding Plan** > **Emails**.

Scroll to  _Welcome to the team_ , then click **Create template**.

Use the email template editor to set up the following:

  * Publish or turn off your new email variation
  * Name your template
  * Add a subject line
  * Build your email message
  * Apply new hire filter criteria



**Note:** Make sure each 'Welcome to the team' email variation has **match criteria** applied to filter for specific new hires. This ensures that the correct email template will reach new hires with matching locations, departments, employment statuses, or other criteria.

When you're done, click **Save and Close**.

Your organization's new 'Welcome to the team' email will be sent to any new hires who fulfill the criteria you've selected.

### Additional resources

  * [Edit 'Welcome to the team' email templates](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360020389612)
  * [Configure 'Welcome to the team' email delivery schedule](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360026375812)

# HRIS Link for UKG Ready integration

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro) with the HRIS Link for UKG Ready add-on

HRIS Link for UKG Ready is available as an add-on for all GHR customers. Contact your Account Manager to learn more.

**Note for accounts with multiple EINs**

Organizations using multiple Employer Identification Numbers (EINs) within UKG Ready must provide both the employee's social security number (SSN) and date of birth when creating a new employee record.

To support this functionality, contact your Greenhouse account team to discuss the required customization. HRIS Link does not natively support multiple "company" records within a single organization.

The HRIS Link for UKG Ready integration gives you the ability to connect your Greenhouse account to UKG Ready.

#### In this article

  * Open the HRIS Link for UKG Ready setup page
  * Create service account in UKG Ready
  * Find UKG Ready details in UKG
  * Select integration user and email in Greenhouse
  * Finish setup
  * Using the integration
    * Candidate export
    * Document export
    * User sync
    * Organizational data sync



**Before you begin**

Greenhouse must enable this feature before the integration can be configured. If this hasn't been done yet, contact your Customer Support Manager or Account Manager.

### Open the HRIS Link for UKG Ready setup page

The setup for this integration can be completed in Greenhouse Recruiting under **Configure** > **Dev Center** > **HRIS Link for UKG Ready**.

Before completing the next sections, open this page in another browser window and keep it open, as you'll need to enter different values during each section.

### Create service account in UKG Ready

Log into UKG Ready as a UKG Ready system administrator.

Click the **hamburger ☰** button on the top left.

Click the **Settings** menu option, then click **Profiles/Policies** to expand the menu.

Click **Security**.

The user-provided credential's security profile should have full access to ensure no integration issues.

### Find UKG Ready details in UKG

To fill out this section in the integration, you'll need to locate your Subdomain, UKG Ready API Key, Employee ID, and Company Short Name.

Log into UKG Ready as a UKG Ready system administrator.

Click the **hamburger ☰** button on the top left.

Click the **Settings** menu option, then click **Global Setup** to expand the menu.

Click **Company Setup**.

This page will have your Subdomain. This value is contained in your domain's URL login. For example, if your login service URL is listed as `https://secure.us.rdy.ukg/ta/company.login`, then your _Subdomain_ is `secure.us.rdy.ukg`.

Your _UKG Ready API Key_ can be found in the **API Keys** menu option.

_Employee ID_ will be defined by you. New employees will begin with this value and increment by 1.

_Company Short Name_ is found in the **Company Info** menu option. Scroll down to **Company Address** to find it.

### Select integration user and email in Greenhouse

For the final step of this integration, select the Greenhouse user who will be attributed to all the API calls for audit purposes.

Then, enter the email address to receive success and error notifications.

### Finish setup

After all of those steps are completed, click **Connect** at the bottom of the "HRIS Link for UKG Ready" page in Greenhouse to finish the setup and finalize the integration.

### Using the integration

#### Candidate export

When you create an offer in Greenhouse Recruiting, you'll have the option to send the new hire's information to UKG Ready. When the candidate is marked as hired, the following information will be sent to UKG:

**Greenhouse field name** | **UKG Ready field name** | **Field type** | **Existing/New Greenhouse field** | **Job field** | **Offer field**  
---|---|---|---|---|---  
First name | First name | Text | Existing |  |   
Last name | Last name | Text | Existing |  |   
Email | Email | Text | Existing |  |   
Phone number | Phone | Text | Existing |  |   
Address | Address | Text | Existing |  |   
UKG Ready Username | Username | Text | New |  | ✓  
UKG Ready Department | Department | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
UKG Ready Division | Division | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
UKG Ready Location | Location | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
UKG Ready Manager | Manager | Dropdown | New |  | ✓  
Hire date | Hire Date | Date | Existing |  | ✓  
Start date | Start Date | Date | Existing |  | ✓  
UKG Ready Employee Type | Employee type | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
Base compensation | Amount $ | Currency | New |  | ✓  
UKG Ready Rate | Rate | Currency | New |  | ✓  
UKG Ready Rate Pay Type | Pay Type | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
UKG Ready Pay Grade | Pay Grade | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
  
#### Document export

  * Offer letter
  * Resume
  * Cover letter



#### User sync

After configuring the integration, you'll receive an email containing a .csv of the user changes that would occur when the user import is enabled. Inspect this file carefully to ensure that no critical data is unintentionally lost as part of the initial sync.

If the values in the update look correct and acceptable for the import, click the link in the email to begin the user import process.

Setting up user sync allows your organization to automatically create a user account in Greenhouse Recruiting when an employee has an account in UKG Ready. All valid UKG Ready users will be included in this sync and will be sent with the following information:

  * First Name
  * Last Name
  * Work Email address
  * Employee ID



#### Organizational data sync

  * **Auto synced:** Manager, Department, Division, Location, Pay Grade, Employee Type, Pay Type
  * **One-time upload:** Hire Type

# Hallo integration

Hallo is an AI-powered language assessment platform that evaluates the proficiency levels of your applicants according to CEFR standards.

With Hallo, you can easily invite candidates to take language assessments where they speak and respond to open-response questions based on real scenarios.

Unlike human-rated proficiency interviews, Hallo's AI-driven assessment process eliminates human error and bias, achieving a remarkable 95% accuracy rate and helping organizations significantly save time and budget.

Hallo integrates seamlessly into your existing Greenhouse workflow without disruption, enabling immediate evaluation of language proficiency.

#### In this article

  * Enable the Hallo integration
  * Use the Hallo integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



### Enable the Hallo integration

**Step 1:** Email [support@hallo.ai](mailto:support@hallo.ai) to get Hallo dashboard credentials.

**Step 2:** Go to the API tab ([dashboard.hallo.ai/development](http://dashboard.hallo.ai/development)) to enable the Hallo API and get your API key.

**Step. 3:** Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923) to work with Greenhouse Support to set up the integration and add the assessment stage to your interview plans.

Once you’ve set up your interview plans and configured your take-home test, you can send the test to candidates.

### Use the Hallo integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

Once the Hallo integration has been enabled for your organization, you can add the Hallo assessment as an interview stage.

You can send an assessment to a candidate by selecting the**Send Test** button next to the interview stage.

After it has been sent, an assessment’s status will be displayed in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Once the candidate has submitted their test, the Interview Kit will contain a link to view the submitted test in the Hallo application.

To see a candidate’s results in Hallo, click **View** **Report**.

On this page, you will be able to view overall language scores for the candidate, as well as subscores, question specifics (including the questions themselves and the candidate’s answers), detailed improvements, and snapshots of the candidate while taking the test (to assist in cheating prevention). These results can also be accessed from the Hallo dashboard at any time.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, go to [hallo.ai/assessment](http://hallo.ai/assessment) or reach out to [support@hallo.ai](mailto:support@hallo.ai) with any questions you may have.

# Hiring experience guide

### Your guide to creating a better hiring experience for everyone

Cultivate a great hiring experience for everyone involved – from candidates and employees to hiring managers and recruiters. Here are some of the most critical ways to achieve this goal. 

**Performance benchmark: Strive for an average response rate of 75% or more on your candidate survey. This benchmark indicates a positive candidate experience with your hiring process. Then use this feedback to enhance your hiring experience even more.**

### Here’s the plan

  * **Set a precedent for ongoing company-wide enablement**

  * **Improve assets with fresh designs and custom branding**

  * **Encourage mobile app usage**
  * **Act on candidate survey results to improve your process**

  * **Set new hires up for success with Greenhouse Onboarding**




# Step 1

### Set a precedent for ongoing company-wide enablement

Now that you've completed the Greenhouse rollout for your organization, it’s time to reinforce your workflows and tools.

Keep communication consistent to ensure everyone stays on track with email templates for:

  * Live role announcements (interviewers and hiring managers)
  * Pipeline updates (hiring managers and stakeholders)
  * Recruiting updates (key stakeholders)
  * Explore email templates in our [Greenhouse rollout toolkit ](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003739232-Greenhouse-rollout-toolkit-Start-here), under the “Prepare for deployment” section.



Train new hires to make structured hiring an ongoing, company-wide priority – check out all these resources:

**User-based training**

  * Download all training templates in our [Greenhouse rollout toolkit](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003739232-Greenhouse-rollout-toolkit-Start-here), under the “Train your teams” section.
  * Basic user training template
  * Interviewer training template
  * Job Admin training template (hiring managers and recruiters)
  * Site Admin training template



**Role-based training**

  * [Recruiter training](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201981530-Greenhouse-training-guide-for-hiring-managers-and-recruiters)
  * [Hiring manager training](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201981530-PRESENTATION-PPT-Greenhouse-101-for-Hiring-Managers)
  * [Interviewer training](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201981520-PRESENTATION-PPT-Greenhouse-101-for-Interviewers)



Visit the [Customer education support page](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/sections/9405519602587-Customer-education-) to find our latest user-based and role-based live training events.

  
[Integrate Slack](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/207344866-Slack) with Greenhouse to increase hiring team involvement and streamline notifications 

**  
**

# Step 2

### Improve assets with fresh designs and custom branding

Greenhouse gives you a variety of tools to customize and brand your communications so you can own your employer brand and provide an engaging candidate experience. 

Upgrade your career page to drive interest and stay competitive with top talent

  * Use[ this guide](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/11941422880283-Careers-page-integration-FAQ) to determine which of our five integration options is best for your organization andlearn how to successfully incorporate your job board into your hiring flow
  * Check out a few of our favorite [career page examples](https://www.greenhouse.io/blog/10-examples-of-awesome-careers-pages) for inspiration 
  * Customize your email templates so they follow your company’s distinct voice and tone
  * Explore and edit our available [email templates](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002573326-Email-template-types) or learn to create your own



# Step 3

### Encourage mobile app usage

The Greenhouse mobile experience provides on-the-go workflow and approval efficiencies for better hiring manager and interviewer experiences. Plus, it creates a faster and smoother process for candidates.

Use [this guide](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000397992-Greenhouse-Mobile-Application) to learn how to download and use the Greenhouse mobile app and encourage your team to do the same

# HRIS Link for Workday®️ and frozen requisitions

HRIS Link can import and update jobs in Greenhouse Recruiting using the most current data from your HRIS. However, HRIS Link will not reopen closed jobs in Greenhouse Recruiting. When your team opts to reopen frozen requisitions in Workday®️, there are some important considerations to keep in mind for the corresponding jobs in Greenhouse Recruiting.  
  
#### In this article

  * Reopening frozen requisitions in Workday®️



### Reopening frozen requisitions in Workday®️

When using [requisitions on Workday®️](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4403889907355) with HRIS Link, reopening frozen requisitions has an impact on the corresponding jobs in Greenhouse Recruiting.

A job in Greenhouse Recruiting can have an _open_ , _closed_ , or _draft_ status, with [openings](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4402057774747) on each job having an _open_ , _closed_ , or _hired_ status.

**Example** : You may have one Customer Success Manager job in Greenhouse Recruiting, under which are multiple openings (or headcounts) on the job.

Ideally, your job / opening status in Greenhouse Recruiting should match the requisition / position status in Workday®️, where a frozen requisition's job is manually closed in Greenhouse Recruiting. This is because if you reopen a frozen requisition in Workday®️, HRIS Link will automatically add an opening to the job in Greenhouse Recruiting, if the job is already open.

However, HRIS Link will not reopen closed jobs in Greenhouse Recruiting, meaning if the job is closed, you'll need manually reopen it in Greenhouse Recruiting when you unfreeze or reopen a requisition in Workday®️.

If the job is closed in Greenhouse Recruiting, navigate to the job (**Jobs** > **Job** **name**), and click **Re-open this Job**.

**Note** : If your job is using [job approvals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360062257351), the job will need to be placed in _draft_ status in order to request approval for reopening. Click **Open as Draft** , then click **Request** **Approval**.

Next, you should manually match the opening ID for your new opening to the requisition's position ID in Workday®️.

Click **Job** **Setup** > **Approvals** , and then click **Edit Job & Openings**.

Find the newly created opening, and edit the opening ID to match your position ID in Workday®️. You should also ensure the opening's open date matches the position's open date in Workday®️.

When finished, click **Save**.

**Note** : Since openings [can be required to have opening IDs](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360039739391), an opening ID may be generated automatically by HRIS Link if your job was already open when you unfroze it in Workday®️. If opening IDs aren't required for your organization, the opening ID will be left blank by HRIS Link. In either case, you should manually edit the opening ID to ensure it matches the position ID set in Workday®️.

**Note:** Greenhouse Recruiting is not sponsored by, affiliated with, or endorsed by Workday®️.

# AB Global integration

AB Global provides fully customizable screening solutions including criminal background checks, education, employment and licensure verifications, reference checks, drug screening and occupational health screening, for domestic and international subjects.

AB Global’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows employers to launch a background check portal to be sent to candidates once they have accepted the job offer and marked as hired.

#### In this article

  * Set up the AB Global integration
    * Create a webhook
  * Use the AB Global integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
    * Submit candidates for a background check
    * Additional configuration
  * Additional resources



### Set up the AB Global integration

#### Create a webhook

To integrate AB Global with Greenhouse Recruiting, you’ll need to create a webhook. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/58881637273) to create your webhook. Use the values listed below to configure the webhook:

  * **Name** : A descriptive name for your integration. Most customers choose ‘AB Global integration'
  * **When** : Candidate has been hired
  * **Endpoint URL** : The Endpoint URL provided by AB Global
  * **Secret Key** : The Secret Key provided by AB Global



When finished, click **Save**.

Your webhook for the Greenhouse Recruiting / AB Global is created and configured.

### Use the AB Global integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Submit candidates for a background check

After setting up the AB Global webhook, the integration will be ready for use.

Orders will be launched into Alliance whenever a candidate is moved to the Hired Stage. The system will flag duplicate orders and submit in draft mode if ordered within a specified time frame (9 days default) This time frame may be customized.

To submit a candidate to AB Global to launch the Candidate portal process, you'll need to first [mark the candidate as hired](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200242039).

When candidates are marked as _Hired_ in Greenhouse Recruiting, the following data points will be sent to AB Global:

  * First Name
  * Last Name
  * Middle Name
  * Email Address
  * Phone Number
  * Home Address



[Additional fields](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360024551831) may be mapped to Billing ID fields in AB Global to help with organizing invoices.

Your AB Global Account manager will work with you during implementation to review your notification preferences, portal expiration times and how to review candidate supplied information prior to running the background check.

#### Additional configuration

Enabling access to your organization's account using Greenhouse Recruiting's [Harvest API](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029266032) will allow AB Global to post back status updates into Greenhouse.

This optional setup will send the following status updates on the process of the background check:

  * **Pending Candidate** \- Candidate has received the link to the applicant portal and we are awaiting their completion.
  * **Pending Recruiter** \- Orders submitted in draft mode that require the recruiter to activate the order in AB Global
  * **Pending Alliance** \- Orders in process
  * **Complete**



Alternatively, Alliance will send status updates via email to the ordering user.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [info@abglobalscreening.com](mailto:info@abglobalscreening.com) or contact your AB Global account manager directly.

# Zenefits integration

Zenefits provides purposeful HR and payroll software services for small and mid-size companies. Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Zenefits allows your organization to import candidates from Greenhouse Recruiting into Zenefits.

#### In this article

  * Enable the integration
  * Use the integration



**Note** : This integration only needs to be enabled by one member of your team. Once the integration is enabled by a single user, it's available for all Greenhouse Recruiting users in your organization.

### Enable the integration

Your organization must retrieve the following credentials from Zenefits before the integration can be enabled:

  * Company ID
  * Secret key



To find these details, first log in to your Zenefits account and click **Add an App**.

Find the _Greenhouse_ tile and click **Learn More**.

Click **Connect Existing**.

A new tile will populate the company ID and secret key for your organization. Copy these credentials to add to Greenhouse Recruiting in the next step.

Next, log in to Greenhouse Recruiting, and click **Integrations** on your navigation bar.

Search for Zenefits, and click **Zenefits** from the results list.

Click **Connect**.

Paste the company ID and secret key obtained from Zenefits.

When finished, click **Save**. Once complete, integration will be enabled for your organization.

### Use the integration

Once the integration is enabled, people with the following permissions can export a candidate to Zenefits:

  * Job Admin who Can view and edit private candidate and application fields
  * Site Admin who can see private notes, salary info, manage offers, request approval, and approve jobs / offers



To export a candidate to Zenefits, navigate to a candidate's profile and click **Export to Zenefits**.

The following details will be sent to Zenefits:

  * Name
  * Resume
  * Job title
  * Job start date
  * Email address



**Note** : A candidate must have a current offer in Greenhouse Recruiting to be exported to Zenefits. However, offer details do not sync to Zenefits.

To view the imported candidate in Zenefits, click **Workers** > **Add** on your Zenefits dashboard.

In the **Import the new hire from ATS** dropdown, select the candidate you exported from Greenhouse Recruiting.

Follow the _Add Worker_ workflow in Zenefits to finish adding the candidate. You'll see the fields that were synced from Greenhouse Recruiting are automatically populated!

# Feature an internal job post

**Permissions:** Site Admin

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Give special attention to specific job posts by marking them as featured.

Featured posts are included in a weekly email notification sent to all employees. On the [internal job boards](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/15366024150555), featured job posts will be tagged with a green icon.. By featuring a job post, you can help all employees see the job, even if they don’t regularly log in to Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### In this article

  * Feature a job post
  * Unfeature a job post
  * Featured jobs email notification
  * Frequently asked questions (FAQs)
  * Additional resources



### Feature a job post

You can feature a maximum of three job posts at a time. Featured job posts stay featured until you unfeature them or the job is closed.

To choose a job post to feature, navigate to **Configure > Job Boards & Posts** and open your internal job board.

In the _Job Posts_ section, find the job post you want to feature. Click the **three dots** to the right of the post, then click **Feature post.**

****

In the pop-up window, click**Feature post.**

The job post is now marked with a green chip on the [internal job board tile](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/15366024150555) and will be included in the email notification sent Mondays at 12 pm EST.

### Unfeature a job post

To remove a job post from being featured, navigate to **Configure > Job Boards & Posts** and click the name of your **internal job board.**

Click the three dots to the right of the post you want to unfeature, then click **Unfeature post**.

### Featured jobs email notification

Featured job posts are included in a weekly email notification sent every Monday at 12 pm EST.

By default, all employees with Greenhouse Recruiting accounts receive the featured jobs email notification. Employees can't opt out or unsubscribe from the weekly email notification.

If an employee has turned on [notifications for new jobs](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/15366024150555), those are also included in the email.

**Note** : The featured jobs email notification cannot be edited. The opening sentence changes based on whether the email contains featured jobs, new jobs, or both.

  * **Featured jobs only** : _Below are the internal roles that are featured for this week_
  * **New jobs only** : _Below are the internal roles that have opened in the last week_
  * **Both featured jobs and new jobs** : _Below are the internal roles that have been featured or opened in the last week_



### Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

#### An employee doesn't want to receive the featured jobs email. Can they unsubscribe?

Employees cannot unsubscribe from the featured jobs email.

#### Some of my employees aren't receiving the featured jobs email.

Employees will only receive the featured jobs email if they meet the following requirements:

  * They have a Greenhouse Recruiting account
  * Their account is associated with a valid email address
  * They have logged into Greenhouse Recruiting before



#### Why does my weekly email notification include other job posts that aren’t featured?

Employees can [turn on notifications](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/15366024150555) to receive updates about new jobs posted to the internal job board. Featured jobs and new job notifications are sent in the same email. 

  * If an employee has turned **on** notifications, the email includes featured jobs _and_ new jobs.
  * If an employee has **not** turned on notifications, the email includes only featured jobs.



#### How long will my job post be featured?

Once you feature a job post, it's featured until you unfeature it or [close](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025499691) the job.

### Additional resources

  * [Access your internal job board](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200913945)
  * [Internal job board tile](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/15366024150555)
  * [Internal candidates](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/17286092068763)

# Best practices for customizing the candidate survey email

**Permissions:** Site Admin

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

You can customize your [candidate survey](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029861512) email to engage with candidates in a way that reflects your organization’s brand.

We've collected some best practices to help you collect meaningful data.

#### In this article

  * [Tell candidates how their responses will be used](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/undefined#h_01HEQV2SKM49X09DV23202F95E)
  * [Confirm responses are confidential](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/undefined#h_01HEQV3EHCXGJYGZQ5NETMWM9W)
  * [Build trust by mentioning the survey during the hiring process](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/undefined#h_01HEQV424TW3GHJXX8TPW442VJ)
  * [Additional resources](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/undefined#h_01HEQV52E6M7R67QGM0114BVH3)



### Tell candidates how their responses will be used

Candidates may be more likely to participate in a survey if they know how their responses will be used.

Be specific as possible about how you’ll use the survey data, and consider communicating how much you value the candidates’ opinion.

**Example** : “We want to know what you think! [Organization name] wants to ensure a positive experience for all candidates, and your survey responses could directly inform our hiring process.”

### Confirm responses are confidential

Candidates are more likely to share honest feedback when they know their responses are confidential. Clearly state that their feedback will be kept anonymous and used exclusively for the purpose of improving the hiring process.

**Example** : “No personal information about you will be seen by [organization name] - all survey results are anonymized.”

### Build trust by mentioning the survey during the hiring process

The more candidates trust your organization, the more candid and valuable their feedback is likely to be. By mentioning the survey during the hiring process, your organization can prepare candidates for the request, establish transparency, and set expectations.

**Example:**

During later stages of the hiring process, such as when scheduling final round interviews, consider adding a brief mention of the upcoming survey:

  * “We'll send you a candidate experience survey in the next week or so, so keep an eye out for that!”
  * “[Organization name] is interested in your experience - we’ll be sending a survey in the next few weeks. Please share your feedback, we want to hear from you!”



### Additional resources

  * [Customize the candidate survey email](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201580199)

# Create a shared calendar with Google Calendar

**Permissions:** —

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Shared calendars enable your team to maintain a centralized scheduling system so that authorized members of your team can schedule, reschedule, and delete to a single calendar.

**Note** : The steps for shared calendar setup may vary depending on how your organization has configured its Google settings. Check with your organization's Google account admin or [learn more on Google](https://support.google.com/calendar/answer/37082?hl=en).

### Create a shared calendar

To create a shared calendar, determine who should own the calendar, then have the owner login to Google Calendar.

Click**+** beside _Other calendars_.

Click **Create new** **calendar**.

Next, use the provided fields to give the calendar a name, description, and time zone.

When finished, click**Create calendar**.

Once the calendar is created, click the name of your new calendar on the left.

Scroll to the _Share with specific people or groups_ section, and click **Add people and groups**.
