# ClearStar integration

ClearStar provides employers and companies across the globe with pre-employment background check software, screening services, and tools they need to quickly, easily, and confidently welcome new individuals to their team.

Greenhouse Recruiting’s integration with ClearStar streamlines the background screening process for recruiters and candidates, allowing users to source, access, engage, and track candidates from ClearStar.

#### In this article

  * Set up the ClearStar integration
    * Create a Harvest API key
    * Configure a webhook
    * Create a background check package and complete setup
  * Use the ClearStar integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
    * Configure candidate education and employment fields
    * Submit a background check order
    * Review the status of a background check
  * Additional resources



### Set up the ClearStar integration

#### Create a Harvest API key

To configure the ClearStar integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key. 

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the Clearstar integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Clearstar (optional)
  * **Description:** ClearStar Harvest API Key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the ClearStar integration: 

**Candidates:**

  * DELETE: Delete Candidate
  * GET: Retrieve Candidate
  * GET: List Candidates
  * PATCH: Edit Candidate
  * POST: Add Candidate
  * POST: Add Note
  * POST: Add E-mail
  * POST: Add Attachment
  * POST: Add Application
  * POST: Add Education
  * DELETE: Delete Education
  * POST: Add Employment
  * DELETE: Delete Employment
  * PUT: Anonymize Candidate
  * PUT: Merge Two Candidates



**Offers:**

  * GET: List Application’s Offers
  * GET: Retrieve Application’s Current Offer
  * GET: Retrieve Offer
  * GET: List Offers
  * PATCH: Update Application’s Current Offer



**Activity Feed:**

  * GET: Retrieve Activity Feed



**Jobs:**

  * GET: Retrieve Job
  * GET: List Jobs
  * PATCH: Update Job
  * POST: Create a New Job
  * GET: Get Hiring Team
  * POST: Add Hiring Team Member
  * DELETE: Remove Hiring Team Member
  * PUT: Replace Hiring Team Member



When finished, click **Save**.

Your Harvest API key for the ClearStar integration is created and configured. Copy the API key to provide to ClearStar in the next step.

#### Configure a webhook

To integrate ClearStar with Greenhouse Recruiting, you’ll need to create a webhook. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163727003) to create your webhook.

Use the values listed below to configure the webhook:

  * **Name:** ClearStar Web Hook API
  * **When** : Candidate has been hired 
  * **Endpoint URL** : The Endpoint URL provided by ClearStar
  * **Secret Key** : The Secret Key provided by ClearStar
  * **Basic Authorization Credentials (in Advanced Settings):** Username & Password for the integration. ClearStar will provide these credentials; note the password will always be hidden.



#### Create a background check package and complete setup

You'll also need to create a background check package in Greenhouse Recruiting to use the integration. The background check package will need to be created as a [custom field](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360024551831). 

To create a background check package, navigate to **Configure** > **Custom Options** and then, click **Offers**.

On _Manage Offer Fields_ , click **Add Field** and enter the following information: 

  * **Field Name** : ClearStar_BGC_Package
  * **Description** **(optional)** : ClearStar Package
  * **Field Type** : Single Select
  * **Options** : Enter the package values supplied by ClearStar 



Click the box next to _Required,_ then click **Save**.

### Use the ClearStar integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Configure candidate education and employment fields

ClearStar retrieves the candidate’s data and populates it into the ScreenMeNow application, giving the candidate a seamless and efficient process. Education and employment history are retrieved from the candidate’s Greenhouse Recruiting candidate details.

**Note** : _Employment fields_ must be turned on for your Greenhouse Recruiting instance by a Greenhouse CSM. This is not a default feature in Greenhouse Recruiting and must be requested.

If this setting is not turned on in your Greenhouse Recruiting instance, the candidate will need to enter their past employment details during their application process.

#### Submit a background check order 

**Note** : All users who plan on utilizing the ClearStar integration [must have permissions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360020855632) configured to**:**

  * **View and edit offers, approve/request approval on offers, and advance candidates/prospects** (Job Admins) 
  * **See private notes and salary info, manage offers, request approval, and approve jobs/offers** (Site Admin)



To submit a candidate for a ClearStar background check, you'll need to first [mark the candidate as hired](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200242039).

To begin, navigate to the _Candidates_ tab and search for the candidate. On the candidate's profile, click **Move Stage** to advance the candidate to the _Offer_ stage**.**

Next, click **Manage Offer** and then**,** click **Mark Candidate as Hired.**

In the _Accept Offer_ window, select your ClearStar customer account and the background screening package from the dropdown menu options.

When finished, click **Save** and mark the candidate as hired. This initiates the invite to the candidate, which is sent from ClearStar.

Below is a sample email:

**Note** : If the candidate has provided a mobile number and your ClearStar integration settings are enabled for text invitations, the candidate will also receive a text message invite to begin the screening application.

#### Review the status of a background check

All background screening information is housed in the candidate’s _Activity Feed_**.**

  * Once the candidate has completed their portion of the background screening application, the ClearStar Report Status updates to _In Progress-Vendor._
  * Once the screening is completed, the Report Status updates to _Complete_ or _Complete – Review_ (if the profile is flagged).
  * If your organization is using the ClearStar scoring matrix, the statuses could be _Complete – Eligible_ , _Decisional_ , or _Not Eligible_.



The completed report is available in the report link. Clicking on the report link takes you to ClearStar’s secure portal so you can sign in and access the completed report.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to the ClearStar Implementation team: [implementations@clearstar.net](mailto:implementations@clearstar.net).

# Release Notes: January 2026

Greenhouse Software regularly releases new product features, updates, and improvements. You can stay up-to-date by following our [release notes](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200929955) or checking out the [latest feature releases](https://www.greenhouse.com/greenhouse-latest-features) page.

### Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Grayscale AI Assistant integration 

Greenhouse now offers a new integration with Grayscale, allowing organizations to embed Grayscale’s AI Assistant (Gracie) directly on their external job boards. 

Customers can enable the assistant from Job Board settings, securely connect it with a token, and automatically track applicants who apply through Grayscale with a default source—keeping candidate data and workflows connected in Greenhouse. This integration helps teams scale timely candidate engagement, answer questions in real time, and improve the application experience without adding manual work or disrupting existing hiring processes.

Greenhouse now includes a {{CANDIDATE_LAST_NAME}} token for email and offer document templates. This gives organizations more flexibility in how they address candidates, especially in industries where last-name–only communication is preferred.

Site Admins can update any existing Harvest API credentials (v1/v2 or v3) to allow requests only from specific IP addresses or ranges. This adds an extra layer of security to API-based integrations.

# Requisition ID overview

**Permissions:** Site Admin, and Job Admin who can create new jobs and request job approvals

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

A job's requisition ID (req ID) allows your organization to identify and track a job based on alphanumeric naming conventions unique to your company's internal processes. Req IDs can be assigned manually on new and existing jobs, or can be auto-generated by Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### In this article

  * Generate a requisition ID for a new job
  * Update requisition ID counter
  * Additional resources



### Generate a requisition ID for a new job

To generate a requisition ID for a new job, go to the _Create a Job_ page. _(**Add** > **Create a job**)_

Choose a starting point to create a new job.

On the next page, fill in any necessary details in the _Job Info_ section. When you get to the _Requisition ID_ field, add a value manually or click **Generate Requisition ID**.

If you click **Generate Requisition ID** , the ID generated is based on the next sequential number as determined by the requisition ID counter.

**Note:** Requisition IDs can also be added to existing jobs. To learn more about adding requisition IDs to existing jobs see the Additional resources section of this article.

### Update the requisition ID counter

**Note:** Only Site Admins can update the organization-level requisition ID counter.

To edit or reset the next sequential number generated for requisition IDs, go to the _Organization_ page. _(**Configure** icon > **Organization**)_

Find the _Next Requisition ID_ field, then click the **Edit** icon  to update the counter.

When you finish, click **Save**.

**Note:** Any numerical value can be used when manually resetting or updating the requisition ID counter, even if it is already in use on an existing job. If a future requisition ID is generated that matches an existing job, a warning is surfaced to the user creating or editing the job.

### Additional resources

# RefNow integration

RefNow allows your organization to request detailed reference check reports for your candidates. Using RefNow's online platform allows you to collect more data and spend less time chasing up references compared with traditional referencing.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with RefNow allows you to seamlessly add a RefNow Reference Request Check to a job's interview plan.

#### In this article

  * Enable the RefNow integration
  * Use the RefNow integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
    * Add RefNow to your job's interview plan
    * Send and review the test
  * Additional resources



### Enable the RefNow integration

To start, contact the RefNow Support Team ([support@refnow.co.uk](mailto:support@refnow.co.uk)) to receive your API key.

Once you've received your API key, fill out the form at [www.greenhouse.io/asksupport](http://support.greenhouse.io/direct) or _[click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/requests/new)_ to open a ticket with Greenhouse Technical Support.

**Note** : Don't send the API key in this initial email. Greenhouse Technical Support will respond with a [SendSafely link](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/) for you to securely share your API key.

Once Greenhouse Technical Support receives your API key via SendSafely, we'll email you to confirm that your API key has been set up in your account and that your integration is enabled.

**Note:** To verify your identity, Greenhouse Technical Support might request you provide a [support verification code](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022771952) before adding the API key to your organization's account.

### Use the RefNow integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Add RefNow to your job's interview plan

Once the integration is enabled for your organization, you'll be able to add RefNow Reference Request as an interview stage.

To do this for an existing job, navigate to your job (**Jobs** >**Job Name**) and click **Job Setup** > **Interview** **Plan**.

Click **\+ Add a Stage**. Select the **RefNow Reference Request** stage.

When finished, click **Add**.

Hover over the stage to select **Edit** , and then select the assessment and assign graders for the test. 

#### Send and review the test

When candidates are moved into the RefNow Reference Request interview stage, Greenhouse Recruiting will display a **Send Test** link on their candidate profile.

**Note** : When you send a test from Greenhouse Recruiting, the interview instructions are actually sent by RefNow.

When sending the test, provide the candidate's email and select which question profile applies to the job the candidate is applying for.

Click **Send Test** , and the candidate will receive an email to initiate the RefNow Reference Request process.

Once the candidate and references have responded to the reference request, the report will be available for viewing within Greenhouse Recruiting on the candidate profile.

On the candidate scorecard / interview kit, click **View** **Report** to be taken to RefNow for full results.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [support@refnow.co.uk](mailto:support@refnow.co.uk).

# Enigma integration

Enigma helps customers discover higher quality candidates specialized in cybersecurity. Enigma’s bit-sized puzzles are based on real-world scenarios evaluating the way candidates think and overall, problem-solve.

Through Enigma's assessment process, costly technical interview needs are eliminated and hidden talent within hiring pipelines is uncovered to better help diversify cybersecurity teams throughout. 

Enigma’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows you to seamlessly add Enigma’s assessments to a job's interview plan.

#### In this article

  * Set up the Enigma integration
    * Retrieve your Enigma API key
    * Add the Enigma stage to your job's interview plan
  * Use the Enigma integration
    * Send and review a test
    * Review assessment results
  * Additional resources



### Set up the Enigma integration

#### Retrieve your Enigma API key 

To begin integration setup, you'll need to retrieve your API key from Enigma. 

Navigate to Enigma and access the dropdown in the top-right corner of your main dashboard. From the listed options, select **Manage API Keys**.

On the following _Manage API Keys_ table, click **Create API Key** and use the _Create Token_ form to name the key. When finished, click **Generate Key**.

You will be able to view your API Key once generated. Copy the key and securely store it for later use [with integration setup in Greenhouse Recruiting](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923).

#### Add the Enigma stage to your job's interview plan

Once the Enigma integration is enabled for your organization, you'll be able to add Enigma as an interview stage.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923) to set up the assessment stage in your interview plans.

### Use the Enigma integration

#### Send and review a test

After enabling the Enigma integration for your organization, you will be able to [add the Enigma assessment as an interview stage to send the test to candidates](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/21338859258267).

When adding Enigma as an interview stage, you can select any of your Enigma assessments from the drop down.

You can send an assessment to a candidate by selecting the **Send Test** button next to the interview stage.

When sending the test, you can confirm which assessment you want to include along with the email of the candidate.

After it has been sent, an assessment’s status will display in Greenhouse Recruiting. When an assessment is sent but not completed or graded, it will appear as **Sent.**

#### Review assessment results

Once the candidate has submitted their test, the Interview Kit will contain a link to view the submitted test in the Enigma application.

To see a candidate’s results in Enigma, click **View** **Report**.

You'll be routed to the candidate’s assessment page in Enigma’s platform. The **Assessment Results** page will show each puzzle in the assessment.

When an assessment is ungraded by Enigma, you will see a graying **Pending** notice on the left hand side of the table under **Score**. Ungraded assessments can also be accessed to view the candidate’s response to each puzzle by clicking **View Response.**

When viewing the puzzle response, you will see a summary of the question and the same detailed instructions received by the candidate. The expected answer along with the candidate’s response and explanation will be enclosed within the results, as well. 

When the assessment has been graded by Enigma, the percentage score will display on the far left of the Assessment Results table.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [info@askenigma.com](mailto:info@askenigma.com).

# Screenify integration

Screenify is an AI interviewing platform that helps hiring teams screen candidates by conducting human-like AI interviews.

Screenify’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows teams to automatically send Screenify interview invites to candidates depending on the stage in the pipeline, as well as allows you to post the interview feedback from Screenify into the Greenhouse Recruiting activity feed so that everything stays in one place. 

#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API key for the integration
  * Add the Harvest API key to Screenify
  * Create a webhook
  * Add custom fields (optional)
  * Add stages for the integration
  * Configure a role in Screenify to initiate integration usage. 
  * Use Screenify integration with Greenhouse Recruiting 
  * Additional resources



### Create a Harvest API key for the integration

To configure the Screenify integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key. 

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the Screenify integration. Copy the API key as you’ll need to paste it on the next step.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Screenify or Unlisted Vendor
  * **Description:** Screenify Harvest API Key



#### Permissions

Verify that ALL the permissions are selected for the Screenify integration by selecting **Select All.**

### Add the Harvest API key to Screenify

To add the API key in Screenify, navigate to the **Integrations** tab in your Screenify account, locate the Greenhouse option, and select it.

Paste the Harvest API key you generated into the **API Key** field

### Create a webhook

Next, you’ll need to create a webhook. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163727003) to create your webhook. Use the values listed below to configure the webhook:

  * **Name** : A descriptive name for your integration. Most customers choose ‘Screenify integration’
  * **When** : Candidate has changed stage
  * **Endpoint URL** : The Endpoint URL you copied from Screenify
  * **Secret Key** : The Secret Key you copied from Screenify



You'll add these webhooks to Screenify to complete the setup.

Once webhooks are created and the API key has been added, click "Install Integration" to confirm setup completion.

### Add custom fields (optional)

To store feedback, you’ll need to create custom fields in Greenhouse. Under Configure, select Custom Options. Depending on your Greenhouse tier, you may have access to Application fields. If you don’t, you may use Candidate fields.

To create custom fields, click Candidates or Applications. Then click "Add Field" and create five fields:

  * Screenify Score (number)

  * Screenify Scorecard Link (URL)

  * Screenify Summary (Long textbox)

  * Screenify Ratings (Long textbox)

  * Screenify Questions & Responses (Long textbox)




### Add stages for the integration

Next, you'll configure stages in your interview pipeline by navigating to the job you wish to integrate.

Select "Job Setup," then "Interview Plan." Add two stages: **Screenify Interview** and **Screenify Completed** , and rearrange them within your pipeline as necessary.

### Configure a role in Screenify to initiate integration usage. 

During role creation or editing in Screenify, go to Automation, enable "Fetch candidate profiles automatically via integration," and select Greenhouse. Specify the job and trigger stage as **Screenify Interview** to invite candidates at the appropriate stage automatically. Set the completion status to **Screenify Completed.**

To publish feedback to Greenhouse, enable the option and map the fields you created. Under Select Fields, it will automatically display all your custom fields. Click **Update Interview** to save your integration with the role.

### Use Screenify integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

Once the setup is complete, simply go to your Greenhouse job’s pipeline and move the candidates to **‘Screenify Interview’** stage, and they will automatically get the invite to take Screenify Interview.

If you would like to automatically send Screenify Invites to all candidates applying to the job, select ‘**Application Review** ’ or whatever the first stage in your pipeline is as the Trigger Status while setting up the role in Screenify.

If you enable Publish Feedback on Screenify, after the candidate interview is complete, you can see the Screenify feedback automatically posted on Greenhouse by visiting the candidate page.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [support@screenify.ai](mailto:support@screenify.ai)

# Release Notes: 2020 - June 26

In an effort to improve our suite of products, Greenhouse Software regularly releases new product features, updates, and improvements. Stay up-to-date with what's new at Greenhouse by **Following** our [Release Notes](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/sections/360000710732-Release-Notes).

Find our releases for this week below:

  * Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Greenhouse Onboarding
  * Integrations
  * Bug Fixes



### **Greenhouse Recruiting**

  * We are excited to share pages related to the Interviewer user experience are now available in French, German, Italian, and Spanish! To learn more about using Greenhouse Recruiting in non-English languages, please [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360030667232). 



  * Grouped Focus Attributes and rich-text editing on scorecards are here! Interviewers will see the most relevant attributes gathered at the top of their scorecards, and also will have the ability to format feedback using rich-text editing. 



### **Greenhouse Onboarding**

  * Additional fields are available to map from Greenhouse Recruiting to Greenhouse Onboarding! The following non-custom fields can now be mapped: 
    * Hire Date
    * Candidate ID
    * Req ID
    * Application ID
    * Recruiter 
    * Referral Source 



### **Integrations**

  * Candidate Testing: [The Chemistry Group](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360044835431)



### **Bug Fixes**

  * In Greenhouse Recruiting, we resolved a bug in which updating the Candidate Survey rules caused the Candidate Survey to be sent retroactively to candidates who met the new criteria, but were rejected or hired prior to the update. Moving forward, a new Candidate Survey rule will not be applied to candidates who were rejected or hired prior to adding the rule. We apologize for any trouble this caused your team. 
  * We fixed a bug that prevented users from deleting jobs with job post rules configured. 
  * We also resolved an issue in which the  _Suggest Interview Times_ modal sometimes displayed inconsistent offsets from GMT for the same time zone. 



  * Users with a Pro Zoom account reported seeing the 40-minute warning when scheduling interviews with the Zoom integration. We confirmed this was a UI error only, and meetings scheduled with Pro Zoom accounts were not capped at 40 minutes. We released a fix to ensure only users with a Basic Zoom account see this warning moving forward. 



  * With our new rich-text editing for scorecards feature, free-text fields on scorecards now support using the characters `<` and `>`. Scorecards created prior to the rich-text editing release might still experience display errors with the noted characters; to resolve this, view the scorecard in edit mode and re-save. 
  * In Greenhouse Onboarding, we fixed a bug that prevented some new hires from accessing their Welcome Experience and outstanding documents through emailed links.

# Report Builder overview

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

#### Tailored reports to help you refine every step of the hiring process

Report Builder gives your organization the flexibility to customize reports so you can easily find data relevant to your goal. Building a report is intuitive – add and organize your data with a few simple clicks! You can live-preview the report as you're building it to see if you get the results and data you really need. Report Builder's customizable pipeline reports help you track the health of your recruiting activity from start to finish.

#### In this article

  * Use Report Builder
  * Additional resources



### Use Report Builder

To use Report Builder, click **Reports** on your navigation bar.

Click **Create** , then choose **Build a report**.  


Next, choose a report starting point.

You can click through the categories on the left to review the available template options, or you can use the search bar at the top to search by keyword.

Report Builder includes many reports to select as your starting point, with each of them falling into one of two categories:

#### Build report from template

 _Build report from template_ allows you to select one of Greenhouse Recruiting's essential reports as a starting point. You can then edit the report's metrics and apply filters to generate the data you need. Building a report from a template is a good option if an existing report has _almost_ what you need, but you want to adjust it just a bit.

#### Build your own report

 _Build your own report_ allows you to create a report nearly from scratch. Select a category you wish to report on, such as candidates, jobs, or departments, and Greenhouse Recruiting will provide a few relevant metrics to help get you started. From there, you can edit the report's metrics and apply filters to generate the report you need.

[Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050783391) to learn more about the templates available in Report Builder.

**Tip** : When choosing a starting point, consider what specific question you aim to answer with the data from your report.

For instance, if you're looking for information on offers from last year, the _Build your own offer report_ might be a good starting point!

Select your template by clicking the report name, and then click **Customize Template**.

On the subsequent page, you can add **Columns** to your custom report on the left. The available columns will differ depending on the report template type you chose.

Click **Filters** to add filters and refine the data that appears on your custom report. Depending on the report template type you chose, the available options may differ, but common filters include activity dates, jobs, and offices.

To learn more about building a custom report, check out [Create a custom report using Report Builder](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050317592).

### Additional resources

  * [Create a custom report using Report Builder](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050317592)
  * [Report Builder filter guide](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050783451)
  * [Report Builder template guide](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050783391)
  * [Save, schedule, and email a custom report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050482292)

# BarRaiser Interview Intelligence integration

BarRaiser Interview Intelligence Platform is at the forefront of revolutionizing the hiring process for the world's most rapidly expanding companies. # HRPeak integration

HRPeak is an online assessment platform that generates technology-based HR solutions. HRPeak as one of the leading companies in the HR industry, revealed by the innovative and experienced software and academy team, is the first digital platform that offers various assessment tools.

In the digitalized HR industry, HRPeak has taken its place among the playmakers with the remarkable success it has made in the country. With its branches, it is able to demonstrate its quality-oriented products and services on a global scale.

Providing services to more than 450 companies including global ones, HRPeak continues to offer online HR solutions to facilitate the recruitment and assessment processes of its partners.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with HRPeak allows you to seamlessly add the HRPeak assessment to a job's interview plan.

#### In this article

  * Enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / HRPeak integration
  * Add HRPeak stage to an interview plan
  * Set up the assessment on the HRPeak stage
    * Send a review a test
  * Additional resources



### Enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / HRPeak integration

To enable the integration, contact your HRPeak representative at [support@hrpeak.com](mailto:support@hrpeak.com) to request an API key for your integration. Once you have received your API key, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/direct) to open a ticket with Greenhouse Technical Support.

**Note** _:_ Do not send your API key in the initial ticket. If needed, Greenhouse Technical Support will respond with a [SendSafely](https://www.sendsafely.com/about/) link for you to securely share the API key.

Wait for a confirmation email from Greenhouse Technical Support. You may be required to verify your account before you can proceed.

If they need your API key, Greenhouse Technical Support will provide a [SendSafely link](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/) where you can enter your API key. Once Greenhouse Technical Support has been notified that you’ve entered your API key, they will send a confirmation email.

### Add HRPeak stage to an interview plan

Once the Greenhouse Recruiting / HRPeak integration is enabled for your organization, you will be able to add the HRPeak assessment as an interview stage.

To add an interview stage to an existing job, navigate to your job (**All** **Jobs** > **Job** **Name**) and click **Job** **Setup**.

Select **Interview** **Plan** on the left side of the page and click **\+ Add a Stage**.

Select the **HRPeak** stage on the next window. When you’re finished, click **Add** to apply the stage to the job's interview plan.

### Set up the assessment on the HRPeak stage

After the stage has been added to the job's interview plan, you’ll need to add the assessment to the stage. To add the assessment, click **Edit Take Home Test**.

Choose the assessments from the dropdown menu. These options are based on the assessments you configured in HRPeak.

Assign at least one Greenhouse Recruiting user to grade/review submitted assessments. When you’re finished, click **Save**.

**Note** _:_ All configuration for the assessment (including the email template) will need to be done in HRPeak.

#### Send and review a test

When candidates are moved into the HRPeak interview stage, Greenhouse Recruiting will display a **Send Test** link.

**Note** _:_ When you send a partner assessment from inside Greenhouse Recruiting, the interview instructions will still be sent by HRpeak.

After it has been sent, an assessment’s status will display in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Once the candidate has submitted their test, the Interview Kit will contain a link to view the submitted test in the HRPeak application.

Click **View** **Report** to see the candidate’s results in HRPeak.

After you click on the Interview Kit on the candidate’s profile, you’ll be taken to a page where the URL is available to view the test results on HRPeak. You will be asked to login using your HRPeak account to view the test results. Management of the candidates and sharing report links will need to be done within HRPeak.

Through the process report, the assessments assigned to the candidate, the scores of them, and the process statuses can be viewed. By clicking on the assessment scores, the details of the candidate's score from the relevant assessment can be accessed. For example, when the score of the Aptitude test is clicked, the scores of each dimension, the number of correct - incorrect - blanks, the percentile according to the company and general distribution, the question booklet, the photos and videos taken in the test (if any) can be displayed.

###  Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [support@hrpeak.com](mailto:support@hrpeak.com).

# Set your target start date

**Permissions:** Site Admin who can see private notes, salary info, manage offers, request approval, and approve jobs / offers, and Job Admin who can edit job info and can view and edit private job fields and approve / request approval on jobs

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

In Greenhouse Recruiting, a job must have [one active opening](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360037953951) for every candidate you wish to hire for the role. An opening's target start date allows your organization to set a goal against a job opening.

Staying on top of target start dates can help keep your hiring team on track and allows your organization to measure hiring performance, through [forecasting](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115005312666) candidate start and offer dates for hires.

#### In this article

  * Edit a target start date
  * Frequently asked questions



### Edit a target start date

**Note** : The target state date is configured within a [job's opening(s)](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360028444371). The process to edit openings on an existing job depends on that job's [approval process](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201087714).

If you're having trouble managing openings, [check your permissions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360020855632). 

To edit the target start date for an opening, navigate to a job and select the **Job Setup** tab from the left-hand menu panel. Next, click **Job Info**. Scroll to the _Openings_ panel and then, click **Manage Openings**.

Select a **specific opening** from the left-hand panel and then, click the **Target Start Date** dropdown. Use the calendar to select a new target start date.

Click **Save Changes** when finished.

**Note** : The target start date for an opening can't be removed once set. When a target start date is configured, the date value can only be updated to reflect a new date.

### Frequently asked questions

#### How do I change the target start date when using Offer forecast?

On the offer forecast widget, click **Set target date** to choose a target start date for your new hire. You can also set a target start date on the opening under **Job Setup** > **Job Info**.

#### Can I make the target start date field required?

Currently, it's not possible to make the target start date required. If you'd like to remind your hiring team to complete the field, [create a custom opening field](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360036370951) and mark it as required. 

#### I'm using Offer forecast and see Heads up! as a status next to the target start date. What does that mean? 

Once you’ve set a target start date, [offer forecast](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360002797252) will share whether you’re on track or off track to meet your target.

**Status** | **Meaning**  
---|---  
On track | The predicted start date is on or earlier than your target start date.  
Heads up | The predicted start date is later than your target start date.  
  
**Learn more**

[Jobs and job openings](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4402057774747)

[Use offer forecast](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/18710896459163)

[How offer forecast works](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360002797252)

# Create and manage goals for new hires

**Permissions:** Hiring Managers and Owners

**Product tier:** Available for Greenhouse Welcome and Greenhouse Onboarding subscription tiers

[Goals for new hires](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9265626455067) elevates your role as hiring manager by allowing you to set measurable and attainable growth-related objectives for your new hires.

Unlike [tasks](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000525691), which commonly focus on administrative actions at the organization or department level, goals provide clear onboarding objectives specific to a new employee's role. This creates stronger alignment between you and your new hires by defining what success looks like in the critical 30-day onboarding period.

#### In this article

  * Get started with onboarding goals
    * Job kickoff form responses
  * Create onboarding goals
  * Edit onboarding goals
    * Edit goal descriptions
    * Add and rearrange goals
    * Delete goals
  * Share onboarding goals with your new hire
    * Reshare goals
  * Additional resources



### Get started with onboarding goals

To begin, select an **employee** from the _My New Hires_ section on your homepage.

Navigate to the **30 day goals** tab in your new hire's [employee profile](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5759718119707).

#### Job kickoff form responses

If the hiring manager submitted a [job kickoff form](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4416516351003) for this role in Greenhouse Recruiting, their responses to goals-related kickoff questions will be available in Greenhouse Onboarding. Use job kickoff responses to guide you when creating onboarding goals for your new hire.

Under the  _Job kickoff form_ section for 30 day goals, click **Expand section**.

You'll see the high-level objectives and goals for your new hire's role as defined by the hiring manager in the job kickoff form. When you create onboarding goals for your new hire, you can manually copy and paste these responses as needed.

### Create onboarding goals

Click**Create 30 day goals** to set up your new hire's onboarding goals.

**Note:** You can create onboarding goals for your new hire before their start date or within 30 days after their start date.

There are **14 pre-defined goals** available to share with your new hires. When you set up a new hire's onboarding goals for the first time, you'll see five default goals that we recommend to create a well-rounded onboarding experience.

**Note:** We recommend that you provide a minimum of three goals, and no more than ten goals, to ensure the best onboarding experience for your new hires.

Click the **caret** icon to expand a goal and provide a description.

Use the editor panel to **format text****** and include**links.**

Click**Add another goal** to include additional onboarding goals from the dropdown menu.

You can also rearrange or delete any of your new hire's onboarding goals.

Click **Save** when you're done setting up your new hire's goals.

### Edit onboarding goals

To edit your new hire's onboarding goals, navigate to _Your new hire's goals_ and click **Edit**.

#### Edit goal descriptions

Click the **caret** to expand the goal and edit the description.

Use the editor panel to update **text formatting** or include additional**links.**

#### Add and rearrange goals

Click**Add another goal**.

The **Choose a goal** dropdown menu will appear at the bottom of your new hire's listed goals. Select another onboarding goal from the dropdown to add it to the list.

Enter a description for each additional onboarding goal, then click **Save**.

Click and drag the **six dots** icon to rearrange the order of your new hire's goals.

#### Delete goals

Click the **delete** icon next to any goal to remove it from your new hire's list of onboarding goals.

### Share onboarding goals with your new hire

Once you've successfully created onboarding goals, click **Share as email** to send them to your new hire by email. You can share onboarding goals within the first 30 days after your new hire's start date.

**Note:** Managers need to share onboarding goals in order for new hires to be [notified](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/12198189055387) about completing their assigned goals. Make sure to click **Share as email** to send goals to your new hire!

#### Reshare goals

Check the **30 day goals** tab on your new hire's employee profile to see when you last shared onboarding goals with them.

Click **Share again as email** to resend onboarding goals to your new hire via email.

### Additional resources

Learn more about how your new hires can [complete and update the status of their assigned goals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9265765891995).

# Map your location field to Greenhouse Recruiting

**Permissions:** Owners

**Product tier:** Available for Greenhouse Welcome and Greenhouse Onboarding subscription tiers

The **l****ocation** field in Greenhouse Onboarding helps your organization categorize new hires and assign onboarding plans based on an employee's work location or office.

When you first set up your [Greenhouse Recruiting integration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/208314493) in Greenhouse Onboarding, mapping location fields between both systems is essential. This helps you ensure that Greenhouse Onboarding will pull in the correct location for newly hired candidates that you're about to onboard.

Since one location can include multiple offices in Greenhouse Recruiting, Greenhouse Onboarding can't automatically map and assign the correct location field. You'll need to create a [custom offer field](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360024551831) in Greenhouse Recruiting to map to your Greenhouse Onboarding location field.

#### In this article

  * Create a custom offer field in Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Map your location fields



### Create a custom offer field in Greenhouse Recruiting

To get started, create a custom offer field in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Open Greenhouse Recruiting, then navigate to **Configure** > **Custom Options**.

Under  _Company custom fields_ , select **Offers**.

On the _Manage offer fields_ page, click **Add field**.

Use the _New Offer Field_ window to give your field a **Name** and apply any rules. We recommend using the name "Location" for your new field.

Select **Single Select** from the _Field T_ _ype_ menu. Use the _Options_ field to list each of your organization's locations.

**Note:** Your custom offer field options should match each [location option](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/11317189972635-Greenhouse-Onboarding-settings-overview#:~:text=or%20edit%20departments.-,Locations,-Add%2C%20edit%2C%20or) in Greenhouse Onboarding. This ensures a candidate's location maps correctly to their employee location in Greenhouse Onboarding.

Mark the **Required** checkbox to require that this field is completed every time someone in your organization creates an offer.

When you're finished, click **Save**.

### Map your location fields

Now that you've created a custom offer field in Greenhouse Recruiting, you can successfully map this field to the location field in Greenhouse Onboarding.

Open Greenhouse Onboarding, then navigate to **Settings** > **Company Info** > **Fields**.

Under  _Basic Information_ , click to open the **Location** field.

From the _Edit Field_ window, use the **Greenhouse Recruiting Field** dropdown to select your new custom offer field.

Mark the **Required for new hires and/or managers** checkbox.

When you're finished, click **Save**. 

Your Greenhouse Recruiting custom offer field is now mapped to the location field in Greenhouse Onboarding. When you onboard a newly hired candidate, Greenhouse Onboarding will now automatically pull in their location from Greenhouse Recruiting.

### Additional resources

  * [Add a new hire to Greenhouse Onboarding](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000683352)
  * [Greenhouse Recruiting to Greenhouse Onboarding integration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/208314493)
  * [Test your Greenhouse Recruiting integration in Greenhouse Onboarding](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360001792491)
  * [Add or edit a field in Greenhouse Onboarding](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360024972792)
  * [Add a custom offer field in Greenhouse Recruiting](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360024551831)

# API approach to candidate export integration

**Permissions: Basic and above,** who can manage all organization's API Credentials

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Some organizations aren’t able to build the candidate export integration with the candidate-hired webhook because the HRIS or integration partner does not have a listener service that can accept webhooks. To get around this issue, you can pull data from the API instead of leveraging Greenhouse Recruiting webhooks.

**Tip:** If your organization needs to utilize this approach, we recommend pulling a list of offers that were accepted during a specific period of time, then using the `application ID`, `candidate ID`, and `job ID` returned in that API response to make subsequent API requests for any additional information that is required by the relevant HRIS.

### API request steps

#### Step 1

Poll [`GET List Offers`](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-offers) using the `status`, `resolved_after`, and `starts_before/starts_after` parameters.

  * This method will return the `application_id`, `candidate_id`, and `job_id` that you need to retrieve the application, candidate, and job data
  * Adding `Status=accepted` ensures that all returned candidates have been hired
  * Including `Resolved_after=[date/time]` ensures that the integration is only pulling offers that were marked as accepted since the last time the integration polled Greenhouse
  * Adding `Starts_before=[date/time]` and `starts_after=[date/time]` will pull offers for candidates expected to start within the designated time frame



**Example request** :
    
    
    curl -X GET \    
    'https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/offers?status=accepted&resolved_after=2019-04-01T00:00:00.000Z' \  
      
      -H 'Authorization: Basic ***********************************'

**Example response** : 

_(application_id, job_id, and candidate_id included in the response body)_**:**
    
    
    [  
        {  
            "id": 1713400,  
            "version": 1,  
            **"application_id": 116713091,**  
            "created_at": "2019-07-11T12:57:55.551Z",  
            "updated_at": "2019-07-15T20:09:59.530Z",  
            "sent_at": null,  
            "resolved_at": "2019-07-15T20:09:59.529Z",  
            "starts_at": "2019-08-15",  
            "status": "accepted",  
            **"job_id": 1026114,**  
    **"candidate_id": 106907233,**  
            "opening": null,  
            "custom_fields": {  
                "employment_type": "Full-time",  
                "legal_name": “Cindy Bananas”,  
                "compensation_plan": "Compensation Plan B",  
                "salary": {  
                    "value": 100000,  
                    "unit": "USD"  
                },  
                "bonus": null,  
                "options": "updated offer",  
                "benefits": null,  
                "visa_cost": "n/a",  
                "notes": "notes notes notes",  
                "offer_date": "2019-03-27",  
                "hiring_manager": {  
                    "name": "Nastia Liukin",  
                    "email": "ghtest+nliukin@gmail.com",  
                    "user_id": 1019645  
                },  
                "return_date": "2019-09-26",  
                "boolean_test": "Yes"  
            }  
        }  
    ]

#### Step 2

Using the `application_id`,` job_id`, and `candidate_id` returned in the response body from step 1, execute the below requests to pull the corresponding application, job, and candidate data that would have been included in the Candidate Hired webhook:

#### Step 3

Use `[GET Retrieve Candidate](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-retrieve-candidate) `to pull candidate data and candidate field values.

The candidate object will include the candidate’s first and last name, contact details, and education info.

**Example request** : 
    
    
    curl -X GET \  
      https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/candidates/**106907233** \  
      -H 'Authorization: Basic ***********************************'

#### Step 4

Use `[GET Retrieve Application](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-retrieve-application) `to pull application data and application field values.

The `Application` object will include the specific `Opening ID` that the candidate has been hired onto (this may correlate with the Requisition/Position ID), the candidate source, and which Greenhouse user that will receive credit for the referral.

**Example request** : 
    
    
    curl -X GET \  
      https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/applications/**116713091**  \  
      -H 'Authorization: Basic ***********************************'

#### Step 5

Use `[GET Retrieve Job](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-retrieve-job)` to pull job data and job field values.

The `Job` object will include the `Requisition ID` and `Opening ID` which typically identify the Requisition and/or Position in the HRIS. 

**Example request** : 
    
    
    curl -X GET \  
      https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/jobs/**1026114**  \  
      -H 'Authorization: Basic ***********************************'

# Can I assign agency recruiters to a job that isn't live on the careers page?

Yes - for agency recruiters to successfully submit candidates to a job, the status of the job needs to be open and the job needs to be posted to your external job board. However, the job post does not need to be LIVE.

  * You can check that the job is open under the **Job Info** tab.
  * You can verify the job post under the **Job Setup** > **Job Boards & Posts**.



To keep a job off your external job board post, make sure the toggle is turned off. However, this setup ensures that your job your agency recruiters will be able to submit candidates while also preventing anyone from seeing the post on your careers page.

# Referrals over time report

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Referrals are consistently the best source for talent leads. Generally, referrals cost less to hire, perform better in the roles, and stay longer than external candidates. Companies that garner more referrals consistently hire better talent and outperform their competition.

Unlike the [candidate quality by referrer](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/203941219-What-is-the-Candidate-Quality-by-Referrer-report-How-do-I-use-it-) report, which shows all candidates arranged by the user listed in the _Who Gets Credit_ field, the referrals over time report will display all candidates whose source is _Referral_. The referrals over time report equips your organization with the data necessary to make actionable changes to how you prioritize referrals.

#### In this article

  * Referrals over time report
  * Referrals over time report filters
  * Referrals over time visualization



### Referrals over time report

To create a referrals over time report, click **Reports** on your navigation bar.

Click **Essential** **reports** on the left.

Scroll to the _Manage Expectations with Hiring Managers_ section and click **Referrals** **Over** **Time**.

The referrals over time report will generate.

The referrals over time report will display information for the following:

  * Total referrals



**Note** : The referrals over time report will populate the number of referrals submitted for every job where you have Job Admin or higher permissions.

### Referrals over time report filters

Click **Filters and more** to apply filters to further refine your report.

The referrals over time report can be filtered by the following:

  * Job
  * Job status
  * Department
  * Office
  * User
  * Hiring team role
  * Custom job field
  * Date



**Note** : The referrals over time report can display a maximum of twelve columns regardless of the periodization or date range selected. If there are not yet twelve weeks in the current year, the report will default to the last twelve weeks of the previous year.

Click **Apply** after applying any filters to your report. 

### Referrals over time visualization

The referrals over time report will visualize the total referrals row values as a single line with the number of referrals displayed on the _y_ -axis and the date periodizations (columns) on the _x_ -axis.

**Note:** The referrals over time report does not support individual trend lines per row.

Hover over any data point in the visualization for an exact number of referrals made for that period.

Since the visualization displays data for the total row in your report, any changes made to your report via **Filters and more** will impact the visualization.

# Goals for new hires email notifications

**Permissions:** Owner

**Product tier:** Available for Greenhouse Onboarding and Greenhouse Welcome tiers

Goals improve the onboarding experience by allowing hiring managers to set measurable and attainable growth-related objectives for their new hires. This creates stronger alignment between managers and new hires by defining what success looks like in the critical 30-day onboarding period.

Greenhouse Onboarding provides three core emails that your organization can set up to remind hiring managers to [create 30 day goals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9265706878619) and remind new hires to [complete their 30 day goals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9265765891995). Managers and new hires will also receive automatic notifications for the following actions:

  * A manager shares newly created onboarding goals with their new hire
  * A new hire changes the status of a goal to "Needs help"



Turn on email notifications to help managers and new hires stay on top of their goals.

**Note:** 30 day goals emails are **turned off** by default in _Settings_. Activate your new hire goals emails to notify hiring managers when it's time to create goals for their new hires! 

#### In this article

  * Turn on new hire goals emails
  * Available new hire goals emails
    * Create goals for new hire
    * Reminder to complete goals
    * Introduction to new hire onboarding goals
    * Reminder to update goal status
    * New hire is blocked
  * Additional resources



### Turn on new hire goals emails

**Note:** Only users with [Owner access](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360019575491) can turn on or deactivate email notifications for new hire goals.

To activate email notifications for new hire goals, navigate to **Settings** > **Onboarding Plan** > **Emails**.

Scroll to find the  _Greenhouse Onboarding core emails_ section.

Click to toggle each **30 day goals** email notification **on**. 

### Available new hire goals emails

#### Create goals for new hire

The Create goals for new hire email notifies managers when they need to [create 30 day goals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9265706878619) for a new hire. These notifications need to be turned on in _Settings_.

Greenhouse Onboarding sends this email to managers 30 days before a new hire's start date.

#### Reminder to complete goals

The Reminder to complete goals email reminds managers when they haven't yet completed onboarding goals for a new hire. These notifications need to be turned on in _Settings_.

This email is sent to managers 7 days before a new hire's start date.

#### Introduction to new hire onboarding goals

Once a manager has created and saved onboarding goals, they can click **Share as email** to notify a new hire that their onboarding goals are now available.

**Note:** This email isn't configurable in _Settings_. Managers will need to click **Share as email** from the 30 day goals tab of their new hire's profile to send this notification manually.

New hires will receive this email 24 hours before their start date.

#### Reminder to update goal status

The Reminder to update goal status email reminds new hires to update the status of their assigned onboarding goals. These notifications need to be turned on in  _Settings_.

This email is sent to new hires 14 days and 30 days after their start date. The new hire's manager will also be copied on this email.

#### New hire is blocked

If a new hire is blocked on one of their assigned goals, they can change their goal's status to **Need help** and add a note to provide details. This will automatically send a notification to alert their manager.

**Note:** This email isn't configurable in _Settings_. Managers will receive this notification any time their new hires change a goal's status to **Need help**.

### Additional resources

Learn more about setting up email notifications in Greenhouse Onboarding:

  * [Emails overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000515452)
  * [Enable emails](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360020657171)
  * [Greenhouse Onboarding core emails](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360039571472)



**Learn more about goals for new hires**

[Goals for new hires overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9265626455067)

[Create and manage goals for new hires](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9265706878619)

# Enter confidential candidate information

Confidential and private candidate information is sensitive or private sections of the candidate profile that contain specific personal or salary information.

#### In this article

  * [User permissions for confidential candidate information](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201344444#h_01HVA07GKZX5GYN2X5H6R7CW4D)
  * [Private candidate information](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201344444#h_01HVA0BJSS5BK4TR4SJR3NXW21)
  * [Private offer details](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201344444#h_01HVA1CVJGADYAZWW2A6YPN4B5)



### User permissions for confidential candidate information

Private candidate information, such as application fields or private notes, are hidden from all users, except those with the following permissions:

  * Job Admins with either of the following permission stripes: 
    * **Can view and edit private candidate and application fields**
    * **Can view and create private notes**
  * Site Admins with the user-specific permission **Can see private notes, salary info, manage offers, request approval, and approve jobs/offers**



Additionally, private offer fields are hidden under a second set of permissions. This separate permission helps organizations who want to grant Job Admins the ability to view one set of information, but not the other:

  * Job Admins with the permission stripe **Can view and edit offers and approve/request approval on offers**
  * Site Admins with the user-specific permission **Can see private notes, salary info, manage offers, request approval, and approve jobs/offers**



**Note:** A Job Admin's visibility depends on exactly which permission stripes they've been assigned. For example, if the user has only permission for **Can view and edit private candidate and application fields** , they'll be able to view private candidate fields, but not private notes.

### Private candidate information

Private candidate information includes background check results and private notes.

Background check results are at the bottom of the **Applications** tab in the right panel. 

If the candidate is currently in a background check stage, you can also see their results in the **Stages** tab.

### Private offer details

Offer details are contained in the **Documents** section of the **Applications** tab in the right panel/

If they're currently in the offer stage, their offer details are also available in the main panel.

# Set up a take home test

**Permissions:** Site Admin, and Job Admin who can edit interview plans

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Take Home Tests are a great way to assess your candidates' skills in writing, coding, project management, and other areas that are necessary for the job. Typically, we recommend the Hiring Manager acting as the subject-matter-expert (SME) for the role be the [individual to draft the Take Home Test](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360007247092-Structured-Hiring-Role-Kick-Off-Meeting#%E2%80%9Croles%E2%80%9D).

#### In this article

  * Add a take-home test stage to an interview plan
  * Configure the message template
  * Options for uploading a candidate's assessment
    * File types
  * Configure focus attributes and graders for a take-home test
  * Anonymous take home tests



### Add a take-home test stage to an interview plan

You can add a take-home test to a job's **Interview Plan**. _(Navigate to a job > **Job Setup** >**Interview Plan**)_

Click **Add a Stage.**

Choose **Take Home Test** from the list and click **Add**.

The Take Home Test stage will be added to your Interview Plan. If you need to move the stage to a different placement in your Interview Plan, click and drag the stage in your interview plan.

Once the Take Home Test stage has been added to your Interview Plan, you can create a templated message that will be sent to candidates who enter the stage, configure focus attributes on scorecards, and assign graders.

### Configure the message template

By default, the take-home test stage includes a template message with basic instructions for the candidate. However, you can revise the template to include a customized message or more specific instructions.

To update the message template, click the **Edit** icon  next to the take-home test.

Navigate to the _Email to Candidate_ panel and modify the email as needed.

The table below outlines the specific parts of an email that can be updated.

**Field** | **Description**  
---|---  
From | By default, this field will include the email token placeholder`{{MY_EMAIL_ADDRESS}}`, which will automatically populate the field with the sender's email address. The field can be edited to include a static email address if you prefer.  
Subject | By default, this field will be **Take Home Test from`{{COMPANY}}`**. Feel free to edit this field.  
Body | By default, this field includes the text "Please include the attached take home test", but this can be customized. This is where you will want to include specific instructions on how to complete the exercise.  
  
### Options for uploading a candidate's assessment

By default, Greenhouse Recruiting provides a link in the initial email for candidates to directly upload their completed test.

When the toggle is turned on, a submission link will be included in the email delivered to the candidate.

If the toggle is turned off, candidates won't be able to upload documents. This process is better for organizations who want candidates to use a [third-party tool to complete an assessment](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/sections/360000685111-Candidate-Testing) or submit their tests to a specific email address.

Best practice: If you're not including an upload link in your email, include detailed instructions in the email template to direct candidates.

#### File types

If your candidates are uploading take home tests using Greenhouse Recruiting's default submission link, they **cannot upload executable files such as .exe, .js, .bat, and .py.**

If you want to further restrict the file types your candidates are able to upload, contact Greenhouse Technical Support.

### Configure focus attributes and graders for a take-home test

The purpose of the Take Home Test is to gauge each candidate's strengths in certain essential competencies. You can define focus attributes for a take-home test on at the top of the page.

Interviewers assigned to this Interview Kit will see the selected Focus Attributes grouped at the top of their Scorecard. All other Scorecard Attributes for the Interview Kit will be listed below the _Focus Attributes_ section.

Once you're finished, navigate to each panel and provide additional information as necessary:

**Panel** | **Description**  
---|---  
**Grading Instructions** |  To ensure that tests are being evaluated consistently, you will want to provide guidelines for the graders. By default, Greenhouse Recruiting provides the following instructions to interviewers: Read through the test and answer a few questions:

  * Was it sent in on time?
  * Was it professionally done?
  * Were the required skills demonstrated and to what extent?

Edit the field to include any additional or alternative instructions for your interviewers  
**Custom Questions** |  By default, the scorecard includes a **Key-Takeaways** text field. If you would like to include specific questions for the graders, perhaps as a way to further structure guidelines for grading, click the **Add Custom Question** button. This will include a new text field on the scorecard.  
**Graders and Notifications** |  You can set a default grader for all tests, or you can select a grader as the test is sent to the candidate. Use the provided field to select users who will be grading the Take Home Tests. In addition, select who will be notified when a candidate submits their response to a Take Home Test. If the Take Home Test is configured to include the Upload link (see above), then the selected users will be alerted via an email notification when the candidate submits the test. If the Take Home Test is configured such that the Upload link is not included, then the selected users will be alerted via an email notification when the test is manually uploaded.  
**Additional Settings** | Use the provided checkbox to make scorecards required  
  
### Anonymous take home tests

**Note:** Anonymous Take Home Test submissions are only included in Greenhouse Recruiting's Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DE&I) feature set, which is available with an Pro subscription tier.

To help facilitate grading objectivity and reduced unconscious bias, Expert tier customers can configure anonymous take-home tests so graders aren't aware of the candidate who submitted the assessment.

For more information, visit [DE&I interviewing features](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360004977491#THT).

# Merge job posting integration

Merge integrates accounting, HR, recruiting, and payroll API platforms into a unified API using those platforms' official APIs so that you can harness the entire range of available data. Integration with Merge's unified API is painless with accessible API design, SDKs in multiple languages, and easy-to-use documentation.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Merge allows companies to integrate Greenhouse Recruiting data with third-party applications.

#### In this article

  * Find your job board token
  * Create a job board tracking link
  * Use the Merge integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



### Find your job board token

To make your job posts available to Merge, you'll need to send your job board token to Merge.

You can find your job board URL by navigating to **Configure** > **Job Boards Posts** > **Ellipsis** icon  next to your job board **Edit Board Settings** , then scroll to the URL field.

Copy the token at the end of the URL and provide it to Merge.

[Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888210160155) for a more detailed walkthrough of locating your job board URL.

### Create a job board tracking link

To track applicants from Merge, [create a job board tracking link](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201823760) by navigating to **Configure** > **Job Boards Posts** > **Ellipsis** icon  next to your job board **Tracking Link**.

**Note** : If Merge doesn't yet exist as a source, you can [create a custom source](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200721664) for the integration.

Click **Create****Link**. **Copy** the resulting URL and provide it to your Merge representative.

### Use the Merge integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

Merge Link is a drop-in UI component that guides you through authorizing any integration on Merge.

Once you have set up Merge Link on Merge, paste the job board token into Merge Link's drop-in UI component.

After you authenticate the Greenhouse Recruiting integration, Merge will create a **Linked Account** for it which can be viewed and managed in your Merge [Dashboard](https://app.merge.dev/linked-accounts).

Merge allows you to send and receive data from Greenhouse Recruiting using their standard [common models](https://www.merge.dev/docs/ats/overview), which include candidates, applications, attachments, and more.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [hello@merge.dev](mailto:hello@merge.dev).

# How do I sync an existing interview to the candidate profile? 

In Greenhouse Recruiting, scheduling candidate interviews involves creating consensus (syncing) with an interview's time and place across three parties:

  * An interviewer's calendar
  * A candidate's calendar 
  * Greenhouse Recruiting



If an existing event is edited to ensure these three requirements are met, the event can seamlessly sync onto the candidate's profile without your team needing to start from scratch.

#### Manually sync an existing interview to a candidate profile

To sync an existing interview onto the candidate profile, follow the [manual scheduling](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/208664396) process to locate a specific interview kit URL along with your organization's assigned [Greenhouse calendar email address](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050154551) to add to your existing event details. 

From your external calendar application ([Google Calendar](https://support.google.com/calendar/answer/72143?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop),[ Microsoft Outlook](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/create-modify-or-delete-a-meeting-request-or-appointment-in-outlook-on-the-web-6283f744-4ce1-470e-9d6b-96fa94e52996), etc.), open the interview and paste the copied interview details within the body of the event. 

Check that your Greenhouse calendar address is listed within the event attendees.

Once the interview details are confirmed, send out the updated invite, ensuring notification is sent to all guests.

The event will sync in Greenhouse shortly. 

**Note:** If the Greenhouse calendar email address is not included as an attendee and/or an update notification is not sent to all guests once the details are saved, the interview and any subsequent updates to it will not be reflected in Greenhouse Recruiting.

# EasySource integration [HireQuotient]

HireQuotient’s talent sourcing tool, EasySource, helps talent sourcers automate time-consuming sourcing tasks to narrow the talent search and enhance the quality of the candidate pool.

EasySource stands out from its competitors due to its advanced AI algorithms, comprehensive filters, and integrated LinkedIn inmail functionality. This unique combination enables EasySource to identify and engage with highly relevant and interested candidates, allowing recruiters to fine-tune their candidate searches and identify the most suitable talent more accurately.

By enabling recruiters to send LinkedIn Inmails and connection requests directly through the platform. EasySource distinguishes itself by eliminating the need to switch between multiple tools or platforms, streamlining the communication process and enhancing productivity.

HireQuotient’s EasySource integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows a seamless and efficient process for talent sourcing and recruitment, ensuring that the most promising candidates are seamlessly moved from the sourcing stage to the applicant tracking and management process within Greenhouse.

#### In this article

  * Set up the Greenhouse Recruiting / EasySource integration
    * Create an Ingestion API key
    * Provide your Ingestion API key to HireQuotient and finish setup
  * Use the Easysource integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
    * Export candidates and prospects
    * View imported candidates and prospects
  * Additional resources



### Set up the Greenhouse Recruiting / EasySource integration

#### Create an Ingestion API key

To integrate with Easysource, you’ll need to create an Ingestion API key and provide it to HireQuotient.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888200444571) for detailed steps on creating an Ingestion API Key. Be sure to copy the API key, you’ll need to paste it into HireQuotient in the next step.

#### Provide your Ingestion API key to HireQuotient and finish setup

To add your created API key to HireQuotient, navigate to your [EasySource dashboard](https://easysource.hirequotient.com/signin) and open the **Integrations** tab.

Navigate to _Greenhouse_ and then, click **Connect**.

In the _Connect Greenhouse_ window, input the required information (Ingestion API key and [service user email](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405511253659-Create-an-ISU-for-an-integration)) and ensure the email address for your Greenhouse Recruiting account/a service user email matches your HireQuotient credentials.

**Submit** when finished.

The Greenhouse Recruiting / EasySource integration will be enabled and ready for use.

### Use the Easysource integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Export candidates and prospects

To source candidates from EasySource to Greenhouse Recruiting, navigate to the EasySource dashboard and select one or multiple candidates.

Click **Add to ATS** after choosing your candidates and select **Greenhouse** from the dropdown.

You can select the type from the 2 available options:

  * [Prospect](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/206729066) \- An unattached prospect who is not associated with any job
  * [Candidate](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002195063) \- A candidate who is associated with a particular job



If **Candidate** is selected, the next step will be to select the job that you would like to associate with the candidate.

Using the _Select Job_ dropdown, select a job and **Confirm**.

The candidate will be sent to Greenhouse with the data below:

  * Candidate name
  * Candidate email ID (Depends on the availability)
  * Location
  * Current company and Job title



#### View imported candidate/prospect(s) 

To see the candidates sourced from EasySource in Greenhouse, navigate to **Configure** (gear icon) > **Custom Options** > **Sources** and make sure _EasySource_ is toggled **On.**

Then, select a Job and go to the **Candidates** tab. Using the [left-hand filter panel](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003320943), select _Source_ to filter by _EasySource_.

Once filtered, candidates sourced from EasySource will appear for your review.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [easysource-support@hirequotient.com](mailto:easysource-support@hirequotient.com). 

**More from HireQuotient**

# Visier integration

Visier for mid-market is a people analytics solution that makes it easy for HR leaders to transform their existing people data into meaningful analytics in just a few clicks.

Greenhouse Recruiting’s integration with Visier allows you to analyze your applicant pipeline and job posting process flow from end to end.

**Sources**

  * GET: List Sources



**Users**

  * GET: Retrieve User
  * GET: List Users
  * GET: List User Future Job Permissions
  * GET: List User Job Permissions
  * GET: List Pending Approvals



### Use the Visier integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

Sign in to Visier with an Administrator's profile and click the **Admin** link on the left-hand side to navigate to the Admin Dashboard. On the _Admin Dashboard_ page, click the **Manage Data Provider(s)** button. 

Click the **Add New Data Provider** button. 

In the  _HR Application_ dropdown, select **Greenhouse**. 

Follow the prompts to paste the Harvest API key previously generated in Greenhouse Recruiting. Click the **Authenticate** button when finished. Visier will test the connect to Greenhouse Recruiting to confirm it can access your data. 

If all is configured correctly, you will be asked to confirm the configuration by clicking the **Next** button.

If you are happy with your configuration, complete the process by clicking the **Finish** button on the confirmation step.

The Greenhouse Recruiting / Visier integration has been enabled successfully on Visier's platform. 

#### Update Visier application and begin analysis

Your Greenhouse Recruiting applicant tracking and posting data can be pulled into Visier and combined with employee data from your HRIS. To move the data from Greenhouse Recruiting to Visier, from the  _Admin Dashboard_ page, click the **Update Now** button. 

Your Visier application will work behind the scenes, bringing all the changes since your last update, to allow you to analyze up-to-the-minute data. Depending on how many changes you have made since the last update, this may take up to 10 minutes to complete. You will receive an email once the data transfer is complete. 

Click the **Update Now** button any time you need to synchronize your analysis environment with changes made in your Greenhouse Recruiting and HRIS data. 

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [help.me@visier.com](mailto:help.me@visier.com).
