# Stage transition rules overview

**Permissions:** Site Admin, and Job Admin who can create, edit and delete Stage Transition rules

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Stage transition rules make your recruiting process more efficient by automating actions that occur when candidates are moved to a new stage in an interview plan.

For example, you can create a stage transition rule that automatically sends an availability request to the candidate when they’re moved into the phone interview stage.

Once a stage transition rule is [created](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360048178672), you can [copy](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360052425952) it to other jobs and [edit](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360048337832) or [delete](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360048335732) it as needed.

#### In this article

  * Available stage transition rules
  * Additional resources



### Available stage transition rules

Greenhouse Recruiting offers the following stage transition rules. 

#### Scheduling

  * **Send an availability request** : When a candidate moves to a specified stage, they receive a request to provide their availability and begin the process of scheduling an interview. This rule can be configured for any stage with one or more schedulable interviews.



**Note:** When sending an availability request using a stage transition rule, you cannot CC other users.

  * **Send a self-schedule request:** When a candidate moves to a specified stage, they are emailed a request to self-schedule an interview. You must [set up candidate self-scheduling](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4409526364443) before you can use this stage transition rule.



**Note:** Self-schedule requests are for use in interview stages with a single interview. Stages with multiple interviews, such as a multi-step onsite interview, can't be scheduled using candidate self-scheduling. [Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360045420091) for more information on scheduling multi-step interviews.

  * **Send a Calendly request:** When a candidate moves to a specified stage, they are emailed a Calendly request to self-schedule an interview. This rule can be configured for any stage with exactly one schedulable interview. The [Calendly integration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029649991) must be enabled before configuring this rule.



**Note:** Availability request rules and Calendly request rules are mutually exclusive; only one of these two rule types can be configured for a single stage.

#### Assessment

  * **Send a take-home test:** When a candidate moves into a Take Home Test, Document Submission, or Trial Project stage, you can automatically send the email containing Greenhouse Recruiting's candidate test.
  * **Send a partner take-home test:** When a candidate moves into a partner's Take Home Test stage, which is named after the partner, you can automatically send the email containing the [partner's candidate test](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/sections/360000685111-Candidate-testing).



**Note:** At this time, we do not support partner take-home test stage transition rules for the following partners: [ClassMarker](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200481209), [CoderPad Live](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201074995), [Codility Screen](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202062659), [HireVue (legacy integration)](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201178004) and [Spark Hire](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/205405739).

#### Communication

  * **Send a candidate email:** When a candidate moves to a specified stage, they receive a templated email message. You can use this email to send general information about the interview process, attach documents, link to external forms or documents, and more. This rule can be configured for any stage.
  * **Send a hiring team email:** When a candidate moves to a specified stage, Greenhouse automatically sends a templated email to the [hiring team](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002194983). Use it to prompt teammates to take action, or share links the candidate's profile and documents. This rule can be configured for any stage.
  * **Send a form:** When a candidate moves to a specified stage, they receive a [form](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360019478952). You can use this form for various [use cases](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360019478952-Forms-overview#h_1ae32fcf-9aa5-4384-aab9-36fa4ab21e83), such as capturing more detailed candidate information or collecting a list of references.
  * **Send an e-Signature agreement:** When a candidate moves to a specified stage, they receive an [e-Signature agreement](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/27637882883995) to sign.
  * **Send an identity verification request:** When a candidate moves to a specified stage, they are emailed a request to complete an identity verification request. This rule can be configured for eligible stages once the [CLEAR integration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/40893011137179) is enabled.



### Additional resources

To learn how to use stage transition rules, check out these articles:

  * [Create stage transition rule](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360048178672)
  * [Edit stage transition rule](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360048337832)
  * [Delete stage transition rule](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360048335732)
  * [Copy stage transition rule](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360052425952)

# CV-Transformer integration (legacy)

**Note:** An updated version of the Greenhouse Recruiting / CV-Transformer integration is available. For the most current version, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/50617680760091).

CV-Transformer helps recruiters turn messy candidate CVs into clean, professional, and consistently branded documents. Our AI assistant drafts the entire CV, allowing recruiters to simply add the finishing touches and saving them hours of manual work. With a flexible layout builder, agencies can create fully custom designs including any data fields they need.

CV-Transformer’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows recruiters to sync candidates between the two platforms, speeding up the CV-transformation process even further.

#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API key
  * Insert Harvest API key in CV-Transformer
  * Connect Greenhouse users with CV-Transformer users
  * Use the integration
  * Additional resources



### Create a Harvest API key

To configure the integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key. 

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the CV-Transformer integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** CV-Transformer or Unlisted Vendor
  * **Description:** CV-Transformer Harvest API Key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the CV-Transformer integration: 

  * Harvest V1
    * Candidates
      * GET: Retrieve Candidate
      * GET: List Candidates
      * POST: Add Attachment
      * POST: Add prospect
    * Users
      * GET: List Users



### Insert Harvest API key in CV-Transformer

To enable the integration in CV-Transformer, navigate to settings > integrations, select “Greenhouse” under ATS and paste the API key you just generated.

### Connect Greenhouse users with CV-Transformer users

Before using the integration, make sure that all users are connected between the two platforms. This way candidates created in CV-Transformer will have the correct “recruiter” set in Greenhouse, and candidates created in Greenhouse will have the correct “contact” set in CV-Transformer.

You can connect users between the platforms directly from the integration page within CV-Transformer:

If some users are registered in Greenhouse, but not in CV-Transformer, consider inviting them to CV-Transformer.  
You can do this within CV-Transformer by going to “Team”, clicking “+Member” and filling in their details.

If some users are registered in CV-Transformer, but not in Greenhouse, consider inviting them to Greenhouse.  
You can do this within Greenhouse by going to “Configure”, then “Users” and clicking “+New Users”.

### Use the integration

#### Greenhouse / CV-Transformer sync

When someone creates a candidate (or prospect) in Greenhouse, that candidate is imported into CV-Transformer.

The contact in CV-Transformer is equivalent to the “recruiter” in Greenhouse.

Initially, the candidate will be “pending” (yellow clock icon). This way it is available in CV-Transformer, but we don’t charge for it yet.

The imported candidate will start blank and we can select attachments (such as resume’s) from Greenhouse.

(For illustration purposes we’ve used a very simple layout here).

Now, the user can ask our AI to fill in the proposal.

Our AI assistant has access to context such as the text from the uploaded attachments, and the candidate’s data within Greenhouse.

Once happy with the proposal, the user can “Share” and “Save to Greenhouse”

Now, the formatted proposal is available in Greenhouse and users can continue as usual from there. The attach action is made on behalf of the Greenhouse user linked to the currently active CV-Transformer user (using the On-Behalf-Of) header.

3\. CV-Transformer -> Greenhouse sync

When a candidate is created within CV-Transformer and it has at least one attachment (CV, Vacancy, etc.), a new prospect will be created within Greenhouse.

We use our AI model to extract data from the uploaded attachment, so that the candidate is created in Greenhouse with much data populated already:

Additionally, we add a note to the candidate in Greenhouse. This way, the user can easily find their way back to the candidate in CV-Transformer to make further edits to the proposal.

  
The candidate is created on behalf of the user that is linked to the CV-Transformer user that created the candidate.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [info@cv-transformer.com](mailto:info@cv-transformer.com).

**Pricing**

CV-Transformer’s pricing is usage-based. One candidate equals one credit. We offer both non-expiring credit bundles in a pre-paid fashion and a monthly billing model in which organizations can get bulk discounts by opting for minimum guarantees: <https://www.cv-transformer.com/en/pricing>

**Layouts**

Our layout builder is accessible to all users (except when denied by an org admin). We even have a layout library (<https://www.cv-transformer.com/en/layouts>)  
Often though, we design the layouts for organizations. Feel free to reach out to learn more about all possibilities.

# Owner access

**Permissions:** Owners

**Product tier:** Available for Greenhouse Welcome and Greenhouse Onboarding subscription tiers

The Owner role in Greenhouse Onboarding is part of the [administrative access tier](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360019200392) and has the highest level of permissions. Users assigned Owner permissions can perform all administrative tasks and have access to all employee fields.

**Note:** Due to its wide-ranging permissions, this role should only be given to select users.

#### In this article

  * Assign Owner permissions
  * Remove Owner permissions
  * View Owner permissions settings
  * Additional resources



### Assign Owner permissions

From your Greenhouse Onboarding homepage, navigate to **Settings** > **Data Flow** > **Permissions**.

Scroll to  _Administrative Access_ , then click on the **Owner** role.

Navigate to the **Users** tab, then click **Add User**.

Use the dropdown menu to assign Owner permissions to specific users in your organization.

Click **Save and Close** when you're done.

### Remove Owner permissions

To remove Owner access from a user in your organization, navigate to the Owner role page and select the **Users** tab.

Hover over the user's name and click **Remove**.

Click **Remove** again to confirm you want to remove this user's Owner access.

**Note:** Owners can't remove their own permissions access.

### View Owner permissions settings

Navigate to the **Settings** tab on the Owner role page to see a list of all the permissions granted to users with this role.

**Note:** These permissions can't be modified.

# Set up HRIS Link for Workday®️  user import

**Permissions:** —

**Product tier:** Available for Pro subscription tier with HRIS Link add-on

With HRIS Link, you can programmatically import user accounts to sync changes from your HRIS to Greenhouse Recruiting. 

To import user accounts, construct a report as a service (RaaS) in your HRIS that meets Greenhouse Recruiting specifications.

**Note** : HRIS Link user import shouldn't be used with [SSO with SCIM](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9825388563483), as they both perform the same function.

#### In this article

  * Set up HRIS Link for users
    * Report specification
    * Sample report output
    * Recommended filters
  * Add custom user fields to HRIS Link
  * Additional resources



### Set up HRIS Link for users

**Note** : HRIS Link currently only supports Workday®️.

First, create a RaaS user import report in Workday®️ using the report specifications below. The primary business object in your report should be **Worker**. Once constructed, [enter the report URL and your ISU credentials](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/11006737633307) in HRIS Link.

#### Report specifications

**Note** : HRIS Link relies on an exact match of the report column header. In most cases, you need to update or override the default value when adding the column to your Workday®️ report.

**Report column header** | **Workday®️ field** | **Notes**  
---|---|---  
`first_name` ✓ Required field | Legal or Preferred First Name | N/A  
`last_name` ✓ Required field | Last Name | N/A  
`email` ✓ Required field | Email | Ensure the email address is the same address used with SSO.  
`employee_id` ✓ Required field | Employee ID | N/A  
`enabled` ✓ Required field | Employment Status | Must be `1` for active (enabled) or `0` for inactive (deactivated).  
`send_email_invite` | calc field |  Must be `1` to send the email invitation or `0` /`null` to not send the invitation email. Any value other than `1` , `0` , or `null` will cause an error.  
See [the change log](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4406914314651-HRIS-Link-changelog) for further information about integration behavior. **Note:** This field will only trigger an invitation upon initial Greenhouse user creation, not on any subsequent updates.  
`Office_IDs` |  Varies |  The value provided must match an`external_ID`for one of your Greenhouse Recruiting offices; the value can be semicolon delimited to assign more than one office to a user.  
`Department_IDs` |  Varies |  The value provided must match an`external_ID`for one of your Greenhouse Recruiting departments; the value can be semicolon delimited to assign more than one department to a user.  
`Custom Fields` |  Check out the Add custom fields to your report section below. |  Add any single-select, multi-select, yes / no, or user type [custom user fields](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/7626796336283) to your Workday®️ report; HRIS Link will match the column header name to the name of your custom field in Greenhouse Recruiting.  
  
Once you've constructed your report, [enter the report URL and your ISU credentials](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/11006737633307) in HRIS Link and reach out to your Greenhouse technical consultant.

They'll enable HRIS Link, and users created or updated in Workday®️ will automatically sync to Greenhouse Recruiting. [Learn more](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058912031).

#### Sample report output
    
    
    <wd:Report_Data>  
    <wd:Report_Entry>  
        <wd:First_Name>James</wd:First_Name>  
        <wd:Last_Name>Bond</wd:Last_Name>  
        <wd:Email>007@mi6.co.uk</wd:Email>  
        <wd:Employee_ID>007</wd:Employee_ID>  
        <wd:Enabled>1</wd:Enabled>  
        <wd:send_email_invite>1</wd:send_email_invite>  
    </wd:Report_Entry>  
    </wd:Report_Data>

#### Recommended filters

  * First name should not be blank.
  * Last name should not be blank.
  * Email should not be blank.
  * Employee ID should not be blank.
  * Exclude employees whose termination date is longer than 1 day ago.



### Add custom user fields to your report

In addition to the standard fields listed in the specifications above, HRIS Link supports importing data into [custom user fields](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/7626796336283). HRIS Link supports single-select, multi-select, yes / no, and user field types for custom user fields.

For all fields, the report column header must match either the custom field immutable key, like`cost_center`, or the field name, like Cost Center _,_ in Greenhouse Recruiting.

**Note** : HRIS Link user import supports required custom fields, if the custom field is marked required on the user import report. If a required custom field has a `NULL` value on the report, you'll receive an [error](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360059987811#h_01GGFQ2AYW23Q1VNJFCXGZ9ART).

Use the table below to explore supported data formats.

**Tip** : Viewing your HRIS Link job import report in SimpleXML format helps ensure each column is formatted as expected.

**Greenhouse Recruiting field type** |  **Notes** |  **Supported values and formats** |  **Sample report field**  
---|---|---|---  
Yes / No |  N/A |  Yes, No, True, False, 1, 0 values only | 
    
    
    <wd:Exempt>  
    Yes  
    </wd:Exempt>  
  
Single-select |  N/A |  Text match with an existing custom field option | 
    
    
    <wd:Job_Profile>  
    Software Engineer 1  
    </wd:Job_Profile>  
  
Reference ID of the custom field option value  
(requires RaaS custom option sync enabled) | 
    
    
    <wd:Job_Profile>  
    7737702002  
    </wd:Job_Profile>  
  
Multi-select |  Semicolon-delimited list of options. |  Text match with a custom field option | 
    
    
    <wd:Remote_Locations>  
    New York;California  
    </wd:Remote_Locations>  
  
Reference ID of the custom field option value  
(requires RaaS custom option sync enabled) | 
    
    
    <wd:Remote_Locations>  
    4009111002;4009111003  
    </wd:Remote_Locations>  
  
User |  This represents a user account in Greenhouse Recruiting (an employee). |  Greenhouse Recruiting user ID (obtainable via user profile URL) | 
    
    
    <wd:Department_Head>  
    820947  
    </wd:Department_Head>  
  
Greenhouse Recruiting user email | 
    
    
    <wd:Department_Head>  
    007@mi6.co.uk  
    </wd:Department_Head>  
  
Greenhouse Recruiting user employee ID | 
    
    
    <wd:Department_Head>  
    112357  
    </wd:Department_Head>  
  
**Note:** Greenhouse Recruiting is not sponsored by, affiliated with, or endorsed by Workday®️.

**Learn more**

[HRIS Link overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360055282972)

[HRIS Link for users](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058975731)

# Sync data using ADP Workforce Now validation tables

**Permissions:** Owners

**Product tier:** Available for the Greenhouse Onboarding subscription tier

Once you've enabled the [ADP Workforce Now](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/210380126) integration with Greenhouse Onboarding, you can transfer specific employee fields across both systems.

Use this article to sync your Greenhouse Onboarding fields successfully to ADP Workforce Now.

#### In this article

  * Step 1: Preparation
  * Step 2: Retrieve your ADP validation tables (ADP values)
  * Update the field's selection options in Greenhouse Onboarding



### Step 1: Preparation

To prepare for the sync, your Greenhouse Onboarding Customer Success Manager (CSM) needs to map your organization's Greenhouse Onboarding fields and selection options to ADP Workforce Now.

The following fields are available to sync from Greenhouse Onboarding to ADP using validation tables:

  * Onboarding Template
  * ADP Company code
  * ADP Job Code
  * Department
  * Location
  * Business unit
  * Marital status
  * Gender
  * Ethnicity
  * Worker category
  * Eligibility Classification
  * Title
  * Cost Center
  * FLSA Status
  * Pay Frequency
  * Federal Tax Filing Marital Status
  * State Tax Filing Marital Status
  * Worked in State
  * Lived in State
  * SUI/SDI Tax Code



**Note****:** This article covers only the employee fields that can be synced using validation tables. Review our [FAQ](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/214013343) for a full list of employee information that can be transferred using the integration.

Contact your CSM with a list of fields you'd like to sync. They'll begin the mapping process between Greenhouse Onboarding and ADP.

While your CSM performs the mapping process, follow the steps below to export the validation tables in ADP.

### Step 2: Retrieve your ADP validation tables (ADP values)

ADP values are stored in ADP validation tables. To download the validation table, navigate to your ADP Workforce Now account and click **Setup** from the navigation bar.

Click **Validation Tables** under  _Tools_.

__

From the _Validation Tables_ page, select the **validation table** you'd like to download.

Click **Download** to save the validation table to your computer.

Next,**open** the downloaded validation table.

Locate the ADP value and selection option in the **Code** and **Description** columns. 

Repeat this process for **every field** that will be synced between Greenhouse Onboarding and ADP Workforce Now.

Once you're done, send the validation table(s) to your CSM so they can complete the mapping process in Greenhouse Onboarding.

### Update field selection options in Greenhouse Onboarding

A field's **selection options** are assigned an ADP value. This is an external ID provided by ADP Workforce Note.

Using the downloaded validation tables from ADP Workforce Now, your organization can manually assign each ADP value to a field's selection option in Greenhouse Onboarding.

**Note:** This step is for customers who have already completed setup and need to edit an existing selection option. Any updates to Display Name and ADP Value must be updated **manually** in a current employee's profile.

To update an existing field's ADP values, navigate to **Settings** > **Company Info** > **Fields**.

Select a **field** from the list that will be synced with ADP Workforce Now.

Scroll to **Selection Options**.

Double-click the **ADP Value field** you want to update. Then use your validation table from ADP to input the unique ADP Value.

**Tip** : Copy and paste the **Description** column from the validation table into the **Display Name** column in Greenhouse Onboarding. Similarly, copy and paste the **Code** column from the validation table into the **ADP Value** column in Greenhouse Onboarding.

Click **Save** when you're done.

The field and its selection options are now synced between Greenhouse Onboarding and ADP Workforce Now. **Repeat** as needed for other fields.

# I'm a Site Admin. Why can't I assign certain Job Admin levels to other users?

Site Admins can only assign Job Admins permissions that they have on their own account. 

If a Job Admin level includes one or more permissions the Site Admin does not have, the Site Admin will not see that Job Admin level available when assigning job-based permissions to Job Admin users. 

**Example:** A Site Admin can only assign another user to the Job Admin level **Can view and edit private candidate and application fields** if their account also has that permission stripe.

# Fastr.ai integration

Fastr.ai’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows Greenhouse customers to leverage the power of AI to maximize recruiter efficiency and speed. Fastr.ai is deployed in the form of a browser extension to help recruiters to focus their time on only the well-qualified applicants first, rediscover qualified candidates for each open req within their Greenhouse Recruiting’s ecosystem, and use Fastr.ai’s AI filters to search, find, and organize candidate pipelines. All these, without your recruiters ever have to leave your Greenhouse Recruiting system.

In this article, we will explain the Greenhouse configuration settings that are necessary for the Fastr.ai’s integration. In order for the two systems to communicate with each other, the following Greenhouse mechanisms need to be configured:

  * Harvest API
  * Greenhouse Recruiting webhooks



The correct configuration of these interfaces is required for valid interaction between Fastr.ai and Greenhouse. Configuration details affect the level of integration.

### Create webhooks for the Fastr.ai integration

To integrate Fastr.ai with Greenhouse Recruiting, you'll need to create several webhooks. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163727003) to create your webhooks. Use the values listed below to configure the webhooks.

  * **Secret key:** Provided by the Fastr.ai team
  * **Error email:** Any email from your organization, or left blank
  * **Deactivated?:** No



#### Endpoint URLs

The <fastrai-api-host> and <key> will be provided by Fastr.ai separately. Once received, plug them into the endpoint URL when creating these endpoints.

**Example:** <fastrai-api-host> = xxx.xxx.fastr.ai <key> = b433de06-r241-4415-8236-7djru57f93l0

9 | MR Candidate has changed stage | Candidate has changed stage | https://<fastr-api-host>/api/private/greenhouse/listener/application/stage?key=<key>

15 | MR Job Post Deleted | Job Post Deleted | https://<fastr-api-host>/api/private/greenhouse/listener/job/post/delete?key=<key>  
16 | MR Job Created | Job Created | https://<fastr-api-host>/api/private/greenhouse/listener/job?key=<key>  
17 | MR Job Updated | Job Updated | https://<fastr-api-host>/api/private/greenhouse/listener/job?key=<key>  
18 | MR Job Deleted | Job Deleted | https://<fastr-api-host>/api/private/greenhouse/listener/job/delete?key=<key>  
19 | MR Job Interview Stage Deleted | Job Interview Stage Deleted | https://<fastr-api-host>/api/private/greenhouse/listener/job/stage/delete?key=<key>  
  
Once complete, the integration is configured and ready to use!

### Use the Fastr.ai Integration

Download the Chrome Extension[Click here to download and install](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mojohire-in-app-ai/gpmokkmflidmiehichapaheffefihhac)

Once installed, you’ll be able to maximize your recruiting efficiency and speed by using Fastr.ai right inside Greenhouse Recruiting.

**Applicant Prioritization**

Fastr’s AI matching technology prioritizes each application based on how well it matches to specific job requirements, so recruiters are always reviewing the most qualified candidates.

**Automated Candidate Rediscovery**

When browsing candidate profiles in Greenhouse, quickly find open reqs that match each candidate’s skills and experience. Also find similar candidates to rapidly fill your recruiting pipeline.

**Built-In AI Candidate Search**

Get full access to the entire Greenhouse Recruiting database with flexible AI-enabled filters to help fill open reqs and populate Greenhouse CRM pools

# Business Intelligence Connector update: May 21, 2025

We are updating the Business Intelligence Connector on **Wednesday, May 21, 2025**.

[Download the updated schema](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/article_attachments/36684323536155)

### Overview of changes

To improve reporting on job post locations, we are finalizing a [previously announced update](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/34191521007387) to the Business Intelligence Connector.

#### Deprecation of location field in job_posts table

  * The `location` field will be removed from the `job_posts` table on **May 21, 2025**.
  * This change ensures that all job post location data is centralized in the `job_post_locations` table.



The `job_post_locations` table was added to the BIC schema on February 19, 2025. It supports job posts with multiple locations and offers improved reporting accuracy.

### Required action

If your reports or dashboards reference the `location` field in the `job_posts` table, update them to use the `job_post_locations` table before **May 21, 2025** to avoid disruptions.

# Speak_ integration

Speak_ revolutionizes the hiring process by empowering teams to swiftly assess candidates for any position with custom signals. Our innovative, inclusive, AI-powered scoring system delivers tailored insights to recruiters and hiring teams, enabling precise evaluations aligned with the unique requirements of each role.

Speak_’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows users to score applicants for any role based on the job description, the candidates’ resumes, and custom signals that recruiters provide about what makes a candidate stand out. ### Setting Up Speak_ Integration with Greenhouse

The Speak_ integration with Greenhouse is seamless and easy to use! Here’s how to set it up once you’ve copied your Greenhouse Harvest API Key:

Access your Speak_ account and navigate to the **Settings** tab located in the left-hand navigation bar.

Find and click on **Connect** next to the Greenhouse Integration option.

Paste your Greenhouse Harvest API Key into the designated field.

Then click the **Connect** button to establish the connection.

Initiate your initial data synchronization by clicking the **Sync** button and allow the process to complete.

You can now use Speak_ to evaluate your candidates for the roles that you choose.

### Use the Speak_ integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Analyzing Candidates

Click on the specific role you want to evaluate candidates for. This action will open a modal containing the job description imported from Greenhouse Recruiting.

Customize the evaluation criteria by adding any additional signals you deem necessary for assessing applicants. These signals can include both hard requirements and nice-to-haves, and they are entirely customizable to your needs.

Once you've finalized the additional signals, click “Score this job”. The Speak_ AI will utilize the Greenhouse Integration to assess all applicants, assigning scores based on their suitability for the role. The system will then generate a list starting with the best matches.

You can click on any candidate to access more details about them. With the Speak_ Greenhouse integration, you can easily progress candidates through your hiring pipeline directly within the platform.

For further actions within Greenhouse, you can swiftly open a candidate’s profile in Greenhouse by clicking the “Open in Greenhouse” button.

Thanks to the Speak_ Greenhouse integration, you can effortlessly import your jobs, review each candidate’s resume using the Speak_ AI, and efficiently manage candidates through your hiring pipeline. # Primary recruiter field empty in All Jobs Summary report

The [All Jobs Summary report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/203940239) provides an overview of the jobs in your organization and includes information about each job, including the assigned recruiters.

Occasionally, an All Jobs Summary report will display an empty _Primary Recruiter_ field, while the _Secondary Recruiter_ field is populated.

This occurs when the primary recruiter's [permission level](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360039614171) has changed or when their account has been [deactivated](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115004791523). When either change occurs, the primary recruiter is automatically moved to the _Secondary Recruiter_ field in the report.

# Manage interviewer training programs

**Permissions:** Site Admins

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

If your team uses shadowing or peer interviews to qualify new interviewers, you can manage those training programs directly in Greenhouse—no need to track progress manually in spreadsheets.

This feature supports informal, participation-based training programs. It helps your team monitor who’s in training, what groups they’re in, and when they’re ready to lead interviews on their own.

#### In this article

  * Set up a training program
  * Link a training program to an interview
  * Filter interviewers by training status
  * Promote or graduate interviewers
  * Update training status manually



### Set up a training program

Training programs can be added to interviewer groups under **Configure** > **Custom Options** > **Interviewer Groups**.

You can create a new group or open an existing group by clicking **Edit**.

Once the group is created, open its **Training settings** tab and select the **Add training program** checkbox.

Add the training steps your team uses and click **Save**.

[Read more about interviewer groups here.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/205982075)

### Link a training program to an interview

To track interviewer progress automatically, you'll need to associate a training program with a specific interview.

From the Job Dashboard, click **Job Setup** > **Interview Plan** > and choose the group that contains the interview you want linked to the training program.

Scroll to the **Default group** section and select the interviewer group that includes the training program.

Once saved, interviewers scheduled for that interview will be tracked through the steps in the program.

For trainees, an interview is considered "complete" when a scheduled interview has a status of "completed" or "awaiting feedback."

### Filter interviewers by training status

Users can be filtered by their groups and training statuses during scheduling.

To view a user's training status, click **Filter interviewers** in the scheduling workflow.

You’ll see each interviewer's groups, including any associated training programs and their current status.

### Promote or graduate interviewers

When an interviewer completes a step in the training program, a Site Admin will need to move them to the next step. When all steps are completed, Site Admins can mark them as "Trained."

Site Admins are notified when interviewers are ready to be promoted or graduated. Notifications appear in the **Tasks** widget and in a weekly roundup email.

To update someone’s training status, go to the associated Interviewer group and click the button next to their name.

### Update training status manually

You can update a user's training status directly on the associated Interviewer group.

To update a single person, click the ellipsis icon next to their name.

To update multiple people at once, select their rows and use the bulk action menu at the top of the page.

# Find your Greenhouse Recruiting user ID

**Permissions:** Site Admin, and Job Admin who can add and remove users to their assigned jobs

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Greenhouse Recruiting user IDs allow you to associate data sent within configured integrations.

A user's ID is included in API calls within the "on-behalf-of" header in order to log changes made within the API. This ensures the correct user is credited for the action. 

**Note:** For more information on using our API, check out our [developer resources](https://developers.greenhouse.io/).

#### In this article

  * Find a user ID in Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Export user IDs from Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Request user IDs with the Harvest API



### Find a user ID in Greenhouse Recruiting

Go to **Configure **> **Users** , then select a user from the list.

When you reach the _Edit User_ page, copy the user ID from the URL in your browser. 

**Example:** In the URL `https://www.app.greenhouse.io/account/user/12345`,[ ](https://www.app.greenhouse.io/account/user/12345,)the user ID is `12345`.

### Export user IDs from Greenhouse Recruiting

Go to **Configure **> **Users** and click **Export to Excel**.

Open the downloaded file. To find the ID for each of your users, navigate to the **User ID** column.

### Request user IDs with the Harvest API

To get a list of all users and their corresponding user IDs using the [Harvest API](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029266032), you or your development team can send a request to the [List Users](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-users) endpoint.

The user ID will show in the **ID** field.

# Configure one-stage job approvals

**Permissions:** Site Admin, who can create and override default approval flows

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Job approvals enable your organization to exercise greater control when opening a job or generating an offer for candidates. When you [set up a new job approval flow](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360062257351) in Greenhouse Recruiting, you can choose between one-stage and two-stage approval processes, which give different levels of control and oversight.

In a [one-stage approval process](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025756071), you'll configure a single stage to request approval before a job can be opened for recruiting. 

#### In this article

  * Add a new job approval workflow
  * Add approvers
    * Sequential job approval steps
    * Non-sequential job approval steps
  * Job approvers by office and department



### Add a new job approval workflow

To configure one-stage job approvals, click the **Configure** icon  in the upper-right corner and select **Approvals** from the left panel.

From this page, you can configure a one-stage job approval for your entire organization or per office/department.

* Number of approvers is dependent on how approvals are configured

If you'd like to also require approval for offers, you can use two-stage job approvals. [Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025776391) for more information. 

### Add approvers

Navigate to the _Job Approvals_ panel and click **Add Approval Step**.

Click **Add** in the next window to select users from the dropdown menu. Repeat this step as necessary to add multiple approvers to this step.

**Note:** The approver list will only contain users with the following permissions:

  * Site Admin with the user-specific permission **Can see private notes, salary info, manage offers, and approve jobs/offers**
  * Job Admin with the permission stripe **Can view and edit private job fields and approve/request approval on jobs** on All Future Jobs.



Depending on how your organization decides to configure its approval flow, you can set how many approvers from the list need to approve a job before it moves to the next step. Use the _**Required**_ dropdown menu at the top of the dialog box to select the required number of approvers.

In the following example, only **1 of 2** of the listed users need to approve a job before it advances.

When you're finished, click **Save.** The approval step will display next to the job approval stage.

When approval is requested, the selected users will receive an email notification about a pending approval. 

You can repeat the steps above to add more than one step to your approval process. Once created, you can choose to make your approval process use sequential or non-sequential steps when moving a job through the pipeline. See the sections below for more information. 

#### Sequential job approval steps

**Sequential job approval steps** mean that your approvers have to grant the offer approval in a specific order to move the job through the workflow. This sequencing allows you to maintain additional control if your organization has detailed processes. 

**Example:** Your organization has decided any new job requires approval from both a mid-level and senior member of your recruiting team before you can start recruiting candidates.

However, to save time and reduce distractions, you only want the senior members of the team to review jobs that have already been approved by the mid-level recruiter.

In this situation, you can use sequential approval steps to ensure that all approvals are sent to the mid-level recruiter first, and only notify the senior member if they are approved.

To create a sequential flow of required approvals across multiple users, create at least 2 approval steps.

Select **In Order** from the dropdown menu in the top right corner of the step. This selection will now sequentially follow the stages as they've been outlined. When steps are in order, a small arrow icon will display between the sequential stages.

#### Non-sequential job approval steps

Using **non-sequential job approval steps** still requires users to approve the job, but allows the approval to occur in any order since all the notifications are sent at once. Non-sequential job approvals are ideal for organizations that require more than one approval in their workflow but don't need them to happen in a specific order. 

**Example:** Before posting a job, you want approval from a both senior recruiter and a member of your finance team who verifies that the role's start date and other information is correct.

By setting up non-sequential steps, you can send the approval to the recruiting team and finance team simultaneously, and they can approve or not approve the job as needed. 

To create a non-sequential job approval process across multiple users, create at least 2 approval steps.

Select **All at once** in the top right corner of the _Official job approval_ box. When approval is requested, all the listed approvers will be notified simultaneously. 

### Configure job approvers by office or department

Instead of configuring a singular one-stage job approval for your entire organization, you can configure one-stage job approvals by office or department.

**Note:** Any office and/or department **not** configured with an approval process defaults to your organization's approval process.

To configure an approval process for a specific office and/or department, click **Add Approval by office/department**.

Use the provided dropdown menus to select an **office** and/or **department**. When finished, click **Create**.

Create an approval process for the selected office and/or department.

**Note:** Unlike [default offer approvals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360035987291) that provide the option to apply newly created workflows to existing jobs in Greenhouse Recruiting, created default job approval workflows can't be added to existing jobs directly in-app. 

Organizations can, however, loop in developer resources to utilize Greenhouse Recruiting's [Harvest API](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html), to add or replace created job approval workflows on their existing jobs.

Using the `PUT: Create or replace an approval flow`endpoint [will create or replace the entirety of an approval flow](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#put-create-or-replace-an-approval-flow) on a certain job or offer as long as the following conditions are true:

  * The **Reopening a job with approval should require reapproval** permission policy is enabled within your [organization's permission policies](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002226606)
  * The [job status for existing jobs](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025208872) has been adjusted after the new approval flow is added



**Tip💡:** If an existing job's approval workflow doesn't update after making changes through the API, modify the job status to **Closed** > **Open**. The changes should reflect once the job is reopened.

# Release Notes: April 2024

Greenhouse Software regularly releases new product features, updates, and improvements. You can stay up to date by following our [release notes](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200929955) or checking out the [latest feature releases](https://www.greenhouse.com/greenhouse-latest-features) page.

#### This month's releases

  * Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Business Intelligence Connector
  * Integrations
  * Bug fixes



### Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Spring packaged release

Greenhouse launched its spring packaged release, dedicated to decreasing time to fill and streamlining the recruiting process.

You can read more about everything in the release in [our blog post](https://www.greenhouse.com/blog/greenhouse-spring-2024-new-releases-designed-to-decrease-time-to-fill-and-streamline-the-recruiting-process), or keep up with the [latest feature releases](https://www.greenhouse.com/greenhouse-latest-features) on our website.

#### Texting, powered by Grayscale

Greenhouse's evolved integration with Grayscale seamlessly embeds 1:1 and bulk texting, along with automation capabilities, into Greenhouse Recruiting. Read more in our [blog post](https://www.greenhouse.com/blog/boost-high-volume-hiring-with-texting-powered-by-grayscale).

#### Other changes

In addition to the packaged release, Greenhouse has released several smaller, but impactful changes across our product:

  * Created new setting to define the date/time format for the entire organization on the _Configure_ page.
  * Greenhouse Sourcing Automation customers can now control their organization's use of AI tools from a new tab on the _Configure_ page.
  * Added departments, offices, job post locations, EEOC status, and demographic questions to .csv exports of job posts.
  * Updated job setup so stages can be copied from closed and draft jobs.
  * Added option to make phone numbers, social media links, or resumes required when submitting referrals.
  * Updated CRM user permissions to allow more control over which Job Admins can view the CRM, create prospect pools and stages, and assign owners to prospects.
  * Updated GDPR consent emails to send automatically to candidates and prospects added through the Harvest API if your organization has chosen to send GDPR data consent emails to manually added candidates or prospects. 



### Business Intelligence Connector

  * A new Business Intelligence Connector schema was released on April 12, 2024. [Read more here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/24195473682843-Business-Intelligence-Connector-update-April-12-2024)



### Integrations

  * **Candidate testing:** [Talent Titan](https://www.greenhouse.com/integrations/talent-titan) integrates seamlessly with Greenhouse, automating the creation of JD-specific assessments to evaluate and shortlist candidates before the final interview.
  * **Free job posts:** [X Hiring organic job posts](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/25140309418267-X-Hiring-organic-job-posts-integration) allows you to post jobs for free on X.
  * **HRIS and onboarding:** [ExponentHR](https://www.greenhouse.com/integrations/exponenthr) builds a lasting relationship with a state-of-the-art system that makes your job easier, adds value to your company, and gives you the data you need to reach the pinnacle of your potential.
  * **Job board:** [TeamWork Online's](https://www.greenhouse.com/integrations/teamwork-online) premium network and proactive data-driven recruiting tools help clients hire talent they couldn’t find anywhere else, candidates with function-specific skills, diverse backgrounds, and passion for the sports business.
  * **Optimization:** [Paraform](https://www.greenhouse.com/integrations/paraform) helps supercharge your hiring with the best startup recruiters and build your all-star team.
  * **Optimization:** [Reczee Screeno](https://www.greenhouse.com/integrations/reczee-screeno) allows recruitment teams to automatically screen and tag the candidates in the Greenhouse pipeline.
  * **Optimization:** [Speak_](https://www.greenhouse.com/integrations/speak) will automatically evaluate your entire pipeline to give recruiters and hiring teams precise signal on every candidate.
  * **Optimization:** [Skyvia](https://www.greenhouse.com/integrations/skyvia) is a universal SaaS data platform for quick and easy solving a wide set of data-related tasks: data integration, automating workflows, cloud data backup, building reports and dashboards, CSV import/export, etc.
  * **Optimization:** [ZYTHR](https://www.greenhouse.com/integrations/zythr) is an analysis tool that provides a better, faster and fairer applicant review process.
  * **Other integrations:** [RapidVerify for Greenhouse Onboarding](https://www.greenhouse.com/integrations/rapidverify) ensures candidate authenticity, mitigates fraud risks, and streamlines your process with real-time ID checks and automated I-9 compliance. 



### Bug fixes

  * Running a bulk action but selecting zero users no longer applies the action to all eligible users.
  * Fixed issue where the Job ID wasn't displaying in the right place when posting jobs on Indeed.
  * Fixed issue where candidtes could submit applications without answering required questions.
  * Updated the job post request email rules to no longer send emails when moving stages.
  * Fixed issue where the All Candidates page couldn't be filtered by specific dates.
  * Fixed issue where anonymized candidate diata still had the GDPR banner displayed.
  * Made update to remove scheduled emails when the candidate's data is anonymzied.
  * Fixed error message on interviews with no assigned interviewers.
  * Updated Harvest API to more reliably recreate jobs if the request initially fails.
  * Fixed timeout issues when calling demographic_answers, greenhouse_job_applications table through the API.
  * Fixed labeling issue when updating an offer with an out-of-range amount.
  * Improved loading times of My Dashboard.

# Add a company initiative for DE&I

**Permissions:** Site Admin

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Sharing your company's Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DE&I) initiative gives your employees greater visibility into your priorities and the intended impact of a DE&I initiative. Likewise, by sharing your initiative with users at key moments, you can take advantage of another opportunity to communicate how employees will contribute to building stronger and more diverse teams for your team.

Greenhouse Recruiting believes it is important to share the vision for your company's DE&I initiative in your own words, so unlike the nudges included in the DE&I feature set, Greenhouse Recruiting does not provide your company with default language or text for this feature.

Instead, we provide a space and some starter questions to help you think about your company's message, which you can then use to write your own initiative.

### Configure the language for your company's DE&I initiative

You will need to input the copy for your company's DE&I initiative before the feature can be activated.

To start, navigate to the **Configure** page and click **Inclusion Tools.**

Scroll to the _Company Initiative for Diversity and Inclusion_ section and click **Configure**.

Enter your message explaining your company's DE&I initiative. If you need help starting, take a look at the starter questions above the text box.

Any formatting (bold, font size, or spacing) will display when your employees view your DE&I initiative in Greenhouse Recruiting.

When you're finished, click **Save**.

Click the toggle next to _Share your company's initiative for building stronger, more diverse teams_ to make your message visible for your employees in Greenhouse Recruiting.

### Access your company's initiative for DE&I in Greenhouse Recruiting

Once configured and activated, your company's DE&I explainer appears as a pop-up window in a couple of places in Greenhouse Recruiting.

A preview of your DE&I initiative will display on the right side of the _Dashboard_ and _[Inclusion](https://app.greenhouse.io/inclusion) _pages. Users can click **Read More** to view the entire message.

Additionally, your company's DE&I initiative can be accessed in [Sourcing](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360004977311-Sourcing-Nudges), [Application Review](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360004977451-Application-Review-Nudge), and [Interviewing](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360004977491-Interviewing-Features) nudges by clicking **Learn More**.

**Note:** In order for your DE&I messages to display on this page, you must have [inclusion nudges](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360004977491) enabled.

# Spotted Zebra integration

Spotted Zebra is an award-winning Interview Intelligence and Assessment platform that helps enterprise companies build a high-performing, future-ready workforce more efficiently at scale. We combine industry-leading skills science and AI to automate administrative tasks, streamline collaboration, and accelerate workflows - surfacing meaningful talent insights instantly and empowering teams to make more objective, data-informed hiring decisions with confidence every time.

Spotted Zebra’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows you to seamlessly add Spotted Zebra’s assessment to a job's interview plan.

#### In this article

  * Enable the Spotted Zebra integration
  * Use the Spotted Zebra integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

### Enable the Spotted Zebra integration

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923) to retrieve your API key from your Spotted Zebra representative and add the assessment stage in your interview plans. 

Contact your Spotted Zebra Customer Success Manager to receive instructions about connecting your Greenhouse tenant with Spotted Zebra.

# Candidate preferred first name

**Permissions:** Site Admins and Job Admins

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Allowing candidates to provide a preferred first name shows your company’s commitment to an inclusive hiring process. Many people use a nickname or a name that better reflects their identity, rather than their legal name. Knowing a candidate’s preferred name before the first interview helps create a positive and welcoming first impression.

### Turn on the preferred first name field

The preferred first name field can be turned on when editing a [job post](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002791566). You can hide the field completely, make it optional, or require it. By default, the field will be optional.

While filling out their application, the candidate will see a field to enter a preferred first name.

### Where you'll see the candidate's preferred name

If a candidate has entered a preferred first name it will be prioritized in the following experiences:

  * Candidate profile
  * Scorecards



When it's important to identify a candidate by either their legal name or preferred first name, their legal name will appear first, followed by their preferred name in parentheses, and then their last name.

A candidate's full name will be displayed in both search and when viewing the  _All candidates_ page.

Any documents or processes of legal significance, like a background check, will use the candidate's legal name.

Use the [token](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360007039771) **{{PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME}}** to insert the candidate's preferred first name into emails. To include both their preferred first name and last name, use **{{PREFERRED_FULL_NAME}}**.

If the field was left empty or is unavailable, the token **{{PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME}}** will use the candidate's first name. For **{{PREFERRED_FULL_NAME}}** , the token will use the candidate's first and last name.

**Note:** LinkedIn Apply Connect and Indeed Apply do not currently support preferred names. Candidates applying through these platforms will be unable to specify their preferred names.

# Edit opening on job with no approval process

**Permissions:** Site Admin, and Job Admin who can edit job info

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

In Greenhouse Recruiting, the process to edit openings on an existing job depends on that job's [approval process](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025756071).

This article covers how to edit the details for openings on a job that doesn't have a configured approval process. 

#### In this article

  * View your openings 
  * Opening ID
  * Opening Status
  * Open Date for Opening
  * Target Start Date for Opening
  * Close Date for Opening
  * Close Reason for Opening
  * Custom Opening Field for Opening



#### View your openings 

To start, click **Jobs** from the navigation bar and **select the job** from the  _All Jobs_ dashboard. 

Navigate to the **Job Info** page. (**Job Setup** > **Job Info**)

Scroll to the bottom of the page until you reach the _Openings_ panel and click **Manage Openings**.

Select a specific **opening** from the left-hand panel of the _Manage Openings_ box. 

The details for the selected opening will populate in the right-hand panel. Continue editing your opening using the following sections of this article. 

### Opening ID

Opening IDs allow your organization to track openings on jobs in a systematic fashion based on naming conventions unique to your company's internal processes. 

Add the **Opening ID** for the select opening, then click **Save** when finished.

### Opening Status

An opening's status can be toggled between open and closed. [Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360028137532) to learn more about how to close an opening on a job.

Change the status of an opening by selecting **Open** or **Closed** from the _Status_ dropdown menu. Then, click **Save** when finished. 

### Open Date for Opening

The Open Date allows your organization to see when a job opening was opened. This field is editable since some organizations may have [evergreen jobs](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000891392) that are perpetually open and requires you to update the Open Date for more accurate [Time to Hire](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/204635705) data. 

Click the **Open Date** and use the calendar to select a new date. Then, click **Save** when finished. 

**Note** : If you manually change an opening's open or close dates, you should ensure that the job open and close dates (under **Job** **Setup** > **Job** **Info**) are also changed to match. This ensures your reports don't show disparate data.

### 

### Target Start Date for Opening

An opening's Target Start Date allows your organization to set a goal against a job opening. This can help keep your hiring team on track and allows your organization to measure hiring performance.

Click the **Target Start Date** and use the calendar to select a new date. Click **Save** when finished. 

### Close Date for Opening

An opening's Close Date can only be edited when the opening's status is set to closed.

Click the **Close Date** and use the calendar to select a date. 

**Note** : If you manually change an opening's open or close dates, you should ensure that the job open and close dates (under **Job** **Setup** > **Job** **Info**) are also changed to match. This will ensure your reports don't show disparate data.

Add a close reason (optional). Click **Save** when finished. 

### Close Reason for Opening

An opening's Close Reason can only be edited when the opening's status is set to closed. 

Click the **Close Reason** and select an option from the dropdown menu. Click **Save** when finished. 

### Custom Opening Field for Opening

A [custom opening field](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360036372071) allows your organization to record select information on a per opening basis rather than for the entire job. 

Custom opening fields are displayed at the bottom of the page. Edit the response of the custom field and click **Save**. 

The response to the custom opening field is recorded and the response will appear in the [Job Status report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360003333251). 

**Note** : Custom opening fields can be edited for **Open** , **Pending** , and **Closed** job openings.

# Guide integration

With Guide, recruiting teams invite their candidates to a single hub to manage everything they need during their hiring process, from interview details to timelines, prep materials, and more. Because Guide acts as the candidate's home base for updates and real-time information, Guide unlocks rich insights that help talent teams understand which candidates are engaged and which are at risk of dropping off.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Guide allows you to automatically create, send, and update Guide content based on each candidate's interview stage in Greenhouse Recruiting. The integration allows enables the automatic import of key information for candidates, such as interviewer profiles and interview schedules.

#### In this article

  * Set up the Guide integration
    * Create a Harvest API key
    * Provide your API key credentials to Guide
    * Create web hooks in Greenhouse Recruiting
    * Install the the Guide Extension for Google Chrome and complete setup

### Set up the Guide integration

#### Create a Harvest API key

To configure the Greenhouse Recruiting / Guide integration, you'll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the credentials and permissions below are selected when configuring the Guide integration.

#### Credentials

  * **API type:** Harvest

#### Permissions

When finished, click **Save**.

Your Harvest API key for the Greenhouse Recruiting / Guide integration is created and configured. Copy the key to provide to Guide in the next step.

#### Provide your API key credentials to Guide

With your Harvest API key securely copied, navigate to Guide's [Integrations page](https://guides.resource.io/settings/integrations) via Guide Dashboard > **Settings** > **Integrations** and choose Greenhouse.

Paste your API key in the _Harvest API Key_ field.

Two other fields must be completed: the Single Sign On (SSO) subdomain and Greenhouse Maildrop address. Guide needs these two pieces of information to communicate with your Greenhouse Recruiting account, and to ensure email messages sent through Guide appear in each candidate's Activity Feed in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Locate your company's subdomain by logging into your Greenhouse Recruiting account. Note the URL in your address bar: this usually is either `app`, `app2`, `app3`, or `companyname.greenhouse.io`.

Locate your company's Maildrop address by visiting [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201990630). Find and copy your Maildrop email address for logging candidate conversations.

Paste your subdomain, and Maildrop email address in the integration setup in Guide and click **Save**.

#### Create web hooks in Greenhouse Recruiting

Connecting web hooks between Greenhouse Recruiting and Guide enables Guide to be notified when changes are made to candidates within Greenhouse Recruiting. This allows powerful functionality like updating a candidate's Guide content when they move interview stages, or sending them an email after they apply.

To retrieve the information for the web hooks, navigate to the Guide _Integrations_ page and click **Configure** under Greenhouse. Follow the instructions to create a webhook, and repeat the same process for each one requested. This will take approximately 10 minutes.

**Note** : The fastest way to create the webhooks is to open a second tab for Greenhouse Recruiting's [webhook configuration page](https://app.greenhouse.io/web_hooks), and switch between both tabs in tandem.

#### Install the the Guide Extension for Google Chrome and complete setup

**Note** : The [Guide Extension](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/guide/hpdfplaccgajokgmocbcpiicbkkjione) is currently supported for the Google Chrome browser. Users of Microsoft Edge may encounter limited success using the Guide Extension, however, Guide does not currently officially support Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, or any other browser.

As the final step to enable the Guide integration, you'll need to install the Guide extension for Google Chrome.

Navigate to [Guide](https://app.guide.co/login) and click your user image in the top-right corner of your Guide Dashboard to populate user settings. From the dropdown, select **Install Chrome extension**.

Alternatively, to directly download the Guide extension, [click here](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/guide/hpdfplaccgajokgmocbcpiicbkkjione).

#### Update the Guide Extension for Google Chrome

Chrome does a updates your extensions automatically, but it checks for updates on its own schedule. Occassionally we may request you proactively update the Guide Extension for Chrome.

To perform a manual update, start Google Chrome and click the vertical ellipsis icon tool icon on the browser toolbar.

From there, select **More Tools** → **Extensions** and then, click the _Developer Mode_ button on the right side of the header. 

Next, find and click the _Update_ button. Once done, the extension update should run as expected. 

### Additional resources

For troubleshooting or setup assistance, please contact the Guide support team at [support@guide.co](mailto:support@guide.co) or refer to Guide's support article [Integrating with Greenhouse](https://support.guide.co/en/articles/4543311-integrating-with-greenhouse).

# HireHunch integration

HireHunch is primarily an 'Interview As a Service' company. We help companies to do the initial round of technical interviews so that their core engineering/product team only speaks to the best of the lot. Currently, we are focused mostly on all software engineering functions along with Product and UI/UX.

Greenhouse Recruiting’s integration with HireHunch allows recruiters to schedule technical interviews with external interviewers directly from Greenhouse

The Greenhouse integration with HireHunch only needs to be configured by one user from your company, however, all users should download the HireHunch Chrome Extension.

#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API key for the HireHunch integration
  * Find your job board token and create a job board API key
  * Create a webhook
  * Activate HireHunch’s Chrome Extension
  * Add the HireHunch interview stage
  * Use the HireHunch integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



### Create a Harvest API key for the HireHunch integration

To configure the Greenhouse Recruiting / HireHunch integration, you'll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the credentials and permissions below are selected when configuring the HireHunch integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** HireHunch (optional)
  * **Description:** HireHunch Harvest API key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the HireHunch integration:

**Applications**

  * GET: Retrieve Application



**Jobs**

  * GET: Retrieve Job
  * GET: List Jobs



**Candidates**

  * GET: Retrieve Candidate
  * GET: List Candidate



### Find your job board token and create a job board API key

To make your job posts available to HireHunch, you'll need to send your job board token to HireHunch.

You can find your job board URL by navigating to **Configure** > **Job Boards & Posts** > **Ellipsis** icon next to your job board **Edit Board Settings** , then scrolling to the URL field.

Copy the token at the end of the URL and send it to HireHunch.

[Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888210160155) for a more detailed walkthrough of locating your job board URL.

#### Create a job board API key

To enable the integration, you'll need to create a job board API key for HireHunch.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888210160155) and use the information below when creating your API key:

  * **API type:** Job Board
  * **Description:** HireHunch Job Board API key



Copy the job board API key to a secure location to provide to HireHunch.

### Create a webhook

To integrate HireHunch with Greenhouse Recruiting, you'll need to create a webhook. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163727003) to create your webhook. Use the values listed below to configure the webhooks.

  * **Name** : HireHunch integration
  * **When** : Job Post Updated
  * **Endpoint URL** : The Endpoint URL provided by HireHunch
  * **Secret Key** : The Secret Key provided by HireHunch



### Activate HireHunch’s Chrome Extension

Download HireHunch’s Chrome Extension. Be sure you are logged in to your HireHunch account.

In HireHunch, navigate to Integrations on the left menu bar to see the Greenhouse integration section. Click ‘Generate API Key’ to land on the Greenhouse Integration page.

Under “Add the API Key to HireHunch’s Chrome Extension”, click on Generate API Key and click Copy to save it to your clipboard.

Paste the API Key on the HireHunch chrome extension activation page and click Submit.

### Add the HireHunch interview stage

In Greenhouse, you need to create a HireHunch Interview stage to the interview plans of your jobs. Select a job and click on "Job Setup" Scroll down to the Interview Plan and click "Edit".

Click "Add Stage" and type HireHunch Interview under Create New Stage. Click "Add" to incorporate the HireHunch Interview stage to your interview plan. Repeat this on all jobs you want to use the integration on.

#### Create a custom job field for HireHunch

In Greenhouse, you’ll create a custom field to “tag” jobs that HireHunch will then pull. The custom field will indicate where a HireHunch Interview is required.

Click the Configure (gear) icon in the upper right-hand corner. Then, navigate to Custom Options on the left-hand panel. From the Custom Options page, click Jobs under Company Custom Fields.

Click on **Add Field**. Enter the following information on the page:

  * **Field Name:** Assessment
  * **Description:** HireHunch Interviewing Platform
  * **Field Type:** Single Select
  * **Options:** HireHunch
  * **Expose in Job Board API: Y** es



Click Save. Remember to select HireHunch from this field while creating jobs and HireHunch will then be able to pull the job.

### Use the HireHunch integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

Open a candidate's profile in Greenhouse and click **Schedule Interview** in the HireHunch Interview stage.

Fill out the date and time. Then, select an interviewer from the dropdown list. Click the green Schedule and Continue button in the bottom right.

Click the green**Send Invites** button to send the invitation.

That's it! You're all set.

Now, HireHunch will export the candidate’s information from Greenhouse, add it under the respective job post, and schedule the candidate’s interview with HireHunch’s interviewer panel.

Please be aware of a few functions that are not currently possible due to limitations with both platforms. HireHunch will continue to develop the HireHunch/Greenhouse integration, and hope to provide more functionalities as new product enhancements are released.

  1. Every recruiter should download and activate HireHunch’s chrome extension. Without this functionality, the interview has to be scheduled by logging in to the HireHunch account only.
  2. HireHunch Feedback form cannot be filled in Greenhouse. Hiring manager and or recruiter have to fill the feedback form on HireHunch only.
  3. There is no way to resend, reschedule, or cancel a HireHunch invitation from Greenhouse.
  4. Greenhouse allows a single test result per job application.
  5. HireHunch Evaluation results cannot be updated after they are populated.
  6. There is no synchronisation with Greenhouse if you send an invitation from HireHunch directly (inviting through HireHunch does not automatically show up in Greenhouse).



### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [support@hirehunch.com](mailto:support@hirehunch.com).

Developer permissions are a subset of user-specific permissions which allow a particular user to manage Greenhouse features related to APIs, webhooks, and certain integrations.

#### In this article

### Assign or remove developer permissions

# Task management overview

**Permissions:** –

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Greenhouse Recruiting includes a variety of ways to stay up to date on your hiring progress, manage important tasks, and keep tabs on candidate progress.

#### In this article

  * Alerts
  * Candidate notifications
  * Follow-up reminders
  * Job notifications
  * Tasks



### Alerts

Alerts let your team know when a candidate has remained in a given stage for too long. Alerts help ensure candidates aren't unintentionally overlooked, improving the candidate experience and your hiring metrics.

Your team can choose which of a job's stages should include an alert, and define when to trigger each alert. Alerts are configured from the job's interview plan page.

Members of the job's hiring team and Site Admins can view activated alerts on the **Job Dashboard** page in the _Pipeline_ _Tasks_ panel.

Check out the following articles to learn more about configuring and using alerts:

  * [Edit candidate alert settings](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200346659)
  * [Edit candidate alert settings in bulk](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202615909)



### Candidate notifications

**Note:** Organizations can choose to turn off the ability to follow a candidate for their entire Greenhouse Recruiting instance. If your organization has deactivated this feature, you can't follow candidates, prospects, or referrals to receive notifications.

Candidate notifications are automated emails sent to a user when a candidate or prospect they are following is advanced to a new stage or rejected from a job. The contents of the automated emails cannot be edited.

Job Admin and Site Admin users can follow any candidate or prospect they have permission to view. Basic users can follow their submitted referrals.

Check out the articles below to learn more about following candidates, prospects, or referrals:

  * [Follow: Email notifications about referrals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360018233971-Follow-Email-notifications-about-referrals)
  * [Follow: Email notifications about candidates or prospects](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/203800369)



### Follow-up reminders

Follow-up reminders help users track and complete custom candidate-specific tasks with a future due date.

To create a follow-up reminder, navigate to the right panel on a candidate's profile and click **\+ Add** next to Follow-up reminder. Select the date the reminder should occur, then choose users by name or hiring team role to receive the reminder. Add notes with any next steps, then click **Set Follow-up**.

When due, follow-up reminders appear on the assigned user's **My** **Dashboard** page in the _My Reminders_ panel. Assigned users also receive an emailed reminder on the due date.

Check out the following article to learn more: [Follow-up reminders](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360017456592).

### Job notifications

Job notifications are automated emails sent when a specified event occurs, and help hiring team members stay closely informed about a job's pipeline. Job notifications can be configured for the following types of events:

  * New candidates submitted
  * New scorecards submitted
  * Scorecard due reminders
  * Approvals requested or issued
  * Candidate moved stages



Job notifications can be configured at the job level by navigating to a job > **Job Setup** > **Notifications** , or at the user level by selecting your initials at the top-right on the navigation bar > **Account Settings** > Notification Preferences. When configured at the user level, you can choose to set specific notification types for all jobs where someone has permissions, or for specific jobs only.

When a notification is triggered, the user receives a default email from Greenhouse Recruiting. The text of these emails cannot be edited.

Many notifications, such as scorecard reminder notifications, also can be sent via the [Slack integration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/207344866).

Check out the following article to learn more about notifications on jobs: [Job notification overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360024629571).

### Tasks

Tasks are specific actions in Greenhouse Recruiting that are assigned automatically to a user based on their role on a job's hiring team.

**Example** : The user assigned as a candidate's coordinator is responsible for all the candidate's scheduling-related tasks.

Only Job Admin and Site Admin users can be assigned hiring team roles and thus be assigned tasks. It is not possible to manually assign tasks to a user.

A user's assigned tasks appear on their **My Dashboard** page, in the _My Tasks_ panel. Site Admins can view all outstanding tasks for all candidates from the **My Dashboard** page in the _All Tasks_ panel.

Tasks include activities such as:

  * Advancing / rejecting a candidate once all scorecards are submitted for a stage (recruiter)
  * Sending take home tests (recruiter)
  * Completing hiring manager review (hiring manager)
  * Scheduling (coordinator)



Check out the following articles to learn more about the tasks assigned to each hiring team role:

  * [Hiring team role: Hiring manager](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360016572311)
  * [Hiring team role: Coordinator](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360016347752)
  * [Hiring team role: Recruiter](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360016347712)
