# CodeSignal integration

CodeSignal's AI-native skills platform helps you clearly see, measure, and develop the skills that matter most.

CodeSignal's integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows users to send assessments to test-takers as well as receive the scores in Greenhouse. To implement this integration, you need to authorize CodeSignal to use your Greenhouse account.

#### In this article

  * Enable the integration
    * Configure Assessment API
    * Configure CodeSignal Pre-Screen
  * Use the integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



### Enable the integration

Log in to your CodeSignal account and click **Config** at the top of your dashboard. You can also access this page directly from [this Greenhouse ATS Integrations page link](https://app.codesignal.com/client-dashboard/integrations/ats.greenhouse).

Click **Integrations**.

Fill in the appropriate **Greenhouse subdomain** for your account. Your subdomain will be _app_ , _app2,_ or _[yourcompany]_.

Under Client configuration, click **Connect to Greenhouse**. When prompted, click **Authorize** to allow CodeSignal to access your Greenhouse account.

Once connected, you will be redirected back to CodeSignal and see confirmation of the connection.

[Optional] Create custom fields for your assessments.

**Default Greenhouse User** : In this field, you may specify the Greenhouse user account that will be used to submit feedback or add notes when a more accurate matching user cannot be found. For convenience, you can create a new Greenhouse user account for this purpose.

#### Configure Assessment API

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923) to retrieve your API key from CodeSignal and add the assessment stage in your interview plans. In CodeSignal, this key can be found within the **ASSESSMENT API** tab.

Once you've set up your interview plans and configured your take home test, you'll be able to send the test to candidates.

#### Configure CodeSignal Pre-Screen

In Greenhouse, you will now be able to add the **CodeSignal Pre-Screen stage** to the interview plans of your choice. Select a job and click on "Job Setup." Scroll down to Interview Plan and click "Edit."

Click "Add Stage" and select **CodeSignal Pre-Screen**. Click "Add" to incorporate sending a CodeSignal assessment to your interview plan.

Congratulations! You have successfully integrated your Greenhouse account and your CodeSignal account.

### Use the integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

Once the CodeSignal integration is enabled for your organization, you will be able to add the CodeSignal assessment as an interview stage.

You can send an assessment to a candidate by selecting the **Send Test** button next to the interview stage. The assessment instructions will be sent by CodeSignal.

After it has been sent, an assessment's status will display in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Once the candidate has submitted their test, the Interview Kit will contain a link to view the submitted test in the CodeSignal application.

To see a candidate's results in CodeSignal, click **View Report**.

### Additional resources

Read on to learn [how to use CodeSignal to schedule live interviews for your candidates](https://support.codesignal.com/hc/en-us/articles/360045195914-Schedule-CodeSignal-interviews-from-Greenhouse) and [how to view interview feedback within Greenhouse](https://support.codesignal.com/hc/en-us/articles/360045975953-Viewing-Interview-Feedback-in-Greenhouse). Reach out to [support@codesignal.com](mailto:support@codesignal.com) with any questions.

#### Notes & Prerequisites

  * **The Greenhouse integration with CodeSignal only needs to be completed by ONE user from your company.**
  * You must be logged in to your CodeSignal account.
  * You must have a CodeSignal user type of **Admin**.
  * You must be logged in to your Greenhouse account.
  * You must have **developer** permissions on Greenhouse (specifically, "Can manage ALL organization's API Credentials")
scorecard-ratings-overview:
<!-- source: https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360035935611-Scorecard-ratings-overview -->

# Scorecard ratings overview

**Permissions:** —

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

If you've ever seen or filled out a scorecard in Greenhouse Recruiting, you likely noticed our unique measurement scale for assessing candidates using a combination of colors and emojis.

We created our scorecard rating setup using science-based survey methods that account for the various ways an interviewer could interpret a scorecard. Our carefully crafted scorecard rating system provides your organization with the best possible platform to reduce bias and individual differences. 

In this article, we will introduce our justification for excluding numbers, text/worded scales, and our ultimate choice to use color and symbolic scales in Greenhouse Recruiting scorecards. Additionally, this article will share some interesting facts about how people tend to respond to surveys with only the smallest tweaks in measurement scales.

#### In this article

  * Psychometrics
  * Our numerical scale's impact on question responses
  * Cultural and regional response differences to worded measurement scales
  * Colors vs. words
  * Sources



### Psychometrics

Our choice of measurement scale for scorecards was far from random. In fact, our choice was heavily informed by research in the field of **psychometrics**. Psychometrics is the study of quantitative measurement practices in the social sciences.

A psychometrician generally researches best practices in evaluating the quality of metrics (_i.e., survey items_), measurement scales (_i.e., Strongly Disagree to Strongly Disagree_), and other related factors that contribute to the accuracy of the behavior or process you’re trying to capture.1

### Our numerical scale's impact on question responses 

Have you noticed the wide variety of numerical scales used in survey questions to represent the same set of response choices? The following 5-point [Likert scale](https://www.britannica.com/topic/Likert-Scale) is a common set of choices available as a range of answers to a survey question:

Strongly Disagree | Disagree | Neither Agree nor Disagree | Agree | Strongly Agree  
---|---|---|---|---  
1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5  
  
And so is this variation of the same scale:

Strongly Disagree | Disagree | Neither Agree nor Disagree | Agree | Strongly Agree  
---|---|---|---|---  
-2 | -1 | 0 | 1 | 2  
  
Several studies on the use of Likert scales have demonstrated that participants' responses will vary based on the numbers shown (or not shown).2 Survey participants tend to evaluate and assign different weights to numbers, which may introduce bias in a survey's results, especially in small sample sizes.

Traditional academic research tends to collect data from larger sample sizes (For example, 200–300 respondents). This helps balance out the variation in response rates from people’s interpretation of a scale. However, these sample sizes are generally much higher than you will see in the hiring process. 

**Example:** As a Hiring Manager, you'll likely receive candidate ratings from 5 to 10 people and even fewer responses on each of the individual attributes to be evaluated.

This means it's important for your organization to be aware of when and where biases may emerge. Any step Greenhouse Recruiting can take to reduce error and bias improves the quality of your candidate evaluations.

### Cultural and regional response differences to worded measurement scales

Did you know that residents of the United States tend to respond overwhelmingly positively to most survey questions they receive versus residents in other parts of the world?3 These differences in survey responses do not reflect any cultural differences in optimism or agreement. In fact, people in the United States tend to be less positive and trusting of institutions as a whole.4

In the U.S., respondents will likely respond to a question as _Strongly Agree_ unless they have a clear reason to disagree with the statement. In other parts of the world, such as in mainland China,3 respondents will respond more neutrally unless they have a clear justification for strongly agreeing with the statement.

Excluding a worded scale ensures that your Hiring Managers can be confident that your candidate is being evaluated consistently across interviewers, and is not subject to bias associated with different individuals’ interpretations of _Strongly Agree/Strongly Disagree_.

### Colors vs. words

People tend to respond more consistently and powerfully to colors than they do to words. Humans process colors and symbols in a different region of the brain than words or numbers.5 We also more readily associate colors with a negative or positive valuation based on opacity, etc.6

Greenhouse Recruiting uses shades of red, yellow and green for our scorecard rating icons to help provide you with more consistent scorecard results across individuals and teams.

### Sources

  1. Psychometric Society: What is psychometrics? [https://www.psychometricsociety.org/content/what-psychometrics ](https://www.psychometricsociety.org/content/what-psychometrics)
  2. Weijters, B., Cabooter, E., & Schillewaert, N. (2010). The effect of rating scale format on response styles: The number of response categories and response category labels. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijresmar.2010.02.004>
  3. Lee, J. W., Jones, P. S., Mineyama, Y., & Zhang, X. E. (2002). Cultural differences in responses to a Likert scale. Research in nursing & health, 25(4), 295–306. <https://doi.org/10.1002/nur.10041>
  4. Twenge, J. M., Campbell, W. K., & Carter, N. T. (2014). Declines in trust in others and confidence in institutions among American adults and late adolescents, 1972–2012. Psychological Science, 25(10), 1914–1923. [https://doi.org/10.1177/0956797614545133 ](https://doi.org/10.1177/0956797614545133)
  5. Peterson, Bradley S., et al. “An fMRI study of Stroop word-color interference: evidence for cingulate subregions subserving multiple distributed attentional systems.” Biological psychiatry 45.10 (1999): 1237–1258. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0006-3223(99)00056-6>
  6. Piotrowski, C., & Armstrong, T. (2012). Color Red: Implications for applied psychology and marketing research. Psychology and education-An Interdisciplinary Journal, 49, 55–57.

# Request consent from candidates in bulk

**Permissions:** Site Admin  
  
**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

**Note** : In order to utilize Greenhouse Recruiting's built-in request consent functionality, your organization will need to have selected explicit consent as the [legal basis for your GDPR configuration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360042142612).

If you edit the legal basis for your organization to explicit consent, your organization will need to request consent from any candidate and / or prospect who existed in your account prior to the edit.

In this article, we will cover how to request consent from multiple candidates to collect, store, and process their data using Greenhouse Recruiting's bulk action feature.

To request consent from candidates in bulk, click**Candidates** on your navigation bar.

From the _All Candidates_ page, expand **Profile Details** on the left.

Scroll to _GDPR Status_ and select **Consent not requested** from the dropdown.

The list of candidates will be filtered to only individuals who have not yet given consent to have their data collected, stored, and processed.

Click **Bulk Actions** and select users who will be sent a consent request email.

When finished, click **Edit Selected**.

From the bulk action dialog box, click **Request Candidate Consent**.

A subsequent box will ask you to confirm the bulk action. Click **Request Consent**.

An email requesting consent will be sent to all candidates included in the bulk action.

The opportunity for the candidates to **Give** **Consent** or **Deny** **Consent** will be appended to the end of the email.

Candidates and / or prospects will have 30 days to either give or deny consent. This window of time is non-editable.

You can refer to the table below for an overview of how consent will impact an individual candidate's profile:

**Scenario** | ** Action **  
---|---  
Gives consent | Your organization can retain the candidate's or prospect's data in accordance with your organization's data retention rules.  
Denies consent | The candidate or prospect will be immediately queued to have their data deleted from your account  
Does not respond | The candidate or prospect will have 30 days to respond to the consent request email. If the candidate or prospect does not respond in 30 days, they will be queued to have their data deleted from your account.

# Circular integration

Circular is an invite-only community where next-gen recruiters hire curated candidates referred by the best startups and tech companies and improve their candidate's experience by inviting them to Circular.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Circular allows you to receive Circular's curated candidates directly in your Greenhouse Recruiting account, allowing the candidates to more seamlessly connect with your existing workflow.

#### In this article

  * Set up the integration
    * Create a Harvest API key
    * Enable the integration
  * Use the integration
  * Additional resources



### Set up the integration

#### Create a Harvest API key

First, create a Harvest API key in Greenhouse Recruiting. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the credentials and permissions below are selected:

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Circular (optional)
  * **Description:** Circular Harvest API key



Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Circular integration:

  * Applications
  * Candidates
  * Job Posts
  * Job Stages
  * Jobs
  * Sources
  * User Roles
  * Users



Copy your API key to a secure location for use in the next step.

#### Enable the integration

Next, log in to your Circular account and click your profile icon at the top-right. Click **Account** **Settings**.

Scroll to _Connect to your ATS_ and click **Connect**.

Select **Greenhouse** and enter the API key created in the previous step.

Once enabled, the integration is ready to use.

### Use the Circular integration

Once enabled, you'll receive candidates from Circular directly into the application review stage on your jobs. Candidates added to your Greenhouse Recruiting account from Circular will have a source of _Circular_ listed on their **Details** tab.

You can also review referral information other members of the Circular community have left about candidates. These reviews are included within each candidate's resume, located under the **Details** tab on the candidate profile in Greenhouse Recruiting.

To schedule an interview with a candidate added from Circular, advance the candidate to an interview stage in Greenhouse Recruiting. The candidate will receive an automatic email from Circular with your interview interest. If the candidate accepts, Circular will introduce you and the candidate by email. 

### Additional resources

Visit Circular's Help Center articles with detailed information about the integration:

  * [Integrate with Greenhouse Recruiting](https://intercom.help/trycircular/es/articles/3481989-integrate-with-greenhouse)
  * [Receive candidates in your Greenhouse Recruiting account](https://intercom.help/trycircular/es/articles/3482041-receive-candidates-in-your-greenhouse-account)

# Scorecard overview

Scorecards allow your hiring team to review all of a job's candidates using a set of predetermined criteria.

After job criteria are created, interviewers use scorecards to submit feedback on candidates as part of the structured hiring process. Interviewers then review submitted scorecards as a group during the [candidate roundup](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360007247872).

#### In this article

  * Scorecard components
  * Configure a scorecard
  * Reconfigure a scorecard
  * Assign a scorecard
  * Fill out a scorecard
    * Key takeaways
    * Attributes
    * Overall recommendation
  * View a submitted scorecard



### Scorecard components

Scorecards include skills, traits, qualifications, and other attributes you want in a candidate. You can then choose one or more of these as [focus attributes](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360018399451) for interviews.

### Configure a scorecard

You [configure a scorecard](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002194863) during a job's setup. At this time, you can add and categorize attributes on which you will assess candidates. You can also choose which, if any, attributes to focus on during the [candidate roundup](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360003464191).

**Note:** Jobs require a scorecard by default, but you can also make scorecards optional.

### Reconfigure a scorecard

You can reconfigure a scorecard even after a job's status is changed to open. You can [edit one scorecard](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360027708172) at a time or [edit scorecards in bulk](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201993099).

### Assign a scorecard

A scorecard is automatically assigned to an interviewer once their interview is scheduled. 

You can also [assign a scorecard manually](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360053107391). 

**Example:** If you want to request feedback from another team member without scheduling an interview, you can assign a scorecard manually to ensure their input is considered. This method of assigning scorecards also works for group interviews in which every interviewer needs their own scorecard or last-minute interviews that don't require scheduling.

### Fill out a scorecard

Once an interview ends, the interviewer will be able to fill out their scorecard.

The scorecard includes multiple sections.

#### Key takeaways

List your conclusions, pros, cons, and anything that should be followed up on in later interviews. You can also add private notes, add a note for another interview, and @ mention another user.

#### Attributes

Rate how well the candidate demonstrated focus attributes and additional attributes. To learn more about the strategy behind our rating system, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360035935611).

#### Overall recommendation

Give a recommendation of whether the candidate passed the interview. Options include**Definitely Not** , **No** , **Yes,** and **Strong Yes**. If you don't choose an option, it'll be recorded as **No decision** on the saved scorecard.

### View a submitted scorecard

Scorecards can be viewed in the _Scorecards_ tab of a candidate's profile by users with job-based permissions or above. 

Depending on your [permission policies](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002226606), interviewers who submitted a scorecard will be able to view their past scorecards never, always, or only after all other interviewers submit their scorecards for the interview. Access to view these scorecards for users without job-based permissions will be contained within the interview kit solely. 

Whether Job Admin can view all scorecards depends on your [Job Admin level](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040467451) permission policies as scorecard visibility is configurable for these users. Site Admins, however, can [view all scorecards for all candidates](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115005415966) without needing any specific scorecard visibility permissions.

Scorecard editing permissions may also limit how long a scorecard can be edited after submission. Depending on your organization’s settings, Job Admins can edit scorecards for up to 30 days after submission, while Site Admins can edit scorecards at any time. [Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200721564) to learn how to edit a scorecard after it's submitted.

You can also set up [new scorecard notifications](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029087331) to alert specific users when a new scorecard is submitted for a candidate.

# Snapcode Review integration

Snapcode Review makes it easy to create, assign, track, and review take-home coding tests. Let candidates and reviewers use the same tools that they use every day to write and review code.

Traditional code assessment tools force the candidate to type and run the code in the browser. Developers are more comfortable using their favorite editors to write and run code. We believe that take-home assignments are superior to web-based clocked tests. Take-home tests enable candidates to think more deeply about the problem and showcase their skills better. The closer the take-home tests mimic real-world problems, the better the chances of hiring the candidate with the right skills.

Snapcodereview uses GitHub for committing and reviewing code. This is what developers do every day at work.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Snapcode Review allows you to seamlessly add Snapcode Review’s assessment to a job's interview plan.

#### In this article

  * Enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Snapcode Review integration
  * Add the Snapcode Review stage to an interview plan
  * Set up the assessment on the  Snapcode Review  stage
  * Additional resources



### Enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Snapcode Review integration

To enable the integration, contact your Snapcode Review representative (email) to request an API key for your integration. Once you have received your API key, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/direct) to open a ticket with Greenhouse Technical Support.

**Note** _:_ Do not send your API key in the initial ticket. If needed, Greenhouse Technical Support will respond with a [SendSafely](https://www.sendsafely.com/about/) link for you to securely share the API key.

Wait for a confirmation email from Greenhouse Technical Support. You may be required to verify your account before you can proceed.

If they need your API key, Greenhouse Technical Support will provide a [SendSafely link](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/) where you can enter your API key. Once Greenhouse Technical Support has been notified that you’ve entered your API key, they will send a confirmation email.

### Add the Snapcode Review stage to an interview plan

Once the Greenhouse Recruiting / Snapcode Review integration is enabled for your organization, you will be able to add the Snapcode Review assessment as an interview stage.

To add an interview stage to an existing job, navigate to your job (**All** **Jobs** > **Job** **Name**) and click **Job Setup**.

Select **Interview Plan** , then click on **Edit** on the left side of the page. Click **Add Stage**.

Select the **Snapcode Review** stage on the next window, then click **Add.**

### Set up the assessment on the Snapcode Review stage

After the stage has been added to the job's interview plan, you’ll need to add the assessment to the stage. To add the assessment, click **Edit Take Home Test**.

Choose the assessments from the dropdown menu. These options are based on the assessments you configured in Snapcode Review.

Assign at least one Greenhouse Recruiting user to grade/review submitted assessments. When you’re finished, click **Save**.

**Note** _:_ All configuration for the assessment (including the email template) will need to be done in Snapcode Review.

#### Send and review a test

When candidates are moved into the Snapcode Review interview stage, Greenhouse Recruiting will display a **Send Test** link.

**Note** _:_ When you send a partner assessment from inside Greenhouse Recruiting, the interview instructions will still be sent by Snapcode Review.

After it has been sent, an assessment’s status will display in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Once the candidate has submitted their test, the interview kit will contain a link to view the submitted test in the Snapcode Review application.

Click **View** **Report** to see the candidate’s submission on Snapcode Review.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [admin@snapcode.review](mailto:admin@snapcode.review).

# Transfer candidates to a different job in bulk

**Permissions:** Job Admin who can view and edit candidates and prospects and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Transferring candidates to a different job is typically recommended only when the candidates are mistakenly associated with the wrong job.

When candidates are transferred to a different job, the following data will be transferred from the old job to the new job:

  * Attachments
  * Application questions
  * Submitted scorecards



Additionally, when candidates are transferred to a different job, the following information will be deleted during the transfer:

  * Records of candidate being on the old job in reports
  * Scheduled interviews
  * Interview information for scorecards pending submission
  * Job-specific forms



To transfer candidates to a different job in bulk, select**Candidates** from your navigation bar, then click **Bulk Actions**.

Expand the _Jobs_ filter on the left and click **Filter by Job**. Select one job from the list and click **Save** when finished.

**Note** : Organizations with the Prospects feature enabled should also use the Application Type filter on the left to filter by _Candidates Only_.

Select candidates who will be included in this bulk action by placing a check in the box next to the candidate name.

Click **Edit Selected** when finished.

Click **Transfer to a Different Job**.

Use the subsequent box to select a job and the stage in which the candidates should be moved into that job's interview plan.

**Note** : Candidates can only be transferred to a job where the user has appropriate permissions.

Click **Move to Job** when finished.

Central Test offers decision-makers a wide portfolio of innovative and reliable online assessment tools to help organizations gain valuable insight into a candidate's people abilities, behavior, and potential to succeed.

### Set up the Central Test integration

Once you've set up your interview plans and configured your take-home test, you'll be able to send the test to candidates.

### Use the Central Test integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

Once the Greenhouse Recruiting / Central Test integration is enabled for your organization, you will be able to add the Central Test assessment as an interview stage.

#### Troubleshoot errors

A user could experience some errors such as not having enough credits to send a test to a candidate. This is the most common "error" that a user may encounter. Another error that the user may encounter could be when he/she tries to send the same test to the same candidate (In that case, the user will get the following notification in his/her inbox : "The candidate has already been invited to take this test. He/she will get a reminder email"). In any case of occuring error, the user will be notified.

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [adrien.mazzoli@centraltest.com](mailto:adrien.mazzoli@centraltest.com) or +33 (0)146594222.

# HRdiversifyd integration

HRdiversifyd is a diversity analytics software that enables an organization to proactively track and measure diversity, and identify unconscious bias in real time through the talent pipeline.

Greenhouse Recruiting’s integration with HRdiversifyd allows your organization to capture diversity data from your applicants and measure that data against the goals set by your organization.

#### In this article

  * Create a webhook
  * Use the HRdiversifyd integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



### Create a webhook

To integrate HRdiversifyd with Greenhouse Recruiting, you'll need to create a webhook. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163727003) to create your webhook. Use the values listed below to configure the webhooks.

  * **Name** : HRdiversifyd integration
  * **When** : Application Updated
  * **Endpoint URL** : The Endpoint URL provided by HRdiversifyd
  * **Secret Key** : The Secret Key provided by HRdiversifyd



### Use the HRdiversifyd integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

The landing page is a customizable dashboard displaying real-time EEO data from Greenhouse Recruiting. The dashboard can display data based on year or quarter with counts or percentages and with active or historical data.

It exemplifies your real-time analytics and displays whether your organizational diversity goals are being met or missed at each stage of your hiring process.

All requisitions are listed within the requisitions tab. You can choose whether they are still active or have been filled.

Status shows if all steps in your hiring process met your diversity goals.

By clicking on a single requisition, you can see if your diversity goals have been met or missed and at what stage.

Within the reports tab, you can further analyze data for a specific requisition, stage (_e.g. Application Review, Phone Screen_), Category (_e.g. Disability, Gender_), and Value (_e.g. Female, Male, Decline to Identify_).

Additionally, reports can be tailored to your organization's needs and business requirements.

Stages and Categories can be custom entries or pre-populated with your candidates’ EEO data from Greenhouse Recruiting.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to support@hrdiversifyd.com

#### FAQs

**Does HRdiversifyd store any personal data (PII)?**

HRdiversifyd does not store any Personal Identification Information. Only diversity data provided in the EEO section of an application is collected by HRdiversifyd. No personal information that can be linked to a specific individual is stored within HRdiversifyd.

**Is HRdiversifyd a SaaS or On-Premise solution?**

HRdiversifyd can accommodate either option; however, it depends on the tiered model selected. The Lite and Pro tiers offer a SaaS solution, and the Enterprise tier provides a choice of either SaaS or On-Premise solutions.

**Does HRdiversifyd send back any information to Greenhouse indicating whether diversity goals are met during the hiring process?**

HRdiversifyd has the ability to send data back into Greenhouse with our Enterprise option. That specific functionality is not offered within the Lite and Pro options.

**How much does HRdiversifyd cost?**

Please contactHRdiversifyd for pricing details. There is a discount offered for non-profit organizations or educational institutions.

**Is there another solution like HRdiversifyd in the market?**

There is no other solution like HRdiversifyd, on the market today providing real-time analytics around diversity in the hiring process. No other solution is tracking whether or not your diversity goals are being met or missed and a what stage. Furthermore, no other solution is tracking whether or not conscious or unconscious bias and discrimination are occurring through the hiring process and at what stage. 

**Who do we contact to see the live demo or license the solution?**

Please visit [www.hrdiversifyd.com](www.hrdiversifyd.com) and check out the “Request a free demo” section for more information.

# Workvisa.io integration

Workvisa.io is a powerful, easy-to-use system for companies hiring skilled foreign talent. Designed with simplicity and efficiency in mind, Workvisa.io allows HR and legal teams to manage immigration processes and compliance requirements for seamless recruiting and faster onboarding.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Workvisa.io allows your recruiters to request pre-hire immigration assessments directly from Greenhouse Recruiting for faster onboarding and a better candidate experience.

  * Enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Workvisa.io integration

  * Create a Harvest API key for the Workvisa.io integration

  * Add Workvisa.io stage to the job's interview plan
  * Configure the custom candidate field
  * Use the Workvisa.io integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
    * Step one: Confirm the candidate requires immigration sponsorship
    * Step two: Initiate the immigration assessment request
    * Step three: Receive the immigration assessment
  * Additional resources



### Enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Workvisa.io integration

Contact your Workvisa.io representative to receive your API key. Once you have received your API key, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/requests/new) to open a ticket with the Greenhouse Technical Support team.

### Create a Harvest API key for the Workvisa.io integration

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Workvisa.io
  * **Description:** Workvisa.io Harvest API key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Workvisa.io integration:

**Applications**

  * GET: Retrieve Application
  * GET: List Applications



**Candidates**

  * GET: Retrieve Candidate
  * GET: List Candidates



**Job Posts**

  * GET: List Job Posts
  * GET: Retrieve Job Post for Job
  * GET: List Job Posts for Job



**Offers**

  * GET: List Application’s Offers
  * GET: Retrieve Application’s Current Offer
  * GET: Retrieve Offer
  * GET: List Offers



**Offices**

  * GET: Retrieve Office
  * GET: List Offices



**Tags**

  * GET: List Tags Applied to Candidate
  * GET: List Candidate Tags



### Add Workvisa.io stage to the job's interview plan

Once the Greenhouse Recruiting / Workvisa.io integration is enabled for your organization, you're able to add the Workvisa.io assessment as an Interview stage.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002194903) to add the **Pre-Hire Immigration Assessment (Workvisa.io)** stage to your job's interview plan.

### Configure the custom candidate field

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202609675) to create a custom candidate field using the following information: 

**Note:** Be sure to enter the words exactly as shown below, including capitalization and spaces.

  * **Field Name:** Requires Immigration Sponsorship
  * **Type:** Yes/No



Your newly created field will now be part of your company’s library of candidate fields, and will be shown under the **Details** tab of a _candidate’s profile_.

### Use the Workvisa.io integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

Now that you have set up the integration, you can move forward with requesting an assessment for any candidates who indicate they need immigration sponsorship.

#### Step one: Confirm the candidate requires immigration sponsorship

When the candidate indicates that they now or will in the future require immigration sponsorship, make sure to indicate this under the **Details** tab of their candidate profile. (Click **pencil icon** > Select **Yes** in the custom candidate field _Requires Immigration Sponsorship_ , as indicated below)

**Note:** If you select **No** or leave the custom field indicated above blank, you will receive an error message and email notification indicating that you will not be able to send the Pre-Hire Immigration Questionnaire to the candidate.

#### Step two: Initiate the immigration assessment request

When you are ready to request an immigration assessment, move the candidate to the _Pre-Hire Immigration Assessment_ stage. Once the candidate is moved to the _Pre-Hire Immigration Assessment_ stage, click **Send Test** to send the Workvisa.io questionnaire to the candidate.

The questionnaire will be emailed to the candidate, copying a primary contact and the assigned recruiter in Greenhouse.

#### Step three: Receive the immigration assessment

The assessment will be issued based on the completed questionnaire, the candidate’s resume/CV, and the details of the offered position harvested from Greenhouse. The recruiter will then receive an email with the assessment.

### Additional resources

Questions? Contact [support@workvisa.io](mailto:support@workvisa.io) for troubleshooting assistance regarding the integration.

# Create and edit candidate tags

**Permissions:** Site Admin, and Job Admin who can manage company metadata

### Create a candidate tag

To create a new candidate tag, click the **Configure** icon  in the upper right-hand corner and navigate to **Custom Options** on the left-hand panel.

From the _Custom Options_ page, click **Candidate Tags** under _Company Metadata_.

On the _Manage Candidate Tags_ page, click **Create New Candidate Tag**.

In the _Create a new Candidate Tag_ dialog box, enter a name for your new candidate tag. When you're done, click **Create Candidate Tag**.

Your new candidate tag is now available to apply manually to candidate profiles. You can also assign your candidate tag to new applications using the [auto-tag feature](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000060551).

### Edit a candidate tag

You can edit the name of existing candidate tags under _Manage Candidate Tags_. 

Click **Edit** next to the tag you'd like to edit.

### Delete a candidate tag

You can also delete any existing candidate tags under _Manage Candidate Tags_.

Click **Remove** next to the candidate tag you'd like to delete.

In the dialog box, select one of the following options for removing your candidate tag:

  * **I want any entity using this candidate tag to use this instead** – select another existing candidate tag from the dropdown to replace your deleted candidate tag anywhere it's currently in use
  * **I want to permanently delete this candidate tag without re-assigning** – permanently delete your candidate tag without selecting a replacement tag

# Unattached prospects

**Permissions:** All Site Admins and Job Admin who can manage unattached prospects

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

A prospect is considered unattached if they have been added to the system without being assigned a specific job. To manage unattached prospects, a user needs to be a Site Admin or a Job Admin with the additional user-specific permission Can manage unattached prospects.

#### In this article

  * Assign 'Can manage unattached prospects' permission
  * Assign 'Can manage unattached prospects' permission to users in bulk
  * Filter for unattached prospects



### Assign 'Can manage unattached prospects' permission

A Job Admin needs to have the user-specific permission Can manage unattached prospects. This permission allows Job Admin to add prospects to jobs and convert the unattached prospects into candidates.

To assign this user-specific permission to a person, click the **Configure** icon  on your navigation bar, then click **Users** on the left.

Select a user with the Job Admin level permission.

Scroll down the user's page to the permissions box and add a check in the box next to 'Can manage unattached prospects.' From the dropdown menu, select the role that you'll assign the user.

When finished, click **Save**.

### Assign 'Can manage unattached prospects' permission in bulk

To assign the 'Can manage unattached prospects' permission to a group of users with the same permission level, click on the **Configure** icon  on your navigation bar, then click **Users** on the left.

Filter the users list by a specific permission level type. You can also apply any additional filters to narrow down your list.

When you've finished narrowing down your list, click **Bulk actions** >**Select all** > **Edited selected**.

Click **Edit user-specific permissions**.

Select **Turn all on** in the same row as the permission 'Can manage unattached prospects.'

When finished, click**Save permissions**.

### Filter for unattached prospects

To filter for unattached prospects, click the **Candidates** tab on your navigation bar.

Expand the **Application type** filter on the left and click **Prospects** **only** from the _Type_ dropdown and add a check in the box next to **Prospects on no jobs**.

All unattached prospects will populate.

# Configure agencies and agency recruiters

**Permissions:** Site Admins, and Job Admins who can invite and deactivate agency recruiters

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Greenhouse Recruiting includes Agencies, which allows the recruiting agencies you work with to submit candidates for your jobs in one convenient location. [Agency recruiters](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202924839) can use their _Agencies_ dashboard to review your available jobs and submit candidates.

#### In this article

  * Set up a new agency
    * Add an agency
    * Add recruiters to an agency
    * Assign a job to an agency recruiter
    * Deactivate an agency recruiter
    * Resend enrollment instructions
  * Configure agency recruiter permissions
  * Identify an agency submission
  * Configure agency submission notifications



### Set up a new agency

Before agency recruiters can access the _Agencies_ homepage, you'll need to add an agency and the agency's recruiters to your organization's account.

#### Add an agency

Agencies can be created from the **Agencies** tab in _Configure_.

When you're ready to create a new agency, click**Add agency** to create a new source.

#### Add recruiters to an agency

Next, click **Add Recruiter** to register a new recruiter account. After you enter their name and email address, the recruiter will receive an enrollment email to create an account.

[Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201078255) for more information on creating an agency.

#### Assign a job to an agency recruiter

After you've added a recruiter to an agency account, click **Add/remove jobs** to assign them to one or more of your organization's jobs.

Select the jobs that the recruiter should have access to. Recruiters will only be able to submit candidates to their assigned jobs in _Agencies_.

#### Deactivate an agency recruiter

If you need to remove a recruiter, select the **Deactivate recruiter** button on their recruiter profile.

For additional guidance, check out [Deactivate agency recruiter](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360037942571).

#### Resend enrollment instructions

If you've invited an agency recruiter and they haven't created their account yet, you can resend their enrollment email by selecting the button next to their name.

If you need to modify the recruiter's information, click the **pencil icon __** to edit their details.

### Configure agency recruiter permissions

When the recruiter logs in to [Agencies](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202924839), they'll only be able to view whether candidates they referred for their assigned jobs are active or hired. 

Site Admins can allow recruiters to see the interview stage under **Configure** > **Permissions Policies.** Giving recruiters access to this information will reduce the amount of communication required to keep agency recruiters up-to-date.

### Identify an agency submission

During application review, candidates submitted by an agency will be marked with an **Agency** tag in  _Candidate details_. The agency and agency recruiter that submitted this candidate will also be listed under **Source**.

You can also check whether a candidate was submitted by an agency in their candidate profile. 

The **Activity Feed** will list when an agency submitted this candidate to your job.

The **Details** tab will list the candidate's agency and agency recruiter under  _Source & Responsibility_.

### Configure agency submission notifications

Job Admins can configure notifications so that specific users receive emails when an agency submits a job candidate.

From the job's dashboard, navigate to **Job Setup** > **Notifications**.

Scroll to  _Candidate Notifications_.

Click **Configure** next to _New Agency Submissions_.

Use the dropdown to select the users in your organization who should be notified about agency submissions. Click **Save** when you're done.

Learn more about [configuring agency submission notifications](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/203529035).

# Aimed Careers integration

Aimed Careers is a platform dedicated to AI roles in Healthcare and Medicine. We cover diagnostics, drug discovery, genomics, medical imaging, healthcare, bioinformatics, health systems, robotics & surgery, and more — with opportunities ranging from internships to full-time positions.

Aimed Careers’ integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows employers or admin to automatically sync AI-focused healthcare job postings to our platform. It enables candidates to easily discover and apply for AI roles in this niche domain that match their specialized skill sets.

#### In this article

  * Retrieve your Job Board URL
  * Finish setup and use the Aimed Careers integration
  * Additional resources



### Retrieve your Job Board URL

To make your open jobs available to Aimed Careers, you’ll need to send your job board URL. 

You can find your Job Board URL by navigating to the Job Board settings. (**Configure** > **Job Boards & Posts** > **Ellipsis** icon next to job board > **Edit Board Settings**) and scroll to the URL field.

Once you have this URL, send it to your **Aimed Careers rep.**

[Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888210160155) for a more detailed walkthrough of how to locate your job board URL.

### Finish setup and use the Aimed Careers integration

**How to use the integration:** To manage your job postings and start receiving applications through **Aimed Careers** , please follow these steps:

**1\. Connecting Your Account**

  * Log in to your **Aimed Careers** employer dashboard.
  * Navigate to the **Integrations** section on the left-hand sidebar and select **Greenhouse**.
  * Enter your **Company Name** and paste your **Greenhouse Job Board URL** (e.g., greenhousedemoboard) into the designated fields and select the relevant domain(s) from the Domain slicer.
  * Click the **Integrate** button to establish the connection.



****

****

Once connected, **Aimed Careers** will automatically sync your AI-focused healthcare jobs from Greenhouse three times a week.

  * To maintain platform quality, synchronized listings are filtered to ensure they align with our focus on AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, and other cutting-edge roles in Healthcare and Medicine.



**3\. Candidate Redirection and Application**

  * **Aimed Careers** utilizes a redirect-based integration model.
  * When a candidate finds a role on our platform and clicks "Apply," they are **redirected directly to your Greenhouse-hosted job board** to complete their application.
  * Because candidates apply on your own site, all applicant data and tracking remain securely within your Greenhouse Recruiting dashboard.



### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [support@aimedcareers.com](mailto:support@aimedcareers.com).

# Link a user account to a candidate profile

**Permissions:** Site Admin

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

To protect the integrity of your organization's hiring process, you can link a Greenhouse Recruiting user's account to a candidate profile. This prevents the user from seeing/accessing the details of their own candidate profile, including submitted scorecards, notes, and other information your team might have input when this user was a candidate for your organization.

#### In this article

Link a user account to candidate profile

Unlink a user account from candidate profile

View candidate profiles from linked user account

**Note:** When a Greenhouse Recruiting user applies through the [Internal Job Board](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200913945-Employee-Access-to-Internal-Job-Board), their Greenhouse Recruiting user account is automatically linked to the candidate profile.

### Link a user account to candidate profile

Navigate to a user's profile and choose a user from the list. (**Configure** icon > **Users** > select a user) 

On the  _Edit User_ page, navigate to the _Linked Candidate_ section and click **\+ Link to Candidate**. 

Use the provided search field to find the candidate profile in your system that should be linked to this user account. Click **Link** in the search results next to the Candidate profile name.

Repeat if necessary.

**Note** : A Greenhouse Recruiting user account can be linked to multiple candidate profiles and a candidate profile can be linked to multiple Greenhouse Recruiting user accounts.

When finished, click **Save** at the bottom of the page.

### Unlink a user account from a candidate profile

To unlink a user account from a candidate profile, navigate to the Greenhouse Recruiting user account page (**Configure **>**Users** >**Greenhouse Recruiting User**) and hover over the name of the linked candidate profile.

Click **Unlink**.

Confirm that you will be unlinking the user account from the candidate profile and click **Unlink** in the subsequent dialog box.

When finished, click **Save user details.**

### Viewing your own candidate record as a linked candidate

When a candidate is linked to a user in Greenhouse Recruiting, there are some additional levels of security to preserve the privacy of the candidate and prevent them from viewing their own candidate account.

When you're logged into a user account currently linked to a candidate record, the following features will change in Greenhouse Recruting: 

  * You'll get a permission error when trying to view your own candidate profile. 
  * You'll appear in the search results for candidates, but won't be able to click your own profile.
  * Your information won't be included in the candidate export. 
  * While your candidate profile will still be counted in reports, it won't be accessible to you in your Greenhouse Recruiting account.

# HackerRank Assessment integration

HackerRank, the developer skills company, helps businesses attract, evaluate, and hire the best technical talent from around the world. Over 2,000 customers across all industries, including 25% of the Fortune 100, rely on HackerRank to raise their hiring bar. More than 7 million developers trust HackerRank to learn and practice coding skills.

Greenhouse's integration with HackerRank is split into two parts:

  * **HackerRank Assessment:** HackerRank's primary integration allows you to seamlessly add HackerRank's assessment to an interview plan.
  * **HackerRank Interview:** An additional integration for organizations who want to use live coding exercises with HackerRank's live pair coding features.



For more information on using HackerRank's live pair coding, see the [HackerRank Interview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201588399) integration.

#### In this article

  * Set up the integration
  * Assessment setup
  * Harvest API key
    * Create Harvest API key
    * Find your user ID
    * Enter information into HackerRank
  * Use the integration
    * Configure an interview plan
    * Send and review the HackerRank test
    * Live coding exercises with HackerRank Interview
  * Frequently asked questions
  * Additional resources



### Set up the integration

Configuring the HackerRank Assessment integration requires you to set up an Assessment integration and a Harvest API integration.

### Assessment setup

To add your assessments to Greenhouse, follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923) to retrieve your API key from HackerRank, send it to Greenhouse support, and add the assessment stage to your interview plans.

You can generate your API key directly in HackerRank. This key must have the **recruiter** and **company admin** permissions to get full access to your configured assessments. 

### Harvest API key

If you already set up the Harvest API as part of the [HackerRank Interview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201588399) integration, you can skip these steps.

HackerRank also uses the Harvest API to send information to Greenhouse. You'll need to [create a Harvest API key](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883), [retrieve your user ID](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/10765948752027), and add both items to the **Greenhouse Integration Settings** page in HackerRank.

#### Create Harvest API key

To create your Harvest API key, follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883). Use the following permissions and credentials when setting up the integration.

**Credentials**

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** HackerRank
  * **Description:** HackerRank Harvest API Key



**Permissions**

Make sure the following permissions are selected when configuring your API key.

  * **Candidates**
    * Post: Add Candidates
    * Post: Add Attachment
    * Post: Add Note
  * **Tags**
    * Get: List tags applied to candidate
    * Get: List Candidate Tags
    * Post: Add New Candidate Tags
    * Put: Add a candidate tag
  * **Users**
    * Get: Retrieve User
    * Get: List Users
  * **Custom Fields**
    * Get: Get custom fields
    * Post: Create custom field
    * Patch: Update custom field



#### Find your user ID

To retrieve your user ID, follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/10765948752027).

#### Enter information into HackerRank

Once you have your Harvest API key and user ID, you can enter them in the **Greenhouse Integration Settings** page in HackerRank.

### Use the integration

#### Configure an interview plan

Once the integration is enabled, update an [interview plan](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002194903) and choose **HackerRank Assessment** from the list of stages. Once the stage has been added to the job's interview plan, click **Edit Take Home Test** to choose the specific assessment and grader.

**Note** : The assessment configuration, including any additional settings like the email template or branding, must be configured in HackerRank.

#### Send and review the HackerRank test

When candidates are moved into the HackerRank interview stage on a job, a **Send Test** link will display on their profile.

Click **Send** **Test** and the candidate will receive an invitation with login credentials to complete the HackerRank assessment.

The status of the test will be viewable in Greenhouse Recruiting:

  * Take Home Test to be sent.
  * Waiting for candidate to submit test
  * Scorecard due from [ GRADER ]



Once the candidate has submitted their test, you can view their HackerRank score by opening the interview kit for the HackerRank interview.

#### Live coding exercises with the HackerRank integration

You need to use the [HackerRank Interview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201588399) integration to complete live pair coding exercises.

### Frequently asked questions

#### What sort of HackerRank license do I need?

Users need a HackerRank recruiter license to send out tests. HackerRank Developer accounts cannot be used with the Greenhouse Recruiting/HackerRank integration.

#### Why are some stages labeled "Legacy HackerRank?"

In January 2024, HackerRank upgraded their integration with Greenhouse Recruiting. If you're viewing a past interview plan that uses the previous setup, those stages will be labeled as "Legacy HackerRank."

### Additional resources

For more information on the HackerRank integration, [contact Greenhouse Technical Support](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/requests/new).

# Sandbox sync FAQ

**Permissions:** \--

**Product tier:** Available for Pro subscription tier

A sandbox is a test environment that allows you to evaluate email and offer templates, workflows, integrations, and more — all without disturbing real data or your recruiting teams. Your sandbox works just like a production environment, with the same features and capabilities, enabling you to test real-world scenarios.

With sandbox sync, you can mirror data from your production environment to your sandbox environment. We've collected answers to a few commonly asked questions about sandbox sync.

#### In this article

  * Who can manage sandbox sync?
  * Who can access a sandbox?
  * What data can I sync from my production environment?
  * What happens to data in the sandbox after sandbox sync?
  * Can I choose which data to sync?
  * When does sandbox sync occur?
  * What happens to data in the sandbox after sandbox sync?



#### Who can manage sandbox sync?

Only Site Admin with permission to manage sandbox configurations can manage sandbox sync. Sandbox sync is managed in your production environment. 

#### Who can access a sandbox?

Anyone who is added as a user to your sandbox can access the sandbox. However, logins aren't interchangeable between your sandbox and your production environments.

User accounts created in your sandbox are retained even after sandbox sync is complete.

#### What data can I sync from my production environment?

The full list of synced data can be found in the [sandbox sync overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/14111892585627) article.

#### What happens to data in the sandbox after sandbox sync?

When sandbox sync syncs data from your production environment, all the existing data in your sandbox is overwritten except for the following settings:

  * [User accounts](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360027077811)

  * [Job board settings](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360031374411-Edit-external-job-board)

  * [Job board configurations](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200721654)

  * [API keys](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115000521723)

  * [Webhooks](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360005574531)

  * [Single sign-on](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/210259723)

  * [Business Intelligence Connector settings](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405507275547)




All other data, like jobs, candidates, hiring plans, and other configurations are overwritten on each sync as part of the data cleanup.

#### Can I choose which data to sync?

Sandbox sync will sync important production data like organization settings, email and offer templates, custom options, and inclusion tool settings [to your sandbox environment](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/17107394697627#h_01H5868EPFD5BZT98DSW1HBT5Q). It isn't possible to select specific data you want to sync.

#### When does sandbox sync occur?

Sandbox sync will sync data from your production environment on a schedule you choose. You can choose a day for the sync, as well as a cadence that you prefer. The sync occurs on the day you choose at 11:59 pm ET. 

**Learn more**

[Sandbox sync overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/14111892585627)

[Troubleshoot a sandbox](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/17057985865371)

# Donut integration

Donut is an employee experience platform that automates and scales your people programs. Donut Journeys is a product that enables teams to create processes for programs like onboarding, training, mentorship, events, and offboarding, then use them over and over. By using Journeys teams can automatically add employees to Slack channels, run buddy programs, collect quick-pulse feedback, and more.

Donut’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows customers to automatically enroll new hires into Journeys workflows designed to support new hires during onboarding. The integration pulls new hire details, start dates, and manager information from Greenhouse and syncs them directly into Journeys.

#### In this article

  * Start the Connection in Donut
  * Create a Harvest API key
  * Finalize the Connection in Donut
  * Use the Donut integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



#### Start the Connection in Donut

Log in to the Donut dashboard at [app.donut.ai](http://app.donut.ai)

Go to **HRIS** in the left sidebar menu

Click **Connect HRIS or ATS** > **Connect Greenhouse ATS.**

#### Enter Your Greenhouse URL

While logged into Greenhouse, copy your dashboard URL. It usually looks like: _https://app.greenhouse.io_

Then, paste it into the designated field in Donut.

### Create a Harvest API key

To configure the Donut integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key. 

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the Donut integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Donut or Unlisted Vendor
  * **Description:** Donut Harvest API Key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Donut integration: 

  * **Applications**
    * GET: Retrieve Application
    * GET: List Applications
  * **Candidates**
    * GET: Retrieve Candidate
    * GET: List Candidates
    * GET: Get Hiring Team
  * **Jobs**
    * GET: List Application's Offers
    * GET: Retrieve Application's Current Offer
    * GET: Retrieve Offer
    * GET: List Offers
  * **Users**
    * GET: Retrieve User
    * GET: List Users
  * **Sources**
    * GET: List Sources



### Finalize the Connection in Donut

Once your API key is created and you're ready to finish setup, check the box **I have checked the above permissions** and click **Next**.

Donut will test your API key:

  * If successful, your Greenhouse data will begin syncing in the background, and you’ll be able to set up your first Journey.
  * If there’s an issue, Donut will tell you exactly what needs fixing so you can adjust and retry. Here’s a screenshot of an example error you might see if you have not added all of the permissions to the API key:



#### Data Sync & Confirmation

Once everything is connected, Donut will start importing your Greenhouse data. You’ll receive a notification once syncing is complete. Donut will sync offer, candidate and application data into our system, but Journeys sessions for new hires with upcoming start dates will not be created until auto-enroll rules are configured as described in the next section.

### Use the Donut integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

The primary feature of the Donut Greenhouse Recruiting integration is the ability to automatically enroll new hires from Greenhouse recruiting into Donut Journeys. When a candidate accepts an offer in Greenhouse and that candidate is marked as hired, Donut will automatically create a Journeys session and apply templates that have been configured as auto-enroll rules. 

The candidate’s work email, personal email, hiring manager’s email, and start date will be used to create a Journeys session based on these rules. The candidate and hiring manager's work emails from Greenhouse will be used to map to Slack users in the workspace that correspond to these emails. Once auto-enroll rules are configured, candidates marked as hired with start dates in the future will be auto-enrolled in Journeys sessions based on the configured rules. The integration will not import sessions for candidates with start dates in the past.

#### Setting up auto-enroll rules for importing new hires from Greenhouse Recruiting

While logged into the [Donut dashboard](http://app.donut.ai), follow these steps:

  * Click on “Auto-enroll” in the left sidebar menu.
  * Under “Default Auto-enroll Journeys”, select the “Import New Hires from HRIS or ATS and auto-enroll default Journeys” option.
  * Select a default Journey template (see 1). This template will be applied to all candidates that are marked as hired in Greenhouse Recruiting.
  * (Optional) Under Auto-enroll rules using ATS Fields, enter additional rules based on Office, Department, or Source data assigned to candidates in Greenhouse Recruiting (see 2). These rules define optional templates that will be applied to candidates that match Office or Department values selected.



####    
Viewing Journeys sessions imported from Greenhouse Recruiting

After the Donut Greenhouse Recruiting integration has been connected and auto-enroll rules have been configured, Donut will start syncing data between Greenhouse Recruiting and Donut every 4 hours. After a candidate is marked as hired in Greenhouse Recruiting and their start date is in the future, Donut will automatically create a Journeys session for this candidate upon the next synchronization (can take up to 4 hours). To see the sessions that have been imported from Greenhouse Recruiting, please follow these steps:

  * While logged into the [Donut dashboard](http://app.donut.ai), click “All New Hires” in the left sidebar menu.
  * Hover over the circular avatars on the Journeys batches page, you will see a green highlight around the avatars for sessions imported from Greenhouse Recruiting. Additionally, a tooltip will be shown upon hover that indicates the name of the candidate and their import source.



### Additional resources

  * [Syncing Greenhouse with Donut](https://help.donut.ai/en/articles/10008502-syncing-greenhouse-ats-with-donut)
  * [How to use Auto-enroll](https://help.donut.ai/en/articles/1749103-how-to-use-auto-enroll)



For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [support@donut.ai](mailto:support@donut.ai) or <https://help.donut.ai/en/>.

# Release Notes: August 2025

Greenhouse Software regularly releases new product features, updates, and improvements. You can stay up-to-date by following our [release notes](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200929955) or checking out the [latest feature releases](https://www.greenhouse.com/greenhouse-latest-features) page.

#### This month's releases

  * Greenhouse Recruiting
  * API
  * Integrations
  * Bug fixes



### Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Introducing MyGreenhouse Jobs

We’ve launched MyGreenhouse Jobs, a centralized job search experience that helps candidates discover open roles from across Greenhouse-hosted job boards in one location. Job seekers can browse opportunities, apply through your existing job board, and manage their applications within the MyGreenhouse portal.

For your team, this means greater visibility for your open roles, more engaged applicants, and a stronger employer brand.

To activate MyGreenhouse Jobs, go to **Configure > Candidate portal** and select **“Turn on for all job boards.”**

[Read more about MyGreenhouse Jobs](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/38110627059099)

#### Improved job notes with AI summary

We’ve revamped Job Notes to make it easier for hiring teams to share updates, keep track of feedback, and stay aligned. Notes now live in a dedicated tab under each job, organized in a feed that supports filtering, private notes, and AI-powered summaries, meaning faster insights and cleaner collaboration during your hiring process.  


[Read more about job notes.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/38050301918363)

#### Updates to scheduling links

We’ve expanded scheduling links to give hiring teams more visibility and flexibility. Users can now insert links into emails sent from the candidate profile, collect phone numbers when scheduling meetings, and see real-time updates in the candidate profile activity feed when a meeting is booked or changed using your link. 

[Read more about scheduling links.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/34270522324763)

#### Improved interview question formatting

This month, we made it easier to create clear, organized interview questions! Users can now use rich text formatting—including bolding, italics, bullets, and numbered lists—to highlight key information and improve readability for interviewers.

#### Single sign-on for Microsoft SCIM

Organizations can now use SCIM to automatically sync users and their information from Microsoft Entra ID to Greenhouse. This helps your team save time, reduce manual updates, and ensure user access stays accurate as roles change.

[Read more about Microsoft SCIM setup.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/35654588835867-Configure-SCIM-for-Microsoft-Entra-ID)

#### Application custom fields now available to all customers

Application custom fields, previously limited to Advanced and Expert subscription tiers, are now accessible to all customers. These fields allow teams to collect and organize structured data from candidates during the application process.

[Read more about creating custom application fields.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003544472-Create-new-custom-application-field)

#### Update tax information directly in Greenhouse

Site Admins can manage tax information from the in-app billing page without contacting support, making it easier to keep billing details accurate and up to date.

[Read more about managing your tax info.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/30383521759259-Billing-page-overview#h_01JZ881B773P5VTFFVQME99YQS)

### API

#### Harvest v3 release

Harvest API v3 has reached full feature parity with v2 and is now available for all customers. While v3 is fully released, ongoing performance improvements and enhancements are underway. 

### Integrations

  * **Candidate testing** : [IKM](https://integrations.greenhouse.com/partners/ikm) offers validated assessments to measure skills and knowledge, helping organizations hire and develop top talent.
  * **Candidate testing** : [Screen By AI](https://integrations.greenhouse.com/partners/screen-by-ai) is an AI-powered hiring platform that automates candidate screening and video interviews saving HR teams hours while hiring.
  * **Candidate testing** : [Screenify](https://integrations.greenhouse.com/partners/screenify) is an AI interviewing platform that helps hiring teams screen top of funnel candidates efficiently.



### Bug fixes

  * Fixed an issue where some customers were seeing a "required" message on the free job board section when editing job posts.
  * Fixed an issue where some customers encountered an error when trying to send documents through DocuSign.
  * Fixed an issue where configured filters weren't saving on candidate reports.
  * Fixed an issue where users couldn't update a start date on offers in the candidate profile.
  * Fixed an issue where repeatedly clicking on the Save button for offers resulted in duplicate records.

# Individual goals

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above  
  
**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

#### Measure, iterate, and improve every part of your hiring process

Individual goals are crucial to hiring efficiency as they drive accountability and promote a vision to attain for individual contributors.

You can set individual goals to track your progress across objectives like the number of candidates added, the number of candidates hired, and more.

Individual goals work best when your [hiring team's](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002194983) responsibilities are set. For instance, the Candidates hired goal gives credit to a job's recruiter. An individual needs to be assigned to the recruiter role in order to track their goal attainment.

**Note** : Individual goals can only be set and viewed by individual users with Job Admin or Site Admin permissions.

#### In this article

  * Available individual goals
  * Create individual goals
  * Edit individual goals
  * Delete individual goals



### Available individual goals

#### Candidates added goal

Use the Candidates added goal to set a target for the number of candidates you'd like to add within a specific time frame. Credit for this goal will go to the user selected in the _Who gets credit_ field when a [candidate is added](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002195063) to Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### Prospects added goal

Use the Prospects added goal to set a target for the number of prospects you'd like to add within a specific time frame. Credit for this goal will go to the user selected in the _Who gets credit_ field when a [prospect is added](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5045926318107) to Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### Candidates referred goal

Use the Candidates referred goal to set a target for the number of candidates you refer within a specific time frame in Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### Candidates hired goal

Use the Candidates hired goal to set a target for the number of candidates you hire within a specific time frame in Greenhouse Recruiting. Credit for this goal goes to the job's [recruiter](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360016347712). 

**Note** : When multiple recruiters are present, credit accrues to the user responsible for recruiting tasks on the job's hiring team.

### Create individual goals

To create an individual, click **Create goal** in the _My goals_ section of your dashboard.

In the _Create goal_ window, fill out the following fields to define your individual goal.

Under **Activity** , select from a list of available goals to measure your individual performance for a specific recruiting activity.

Select a **Frequency** to determine how often Greenhouse Recruiting will measure your performance for this goal.

Set a **Target value** for your individual goal. If you'd like to create an individual goal for adding 10 candidates per week, enter '10' as your target value.

**Note:** The target value can't be greater than 5,000.

Click **Create goal** when you're finished.

Your goal will now appear in the _My goals_ section of your dashboard. This goal will update in real time as you add, refer, and hire candidates and prospects.

**Note** : You may need to [personalize your dashboard](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003243886) to ensure the _My_ _goals_ tile appears.

### Edit individual goals

To edit your individual goals, click **See all goals** in the  _My goals_ section of your dashboard.

#### Create additional goals

On the  _My goals_ page, click **Create goal** to add any additional individual goals that you have not yet set up.

#### Edit existing goals

To edit an existing individual goal, hover over the goal and click the pencil icon.

In the  _Edit goal_ window, update your goal's **frequency** or **target value**. Click **Save** when you're done.

**Note:** You can't change an existing goal's **activity**. If you'd like to stop tracking a selected activity, you can turn off or delete this goal instead.

#### Turn goals on or off

Turn your individual goals off to temporarily stop tracking your attainment. When you turn off an individual goal, it will no longer appear in the _My goals_ section of your dashboard. In addition, you won't be able to review data for this goal in reports while it's turned off. You can turn this goal back on at any time to resume tracking your attainment.

On the  _My goals_ page, click the toggle to turn off a goal.

Click the toggle again to turn a goal back on. 

### Delete individual goals

You can also delete an individual goal at any time. When you delete a goal, it will be removed from your list of individual goals. You will no longer be able to track this goal in your dashboard or reports, and historical attainment metrics will not be available for this goal in your reports.

**Note:** You cannot undo this action. If you'd like to start tracking attainment for a deleted goal's activity at a later date, you'll need to create a new goal.

To delete an individual goal, hover over the goal and click the delete icon.

Click **Delete goal** to confirm that you'd like to delete this goal.

**Learn more about goals**

[Goals overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/6829789189915)

[Company goals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/8382420999835)

[Report on goals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/8383632617755)
