Your Harvest API key for the Greenhouse Recruiting / CodeSignal. Provide your API key to CodeSignal in the next step.

#### Enter the Harvest API key in CodeSignal

With your Greenhouse Recruiting Harvest API key copied, navigate to the [_Integrations_ page](https://app.codesignal.com/client-dashboard/integrations/ats.greenhouse) in CodeSignal. Click your name in the upper right-hand corner and select **Integrations** from the dropdown menu.

Paste your API key into the _Harvest API Key_ field and click **Save**.

Fill in the appropriate Greenhouse subdomain for your account and click **Save**.

The subdomain can be found by looking at the URL when logged into Greenhouse Recruiting.

**Note:** Your subdomain likely will be app, app2, app3, etc., or yourcompany.

#### Add the CodeSignal assessment API key to Greenhouse Recruiting

From CodeSignal's _Integration_ box, click the **Assessment API** tab. Click the **Copy** icon next to the _Assessment API Key_.

Once you've obtained your API key, fill out the form at [www.greenhouse.io/asksupport](http://support.greenhouse.io/direct) or [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/requests/new) to open a ticket.

**Note** : Don't send the API key in this initial email. Greenhouse Technical Support will respond with a [SendSafely link](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/) for you to enter your API key.

Greenhouse Technical Support will email you once your API key has been set up in your account and your integration has been enabled.

**Note:** To verify your identity, Greenhouse Technical Support might request you provide a [support verification code](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022771952) before adding the API key to your organization's account.

### Use the CodeSignal integration

#### Add CodeSignal stage to your job's interview plan

Once the Greenhouse Recruiting / CodeSignal integration is enabled for your organization, you'll be able to add the CodeSignal pre-screen (formerly CodeSignal test) as an interview stage.

Navigate to a job (**Jobs** > **Job Name**) and click **Job Setup** from the job navigation bar.

Click **Interview Plan** and select **Add a Stage**.

From the _Add Stage_ box, select the CodeSignal stage: _CodeSignal Pre-screen_.

Click **Add** to apply the stage to the job's interview plan.

Note: In the _Default Greenhouse User_ field, you can specify a Greenhouse user account that will be used to submit feedback or add notes when a more accurate matching user cannot be found. You can create a new Greenhouse user account for this purpose.

#### Send and review CodeSignal Pre-screen from Greenhouse Recruiting

When candidates are moved into the CodeSignal interview stage, Greenhouse will display a **Send Test** link.

**Note:** When you send a test from Greenhouse Recruiting, the interview instructions are actually sent by CodeSignal.

Select the assessment and the name of the person who should evaluate the test. The candidate's email address will be auto-populated.

The status of the assessment will be viewable in Greenhouse Recruiting (like _Sent_).

Once the assessment is completed, the candidate's score will be recorded in the CodeSignal Pre-screen stage. The grader will be notified via email to review the candidate's result and complete a scorecard in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Once the grader has completed their scorecard, their overall recommendation for the candidate will also be displayed along with the candidate's score in the CodeSignal Pre-screen on the candidate's profile in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Click **CodeSignal Pre-screen** to view a summary of the candidate's scores.

**Note:** The CodeSignal Pre-screen stage may appear as CodeSignal test on jobs or reports created before April 2022.

When viewing the summary of results, click **View Report** to view the candidate's results (including coding replays) in detail on CodeSignal.

#### Schedule CodeSignal interviews from Greenhouse Recruiting

**Note:** Make sure you have already downloaded [CodeSignal's Chrome extension](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/codesignal/ljpmmkjcophmdnndejefcilnkmhpjlfh).

You can schedule CodeSignal interview sessions directly within Greenhouse Recruiting by clicking**Schedule Interview** in the appropriate stage.

Select a date, time, interviewer, and location. When you're finished, click **Schedule and Continue**.

Under the _Description_ field, click **\+ CodeSignal Interview Link** to create an interview URL. This URL will display at the top of the _Description_ field.

The CodeSignal Interview URL will appear in the _Location_ field. Send this URL to both the interviewers and candidates to access their interview session at the scheduled time.

Finalize the invitation and send this URL to both the interviewers and the candidates. 

During or after the interview session, the interviewer can leave optional candidate feedback in CodeSignal. Any feedback will appear in Greenhouse Recruiting as a note in the candidate's Activity Feed.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [support@codesignal.com](mailto:support@codesignal.com).

# HRIS Link notifications

**Permissions:** —

**Product tier:** Available for Pro subscription tier with HRIS Link add-on

HRIS Link can notify you of errors, custom field issues, or job status problems with the integration. When HRIS Link is enabled, provide your Greenhouse Technical Consultant with an administrative email address for these notifications. You can provide multiple email addresses if different parties need to stay informed of HRIS Link updates.

Check out the different notifications HRIS Link supports below.

#### In this article

  * HRIS Link status email
  * Job created email
  * Job status email
  * Auto-close email
  * Error notifications



### HRIS Link status email

When HRIS Link is enabled, your Greenhouse Technical Consultant will set up an HRIS Link status email to deliver to an HRIS Link logging email address you prefer. 

While any email address can receive the integration logging email, we recommend utilizing a faceless email account or distribution list so that it does not require future updating. At a minimum, the following people typicallywould benefit most from receiving the HRIS Link status email:

  * **Your HRIS admin:** An HRIS admin would benefit from the HRIS Link status email in the event that your HRIS jobs report or a specific field from your HRIS platform needs to be updated to resolve an error.
  * **Greenhouse Recruiting Site Admin:** A Greenhouse Recruiting Site Admin would benefit from the HRIS Link status email in the event that custom fields or custom field options need to be added or updated in Greenhouse Recruiting to resolve an error.



**Note** : HRIS Link supports a single set of email addresses for status emails across all of the HRIS Link integrations including jobs, offices, departments, and users. It isn't possible to use unique email addresses for each HRIS Link integration.

The HRIS Link status email is sent every 15 minutes upon each HRIS Link integration sync for each component of HRIS Link including offices, departments, users, and jobs. This email will contain a summary of the HRIS Link integration sync.

  * If the sync is successful, the email will include a list of jobs, offices, departments, or users that were created or updated by HRIS Link.
  * If the sync is unsuccessful, the email will include error information.



**Example HRIS Link status email** :
    
    
    Subject: HRIS Link: Job import completed successfully
    Body: Everything imported successfully! The following jobs were created or updated:
    
         New Jobs Created (1)
         <link to Greenhouse Recruiting job> Test Job A
    
         Existing Jobs Updated (1)
         <link to Greenhouse Recruiting job> Test Job B
    
    The information above is related to Workflow <workflow ID here>.

**Note** : The content of the HRIS Link status email isn't customizable.

### Job created email 

The job created email is only configurable for [HRIS Link for jobs](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058912031). This email contains a direct link to the Greenhouse Recruiting job created or updated by the HRIS Link sync so you can easily navigate to the job and complete any necessary tasks.

The recipient of the job created email is assigned on the [HRIS Link job import report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4403889907355) in the `Notify_email` column.

**Note** : The job created notification email can be assigned to unique email addresses on each job. The email address can be a calculated field in your HRIS platform or the recipient can be a static field if your organization prefers a group email address. 

While any person can receive this email, the following people would benefit most from the notification:

  * **A member of the recruiting team** : A recruiting team member would benefit from the HRIS Link job created email so they could add the coordinator and sourcer to the hiring team in Greenhouse Recruiting. This person is typically a member of one of these teams:
    *       * Recruiting leaders
      * Recruiting managers
      * Recruiting ops



**Example job created email** :
    
    
    Subject: <Job name (req ID)> is now available in Greenhouse
    Body: Your job has been successfully imported to Greenhouse.  You can access it <link>.

**Note** : The content of the job created notification email is not customizable.

### Job status email

The job status email is only configurable for [HRIS Link for jobs](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058912031). The job status email audits jobs in open or closed status in both Greenhouse Recruiting and the HRIS to find disparities between the platforms. The job status email is delivered when the Greenhouse Recruiting job status doesn't match the status indicated in the `Status` column on the [HRIS Link job import report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4403889907355).

This email contains a direct link to the Greenhouse Recruiting job so you can easily navigate to the job and make any needed updates.

The following people receive this notification:

  * **Recruiters** : People assigned to the [recruiter](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360016347712) role on the Greenhouse Recruiting job's hiring team receive the job status email.
  * **Job created email recipients** : The person or people configured to receive the job created email receive the job status email as well.
  * **HRIS Link status email recipients** : The person or people configured to receive the HRIS Link status email receive the job status email as well.



**Note** : The job status email will be deactivated if your [HRIS Link job import report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4403889907355) doesn't include the optional `Status` column.

**Example job status email** :
    
    
    Subject: <Job name (req ID)> should be opened in Greenhouse
    Body: We noticed that this job was recently opened externally. Please go ahead and open it in Greenhouse <link>.

**Note** : The content of the job status out of parity email is not customizable.

**Example scenario:** If a requisition or position in the HRIS is `Closed`, `Frozen`, or `Filled`, and the requisition in Greenhouse Recruiting is still in a `Draft` or `Open` status, the job status email will notify a member of your team that you need to manually close the job in Greenhouse Recruiting to keep your HRIS and Greenhouse Recruiting in parity with one another. Alternately, if a requisition or position in the HRIS is `Open`, and the requisition in Greenhouse Recruiting is still `Closed`, this email will notify a member of your team that you need to manually open the job in Greenhouse Recruiting to keep your HRIS and Greenhouse in parity.

### Auto-close email

The auto-close email is sent when a job is closed by [HRIS Link for jobs](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058912031). This email contains a direct link to the Greenhouse Recruiting job so you can easily navigate to the job for further review.

**Note** : This email is only delivered if your organization is using auto-close.

**Example auto-close email** :
    
    
    Subject: <Job name (req ID)> automatically closed in Greenhouse
    Body: We noticed that this job was recently closed externally, so we automatically closed it for you in Greenhouse. You can access it here. A close reason was not provided, so we closed the job without listing a reason.

The following users receive the auto-close email:

  * **Recruiters** : People assigned to the [recruiter](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360016347712) role on the Greenhouse Recruiting job's hiring team receive the auto-close email.
  * **Job created email recipients** : The person or people configured to receive the job created email receive the auto-close email as well.
  * **HRIS Link status email recipients** : The person or people configured to receive the HRIS Link status email receive the auto-close email as well.



### Error emails

HRIS Link error emails inform you of a problem with the HRIS Link sync and the suggested solution. Check out these resources for more information on specific errors:

  * [HRIS Link job import errors](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360059154811)
  * [HRIS Link user import errors](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360059987811)
  * [HRIS Link office / department import errors](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360059568972)

# Turn off notifications for single job

**Permissions:** **Job** **Admin** and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Job notifications automatically update configured users on recent actions that have occurred for a particular job. In this article, we will cover how to remove a user from the notifications list for a job event.

Job notifications are sent via email and can be configured for the following events that occur for a job:

**Job Event** | **Description**  
---|---  
[Weekly recruiting report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360016456671-Weekly-Recruiting-Report) | A weekly email that summarizes the week's recruiting activity for the job.  
[New applicants](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360028659832) | An email is generated for each new candidate that applies to the job.  
[New internal applicants](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360028978271) | An email is generated for each new internal applicant to the job.  
[New referrals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029035211) | An email is generated for each referral submitted to the job.  
[New agency submissions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360028757892) | An email is generated for each new agency submission to the job.  
[Stage transitions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029079151) | An email is generated when candidates enter into stages configured for notifications.  
[New scorecards](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029087331) | An email is generated when interviewer scorecards are submitted for stages configured for notifications.  
  
To remove a user from the notifications list for any of these job events for a single job, click**Jobs** from the navigation bar and select a job from the subsequent list.

Click **Job Setup** and navigate to **Notifications** on the left-hand panel.

Navigate to an event for the job and click **Configure** inline with the _Job Event name_.

Navigate to the user's name in the provided field and click **X** to the right of their name. The user will be removed from the notifications list for the job event.

Click **Save** when finished.

# Integrate your 3rd-party task system with Greenhouse Onboarding

**Permissions:** Owners

**Product tier:** Available for Greenhouse Welcome and Greenhouse Onboarding subscription tiers

You can connect most [third-party task systems](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022403771) to integrate your existing onboarding tasks and processes with Greenhouse Onboarding.

Greenhouse Onboarding supports the following third-party task systems by default:

  * [Asana](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022242812)
  * [Jira software](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022426091)
  * [ServiceNow](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022426351)
  * [Trello](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022431511)
  * [Zendesk](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022431391)



In addition, you can integrate any other third-party task system with Greenhouse Onboarding, so long as it meets specific criteria. Use this article to learn how to set up another third-party task system in Greenhouse Onboarding.

#### In this article

  * Integration criteria
  * Connect your 3rd-party task system
    * Configure viewable fields
  * Additional resources



### Integration criteria

Greenhouse Onboarding can connect with most third-party task systems if they meet the following conditions:

  * Email address from your task system's board or project
  * Email address configured to receive emails from systems like Greenhouse Onboarding



**Note****:** Reach out to [Greenhouse Technical Support](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/8921763177115) for additional help.

### Connect your 3rd-party task system

Once you've retrieved your third-party task system's email address, navigate to [Greenhouse Onboarding](https://onboarding.greenhouse.io/).

From your Greenhouse Onboarding homepage, click **Settings**.

On the _Settings_ page, navigate to **Company Info** > **3rd-Party Task Systems**.

Under _3rd-Party Task Systems_ , click **Add New**.

Give your third-party task system a **Name**. This name will be used when displaying your integration in the integrations menu and other locations within Greenhouse Onboarding.

Next, select **Other** from the **System** dropdown.

Input a **System Name**. Greenhouse uses this field internally to track which other systems are being integrated with Greenhouse Onboarding.

Paste the **Email Address** from your third-party task system. Greenhouse Onboarding will use this email to send tasks.

#### Configure viewable fields

Since Greenhouse Onboarding allows you to insert tokens into tasks (which may reveal personally identifiable information), you'll need to explicitly configure which fields your third-party system can view.

Use the **Viewable Fields (Optional)** dropdown to select which Greenhouse Onboarding fields your third-party system can view. If a task with a non-viewable token is assigned to the third-party system, Greenhouse Onboarding will block the system from viewing this information.

When you're finished, click **Save and Close**.

Your other third-party task system is now integrated with Greenhouse Onboarding, and you can begin [assigning tasks](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022405211). Repeat the above steps for any additional task systems that your organization wants to connect.

### Additional resources

  * [3rd-party task systems overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022403771)
  * [3rd-party task system emails](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022405691)
  * [Assign new task to 3rd-party task system](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022405211)
  * [Reassign tasks in bulk to a 3rd-party task system](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360024685832)

# Use AI to automatically review prospect responses

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above with CRM access and a Sourcing Automation seat

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro) with the Sourcing Automation add-on

Sentiment tags are an easy way to classify replies so you can focus on interested prospects. While they can be assigned manually, prospect response review uses AI to scan incoming prospect emails and automatically mark prospects as interested based on their response.

You can pair this tool with [automated rules for campaign pools](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/21740234706587) to quickly move interested candidates to the right pool and the top of your queue. 

#### Turn on AI prospect response review

Go to **Configure** > **AI Tools** and select “Prospect response review” on to activate the feature.

A tag is only assigned when the system is at least 90% confident in its interpretation. You can still add or change sentiments manually, even with the automated analysis turned on.

For more details on AI and ML security, refer to our [AI/ML Security Support Document.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/24315491395227-AI-ML-Security-Privacy)

# Release Notes: 2020 - September 11

In an effort to improve our suite of products, Greenhouse Software regularly releases new product features, updates, and improvements. Stay up-to-date with what's new at Greenhouse by **Following** our [Release Notes](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/sections/360000710732-Release-Notes).

Classic Interviewer permissions are still available for now, but [will be deprecated](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360046082131) in late October.

Streamline your scheduling process by sending an Availability Request email automatically to a candidate when any member of your team advances them to a specified stage.   * A Scorecard Notifications update is also on the horizon! These updates will give your organization greater control over notification cadence, plus new options to keep your interviewing team in the loop as scorecards are submitted. In addition, more users will have access to enable the Slack integration, allowing your team to reach interviewers outside of email.

Choreographed Introductions is a flexible email tool that allows your team to send customized, automated notifications about a New Hire class to relevant employees at your organization. This feature will help you set expectations and keep team members informed on what’s happening with new hires as the Onboarding plan progresses.

  * Users can now map Yes/No type fields from Greenhouse Recruiting to Greenhouse Onboarding.

# Remove job permissions from a specific user

**Permissions:** Site Admin, Job Admin who can add users to their assigned jobs

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Job permissions can be assigned to Job Admin to dictate how much access they have on each job. For example, one job admin may be given access to move candidate's stages, where another may just be able to view candidate details. If no job permission is assigned to a Job Admin / Interviewer user on a job, the user will not be able to access the job.

While Job Admin permissions are created under the [Permissions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/207813806) page, an individual user's permissions can be updated on the user page.

**Note:** Prior to removing a user's job-based permissions, we recommend reviewing [the impacts of removing user permissions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040189391#h_c9053ec1-ded3-4177-a900-02fe84c94908). 

### Remove a user's permission on a job

Open the user's permissions by navigating to **Configure** > **Users** and selecting their name from the list.

On the _Edit User_ page, scroll down and click **Add** in the  _Job-Based Permissions_ panel. 

Click the **Edit** icon next to the permission. 

Select **None** from the dropdown and click **Save**.

# Review applications in bulk

**Permissions:** Job Admins who can view or edit candidates or above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

For job posts that receive a high volume of applicants, you might want to bulk review a subset of applications from the candidate pool based on relevant filters or tags. By knowing that you're looking at a subset of applications that fit certain criteria (such as willingness to relocate or other custom fields), you can streamline your recruiting process and avoid mental stress. 

Bulk Application Review can only be performed on Candidates for a single job in a review stage type in the hiring process (i.e. Application review, Hiring Manager review). If a candidate is selected but not in a reviewable stage, they will not be included in the process.

**Note:** You will still need to individually review, move, or reject each application while using this process. However, it limits the applications in the Application Review to only the selected candidates.

### Select candidates for bulk review

Navigate to a specific job and select the **Candidates** tab. You'll see a list of all current candidates for the job.

Choose **Candidates only** in the **Application Type** filter on the left side of the page. 

Define any other filters for your list and select **Bulk Actions** on the right side of the page. 

Select the checkboxes for each candidate you want to include.

Select **Edit Selected**. 

Click **Application Review** in the Bulk Action dialog box. 

The selected applications will open inside the application review workflow where you can quickly process them. [Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4401963991707) for more information on completing the application review.

# StaffGeek integration

StaffGeek helps your company identify which candidates are the right fit by creating a customized FitTech™ assessment around your company. Your FitTech assessment is based on your company's distinct attributes or DNA. Your company DNA will identify what is critical for success at your company. For every FitTech assessment that is filled out, a FitTech report will be generated demonstrating how that particular candidate scored relative to your company DNA.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with StaffGeek allows you to seamlessly add StaffGeek's assessment to a job's interview plan.

#### In this article

  * Enable the StaffGeek integration
  * Send and review the StaffGeek FitTech survey
  * Additional resources



### Enable the StaffGeek integration

To start, contact your StaffGeek representative at [hello@staffgeek.com](mailto:hello@staffgeek.com) to receive your API key.

Once you've received your API key, fill out the form at [www.greenhouse.io/asksupport](http://support.greenhouse.io/direct) or _[click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/requests/new)_ to open a ticket.

**Note** : Don't send the API key in this initial email. Greenhouse Technical Support will respond with a [SendSafely link](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/) for you to securely share your API key.

Once Greenhouse Technical Support receives your API key via SendSafely, we'll email you to confirm that your API key has been set up in your account and that your integration is enabled.

**Note:** To verify your identity, Greenhouse Technical Support might request you provide a [support verification code](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022771952) before adding the API key to your organization's account.

Once the Greenhouse Recruiting / StaffGeek integration is enabled for your organization, the StaffGeek stage with your assessments will be set up for you automatically.

### Send and review the StaffGeek FitTech survey

When a candidate is moved into the StaffGeek interview stage, Greenhouse Recruiting will display a **Send Test** link. Click the **Send Test** link to begin the process of sending a survey to a candidate.

**Note:** When you send a test from Greenhouse Recruiting, the interview instructions are actually sent by StaffGeek.

Click the _Test_ dropdown to select your StaffGeek test, called _FitTech [Company Name]_.

Select a user who should review the survey when completed by the candidate.

When finished, click **Send Test** at the bottom.

The candidate will receive an email with a link to the survey. When a candidate completes the survey, the user who was selected as the grader will receive an email notification with a link to the Survey Results PDF.

To view more details about a candidate's score, or add notes to the candidate's scorecard, navigate to the candidate's profile in Greenhouse Recruiting, then click on the StaffGeek scorecard.

From the StaffGeek scorecard, the **Grading Instructions** tab will allow you to review notes about the candidate's score, as well as access the URL to the Survey Results PDF. The assigned grader can complete their scorecard feedback from the **Scorecard** tab on this page as well.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to StaffGeek support at [support@staffgeek.com](mailto:support@staffgeek.com).

# Real Talent instructions

Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro) with the Real Talent add‑on. 

If you don’t see Real Talent in your account, contact your Greenhouse representative to learn more.

Real Talent is an add‑on suite that helps you reduce fraud, cut down on spam, and focus on qualified candidates in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Real Talent includes four key features:

  * **Identity verification with****CLEAR®****:** Confirms that candidates are who they say they are using Greenhouse's partnership with CLEAR.
  * **Fraud detection:** Flags unusual or risky application patterns so your team can focus on real candidates.
  * **Spam blocklist:** Helps keep your outreach focused on genuine candidates and protect your pipeline from malicious or risky outreach. 
  * **Talent Matching:** An AI‑assisted feature in the Real Talent suite that surfaces candidates who are a strong fit for your jobs based on your defined criteria and weighted calibration.



Depending on which features you’re using, you’ll need to adjust some settings in Greenhouse Recruiting. Follow the sections below to get Real Talent set up.

For a high‑level summary of each Real Talent feature and links to all related guides, see[ Real Talent overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/45127324799003-Real-Talent-overview).

#### In this article

  * Real Talent settings page
  * Identity verification with CLEAR
  * Spam blocklist
  * Talent Matching setup
  * Fraud detection setup



### Real Talent settings page

Most settings for the Real Talent beta can be configured under _Configure_ > _Real Talent_.

Users must be a Site Admin to access this page.

### CLEAR setup

#### Configure settings

To begin, go to the _Real Talent_ settings page. From there, update your offices and departments to specify where you want to enable CLEAR identity verification.

Once enabled, candidates in those offices or departments will go through CLEAR’s identity verification process as part of their application.

#### Update permissions

Next, update the [Job Admin permissions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360039863731-Edit-or-delete-a-Job-Admin-level) for your users who will be responsible for sending and receiving CLEAR ID verifications. 

  * **Can view identity verification details:** Able to see CLEAR results when they are received from a candidate.
  * **Can request identity verification details:** Able to send CLEAR identity requests to the candidate



[Read more about sending CLEAR identity verification requests. ](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/40893011137179/)

### Spam blocklist setup

The IP address and email domain blocklist can be configured on _Configure_ > _Real Talent_ > _Spam_. For step‑by‑step instructions and guardrails, see[ Spam blocklist setup](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/41595563125787-Block-IP-addresses-and-email-domains)

### Talent Matching setup

#### Turn on Talent Matching for your organization

Talent Matching is part of the Real Talent add‑on and can be managed from the _AI Tools_ page. Site Admins can enable this feature for your organization.

**Note:** Both _Talent Matching_ and _Resume parsing_ must be enabled to use the full Talent Matching functionality.

Then go to _Configure > Real Talent > Talent Matching_ to choose which offices and departments can use Talent Matching and to manage AI transparency settings.

For detailed enablement and calibration steps, see the following articles:

  * [**Talent Matching setup**](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/45126074890523-Talent-Matching-setup)
  * [**Talent Matching**](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/41396009937307-Talent-Matching)



#### Configure AI disclaimers and candidate AI opt-out

Some jurisdictions may require candidate disclosures and/or alternatives to AI‑assisted review. If your organization enables candidate AI opt‑out, candidates can request manual review instead of AI‑assisted review on a per‑job basis.

To manage AI transparency language for job posts, use _Configure > Real Talent > Talent Matching_ or click **Open settings** on the _AI Tools_ page.

Click the **Edit** button.

Turn on the disclaimer by clicking the checkbox and following the instructions on the page to update the disclaimer language.

When you're finished, click **Save**.

[Read more about Talent Matching.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/41396009937307)

For more about how Talent Matching processes and stores candidate data, including match scores, calibration history, and industry signals, see[ ](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/41131616864283-Talent-Matching-Data-Processing-FAQ)[Talent Matching – Data Processing FAQ.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/41131616864283-Talent-Matching-Data-Processing-FAQ)

### Note on GDPR

If your organization operates under GDPR regulations, make sure to update your _GDPR_ _data retention rules_ for Real Talent features. In particular, review the _Data to be Deleted_ settings to ensure they include CLEAR identity data, Spam blocklist data, and **T** alent Matching match scores and reasoning, so that candidate information is deleted appropriately when requested or when your configured retention period expires.

  * [Candidate packets](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000916572) can be updated under _Configure_ > _Candidate Packets_.
  * [Data retention rules](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360002418112) can be updated under _Configure_ > _Privacy and Compliance_ > _GDPR_ > _Data retention rules_.



For more detail on Talent Matching data, including how match scores, industry signals, calibration history, and candidate AI opt‑out interact with data retention, see:

[Talent Matching setup](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/45126074890523-Talent-Matching-setup)

[Talent Matching – Data Processing FAQ](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/41131616864283-Talent-Matching-Data-Processing-FAQ)

### Fraud Detection setup 

To set up Fraud Detection, you'll need to update your Real Talent settings and update permission levels.

#### Update Real Talent settings

Fraud detection settings can be updated under _Configure_ > _Real Talent_ > _Fraud detection_. 

Choose which offices and departments should have fraud detection.

**Note:** Fraud reports run automatically for organizations on the Pro subscription tier. Organizations on the Plus subscription tier need to run reports manually. 

#### Permissions

You can add the ability to view and run fraud reports to your existing Job Admin levels. To edit your levels, go to  _Configure_. Select **Permissions** from the menu, then select **See and manage Job Admin levels** _._**** Assign the following permissions to users to give them access to fraud detection:

  * **Can view fraud reports:** The user is able to see the results of existing fraud reports
  * **Can run fraud reports:** The user can run new fraud reports

# Troubleshoot single sign-on (SSO)

**Learn more about SSO**

[Single sign-on (SSO) overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/210259723)

[Configure single sign-on (SSO) for Greenhouse Recruiting](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040753811)

Greenhouse Recruiting provides people with the ability to sign on via [single sign-on (SSO)](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/210259723-Single-Sign-On-overview). SSO enables your organization to better manage data security, enforce access protocols, and maintain user accounts on the hiring software.

Sometimes you may have trouble signing in with SSO, or you may have trouble enabling SSO for your organization. We've collected a few quick troubleshooting steps to help get you back on track.

#### In this article

  * **Login**
    * Unable to login
    * How do I reset my password?
    * How do I allow third parties to access Greenhouse Recruiting?
    * Why can't I sign in with Google?
    * Who do I contact for help?
  * **SSO configuration**
    * How do I enable SSO?
    * What's the default session timeout?
    * How do I replace an expired certificate?
    * How do I deactivate SSO?
    * Can I enable SSO with more than one provider?
  * **Error messages**
    * "Your SSO integration appears to be misconfigured."



### Login

#### Unable to login

If you're unable to log in, reach out to your SSO provider or your IT department. Once SSO is enabled for your organization, you'll need to log in from your SSO provider to access Greenhouse Recruiting. Any username or password resets should be completed in your SSO provider, and not on Greenhouse Recruiting itself.

#### How do I reset my password?

If you forgot your username or password, reset it via your SSO provider or reach out to your IT department.

#### How do I allow third parties to access Greenhouse Recruiting with SSO?

Once SSO is enabled for your organization, all of your users must log in to Greenhouse Recruiting with SSO. For this reason, any third parties such as developers, analysts, or recruiters that need access must have an SSO profile [configured](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040753811) in your idP.

#### Why can't I sign in with Google?

Sign in with Google is not synonymous with SSO and is only available for organizations that have configured this alternate authentication method for apps like Greenhouse Recruiting. While you may see the option to Sign in with Google, if your organization has enabled SSO you can _only_ log in using your SSO provider.

#### Who do I contact for help?

Contact your IT department or the administrator for your company's SSO provider for help signing in.

### SSO configuration

#### How do I enable SSO?

Check out [Configure single sign-on (SSO) for Greenhouse Recruiting](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040753811).

#### What's the default session timeout?

The default session timeout for SSO on Greenhouse Recruiting is thirty (30) days. Your SSO provider's session timeout will take precedence over the Greenhouse Recruiting timeout. If you prefer a shorter session timeout for Greenhouse Recruiting, reach out to [Greenhouse Technical Support](https://support.greenhouse.io/direct).

#### How do I replace an expired certificate?

You can [update your SSO configuration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040753811-Configure-Single-Sign-On-SSO-in-Greenhouse-Recruiting#h_6a513f87-8ed2-4ead-b9e0-6075c2e79786) at any time in Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### How do I deactivate SSO?

To deactivate SSO, reach out to [Greenhouse Technical Support](https://support.greenhouse.io/direct).

**Note** : If your team deactivates SSO, each user at your organization must [request a password reset](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360002289251) via email and create a new password to regain access to Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### Can I enable more than one SSO provider?

Greenhouse Recruiting only supports one SSO provider per instance.

### Error messages

#### "Your SSO integration appears to be misconfigured."

This error message means that your user account is not provisioned for Greenhouse Recruiting in your SSO. Reach out to your IT team for help getting Greenhouse Recruiting added to your SSO profile.

# Hired integration

Hired believes we are entering a new era of work, where people are not looking for jobs — they are seeking opportunities. Focusing on in-demand technology roles, Hired intelligently matches outstanding people to full-time and freelance opportunities at the world's most innovative companies.

#### In this article

  * Configure user setup permissions
  * Create a Harvest API key for the Greenhouse Recruiting / Hired integration
  * Enter the Harvest API key in Hired



### Configure user setup permissions

In order to enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Hired integration, you will need the developer permission **Can manage ALL organization’s API Credentials**.

Contact a Greenhouse Recruiting user in your organization with Site Admin level permissions with the additional user-specific permission **Can edit another user's advanced permissions** to apply the API credential management permission to your account. Have the user with Site Admin level permissions edit your user account's permissions by navigating to the **Configure** icon  > **Users** > **Your Name**.

The user with Site Admin level permissions should navigate to the _User-Specific Permissions_ panel on your user page and click **manage ALL organization’s API Credentials** under the Developer Permissions section. When finished, click **Save**.

Repeat as necessary for any other user that should have access to set up the integration.

### Create a Harvest API key for the Greenhouse Recruiting / Hired integration

To create a Harvest API key for the integration, click the **Configure** icon  in the upper right-hand corner. Navigate to **Dev Center** on the left-hand panel. From the _Dev Center_ page, click**API Credential Management**.

From the _API Credential Management_ page, click **Create New API Key** to generate the API key for Hired.

In the _Create New Credential_ dialog box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type** : Harvest
  * **Partner** : Hired
  * **Description** : _Hired Harvest API Key_



When finished, click **Manage Permissions** to generate the Harvest API key and automatically assign it the appropriate permissions required by Hired.

In the subsequent dialog box, click **Copy** to save your API key to your clipboard. Store the API key in a secure location to provide to Hired in the next step. Click **I have stored the API Key** once you have copied and saved the key.

**Note** : You cannot access the full Harvest API key again after clicking **I have stored the API Key**. If you lose your API key and need to access it later, you must create a new API key, provide it to the integration partner, and then revoke access to the original key.

On the subsequent page, confirm the following permissions are assigned to your new API key:

**Applications**

  * GET: Retrieve Application
  * GET: List Applications



**Candidates**

  * GET: Retrieve Candidate
  * GET: List Candidates
  * POST: Add Candidate

  * POST: Add Application
  * POST: Add Prospect

  * GET: List Job Posts
  * GET: Retrieve Job Post for Job
  * GET: List Job Posts for Job



**Job Stages**

  * GET: Retrieve Job Stage
  * GET: List Job Stages
  * GET: List Job Stages for Job



**Jobs**

  * GET: Retrieve Job
  * GET: List Jobs



**Scheduled Interviews**

  * GET: List Interviews for Application
  * GET: Retrieve Interview
  * GET: List Interviews



**Sources**

  * GET: List Sources



**Users**

  * GET: Retrieve User

# Turn off notifications for multiple jobs

**Permissions:** **Job** **Admin** and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Job notifications automatically update configured users on recent actions that have occurred for a particular job. In this article, we will cover how to remove a user from the notifications list for job events across multiple jobs.

_**Note** : A user can only remove other users from the notification list on jobs where they (the removing user) have Job Admin permission levels or above_

Job notifications are sent via email and can be configured for the following events that occur for a job:

**Job Event** | **Description**  
---|---  
[Weekly Recruiting Report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360016456671-Weekly-Recruiting-Report) | A weekly email that summarizes the week's recruiting activity for the job.  
[New Applicants](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360028659832) | An email is generated for each new candidate that applies to the job.  
[New Internal Applicants](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360028978271) | An email is generated for each new internal applicant to the job.  
[New Referrals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029035211) | An email is generated for each referral submitted to the job.  
[New Agency Submissions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360028757892) | An email is generated for each new agency submission to the job.  
[Stage Transitions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029079151) | An email is generated when candidates enter into stages configured for notifications.  
[New Scorecards](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029087331) | An email is generated when interviewer scorecards are submitted for stages configured for notifications.  
  
_**Note:** [Stage transition](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029079151) and [new scorecard](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029087331) notifications can be turned off on a per-job basis only. _

To remove a user from the notifications list for job events, click the **Configure** icon  on your navigation bar, and select **Notifications** from the left.

On the _Notifications_ page, select the _Set Notifications by_ option for **User**.

Navigate to a user from the subsequent list and click **Edit** to the right of _**# jobs**_ inline with the user's name.

From the subsequent dialog box, click **Turn all off** inline with any job event. The user will be removed from the notification list for all jobs where you have Job Admin level permissions or above.

Click **Done** when finished.

Repeat as necessary for other job events and other users.

# Nexa integration

Nexa is an end-to-end career service and hiring platform for enterprises, training centers, and job seekers. Nexa’s RU product helps companies source, vet, screen, and connect with top 1% talent efficiently. Hiring today is costly, inefficient, and often very time-consuming- Nexa’s technology and platform solves this in the best way with AI.

Nexa’s integration with Greenhouse platform allows quick analysis of candidate resumes and evaluates their fit against job descriptions for the roles they are applying to. By seamlessly integrating with Greenhouse Recruiting, Nexa integration provides the following key benefits:

  * **Comprehensive Candidate Feedback** : Within 10–15 minutes of applying for a role, candidates receive detailed feedback on how closely they align with the job requirements. This feedback includes the specific parameters used in the evaluation, empowering candidates to better understand their fit for the role.
  * **Effortless Resume Assessment for Recruiters** : Recruiters save valuable time by focusing only on resumes that align most closely with job requirements. Nexa automatically scores and prioritizes resumes, eliminating the need for manual screening.



Included integration features:

  * **Resume Parsing:** Candidate resumes submitted through Greenhouse Recruiting are retrieved via the Harvest API for AI-driven analysis.
  * **Job Description Matching:** Using job description data accessed via the API, Nexa evaluates candidates against the role's key qualifications.
  * **Score Delivery:** The results of the analysis, including a compatibility score, are made available to recruiters directly within Greenhouse Recruiting.



#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API key
  * Create a webhook
  * Create custom candidate fields
  * Use the Nexa integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Frequently asked questions
  * Additional resources



### Create a Harvest API key

To configure the Nexa integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key.

The created API key must be emailed to [welcome@trynexa.com](mailto:welcome@trynexa.com) with the subject _Greenhouse/Nexa integration: <your organization name>_. The received API key will be utilized by the Nexa platform to invoke Greenhouse Harvest APIs for updating the results of resume evaluations. We recommend using a secure service such as SendSafely when sending sensitive data such as API keys.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the Nexa integration. 

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Nexa or Unlisted Vendor
  * **Description:** Nexa Harvest API Key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Nexa integration: 

  * **Candidates**
    * GET: Retrieve Candidate
    * POST: Add E-mail Note
    * PATCH: Edit Candidate
  * **Job**
    * GET: List Job Posts for Job
  * **Application**
    * GET: Retrieve Application
    * POST: Reject Application
    * POST: Move Application 
  * **Job Stages**
    * GET: List Job Stages
  * **Users**
    * GET: List Users



### Create a webhook

Next, you'll need to create a Webhook in Greenhouse by following the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360005574531-Create-a-webhook). Use the following values to create the webhook.

  *     * **When:** Candidate has submitted application
    * **Endpoint URL:** https://9o3spfzsu2.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/downloadResumeFunction
    * **Secret Key** : 53d3ddba744d81ae4057e25a6723d6ef-8



### Create custom candidate fields

You'll need to create 5 custom candidate fields for this integration. Create the following custom candidate fields by following the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202609675-Add-or-edit-a-custom-candidate-field).

  *     * **Field name:** Risk justification 
      * **Field type:** Short textbox
    * **Field name:** Risk score 
      * **Field type:** Short textbox
    * **Field name:** Skill justification 
      * **Field type:** Short textbox
    * **Field name:** Skill score 
      * **Field type:** Short textbox
    * **Field name:** Interview screening 
      * **Field type:** Short textbox



### Use the Nexa integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

After the setup of Nexa integration is complete, the integration features are utilized by the users as follows for candidate screening.

  * When a candidate applies to a job, NEXA will evaluate the candidate application against the job description
  * Using the Candidate application ID and the Job ID received from the webhook trigger, NEXA API downloads the job description and candidate resume for evaluation.
  * NEXA evaluates the resume using AI technologies and compares it with the job description.
  * Compatibility scores and feedback are sent back to Greenhouse via API invocations for recruiter access.



Here is an example of Nexa evaluation on the candidate application as seen in Greenhouse UI. The evaluation is displayed using the custom candidate fields configured above.

  * Candidates receive personalized feedback via email from Nexa. The emails are pre-configured and cannot be customized by the customer currently. 
    * Here is a screenshot of an example email with personalized feedback of the candidate’s resume evaluation.



### Frequently asked questions

**How does NEXA ensure data security?**

NEXA follows industry standards for data encryption and does not store sensitive candidate data beyond the evaluation period.

**How quickly are results generated?**

Compatibility scores and candidate feedback are typically delivered within 10–15 minutes of submission.

**What happens if a candidate applies to multiple roles?**

Each application is evaluated individually based on the specific job description.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [welcome@trynexa.com](mailto:welcome@trynexa.com).

# Does Greenhouse scan resumes and other attachments for viruses?

Yes - attachments added to Greenhouse Recruiting are scanned to ensure security issues won't disrupt your hiring process.

**Note:** The virus scanner does not scan files larger than 50MB. However, candidates aren't able to upload any files larger than 50MB. If you have a large file to attach to a candidate profile, you can [manually upload](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058891331) it on their _Details_ tab.

In most cases, you'll never see the virus scanner, but it will run in the background when a new document is uploaded. Additionally, any questionable attachments are removed from automated candidate emails, such as a new candidate applying to a job.

If Greenhouse Recruiting detects an issue, you'll be notified and asked to confirm before downloading the file.

Additionally, Greenhouse Recruiting will warn you about any malicious files if you try to email your recruiting team about a candidate so you don't inadvertently impact other users in your organization.

# Create or update a job with Harvest API

**Permissions:** Basic and above who can manage ALL organization's API credentials

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

This article outlines the API requests needed in order to create a new job in Greenhouse Recruiting and import all job information from a third-party system through the [Greenhouse Harvest API](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html).

#### In this article

  * Integration development in Greenhouse Recruiting sandboxes
  * Create a new Greenhouse Recruiting job (via POST: Create job)
  * Add custom job field values and update existing jobs (via PATCH: Update job)
    * Add a job post description (via PATCH: Update job post)
    * Add a hiring team to a job
    * Add a job opening (via POST: Create new openings)
    * Edit a job opening (via PATCH: Edit Openings)
    * Custom job field options



**Note** : This article assumes that you have [established API connectivity](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029266032).

### Integration development in Greenhouse Recruiting sandboxes

A Greenhouse Recruiting sandbox isn't a copy of production. A sandbox is a distinct environment, and the settings and data cannot be copied over or moved between a Greenhouse Recruiting sandbox and a production instance. The Greenhouse Recruiting sandbox is a secondary empty production instance that can be used for testing integrations or alternative workflows or settings. It's important to note that Greenhouse Recruiting object IDs (such as job ID, user ID, or custom fIeld IDs) will be different between sandbox and production, and the Harvest API key will be different between sandbox and production instances as well.

### Create a new Greenhouse Recruiting job (via POST: Create job)

The POST request can be used only to initially create the job and add the following default field values:

  * Number of openings
  * Job name
  * department
  * office
  * Requisition / opening IDs



You will also need to make a subsequent **PATCH: Update Job** request to add custom job field values (see: Add custom Job Field Values and Update Existing Jobs).

Only the Greenhouse Recruiting template job ID, number of openings, and job name are required. The template job will be used to populate workflows and objects that cannot be imported via the API (like scorecards or hiring teams), as Greenhouse Recruiting typically is the source of truth for these items.

**Note** : We strongly recommend including an office and / or department value in the initial POST: Create job request because the offices and departments a job is assigned to can have many dependent workflows in Greenhouse. Check out the [Office and department dependent workflows](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029591631) help guide for more information. We recommend reviewing these dependencies with your recruiting team to see if any will be impacted by your integration.

Below are the additional resources typically required to create the POST: Create Job request:

  * [GET: List Jobs](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-jobs): to retrieve the job ID values needed to fill the `template_job_id`
  * [GET: List offices](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-offices): to retrieve the Greenhouse office ID values or external values stored in Greenhouse Recruiting
  * [GET: List departments](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-departments): to retrieve the Greenhouse department ID values or external values stored in Greenhouse Recruiting



**Example**
    
    
    curl -X POST \  
     https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/jobs \  
     -H 'Authorization: Basic *******' \  
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  
     -H 'on-behalf-of: 123456 \  
     -d '{  
     "template_job_id": 1023578,  
     "number_of_openings": 2,  
     "job_post_name": "API Test Job - External Name",  
     "job_name": "API Test Job",  
     "external_department_id": “GEN”,  
     "office_ids": [  
     61348   
     ],  
     "requisition_id": "ABC",  
     "opening_ids": [  
     "ABC-1",   
     "ABC-2"  
     ]  
    }'

### Add custom job field values and update existing jobs (via PATCH: Update job)

This can be used to update both default and custom job field values on existing jobs, or to add custom field job values to a new job. To make this PATCH request to update custom job field values, you must:

1\. [GET: List jobs](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-jobs) to pull the Greenhouse Recruiting job ID for the job you need to update. The below example retrieves the job using the `requisition_id` "ABC-123."

**Example**
    
    
    curl -X GET \  
     'https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/jobs?requisition_id=ABC-123' \  
     -H 'Authorization: Basic *******’ \  
     

2\. [GET: List custom fields](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-custom-fields) to retrieve all custom job field name keys and available option values for single and multi-select fields

**Note** : Any single-select or multi-select field values must match an available field option name or ID in Greenhouse Recruiting exactly for the PATCH to be successful.

**Example**
    
    
    curl -X GET \  
     https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/custom_fields/job \  
     -H 'Authorization: Basic *******' \  
      
    [  
     {  
     "id": 152956,  
     "name": "Short Textbox Test",  
     "active": true,  
     "field_type": "job",  
     "priority": 11,  
     "value_type": "short_text",  
     "private": true,  
     "required": false,  
     "require_approval": true,  
     "trigger_new_version": false,  
     "name_key": "short_textbox",  
     "custom_field_options": []  
     },  
     {  
     "id": 284617,  
     "name": "Cost Center",  
     "active": true,  
     "field_type": "job",  
     "priority": 14,  
     "value_type": "single_select",  
     "private": false,  
     "required": true,  
     "require_approval": true,  
     "trigger_new_version": false,  
     "name_key": "cost_center",  
     "custom_field_options": [  
     {  
     "id": 12302153,  
     "name": "option 1",  
     "priority": 0  
     },  
     {  
     "id": 12302154,  
     "name": "option 2",  
     "priority": 1  
     },  
     {  
     "id": 12302155,  
     "name": "option 3",  
     "priority": 2  
     },  
     {  
     "id": 12302156,  
     "name": "option 4",  
     "priority": 3  
     },  
     {  
     "id": 12302157,  
     "name": "option 5",  
     "priority": 4  
     }  
     ]  
     },...  
     }  
    ]

Once you have retrieved all the custom field `name_keys` and `custom_field_options`, you can use this request to PATCH an existing job’s custom field values. Below is an example including each available custom field type, for reference. The multi-select and single-select fields use text matching to write / update values:

**Example**
    
    
    curl -X PATCH \  
     https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/jobs/1019899 \  
     -H 'Authorization: Basic *******' \  
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  
     -H 'on-behalf-of: 123456 \  
     -d '{  
     "name": "Updated Job Name",  
    "department_id":53771,  
     "external_office_ids": "APAC-1",  
     "custom_fields":[  
     {  
     "name_key":"short_textbox",  
     "value":"This is a short text field for comments."  
     },  
     {  
     "name_key":"long_textbox",  
     "value":"This is a long text field for comments exceeding 255 characters."  
     },  
     {  
     "name_key": "cost_center",  
     "value": "option 4"  
     },  
     {  
     "name_key": "custom_multi_select_field",  
     "value":  
     [  
     "Multi select 1",  
     "Multi select 2"  
     ]  
     },  
     {  
     "name_key":"recruiter",  
     "value": 793196  
     },  
     {  
     "name_key": "salary_range",  
     "min_value": 75000,  
     "max_value": 95000,  
     "unit": "USD"  
     },  
     {  
     "name_key": "currency_field",  
     "value": 87500,  
     "unit": "USD"  
     },  
     {  
     "name_key": "number_range",  
     "min_value": 0,  
     "max_value": 10  
     },  
     {  
     "name_key":"level",  
     "value":"Mid"  
     },  
     {  
     "name_key": "travel_required_",  
     "value": "no"  
     },  
     {  
     "name_key": "expiration_date",  
     "value": "01/01/2020"  
     },  
     {  
     "name_key":"url_example",  
     "value": "https://testingexample.com"  
     }  
     ]  
    }'  
     

#### Add a job post description (via PATCH: Update job post)

Each Greenhouse Recruiting job can have one or more job posts that can be made live on your careers page. The job must already have a placeholder job post created in order to use this endpoint. **  
**

  1. Retrieve the job post ID via [GET: List job posts for job](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-job-posts-for-job).
  2. Make the PATCH: Update job post request:



**Example**
    
    
    curl -X PATCH \  
     https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/job_posts/1611527 \  
     -H 'Authorization: Basic *******' \  
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  
     -H 'on-behalf-of: 123456 \  
     -d '{  
     "status": "live",  
     "title": "Ice Cream Vendor",  
     "location": "New York, NY",  
     "content": "This is where the job post description should go."  
    }'

#### Add a hiring team to a job

[Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029266172) for information on how to add a hiring team to a job via Harvest API.

#### Add a job opening (via POST: Create new openings)

The POST: Create new openings endpoint can be used to add a new opening to an existing job.

**Example**
    
    
    curl -X POST \  
     https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/jobs/1019899/openings \  
     -H 'Authorization: Basic *******' \  
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  
     -H 'on-behalf-of: 123456’ \  
     -d '{  
     "opening_id": "ABC-3"  
     }   
    }'

#### Edit a job opening (via PATCH: Edit openings)

This endpoint can be used to edit an existing opening on a job. You can close an opening via the API, but you cannot re-open a closed opening via the API.

**Note** : You need to first [GET: List job openings](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-job-openings) for the job and use the Greenhouse Recruiting opening ID that is returned in the response. You can only PATCH open openings, and you are limited to either updating the opening ID **or** closing the opening (you can not do both at once). The example below demonstrates how you would close **opening ID 2460180**. `Close_reason_id` is an optional field; you can pull the available close reasons via [GET: List close reasons](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-close-reasons).

**Example**
    
    
    curl -X PATCH \  
     https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/jobs/1019899/openings/2460180 \  
     -H 'Authorization: Basic *******' \  
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  
     -H 'on-behalf-of: 123456’ \  
     -d '{  
     "status": "closed",  
     "close_reason_id": 18137  
    }'

#### Custom job field options

Custom field options can be added and maintained through the API on single-select or multi-select custom job fields. You can find more information about this in the following article: [Custom options sync overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360044483232-Custom-Options-Sync-Overview).

  * [GET: List Custom Fields](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-custom-fields) – retrieve field and option value IDs for PATCH Update Job request.
  * [POST](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#post-create-custom-field-options) / [PATCH](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#patch-update-custom-field-options) / [DELETE](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#delete-remove-custom-field-options) Custom field options – modify option values on an existing custom field.

# Ramped organic job posts

Greenhouse Recruiting offers the ability to post free job advertisements on many job boards, including Ramped. These free ads can help expand your sourcing, allowing you to access more candidates at no additional cost to your organization.

Unlike posting to other job boards which are determined on a job post by job post basis, the Ramped integration is configured on the organization-level, meaning all of your live job posts will automatically sync to Ramped’s job board once enabled.

Ramped's integration with Greenhouse recruiting allows Greenhouse users to post open job requirements to the Ramped job board and receive qualified candidates from Ramped directly into your Greenhouse system.

#### In this article

  * Enable Ramped organic job posts
  * Edit or delete a job post on Ramped
  * Additional resources



### Enable Ramped organic job posts

To enable Ramped organic job posts, click the **Configure** icon on your navigation bar, then click **Job Boards & Posts** on the left.

Click the **Ellipsis** icon beside your job board and select **Edit Board Settings** from the dropdown.

Scroll to _Allow candidates to apply directly from Ramped_ and select **Yes**.

When finished, click **Save**.

Once enabled, all live job posts from the job board you selected will be sent to Ramped.

**Note:** Your job post must have a location selected under Job Setup > Job Posts, or the job post will not sync.

Candidates applying through these job posts will be added to Greenhouse Recruiting with Ramped as the source.

**Note:** Once a job post is published, Greenhouse Recruiting sends the job post information to Ramped within 3 – 4 hours. From there, it can take up to 48 hours for the data to be processed and the job post to appear on Ramped’s job board.

### Edit or delete a job post on Ramped

To edit the content of a job post or remove it entirely from the Ramped job board, [edit or delete the job post](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002791566-Edit-external-job-post) on Greenhouse Recruiting.

Your changes will sync with Ramped the next time Ramped receives updates from Greenhouse Recruiting.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [success@rampedcareers.com](mailto:success@rampedcareers.com)

# Dstribute.io integration

**Elevate Your OFCCP Compliance and Expand Your Reach with Dstribute.io**

Stop managing OFCCP compliance job-by-job. The Dstribute.io OFCCP Posting Service is configured at the organization level to seamlessly integrate with your Greenhouse Recruiting job board feed, ensuring all your live job posts are automatically synced and distributed to the appropriate state job boards.

**Key Benefits:**

  * **Effortless Compliance:** Automatically posts all your jobs to the required state-specific sites based on job location. For remote or nationwide roles, we use your corporate headquarters as the posting location to ensure compliance coverage.
  * **Maximize Reach:** Go beyond compliance with our robust diversity network of over 11 sites and our extensive, geo-location-driven outreach to a 25,000+ email list of targeted contacts.
  * **Simplified Credentialing:** We process your active postings, evaluate required state locations, and can even assist you in creating the active credentials needed for state job boards you haven't yet configured. Once we have confirmed your credentials are active and valid, your jobs are automatically posted.
  * **Total Transparency and Audit Readiness:** Gain full access to the Dstribute system for clear, transparent information on all your job postings. We also provide weekly reports on any rejected jobs or missing credentials, giving you peace of mind during OFCCP audits or requests.



The combination of required state site posting, a powerful diversity network, and targeted outreach solidifies all your OFCCP posting requirements with a single, organization-level integration.

#### In this article

  * Locate your job board URL
  * Edit or delete a job post on State-Specific Job Boards
  * Enabling OFCCP Source tracking
  * Additional resources



### Locate your job board URL

To make your open jobs available to Dstribute.io, you’ll need to send your job board URL.

You can find your Job Board URL by navigating to the Job Board settings. (**Configure** > **Job Boards & Posts** > **Ellipsis** icon next to job board > **Edit Board Settings**) and scroll to the URL field.

Once you have this URL, send it to [**dstribute.io**](http://dstribute.io)**at** support@dstribute.io.

[Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888210160155) for a more detailed walkthrough of how to locate your job board URL.

Once Dstribute enables the integration, all live job posts from the job board you selected will be sent to Dstribute.io.

**Note:** Your job post must have a location selected under **Job** **Setup** > **Job** **Posts** ; otherwise, it will not sync.

Any job posting that does not have a valid City / State combination (i.e., remote and nationwide) will be posted under the company's headquarters.

This information will be configured during initial setup at dstrbute.io

**Note:** Once a job post is published, dstribute will automatically import your jobs multiple times a day. From there, it can take up to 48 hours for the data to be processed and the job post to appear on the correct OFCCP site.

You are required to have an account with each individual state job board, and [dstribute.io](http://dstribute.io) can help you set up all of your sites. You will manage your job board credentials on dstribute.io.

Once your job has been imported, dstribute will automatically post it to the diversity network and email it to the appropriate outreach contacts using geo-location data.

### Edit or delete a job post on State-Specific Job Boards

To edit the content of a job post or remove it entirely from the specific OFCCP state job board, [edit or delete the job post](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002791566-Edit-external-job-post) on Greenhouse Recruiting. Please note that not all state Job boards support edits and deletions.

Your changes will automatically sync with dstribute.io the next time dstribute.io receives updates from Greenhouse Recruiting and will update or delete your position accordingly.

### Enabling OFCCP Source tracking

If you want to [add a custom source](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200721664-Add-custom-source), such as the example below, for your applicants, you can do the following.

Click the Gear icon to get to the (**Configure page**)

Click on **Custom Options,** then**Sourcing Strategies**  
From the Manage Sourcing Strategies page, create a new sourcing strategy as **OFCCP**(or any label you wish to use).

Once created, go back to the **Custom Options** page and click on the **Source option.**

**Click the Create New Source** button and select the custom OFCCP as your Sourcing Strategy, and then enter **Dstribute** as the Name of the source   
(You can label these values as needed for your organization.)  


Then Click the Gear Icon (**Configure Page**) and Select **Job Boards** page.  
**Ellipsis** icon next to job board > **Tracking Link**

In the Get Tracking Link Module Window.

Select **No one** for (who gets credit)

Select **Dstribute** for the source.

(You will see the new sourcing strategy and name you just created in this pulldown list.)

Click **Create Link.** Copy that link and email it to [support@dstribute.io](mailto:support@dstribute.io).

Once we have the correct tracking link code, we will add this information to your dstribute account, and all traffic from our OFCCP postings will be automatically assigned to this new source  
  
**Dstribute OFCCP Status Page**

****

**State Specific Reports**

Dstribute provides organizations with a real-time status dashboard that imports all active job postings directly from Greenhouse.

**This dashboard offers:**

  * **Current Job Status:** A breakdown of your active job postings by state.
  * **Credentials Management:** You can add/manage specific credentials for each state site.
  * **Processing Confirmation:** Verification that your job postings have been successfully processed and accepted.
  * **Performance Timeline:** A timeline view showing when jobs were posted and the resulting traffic from those postings.



**State-Specific Reports**

  
Dstribute provides clear, real-time reporting on all processed jobs, accessible by clicking "View" or searching by specific state. This reporting includes the posting status, processing dates, and applicant traffic reported from your postings, and the pages are fully searchable..

**Specific Job Details**

This report provides the current status of each job posting, including confirmation details such as screenshots and posting receipt information received from the job boards. It also includes direct links to all the different Diversity Networks associated with the postings.

Additionally, the report lists all outreach contacts to whom the job posting has been emailed, detailing the contact name, email address, and contact type. Users can search and add more contacts from our extensive, geo-location-based database to ensure local representatives are included for your postings.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [support@dstribute.io](mailto:support@dstribute.io).
