# Create an external job post

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

How your organization interacts with external candidates can differ drastically from how you interact with internal candidates (that is, candidates who are already employees in your organization).

Components such as the questions in an interview kit, the type of information required from the candidate during their application, and job posts may not necessarily overlap between both internal and external candidates.

Greenhouse Recruiting allows your organization to manage your external job posts and [internal job posts](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360020285291) separately. This allows you to take all of the configurations of a job post — name, location, language, description, job post questions, and application confirmation emails — and have it be completely distinct between the external and internal post on a job.

#### In this article

  * Create external job post during new job workflow
  * Add external job post to existing job
  * Download the external job description (PDF)



**Note** : To create an external job post, your organization must have already configured an [external job board](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/sections/360000693012-External). 

### Create external job post during new job workflow

**Note** : Only a **Site** **Admin** or **Job Admin** with the additional user-specific permission, **Can create new jobs or request job approvals** , can create a job post as part of a new job workflow.

If the _Job Post_ step is enabled for the [job setup flow](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/204923599), users are prompted to configure a job post when [creating a new job](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200668380-Create-a-New-Job) in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Navigate to the _Post To_ field and select an **external job board** from the dropdown menu.

**Note:** After selecting an external job board, you can also post to an **internal job board** by checking the applicable box. 

Fill in the following details that apply to the job post (keep in mind your audience of external candidates):

  * **Job name** that will be displayed on your post
  * **Job board** that your job will be posted to
  * **Location** or **locations** that will be displayed on the job post
  * **Searchable locations** that**** help**** your post surface in location-based search results on third-party job boards
  * **Work type** (In person, hybrid or remote)
  * [**Pay transparency**](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/10028084062491) fields
  * **Description** box including the [image and video](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003515106)
  * **Basic application information** (personal information and [education](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360030839892))
  * [**Custom application question**](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025222851)
  * **Settings**
  * **Free job boards**



**Note:**

  * The _Job name_ field has a limit of 255 characters.
  * When you share this job post to third-party job boards, you can add up to seven _Searchable locations_. These are the structured locations sent to third-party job boards and are separate from the main _Location_ field displayed on your Greenhouse-hosted job post.
  * _Work type_ is required for any job post that’s shared with third-party job boards, and you can select only one work type per job post.



Continue with the job setup flow when finished. 

Once the job is approved for recruiting, navigate to **Job** >**Job Setup** >**Job Post** and toggle the _Status_ button to **LIVE**.

Your job post is now live on your external job board!

### Add external job post to existing job

**Note** : Only users with **Job Admin** level permissions with the additional user-specific permission **Can create, edit, and delete job posts,** or **Site Admin** level permissions can create a new job post for an existing job.

To create an external job post for an existing job, navigate to a job by clicking the**Jobs** tab on the navigation bar and selecting a job from the subsequent list.

From the _Job Dashboard_ page, click **Job Setup** > **Job Posts**.

Navigate to the _Job Posts_ panel and click **Add Job Post**.

**Note** : A single post can only be related to one job board at a time, but there is no limit to how many times a single job can be posted to a board (either internal or external).

Alternatively, click the **Ellipsis** icon ****and select**Duplicate** to easily create copies of a job post. Keep in mind, only Plus and Pro subscription tiers can duplicate job posts. 

Navigate to the _Post To_ field and select an **external job board** from the dropdown menu.

**Note:** After selecting an external job board, you can also post to an **internal job board** by checking the applicable box. 

Fill in the following details that apply to the job post (keep in mind your audience of external candidates):

  * **Job name** that will be displayed on your post
  * **Job board** that your job will be posted to
  * **Location** or **locations** that will be displayed on the job post
  * **Searchable locations** that**** help your post surface in location-based search results on third-party job boards
  * **Work type** (In person, hybrid or remote)
  * [**Pay transparency**](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/10028084062491) fields
  * **Description** box including the [image and video](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003515106)
  * **Basic application information** (personal information and [education](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360030839892))
  * [**Custom application question**](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025222851)
  * **Settings**
  * **Free job boards**



**Note:** The  _Job name_ field has a limit of 255 characters.

Continue with the job setup flow when finished. 

Once the job is approved for recruiting, navigate to **Job** >**Job Setup** >**Job Post** and toggle the _Status_ button to **LIVE**.

Once you've created your new job post, you might wish to set that post as the job's primary job post. [Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360060261992) to learn more.

### Download the external job description (PDF)

You can download a copy of an external job post’s description as a PDF directly from the Job Posts page.

  1. From the job, click **Job Setup > Job Posts**.
  2. In the **Job Posts** panel, find the external job post you want to export.
  3. Click the **Download PDF** icon in the job post row.
  4. A PDF of the job post description downloads to your device. You can share or store this file for audits, compliance reviews, or internal documentation.



**Note:** You can download the job description from a job post whether it is currently live or unpublished.

# Add openings to a job with two-stage job approvals

**Permissions:** Site Admin who can see privates notes, salary info, manage offers, request approval, and approve jobs / offers, and Job Admin who can edit job info and view and edit private job fields and approve / request approval on jobs

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

A job must have one opening for every candidate you wish to hire for the role. If your team decides later in the interview process that you would like to hire more candidates than originally planned, you must add more openings to the job.

In Greenhouse Recruiting, the process to add new openings to an existing job depends on that job's approval process. In this article, we'll cover how to add openings to a job with a configured [two-stage job approval process](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025776391-Configure-Two-Stage-Job-Approvals).

**Note** : A job can have a maximum of 100 active openings at any time.

Changes to the number of openings for a job must be made on the job's _Approvals_ page.

To add openings to a job with two-stage job approvals, click**Jobs** on your navigation bar and select a job from the list.

Click **Approvals** and select **Edit Job & Openings**.

Scroll to the _Openings_ panel. Click **Add New** to add a single opening to the job.

Alternatively, your organization can add multiple openings to a job simultaneously by clicking the carrot icon  and selecting a number from the dropdown menu. Click **Add** when finished.

**Note** : Users can only add 99 openings to a job at a given time.

The openings are added to the job. Once added, you can edit the opening ID, open date, and so on for the added openings. [Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360035446212) to learn more.

Click **Save** **Changes** when finished.

**Note:** If the second stage of approvals has been completed for the job already, this process will re-trigger the second stage of approvals.

# Cancel candidate bulk action

**Permissions:** Job Admins who can view or edit candidates or above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Candidate bulk actions allow your organization to perform the same task on multiple candidates simultaneously.

If a candidate bulk action was performed mistakenly or erroneously, the user who performed the candidate bulk action can cancel the task before it is completed to prevent additional data from being lost.

_**Note:** Canceling a candidate bulk action will prevent data loss only for candidates who have not been actioned already. _

Once a candidate bulk action is initiated (or in the queue to start), expand the **Action in Progress** tab in the lower right-hand corner of the screen.

From the expanded _Action in Progress_ panel, navigate to the candidate bulk action that will be aborted and click **Cancel**.

_**Note** : Only candidate bulk actions with the status **In Progress** or **In Queue** can be cancelled._

The candidate bulk action is cancelled and will be visible in the _Bulk Actions_ tab for the next 24 hours.

# Upwage integration

Upwage screens applicants for any job instantly, saving high-volume recruiters and companies time and money.

Upwage’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows screener transcripts to be delivered immediately to recruiters and hiring managers directly in the candidate's application.

#### In this article

  * Set up the Upwage integration
    * Create a Harvest API key
    * Provide your API credentials to Upwage and finish setup
  * Use the Upwage integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



### Set up the Upwage integration

#### Create a Harvest API key

To configure the Upwage integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the Upwage integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Upwage or _Unlisted Vendor_
  * **Description:** Upwage Harvest API Key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Upwage integration:

**Users**

  * GET: List Users



**Applications**

  * PATCH: Update Application
  * POST: Advance Application
  * POST: Add Attachment to Application
  * GET: Retrieve Application
  * POST: Moves Application to Job
  * POST: Move Application
  * GET: List Applications
  * POST: Hire Application
  * PATCH: Update a rejected application’s rejection reason



**Jobs**

  * GET: List Jobs



**Candidates**

  * POST: Add Note
  * POST: Add Application
  * GET: List Candidate
  * POST: Add Candidate
  * PATCH: Edit Candidate
  * GET: Retrieve Candidate
  * POST: Add Attachment
  * POST: Add Employment
  * POST: Add Education
  * POST: Add Prospect



**Job Stages**

  * GET: Retrieve Job Stage
  * GET: List Job Stages for Job
  * GET: List Job Stages



**Tags**

  * PUT: Add a candidate tag
  * GET: List Candidate Tags
  * Post: Add New Candidate Tags



**Sources**

  * GET: List Sources



When finished, click **Save**.

Your Harvest API key for the Upwage integration is created and configured. Copy the API key to provide to Upwage in the next step.

#### Provide your API credentials to Upwage and finish setup

After you’ve created your API key, you’ll need to share your API credentials through [Merge](https://www.merge.dev/), a developer tool that allows us to connect your Upwage account to your Greenhouse Recruiting account through a secure connection.

To provide your API key, the Upwage team will share with you the link to connect the API key directly – it is a unique link for each customer.

Upon clicking the link, select **Applicant Tracking System** as your category. 

Then, select **Greenhouse** as your integration.

When finished, click **Continue**.

The permissions set earlier when creating your Harvest API key is the access being requested. 

Next, input your API key in the _Enter the Greenhouse API key_ field and then, click **Submit**.

Your Upwage and Greenhouse accounts are now connected.

### Use the Upwage integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

After enabling the Upwage integration, transcripts of screener conversations (i.e. Super Screener PDF) will be delivered directly into the candidate profile in Greenhouse Recruiting. 

You can access these transcripts by viewing [_All attachments_](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202815509) within the **Details** or **Application** tabs within the candidate profile.

To view an Upwage PDF, click the _Super Screener PDF_ attachment. 

The integration also adds a Candidate Tag to each candidate that has completed the screener, allowing you to easily see where each candidate is in the process.

In addition, the integration also changes the stage the applicant is in to show that they have completed the Upwage screener.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, visit [upwage.com/employers](https://upwage.com/employers) or reach out to [customersupport@upwage.com](mailto:customersupport@upwage.com).

# Release Notes: 2019 - July 12

In an effort to improve our suite of products, Greenhouse Software regularly releases new product features, updates, and improvements. Stay up-to-date with what's new at Greenhouse by **Following** our [Release Notes](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/sections/360000710732-Release-Notes).

# Configure structured job post locations

**Permissions:** Site Admin

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Job post location is a required field for all job posts in Greenhouse Recruiting and allows job post creators to tie a role to a unique location. This location will appear on your careers page.

By default, the job post location field is a free text field where job post creators can input any value. Alternatively, organizations can enable structured job post locations on a per-job-board basis to maintain data integrity and control which locations can be selected for any given job post.

In this article, we will cover how to configure the two structured job post location types: organization offices and custom location lists.

#### In this article

  * Organization offices
  * Create a Custom List



**Note** : The following instructions are also applicable for [internal job boards](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200521739-Configure-Internal-Job-Board) (if applicable).

To get started, navigate to the _Configure Job Boards_ page. _(Configure icon > **Job Boards & Posts**)_

Find and edit the job board. _(Ellipsis icon > **Edit Board Settings**)_

On the _Edit Your Job Board_ page, find the section _Manage locations users can select for job posts_.

To make your job posts more structured, choose either **Organization offices** or **Create a custom list**. See the sections below for more information.

After choosing an option, scroll to the bottom of the page, then click **Save**.

### Organization offices

If **Organization offices** is selected, the job post location field will only populate a dropdown menu of your [organization's offices](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002226426).

**Note** : The specific location for each office is pulled from the **Configure > Organization > Office > Location** field. If the office does not have a configured Location field, Greenhouse Recruiting will default to the Office name. 

If a pre-existing job post remains unedited, the free text version of the job post location will still appear on your job posts. However, users will be unable to edit a pre-existing job post without selecting one of the new structured job post location options.

**Tip:** Users can add multiple locations to job posts on Greenhouse-hosted new job boards by default. [Learn about customizable job boards.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/18996861758363)

### Create a Custom List

If **Create a Custom List** is selected, the job post location field will only populate a dropdown menu of options entered into the provided field.

**Note** : Every location should be entered on a separate line. 

If a pre-existing job post remains unedited, the free text version of the job post location will still appear on your job posts. However, users will be unable to edit a pre-existing job post without selecting one of the new structured job post location options.

# Add employment status field options

**Permissions:** Owners

**Product tier:** Available for Greenhouse Welcome and Greenhouse Onboarding subscription tiers

The [employment status field](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360045429531) indicates a new hire's type of employment, such as full-time or part-time. You can use this field to automatically assign specific tasks and E-Signatures through a new hire's onboarding plan.

The employment status field includes four default options, which you can update to match your organization's unique needs. In this article, we'll cover how to add a new option to the employment status field.

#### In this article

  * Add a new employment status field option
  * Additional resources



### Add a new employment status field option

From your Greenhouse Onboarding homepage, navigate to **Settings** > **Company Info** > **Fields**.

On the  _Fields_ page, scroll to  _Additional Information_.

Click **Employment Status** to edit the field.

On the _Edit Field_ page, scroll to  _Selection Options_.

Under your existing field options, double-click an **empty cell** in the _Display name_ column.

Next, type in your new field option's display name. This is how it will appear to other users across Greenhouse Onboarding.

**Note:** Learn more about [selection option values](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360045429531#:~:text=a%20new%20hire.-,Employment%20status%20field%20selection%20options,-When%20editing%20or).

If your team uses a [third-party task system](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022403771) that requires field mapping, you can enter the integration's matching field value in the _External value_ column. Double-click the external value cell next to the new option you added, then enter the necessary external value.

**Note:** If your team doesn't use a third-party integration, you can skip the above step.

Repeat the above steps to add as many employment status field options as needed.

Click **Save** when you're finished.

**Note:** Once you've saved, employment status options are always displayed in alphabetical order. This display order can't be edited.

### Additional resources

  * [Employment status field overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360045429531)
  * [Edit employment status field options](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360052293372)
  * [Delete employment status field options](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360052740331)

# Trading Interview integration (legacy)

Trading Interview is a specialized assessment platform designed for the quantitative finance industry. Our integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows you to seamlessly incorporate Trading Interview's assessments into your job interview plans, enabling a more comprehensive evaluation of candidates' quantitative skills. We differentiate ourselves by offering candidates preparation resources, enabling them to showcase their full potential during their assessment.

    * Add the Trading Interview assessment to a job
    * Send an assessment to candidates

### Enable the Trading Interview integration

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923) to retrieve your API key from your Trading Interview representative and add the assessment stage to your interview plans. 

Once you’ve set up your interview plans and configured your take-home test, you’ll be able to send the test to candidates.

### Use the Trading Interview integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Add the Trading Interview assessment to a job

Once the integration is enabled, you can add the Trading Interview assessment as an interview stage in your job's interview plan:

  1. Go to the job for which you want to add the assessment.
  2. Click on "Job Setup" and then "Interview Plan."
  3. Click "Add a Stage" and select "Trading Interview" from the options.
  4. Select the corresponding assessment that you would like to send to the candidates for this job and configure the assessment details as needed.



**Note** : Make sure that you have created the corresponding role/job in your [Trading interview dashboard](https://www.tradinginterview.com/my-assessment-roles/). This step is crucial as it determines which tests are sent to the candidate.

#### Send an assessment to candidates

To send an assessment to a candidate:

  1. Navigate to the candidate's profile in Greenhouse Recruiting.
  2. Move the candidate to the Trading Interview assessment stage.
  3. Click the "Send" or "Send test to candidate" button next to the interview stage.
  4. Double check if the correct Test is selected and assign a grader. Now click “Send Test”



**Note** : When you send a test through Greenhouse Recruiting, the actual instructions are sent by Trading Interview.

After it has been sent, an assessment’s status will display in Greenhouse Recruiting.

You will also be able to see the status of the candidate in your [trading interview dashboard](https://www.tradinginterview.com/my-assessment-candidates/).

#### View assessment results

Once the candidate has submitted their test, the Interview Kit will contain a link to view the submitted test in the Trading Interview application. 

To see a candidate’s results in Trading Interview, click **Go to test.** To see the results in Greenhouse, click **View interview kit.**

To see more details of the candidate’s results, click **View Report** , to see the results in Trading Interview.

# Add a hiring team to a job with Harvest API

Developers using Greenhouse Recruiting's Harvest API to import jobs from an external system may also want to add a hiring team (hiring managers, recruiters, coordinators, or sourcers) to the job. This article describes the process for adding a hiring team to a job using Harvest API.

If all recruiters in your Greenhouse Recruiting instance are **Site** **Admins** or already have future Job Admin permissions to all new jobs in their assigned offices or departments, you will only need to retrieve the recruiter's Greenhouse Recruiting user ID (Step 1) and then assign them to the new job's Hiring Team (Step 4).

If all recruiters in your Greenhouse Recruiting instance do not have future Job Admin permissions, you'll need to assign their Job Admin access to each new job first, and then assign their role on the Hiring Team. In this case, you should follow all of the steps below to ensure that users have the necessary level of access before adding them to the hiring team.

For more information on Greenhouse user permissions, check out our [Permissions documentation](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/categories/360000311371-Recruiting-Users-Permissions-Roles).

For more information about Harvest API, check out our [Developers Resources](developers.greenhouse.io).

#### In this article

  * Step 1 – GET: List users
  * Step 2 – GET: List user roles
  * Step 3 – PUT: Add job permission
  * Step 4 – POST: Add hiring team members



**Note** : The "on-behalf-of" user in the API request header should have Site Admin permissions to avoid permissions errors.

### Step 1 – GET: List users

Use [GET: List users](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-users) using the email address or employee ID parameter to identify the particular user. The API response will include the user's ID in the "id" field.

**Example**
    
    
    **Request**  
      
     curl -X GET \  
     'https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/users?email=test@example.com' \  
     -H 'Authorization: Basic *******' \
    
    
    **Response**  
      
    {  
     "id": 123456,  
     "name": "Greenhouse Test",  
     "first_name": "Greenhouse",  
     "last_name": "Test",  
     "primary_email_address": "test@example.com",  
     "updated_at": "2019-04-01T17:32:41.665Z",  
     "created_at": "2017-09-13T17:43:56.968Z",  
     "disabled": false,  
     "site_admin": false,  
     "emails": [  
     "test@example.com"  
     ],  
     "employee_id": "abc123"  
    }

### Step 2 – GET: List user roles

Use [GET: List User Roles](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#get-list-user-roles) to retrieve the Job Admin user role ID that you wish to assign the user.

**Example**
    
    
    **Request**  
      
     curl -X GET \  
     https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/user_roles \  
     -H 'Authorization: Basic *******' \
    
    
    **Response**  
      
    [  
      {  
        "id": 02480,  
        "type": "job_admin",  
        "name": "Standard"  
       },  
       {  
         "id": 98765,  
         "type": "interviewer",  
         "name": "Interviewer"  
       }  
    ]

### Step 3 – PUT: Add job permission

Assign Job Admin permissions to the user on the job in question before adding them to the hiring team. For simplicity's sake, we recommend using one Job Admin level.

Use the user ID (retrieved in Step 1) and the user role ID (retrieved in Step 2) and add the user to a job ID using the [PUT: Add Job Permission](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#put-add-a-job-permission) request.

**Note** : In addition to the API key, this write request also requires an on-behalf-of header (see the [Establish API Connectivity](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029266032) article for more information on making write requests to the API).

**Example**
    
    
    **Request**  
      
     curl -X PUT \  
     https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/users/123456/permissions/jobs \  
     -H 'Authorization: Basic *******' \  
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  
     -H 'on-behalf-of: 1049756' \  
     -d '{   
     "job_id": "11111",   
     "user_role_id": "02480"   
    }’  
     

**Note** : If the user already has Site Admin permissions (which by default gives them access to all jobs), this request will have no effect and will return a 204 status, whereas adding the job permission to a user who doesn’t yet have access to the job will return a 201 status.

### Step 4 – POST: Add hiring team members

Once the user has the appropriate permissions on the job, you can add them to the hiring team via the [POST: Add Hiring Team Members](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#post-add-hiring-team-members) endpoint.

In the example below, the request would add the user as the "Responsible Recruiter" for future, active, and inactive candidates on job 11111.

**Example**
    
    
    **Request**  
      
     curl -X POST \  
     https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/jobs/11111/hiring_team \  
     -H 'Authorization: Basic *******' \  
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  
     -H 'on-behalf-of: 1049756' \  
     -d '{  
    "recruiters": [  
     {  
     "user_id": 123456,  
     "responsible_for_future_candidates": true,  
     "responsible_for_active_candidates": true,  
     "responsible_for_inactive_candidates": true  
     }  
     ]  
    }’

# Bulk upload prospects with the Greenhouse Recruiting Chrome extension

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above with CRM access, a Sourcing Automation seat, and LinkedIn Recruiter access

**Product tier:** Available for the Plus and Pro subscription tiers

You can use the [Greenhouse Recruiting Chrome extension for Sourcing Automation](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/8302875133083) to bulk upload prospects from LinkedIn Recruiter. Bulk uploads through the Chrome extension help you to quickly add multiple prospects to your campaign pools and streamline your sourcing workflows.

#### In this article

  * Open the extension
  * Save LinkedIn prospects to a CSV
  * Bulk upload your prospects
    * Review your prospect list in the extension
    * Select a pool and source
    * Provide job details
    * Upload your prospects to Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



### Open the extension

First, you'll need to open the extension before you can retrieve prospects in LinkedIn.

If you haven't already, [install the Greenhouse Recruiting Chrome extension](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/8302339682843).

**Tip:** Pin the extension to your browser for easy access.

To get started, click the **Greenhouse icon** in your extensions menu to open the Greenhouse Recruiting extension. Keep the extension open while you complete the next step in LinkedIn Recruiter.

### Save LinkedIn prospects to a CSV

In LinkedIn Recruiter, navigate to the **Pipeline** for your open job.

Mark the checkbox to select each prospect you'd like to save to a CSV file.

Click the **three dots icon** on the right side of your pipeline navigation bar. Select **Save to CSV**.

### Bulk upload your prospects

#### Review your prospect list in the extension

Once you save a CSV from LinkedIn Recruiter, the Greenhouse Recruiting extension will immediately display all the prospects included in your file and perform automatic [email lookups](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/6018927588635) for them.

Review the list of prospects you're about to bulk upload. Potential duplicates will be flagged with a red exclamation mark. These flags appear when a prospect in your CSV shares any of these details: first and last name, email address, phone number, or LinkedIn profile URL with an existing prospect. These duplicate checks always use all four details and aren’t affected by how [Duplicate tag](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/49207850415003-Configure-the-Duplicate-tag) is configured for candidates in the Greenhouse Recruiting web app.

You can remove any prospects you don't want to upload by clicking **X** next to their name.

Click **Continue**.

**Note:** If your organization requires [email addresses for explicit consent](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360042142612), prospects without an email address won't be added to your campaign pool during bulk upload.

#### Select a pool and source

Once you've reviewed your list of prospects, select the **pool** where you'd like to add them in bulk.

`LinkedIn` will be selected automatically as your **source** for any bulk uploads from LinkedIn Recruiter.

**Note:** Your pool and source selections will apply to all prospects uploaded in bulk.

#### Provide job details

Next, use the dropdown fields under **Job details** to select the relevant job and recruiter for prospects.

Click **Edit additional details** to include any of the following information for these prospects:

  * Coordinator
  * Department
  * Office
  * Prospect owner
  * Tags
  * Notes



**Note:** Your selected job details will apply to all prospects uploaded in bulk.

#### Upload your prospects to Greenhouse Recruiting

Click **Upload prospects** when you're ready.

Your list of prospects will be uploaded in bulk to the campaign pool you've selected.

Click **Upload next prospect** to add more prospects individually or in bulk to Greenhouse Recruiting through the extension.

**Tip:** If your campaign's first step includes a [manual task or LinkedIn InMail](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5285464148379-Manage-prospects-in-a-campaign-pool#:~:text=account%20settings.-,Send%20LinkedIn%20InMail,-Use%20your%20LinkedIn), visit your campaign pool's _Tasks_ page to manage these.

### Additional resources

  * [Greenhouse Recruiting Chrome extension for Sourcing Automation](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/8302875133083)
  * [Add a LinkedIn prospect to the Greenhouse Recruiting Chrome extension](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/16445656895131)
  * [View prospect activity in campaign pools](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/17267590927259)

# Infomart integration

Infomart is a background screening company specializing in pre-employment background checks, enterprise screening, and small business background screening services. Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Infomart allows you to send background screening updates as notes in a candidate's Activity Feed.

#### In this article

  * Create Harvest API key for the Greenhouse Recruiting / Infomart integration
    * Create new credential
    * Permissions
  * Create Greenhouse Recruiting / Infomart webhook
  * Create a custom job field



### Create Harvest API key for the Greenhouse Recruiting / Infomart integration

To configure the Greenhouse Recruiting / Infomart integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the Infomart integration.

#### **Create new credential**

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Infomart (optional)
  * **Description:** Infomart Harvest API Key



#### **Permissions**

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Infomart integration:

  * Candidates: 
    * POST: Add Note



Copy your Harvest API key and provide it to your contact on the Infomart Tech team so they can set up the integration. When you provide your Harvest API key to the Infomart team, they will provide you with the **Secret Key** you need to create the webhook in the next step.

### Create Greenhouse Recruiting / Infomart webhook

The Infomart integration uses a webhook to initiate background screening services when a candidate is marked as hired in Greenhouse Recruiting.

On the _Create A New Web Hook_ page, provide the following details:

  * **Name:** A descriptive name for your integration. Most customers choose "Infomart services"
  * **When:** **The time that the event will be sent to Infomart. Select the following options for this integration:**
    * Candidate has been hired
  * **Endpoint URL:** <https://api.infomart-usa.net/webasap-api/v1/greenhouse/initiateScreening>
  * **Secret key:** The secret key provided by the Infomart Tech team
  * **Error recipient email:** The email address that should be notified if a webhook error occurs
  * **Advanced settings**
    * **Username:** Your Infomart account number
    * **Password:** Your Infomart account password
    * **Disabled?:** Set to _No_



### Create a custom job field

Infomart services requires a **background package** and **employment type** to be selected for job.

You'll need to [create a custom job field](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202609855) using the details below:

  * **Field Name:** Background Screening Package
  * **Description:** Field for selecting background screening packages
  * **Type:** Single select
  * **Options:** Enter all available package options, with each option on a new line

# I can’t see my teammates’ calendars when scheduling

When scheduling from within Greenhouse Recruiting, you can view multiple calendars at once to ensure your interviewers are available when you need them.

# View candidate alerts

**Permissions:** Job Admin who can view and edit candidates and prospects and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Candidate alerts inform users about candidates who are in an interview pipeline stage for too long. With candidate alerts, your organization can ensure that all responsible roles are aware of how candidates are progressing through your interview pipeline and what action they may need to take.

#### In this article

  * View candidate alerts
    * Alerts for candidates on all jobs
    * Alerts for candidates on a specific job
  * Dismiss a candidate alert
  * Additional resources



### View candidate alerts

Candidate alerts display throughout Greenhouse Recruiting. By default, the alerts appear only in Greenhouse Recruiting and cannot be sent by email.

#### Alerts for candidates on all jobs

To see alerts for all candidates in your organization, navigate to the _All Candidates_ page. _(Dashboard > Candidates)_

Alerts display as a red exclamation mark symbol  near a candidate's name. 

**Tip** : Use the filters on the left side panel to narrow the list of candidates shown. For example, if you're a recruiter, click **Responsibility** then select your own name to see only candidates you're responsible for.

Hover over the symbol to see the alert, including the candidate's stage and time in that stage.

#### Alerts for candidates on a specific job

To see alerts for candidates on a specific job, navigate to that job's page. (_Jobs > job name_)

Scroll down to the _Pipeline Tasks_ section. Alerts for candidates on the job are listed under _Alerts_. 

### Dismiss a candidate alert

To dismiss a candidate alert, navigate to a job's page (_Jobs > job name_) and scroll down to the  _Pipeline Tasks_ section.

Hover over the alert you want to dismiss, then click the **X** that appears to the right of the alert. 

**Note** : After you dismiss an alert, it still appears in the job's _Visual pipeline_. (_Jobs > job name > Pipeline_)

# Humantelligence integration

Humantelligence is the leading cloud-based recruiting and culture analytics solution that leverages AI to significantly streamline the interview process, eliminate hiring subjectivity, improve the quality of hire, reduce turnover, drive engagement, and ensuring diversity. Greenhouse Recruiting has three different types of integrations with Humantelligence that your organization can leverage:

  * **Data synchronization integration:** Enable the flow of data between Humantelligence and Greenhouse Recruiting.
  * **Self-assessment integration:** Add _Humantelligence - Team Culture Fit’s_ assessment to a job's interview plan.
  * **Sync with webhooks:** Connect Greenhouse Recruiting and Humantelligence using webhooks



#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API key for the Humantelligence integration
    * Credentials
    * Permissions
  * Retrieve your Greenhouse Recruiting subdomain
  * Finish setup in Humantelligence
  * Data synchronizations
  * Configure the self-assessment integration
    * Add Humantelligence stage to job’s interview plan
    * Configure Humantelligence Stage
    * Send and review an assessment
  * Sync Greenhouse Recruiting and Humantelligence with webhooks
    * Retrieve the Humantelligence Webhook Secret Key and API Key
    * Create a webhook
      * Webhook 1: New job
      * Webhook 2: New application
      * Webhook 3: Candidate hired



### Create a Harvest API key for the Humantelligence integration

To configure the Greenhouse Recruiting / Humantelligence integration, you'll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the credentials and permissions below are selected when configuring the Humantelligence integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Humantelligence
  * **Description:** _Humantelligence Harvest API Key_



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Humantelligence integration:

**Applications**

  * GET: Retrieve Application
  * GET: List Applications
  * POST: Add Attachment to Application



**Candidates**

  * GET: Retrieve Candidate
  * GET: List Candidates



**Departments**

  * GET: Retrieve Department
  * GET: List Departments



**Job Stages**

  * GET: Retrieve Job Stage
  * GET: List Job Stages
  * GET: List Job Stages for Job



**Jobs**

  * GET: Retrieve Job
  * GET: List Jobs



**Offices**

  * GET: Retrieve Office
  * GET: List Offices



**Sources**

  * GET: List Sources



**Users**

  * GET: Retrieve User
  * GET: List Users



Provide the API key to Humantelligence in the below step.

### Retrieve your Greenhouse Recruiting subdomain

To configure this integration, you'll need to write down your Greenhouse Recruiting subdomain. The subdomain can be found by looking at your Greenhouse Recruiting URL and copying the text directly before greenhouse.io.

For example, in the URL [https://app5.greenhouse.io/dashboard](https://app5.greenhouse.io/dashboard,), the subdomain is `app5`.

### Finish setup in Humantelligence

Open Humantelligence and navigate to the Humantelligence Integration settings panel. Enter your Harvest API Key and Greenhouse Recruiting subdomain in the appropriate fields and click **Save Settings**.

### Data synchronizations

Humantelligence Connect Integrations will periodically and automatically sync Humantelligence and Greenhouse Recruiting.

When the sync runs, Humantelligence will import and update users, departments, jobs, applications, and other data points from Greenhouse Recruiting.

You can also manually begin a sync in Humantelligence.

### Configure the self-assessment integration

Humantelligence's scientifically proven 12-minute self-assessment and analytics platform measure culture at every level, uncovering talent insights that can be leveraged for improving performance, engagement, and hiring. Greenhouse Recruiting's self-assessment integration with Humantelligence allows you to seamlessly add _**Humantelligence - Team Culture Fit**_ ’s assessment to a job's interview plan.

To start, contact your Humantelligence representative to receive your API key. Once you have received your API key, fill out the form at [www.greenhouse.io/asksupport](http://support.greenhouse.io/direct) or [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/requests/new) to open a ticket.

**Note:** Do not send the API key in this initial email.

The Greenhouse Technical Support team will respond with a [SendSafely link](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/) for you to enter your API key. A notification will be sent to the Greenhouse Technical Support team after you have entered your API key and they will email you to confirm that your API key has been set up in your account and your integration is enabled.

**Note:** To verify your identity, the Greenhouse Technical Support team might request you provide a [Support Verification Code](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022771952) before adding the API key to your organization's account.

### Add Humantelligence stage to job’s interview plan

Once the Greenhouse/Humantelligence integration is enabled for your organization, you will be able to add the Humantelligence assessment as an Interview stage. To add the stage, modify the [interview plan](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002194903) where you want to include the Humantelligence integration.

When you click**Add Stage** , a Humantelligence stage can be selected.

#### Configure Humantelligence Stage

Once the stage has been added to the job's interview plan, click **Edit Take Home Test** and choose assessment and grader.

**Note:** The available assessments, including any email templates or branding, are configured in Humantelligence.

#### Send and review an assessment

When candidates are moved into the Humantelligence interview stage, you can click the Send Test button to email an assessment to a candidate.

**Note:** Even though you are sending the email from Greenhouse Recruiting, the candidate will see the interview instructions are actually sent by Humantelligence.

After it's been sent, the assessment status will display in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Once the candidate has submitted their test, the recruiter or admin responsible for grading the test will receive an email notification with a link to the test.

Once the candidate finishes the assessment, the test results can be seen in the Humantelligence platform. The Humantelligence Talent Profile provides clear feedback and valuable insights instantly based on your results and can be used to develop and perform at each one’s best.

### Sync Greenhouse Recruiting and Humantelligence with webhooks

Greenhouse Recruiting’s integration with Humantelligence uses Web Hooks to keep the two platforms in sync. When an event occurs in Greenhouse Recuiting, Humantelligence will get notified and your Humantelligence portal data will be updated accordingly.

#### Retrieve the Humantelligence Webhook Secret Key and API Key

Before enabling the Greenhouse/Humantelligence integration, you'll need to get the **Webhook Secret Key** and the **Humantelligence API Key** from the Humantelligence platform.

These values are listed on the **Integration Credentials** panel in Humantelligence.

### Create a webhook

To integrate Humantelligence with Greenhouse Recruiting, you'll need to create a webhook. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163727003) to create your webhook. Use the values listed below to configure the webhooks.

You'll need to create three webhooks for the Humantelligence integration.

#### Webhook 1: New job

  * **Name** : Humantelligence New Job
  * **When** : Job Created
  * **Endpoint URL** : [https://portal.humantelligence.com/api/v1/ integrations/webhooks/positions](https://portal.humantelligence.com/api/v1/%20integrations/webhooks/positions)
  * **Secret Key** : Your Webhook Secret Key from the previous section
  * **Error recipient email:** Your Humantelligence Portal Administrator
  * **Advanced Settings - Additional HTTP Headers:** The Humantelligence API Key from the previous section



#### Webhook 2: New application

  * **Name** : Humantelligence New Application
  * **When** : Candidate has submitted application
  * **Endpoint URL** : [https://portal.humantelligence.com/api/v1/integrations/webhook/applications](https://portal.humantelligence.com/api/v1/integrations/webhooks/applications)
  * **Secret Key** : Your Webhook Secret Key from the previous section
  * **Error recipient email:** Your Humantelligence Portal Administrator
  * **Advanced Settings - Additional HTTP Headers:** The Humantelligence API Key from the previous section



#### Webhook 3: Candidate hired

  * **Name** : Humantelligence Candidate Hired
  * **When** : Candidate has been hired
  * **Endpoint URL** : <https://portal.humantelligence.com/api/v1/integrations/webhooks/employees>
  * **Secret Key** : Your Webhook Secret Key from the previous section
  * **Error recipient email:** Your Humantelligence Portal Administrator
  * **Advanced Settings - Additional HTTP Headers:** The Humantelligence API Key from the previous section



### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [support@humantelligence.com](mailto:support@humantelligence.com).

# Focus attributes for candidate roundup

**Permissions:** Site Admin

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Focus attributes for candidate roundup are an additional layer to scorecard attributes that provide the hiring team with guidance during the candidate roundup process. When using this feature, the hiring team will identify which focus attributes from the entire interview process should be covered specifically in the post-interview team sync. 

For more information on why focus attributes are important, see our article on [structured decision making](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360004923392). 

#### In this article

  * Enable focus attributes for candidate roundup
  * Edit focus attributes for candidate roundup
  * View focus attributes during candidate roundup



### Enable focus attributes for candidate roundup

To enable focus attributes for candidate roundup, select the **Configure** icon  on your navigation bar, then click **Inclusion** **Tools**.

Scroll to the _Candidate Roundup_ section and enable the scorecard attributes during candidate roundup. 

**Note** : While interviewers will see focus attributes (i.e. attributes they should focus on), they will not know which are focus attributes for candidate roundup.

### Edit focus attributes for candidate roundup 

Focus attributes for candidate roundup can be edited when creating the candidate scorecard for a new job or for existing jobs.

To start, navigate to an existing job's candidate scorecard (**Jobs > Job Name > Job Setup > Scorecard**) and click **Edit**.

Select the checkbox for each focus attribute you would like to cover during the candidate roundup. 

When you're finished, click **Save**.

**Note** : You can also remove, rename, or add attributes while editing.

### View focus attributes during candidate roundup

During the candidate roundup, your hiring team can view the summarized scorecards on the **Scorecards** tab of the candidate's profile.

All attributes marked as focus during candidate roundup will be grouped in their own section.

# TestGorilla integration

TestGorilla makes hiring the best people easy and unbiased, offering screening tests at an affordable price. Using TestGorilla, customers save valuable time, make hiring decisions objectively, and avoid expensive mis-hires. TestGorilla tests replace subjective, incomplete, and often inflated CVs with objective, reliable, and fair test results that measure aptitude, practical job skills, culture add, and motivation.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with TestGorilla allows you to invite candidates to a TestGorilla assessment from within Greenhouse Recruiting, and then view the summarized assessment results within Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### In this article

  * Enable the TestGorilla integration
  * Add the TestGorilla assessment stage
  * Configure the TestGorilla assessment stage
  * Send and review the TestGorilla assessment



### Enable the TestGorilla integration

To connect TestGorilla and Greenhouse Recruiting, you’ll need to enable the integration in TestGorilla. Log in to TestGorilla, click your name in the top right corner, then click **Integrations**.

Scroll to the Greenhouse integration and click **Enable**.

Click **Copy API key**.

Once you have copied your API key, fill out the form at [www.greenhouse.io/asksupport](http://support.greenhouse.io/direct) or _[click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/requests/new)_ to open a ticket.

**Note** : Don't send the API key in this initial email. Greenhouse Technical Support will respond with a [SendSafely link](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/) for you to securely share your API key.

Once Greenhouse Technical Support receives your API key via SendSafely, we'll email you to confirm that your API key has been set up in your account and that your integration is enabled.

**Note:** To verify your identity, Greenhouse Technical Support might request you provide a [support verification code](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022771952) before adding the API key to your organization's account.

This is also a good time to invite any of your colleagues to TestGorilla to make sure they can access the full assessment results of a candidate. As an account owner or administrator, you can add your colleagues in the TestGorilla **Team Management** tab.

### Add the TestGorilla assessment stage

Once you receive confirmation from your Greenhouse Technical Support representative, you can create a new assessment in TestGorilla. Follow the steps to create the assessment, and when you get to _Invite Candidates_ , select **Greenhouse**.

Once you complete this step, your assessment becomes available in Greenhouse Recruiting and you can add TestGorilla as an interview stage.

To do this for an existing job, navigate to a job (**Jobs** > **Job Name**) and click **Job Setup**.

Click **Interview Plan** on the left.

Click **Add a Stage.**

Select the TestGorilla stage.

When finished, click **Add** to apply the stage to the job's interview plan.

**Tip** : The TestGorilla team recommends using the TestGorilla assessment before any interviews or other stages. This allows your team to focus quickly on the most promising candidates.

### Configure the TestGorilla assessment stage

Once the stage has been added to the job's interview plan, click **Edit Interview**.

Use the provided dropdown to choose the test you previously set up in TestGorilla.

**Note** : All configurations of the assessment itself, as well as the email template, will need to be set up in TestGorilla. When you click **Send** **Test** in Greenhouse Recruiting, the assessment is actually sent by TestGorilla.

Assign at least one Greenhouse Recruiting user to grade submitted TestGorilla assessments.

When finished, click **Save**.

#### Send and review the TestGorilla assessment

When you have one or more candidates for the job, you can [move them to the TestGorilla stage](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002227126-Managing-candidates#h_01GA9BEF3FR4A2Z93T01373P2Q) and click **Send Test**.

**Tip** : You can use [stage transition rules](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360053129752) on the TestGorilla stage to automatically send the test.

In the box that appears, take the following actions:

  * Confirm the email address of the candidate
  * Select which test the candidate will take
  * Assign a grader



Click **Send Test** when finished. The email is then sent from TestGorilla to the candidate.

Once the email is sent, the status of the TestGorilla assessment changes in Greenhouse Recruiting. The following statuses are possible:

  * Take Home Test to be sent
  * Waiting for candidate to submit test
  * Scorecard due from [designated grader]



Once the candidate has taken the assessment, the Interview Kit will contain a link to view the submitted test in the TestGorilla application. 

**Note:** Synchronization between TestGorilla and Greenhouse Recruiting occurs every 30 minutes.

To see a candidate's results in TestGorilla, click **View Report**.

**Permissions:** Job Admins, who can manage company email and social media templates, and Site Admins

**Product tier:** Available for Plus and Pro subscription tiers

Office-specific email templates provide additional filter criteria to email templates so that users can avoid scrolling through irrelevant templates designed for other offices.

To create a new template, click the **Configure** icon  in the upper right-hand corner and navigate to **Email Templates** on the left-hand panel.

Check the box next to _Enable Office-Specific Templates._

Once office-specific templates are enabled, you can assign new or pre-existing email templates to a specific office or multiple offices. 

**Note:** _Any pre-existing email templates created before the option was enabled will default to**Anywhere** and must be edited manually._

To update a pre-existing email template so that it is assigned to a specific office(s), navigate to the template and click the **Edit** icon  in the same row.

From the _Edit Custom Email Template_ page, uncheck the box next to _Anywhere_. Use the _Office_ field to select one or more offices from the dropdown menu.

When you have finished editing the email template, click **Save** at the bottom of the page.

With office-specific email templates enabled and configured, users can select an office when sending emails to filter the list of available templates to choose from.

# HRIS Link for UKG Pro integration

**Permissions:** Site Admin

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro) with the HRIS Link for UKG add-on

HRIS Link for UKG Pro is available as an add-on for all GHR customers. Contact your Account Manager to learn more.

The HRIS Link for UKG Pro integration gives you the ability to connect your Greenhouse account to both UKG Core and UKG Onboarding using the same integration.

#### In this article

  * Open the HRIS Link for UKG Pro setup page
  * Create service account in UKG Pro Core
  * Find UKG Pro Core details in UKG
  * Select integration user and email in Greenhouse
  * Finish setup
  * Using the integration
    * Candidate export
    * Internal transfer export
    * User sync
    * Organizational data sync



### Open the HRIS Link for UKG Pro setup page

The setup for this integration can be completed in Greenhouse Recruiting under **Configure** > **Dev Center** > **HRIS Link for UKG**.

Before completing the next sections, open this page in another browser window and keep it open, as you'll need to enter different values during each section. 

### Create service account in UKG Pro Core

**Note:** By default, service accounts don't have access to [Business Intelligence (BI)](https://library.ukg.com/a/179488#x31308) in UKG and must contact a UKG representative to get those features enabled. 

Log into UKG Pro as a UKG Pro system administrator.

Click the **system configuration icon** (the cog).

Click **Security** to expand the menu, then click **Service account administration**.

  
In the top right corner, click **Add**.

Provide a **username** and an **email address** for the new account. Use a company-specific email or distribution list for the account (rather than an account tied to a specific individual) to ensure you can still access your integration even as your organization changes over time.

The password will be auto-generated after you click save.

Below these username and email fields, you'll see a table of granular permission settings.

Within the _Web Service_ section, make sure you have the following enabled for this integration:

  * **Employee Person:** View, Edit
  * **Employee Job:** View, Edit
  * **Employee Compensation:** View, Edit
  * **Employee Phone Information:** Add, View, Edit
  * **Employee Process Hire:** Add, View, Edit
  * **Company Configuration Integration:** View
  * **Personnel Integration:** View
  * **Employee Person Details:** View



Click **Save** in the top right corner.

A window will appear with your auto-generated password. Save this password value. You will not be able to retrieve it later, you'd have to generate a new one.

Once you've generated the password for the service account, enter the username and that password for that service account into the settings page of Greenhouse Recruiting.

### Find UKG Pro Core details in UKG

To fill out this section in the integration, you'll need to locate your API URL, Customer API Key, and User API key within UKG. 

Log into UKG Pro as a UKG Pro system administrator.

Click the **system configuration icon** (the cog).

Click **Security** to expand the menu, then click **Web Services**.

This page will have your login service endpoint. The endpoint value is contained at the end of the URL. For example, if your login service endpoint is listed as `http://Servicet.ultipro.com/servicesLoginService`, then your **API URL** is `Servicet.ultipro.com`

At the top of this page, your **Customer API key** and **User API Key** will also be listed.

**Copy** each of these (API URL, Customer API Key and User API Key) and **paste** them into the appropriate sections in Greenhouse Recruiting under the _UKG Pro Core details_ section.

#### UKG Pro Onboarding details

#### Set up integration and locate Onboarding Owner RoleID

To complete this setup, you'll need to open a ticket with UKG to add the Greenhouse integration to your UKG Onboarding environment.

After a ticket is complete, go into your UKG settings by clicking **Menu**. Then, select **System Configuration** > **Role Administration**.

Use the _Find by_ search bar to locate your _Onboarding Owner_ and select it from the list.

Copy and save the URL from the top of the page.

Your onboarding owner URL should look similar to the following values.

`https://e9.ultipro.com/edit/CompanyRoleAddChange.aspx?eeid=1HL8k=ESYSA!roleid=120`

Using the URL, copy the value after `roleid=`. This value will be used later as your Onboarding Owner RoleID.

In the URL above, the Onboarding Owner RoleID is 120.

When you're finished, enter this information in the setup page in Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### Find your tenant alias

To complete the Greenhouse setup, Site Admins will need to locate the tenant alias in UKG Pro.

Log in to UKG Pro using a UKG Pro system administrator account.

Click the **My Team** icon, select **Onboarding,** then click **Onboarding Gateway**.

You'll be redirected to your UKG Onboarding page. The URL of this contains the tenant alias. 

In the browser bar, locate the portion of the URL that appears after the domain. The value is the tenant alias. For example, in the URL `https://onb-demo-b.ultipro.com/USG1008IT157S`, the tenant alias is `USG1008IT157S`

**Copy** this value and enter it in the **Tenant Alias field** on the UKG Pro setup page in Greenhouse.

### Select integration user and email in Greenhouse

For the last two steps of this integration open the setup page in Greenhouse Recruiting and select the user fields at the bottom of the page. This **User** that will be attributed to all API calls for this integration. This must be a Site Admin.

Then, enter an **Email address** for the person who should receive success and error notifications.

**Note:** You can use a distribution list in this field to send these emails to multiple users.

### Finish setup

After all the sections on the HRIS Link for UKG page have been completed, click **Connect** at the bottom of the page to finish the setup and finalize the integration.

### Using the integration

**Note:** For Candidate and Internal transfer exports, you will need to select a company that is in the same country as the UKG job

#### Candidate export

When you create an offer in Greenhouse Recruiting, you'll have the option to send the new hire's information to UKG Pro Onboarding. When the candidate is marked as hired, the following information will be sent to UKG:

**Greenhouse field name** | **UKG Pro field name** | **Field type** | **Existing/New Greenhouse field** | **Candidate field** | **Job field** | **Offer field**  
---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
First name | First name | Text | Existing | ✓ |  |   
Last name | Last name | Text | Existing | ✓ |  |   
Email address | Email | Text | Existing | ✓ |  |   
Phone number | Phone | Text | Existing | ✓ |  |   
Address | Address | Text | Existing | ✓ |  |   
Component company | Component Company | Dropdown | New |  |  | ✓  
Work location | Work Location | Dropdown | New |  |  | ✓  
Onboarding owner | Onboarding Owner | Dropdown | New |  |  | ✓  
Supervisor | Supervisor | Dropdown | New |  | ✓ |   
Hire date | Hire Date | Date | Existing |  |  | ✓  
Start date | Start Date | Date | Existing |  |  | ✓  
Full or Part-time | Full Time / Part Time | Dropdown | New |  | ✓ |   
Hourly or Salaried | Salary / Hourly | Dropdown | New |  | ✓ |   
Pay rate (salary) | Rate | Currency | New |  |  | ✓  
Pay period | Rate Pay Period | Dropdown | New |  |  | ✓  
Job code | Job | Dropdown | New |  | ✓ | ✓  
Work hours | Scheduled Hours | Dropdown | New |  |  | ✓  
Organization level 1 | Organization level 1 | Dropdown | New |  | ✓ | ✓  
Organization level 2 | Organization level 2 | Dropdown | New |  | ✓ | ✓  
Organization level 3 | Organization level 3 | Dropdown | New |  | ✓ | ✓  
Organization level 4 | Organization level 4 | Dropdown | New |  | ✓ | ✓  
  
#### Internal transfer export

When you create an offer in Greenhouse Recruiting, you'll have the option to send the internal transfer's information to UKG Pro, where we will update the employee personal, job, and compensation information. When the internal transfer is marked as hired, the following information will be sent to UKG:

**Greenhouse field name** | **UKG Pro field name** | **Field type** | **Existing/New Greenhouse field** | **Job field** | **Offer field**  
---|---|---|---|---|---  
Component company | Component Company | Dropdown | New |  | ✓  
Employee type | Employee Type | Dropdown | New |  | ✓  
Work hours | Scheduled Hours | Dropdown | New |  | ✓  
Effective date | Effective Date | Date | New |  | ✓  
Employee number | Employee Number | Text | New |  | ✓  
Job code | Job | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
Transfer reason | Transfer Reason | Dropdown | New |  | ✓  
Full or Part-time | Full Time / Part Time | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
Hourly or Salaried | Salary / Hourly | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
Paygroup | Pay Group | Dropdown | New |  | ✓  
Organization level 1 | Organization level 1 | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
Organization level 2 | Organization level 2 | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
Organization level 3 | Organization level 3 | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
Organization level 4 | Organization level 4 | Dropdown | New | ✓ |   
  
#### User sync

After configuring the integration, you'll receive an email containing a .csv of the user changes that would occur when the user import is enabled. Inspect this file carefully to ensure that no critical data is unintentionally lost as part of the initial sync.

If the values in the update look correct and acceptable for the import, click the link in the email to begin the user import process.

Setting up user sync allows your organization to automatically create a user account in Greenhouse Recruiting when an employee has an account in UKG Pro Core. All valid UKG Pro Core users will be included in this sync and will be sent with the following information:

  * Name
  * Email address
  * Employee ID
  * Status



For answers to common questions about user sync, see [FAQ: HRIS Link for UKG Pro user sync](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/48917288960027).

#### Organizational data sync

**Important:** The turnkey UKG Pro integration imports all reference data (locations, job codes, departments, etc.) from your UKG tenant into Greenhouse's offer fields area. If you need to limit data to specific company codes, business units, or locations, you'll need a custom/filtered integration. Please contact your Account Manager before purchasing.

  * **Auto synced:** Component company, Work location, Onboarding owner, Supervisor, Pay group, Transfer reason, Job code, Organization levels 1-4
  * **One-time upload:** Full or Part-time, Hourly or Salaried, Work hours, Pay period

# BackgroundChecks.com integration

BackgroundChecks.com provides comprehensive, compliant background screening services for employers.

The BackgroundChecks.com integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows you to order and review background checks directly from Greenhouse, enabling a seamless hiring workflow.

#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API key
  * Enter API Key in BackgroundChecks.com
  * Create a webhook
  * Use the BackgroundChecks.com integration
  * Additional resources



### Requirements to get started

  * A BackgroundChecks.com account
  * A Greenhouse account with admin permissions



**Note:** If you are not yet a BackgroundChecks.com customer, [create an account here](https://app.backgroundchecks.com/create-account?source_token=TG1IbnNRb2ZlbllwVkw0azlYR3JUbEVhcUQ1THFucFVGbWpZVzgyZVNSZz0) or contact our sales team ([sales@backgroundchecks.com](mailto:sales@backgroundchecks.com)) to discuss custom packages or volume pricing.

### Create a Harvest API key

To configure the BackgroundChecks.com integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the BackgroundChecks.com integration. Copy the API key as you’ll need to paste it in the next step.

#### Credentials

In the **Create New Credential** box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type** : Harvest
  * **Partner** : BackgroundChecks.com
  * **Description** : BackgroundChecks.com Integration



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the BackgroundChecks.com integration:

  * **Users**
    * GET: List Users
  * **Candidates**
    * POST: Add Note
  * **Custom Fields**
    * POST: Create custom field
    * DELETE: Delete custom field



### Enter API Key in BackgroundChecks.com

  * Log into your BackgroundChecks.com account
  * Navigate to **Integrations & API → Partner Integrations**
  * Select the Greenhouse integration toggle switch
  * **Paste** the Greenhouse API Key 

  * Select the Greenhouse Admin to be the owner of the integration & choose which team you want the orders associated with



### Create a webhook

Next, create a webhook in Greenhouse Recruiting. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163727003) to create your webhook, using the settings below:

  * **Name:** Backgroundchecks integration
  * **When:** Candidate has been hired
  * **Endpoint URL:** The endpoint URL you obtained from BackgroundChecks.com
  * **Secret key:** The secret key you obtained from BackgroundChecks.com
  * **Error recipient email:** The email address that will receive an email notification if the webhook fails. BackgroundChecks.com recommends choosing a Greenhouse Recruiting Site Admin to receive the email notification.



Once you create the webhook, the integration is set up and ready to use.

### Use the BackgroundChecks.com integration

A dropdown will allow you to re-assign all background check orders to another team

#### How to order and view background checks

  * Background checks by default are attached to a job
  * When you advance a candidate to the **Offer** stage and create an offer, you’ll see the option to order a background check
  * You have the option to change the package for a candidate at this stage in the dropdown
  * You can add background check packages to both an **existing job** or **new job** :



**For existing jobs**

  * Go to **All Jobs** → Select the job
  * Click **Job Setup → Job Info**   
  

  * In the **Details** section, you will find a setting for “**Default BackgroundChecks.com Report Package** ” **→** Select**Edit** icon**→** Choose package you want to use for this job 




**For new jobs**

Select the default package during job creation under “**Default BackgroundChecks.com Report Package** ”

**Note:** All background check package options in the dropdown are set in ClearChecks and not in Greenhouse Recruiting.

### Additional resources

For additional support or troubleshooting, reach out to their team: [support@backgroundchecks.com](mailto:support@backgroundchecks.com) or 1-800-942-1366 _(direct human support)_

# Edit consent request email template

**Permissions: Site Admin** , and **Job Admin** , who can manage company email and social media templates

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

**Note** : This article pertains to organizations that have selected explicit consent as the [legal basis for their GDPR configuration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360042142612).

When explicit consent is selected as the legal basis for your organization's GDPR configuration, any prospect or candidate that enters your account will need to provide consent to have their data collected, stored, and processed.

Anyone under a data retention rule that does not enter through a consent portal will be sent a consent request email automatically. Additionally, this email can be manually sent to pre-existing candidates and / or prospects in your account who have not yet given consent.

In this article, we will cover how to edit the copy of the consent request email.

To edit the consent request email template, click the **Configure** icon  on your navigation bar, then select **Email Templates** on the left.

=

Navigate to your default GDPR notification under _Organization-Wide Templates_ and click the **Edit** icon  beside the Default GDPR Notification template.

From the _Edit Email Template_ page, input a name for the template, sender address, and subject heading for the email in the appropriate fields.

Enter the text that will be automatically sent to candidates whose data you're collecting. 

**Note** : You should seek the advice of your legal counsel to prepare this language as it applies to your business.

When finished, click **Save**.

Greenhouse Recruiting will automatically append buttons to **Give** **Consent** or **Deny** **Consent** to the end of the email when it is delivered to candidates or prospects. The text of these buttons is non-editable.

**Note** : For candidates with an active consent request, it's possible to resend a GDPR consent request email to a candidate. In this case, the 'consent request email' will be resent as configured. # Job notes

**Permissions:** Site Admins, and Job Admins with permission to create, edit, and view job notes

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Job notes allow Greenhouse users to record and share notes on open and closed jobs, helping your team collaborate and stay aligned without needing external documents or tools. In this article, we’ll cover how to create and manage job notes, including visibility permissions, notifications, mentioning teammates, and summarizing notes with the help of AI.

#### In this article

  * [Create a job note](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/38050301918363#h_0b921b3d-01bc-45fe-81aa-4afba0773125)
  * [Organizing notes](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/38050301918363#01JXX2DZY7YGAKKNMYG34MC2E4)
  * [Summarize notes using AI](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/38050301918363#01JXX3TDKTS2T95D1G7J7SXHGG)
  * [Mentions and notifications](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/38050301918363#01JXX3TMP746SR75X3MT1N9NAP)



### Create a job note

Site Admins and Job Admins can leave notes on any open or closed job.

To create and view notes, choose a job and select **Job notes** from the menu on the left.

If you're the first person to add a note to the job, you'll see an empty state and the text field where you can begin composing your note. Other notes left by your team will be shown in ascending chronological order.

### Organizing notes

Similarly to [candidate profile notes](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360031123652), job notes can be pinned for easy reference. To pin a note, hover over it, open the menu, and select **Pin note.**

When there are more than 2 pinned notes, you can select the **Pin** icon at the top to filter by pinned notes.

To filter through all notes, select the **Filter** icon at the top of the page.

You can filter by the note's visibility or creator.

Notes marked as private will only be visible to other users who have [permission](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360039518131) to see private notes. They will be hidden from view to users who don't have that permission. Privates notes contain a lock icon with the word _Private_ underneath the note creator's name.

### Summarize notes using AI

When there are a lot of job notes and you need to get up to speed quickly, you can use AI to help create a summary of all the notes that have been posted by your team so far.

When you select the **Summarize** button, a new comment will appear at the end of the feed from Greenhouse. This comment is only visible to you and will disappear when you navigate away from the page.

Summaries distill job notes into key bullet points based on what was discussed by your team, including their names. Private notes are excluded from summaries by default.

This feature can be toggled on or off for your organization by a Site Admin on the [AI tools page in Configure.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/27677342026651)

### Mentions and notifications

Highlight a note and bring it to another Greenhouse user's attention by tagging them with an [@mention (at-mention)](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360013153651). They'll receive an email from Greenhouse letting them know they've been tagged in a job note.

Whenever a job note is added, edited, or deleted, these events appear in the activity feed for that job. If a note is deleted, the deletion itself is logged. Any previous activity related to that note will still remain in the feed.

If your company's Greenhouse account is integrated with [Slack](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/207344866), @mentions will trigger a Slack notification as well.
