# HRIS Link configuration options

**Permissions:** —

**Product tier:** Available to Pro subscription tier with HRIS Link add-on

[HRIS Link](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360055282972) is a customizable integration that allows your organization to hire at scale. You can programmatically import [jobs](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058912031), [users](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058975731), and [offices and departments](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058975151) from your HRIS to Greenhouse Recruiting. You can also [export new hires](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/11757838187547) to be used in your HRIS.

This article outlines some of the configuration options available with HRIS Link. These features can be enabled individually and aren't required for the integration to function. To enable any of the options listed in this article, reach out to [Greenhouse Technical Support](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058320292).

**Tip** : Looking to manage your HRIS reports or ISUs for HRIS Link? Check out [Manage HRIS Link ISUs and reports](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/11006737633307).

#### In this article

  * Append hiring team
    * Chart: Expected behavior for hiring team responsibility
  * Automatically close jobs
    * Close a job with a case-insensitive match
    * Close a job with no matching close reason in Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Switch from without job requisitions enabled to with job requisitions enabled
  * Do not send 'no changes were made' emails
  * Frequently asked questions



### Append hiring team

This configuration option affects how updates to the `Recruiters`, `Hiring_Managers`, `Coordinators`, and `Sourcers` columns on your HRIS report flow over to the hiring team on jobs in Greenhouse Recruiting. This option allows you to add users to a job's hiring team in Greenhouse without the risk of them being automatically removed by HRIS Link.

When the Append hiring team configuration option is enabled, updates to the `Recruiters`, `Hiring_Managers`, `Coordinators`, and `Sourcers` columns in the HRIS report after initial job creation will add hiring team members (recruiters, hiring managers, coordinators, or sourcers) to a Greenhouse Recruiting's hiring team without replacing any existing hiring team members already assigned to the job.

If the Append hiring team option is not enabled, updates to the `Recruiters`, `Hiring_Managers`, `Coordinators`, and `Sourcers` columns in the HRIS report after initial job creation will replace all hiring team members on a Greenhouse job’s hiring team. Any users added to a job's hiring team manually in Greenhouse Recruiting can be overwritten and removed by HRIS Link.

Check out the chart below for more information on how responsibility is assigned to recruiters or coordinators in different scenarios.

[ Click here ](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058912031) for details on how to configure these columns in your report.

#### Questions about this configuration?

See our frequently asked questions.

### Chart: Expected behavior for hiring team responsibility

See the charts below for more information on the expected behavior for hiring team responsibilities, depending on whether the append hiring team flag is _activated_ or _not_ _activated_ (default).

Append hiring team not activated (default)

  * Create job
  * Update job



Append hiring team activated

  * Create job
  * Update job



### Append hiring team not activated (default)

#### Create job

HRIS Report Values |  No recruiter or coordinator on Greenhouse Recruiting job |  One responsible recruiter or coordinator on Greenhouse Recruiting job |  Multiple recruiters or coordinators on the Greenhouse Recruiting job  
---|---|---|---  
No recruiter or coordinator |  No recruiter or coordinator is set in Greenhouse Recruiting. | N/A | N/A  
One recruiter or coordinator |  The recruiter or coordinator in the HRIS report is added and set as the responsible recruiter or coordinator in Greenhouse Recruiting. | N/A | N/A  
Multiple recruiters or coordinators |  All recruiters or coordinators in the HRIS report are added and first in the list is set as the responsible recruiter or coordinator in Greenhouse Recruiting. | N/A | N/A  
  
#### Update job

HRIS Report Values |  No recruiter or coordinator on Greenhouse Recruiting job |  One responsible recruiter or coordinator on Greenhouse Recruiting job |  Multiple recruiters or coordinators on the Greenhouse Recruiting job  
---|---|---|---  
No recruiter or coordinator |  No recruiter or coordinator is set in Greenhouse Recruiting. |  No change to the Greenhouse Recruiting recruiter or coordinator. |  No change to the Greenhouse Recruiting recruiters or coordinator.  
One recruiter or coordinator |  The recruiter or coordinator in the HRIS report is added and set as the responsible recruiter or coordinator in Greenhouse Recruiting. |  The original Greenhouse Recruiting recruiter or coordinator is removed, and the new recruiter or coordinator in the HRIS report is added and set as responsible. |  All original recruiters or coordinators on the Greenhouse Recruiting job are removed, and the new recruiter or coordinator in the HRIS report is added and set as responsible.  
Multiple recruiters or coordinators |  All recruiters or coordinators in the HRIS report are added and first in the list is set as the responsible recruiter or coordinator in Greenhouse Recruiting. |  The original Greenhouse Recruiting recruiter or coordinator is replaced by the new recruiters or coordinators in the HRIS report. The first recruiter or coordinator listed in the HRIS report is set as responsible. |  All original Greenhouse Recruiting recruiters or coordinators are replaced by the new recruiters or coordinators in the HRIS Report. The first recruiter or coordinator listed in the HRIS report is set as responsible.  
  
### Append Hiring Team activated

#### Create job

HRIS Report Values |  No recruiter or coordinator on Greenhouse Recruiting job |  One responsible recruiter or coordinator on Greenhouse Recruiting job |  Multiple recruiters or coordinators on the Greenhouse Recruiting job  
---|---|---|---  
No recruiter or coordinator |  No recruiter or coordinator is set in Greenhouse Recruiting. |  N/A |  N/A  
One recruiter or coordinator |  The recruiter or coordinator is added and set as the responsible recruiter or coordinator in Greenhouse Recruiting. |  N/A |  N/A  
Multiple recruiters or coordinators |  All recruiters or coordinators on the HRIS report are added and first in the list is set as responsible . |  N/A |  N/A  
  
#### Update job

HRIS Report Values |  No recruiter or coordinator on Greenhouse Recruiting job |  One responsible or coordinator recruiter on Greenhouse Recruiting job |  Multiple recruiters or coordinators on the Greenhouse Recruiting job  
---|---|---|---  
No recruiter or coordinator |  No recruiter or coordinator is set in Greenhouse Recruiting. |  N/A |  N/A  
One recruiter or coordinator |  The recruiter or coordinator on the HRIS report is added and set as the responsible recruiter or coordinator in Greenhouse Recruiting. |  The original Greenhouse Recruiting recruiter or coordinator remains on job, and the new recruiter or coordinator in the HRIS report is added and set as responsible . There is no change if the original Greenhouse Recruiting recruiter or coordinator is the same as the HRIS recruiter or coordinator. |  All original Greenhouse Recruiting recruiters or coordinators remain on job, and the new recruiter or coordinator in the HRIS report is added and set as responsible. If the new recruiter or coordinator was already present and responsible on the Greenhouse Recruiting job, no change occurs. If the new recruiter or coordinator was present on the Greenhouse Recruiting job, but not responsible, they are set as responsible.  
Multiple recruiters or coordinators |  All recruiters or coordinators on the HRIS report are added and first in the list is set as responsible. |  The original Greenhouse Recruiting recruiter or coordinator remains on the job, all recruiters or coordinators listed in the HRIS report are added to the job, and the first recruiter or coordinator listed in the HRIS report is set as responsible. There is no change to the responsible recruiter or coordinator if the first recruiter or coordinator in the HRIS report is already set as responsible. |  All original Greenhouse Recruiting recruiters or coordinators remain on job, all recruiters or coordinators listed in the HRIS report are added to the job, and the first recruiter or coordinator listed in the HRIS report is set as responsible. There is no change to the responsible recruiter or coordinator if the first recruiter or coordinator in the HRIS report is already set as responsible.  
  
### Automatically close jobs

This option allows your organization to automatically close jobs in Greenhouse Recruiting based on the requisition/position status in HRIS.

For instance, if a requisition/position in your HRIS is in a _closed_ status and the job in Greenhouse is in an _open_ status (including drafts), the integration automatically closes all openings on the job in Greenhouse Recruiting and applies a close reason if one is provided in the [HRIS Link Job import report](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058912671-Report-specification-Import-jobs-from-HRIS&sa=D&source=editors&ust=1622844765186000&usg=AOvVaw0vu0q6IDSlVS3YzY6VyVTQ).

When a job is automatically closed with this integration, HRIS Link will send an email notification to the `Notify_Email`. This notification email will also include jobs that were closed without a provided close reason.

#### Close a job with a case-insensitive match

If HRIS Link attempts to close a job but a close reason does not exactly match a close reason in Greenhouse Recruiting, the job will be closed and an email notification will be sent with the provided close reason.

#### Close a job with no matching close reason in Greenhouse Recruiting

If a close reason is provided but the integration is unable to find a match in Greenhouse Recruiting, HRIS Link still closes the job without a close reason and sends a notification email to your organization.

#### Questions about this configuration?

See our frequently asked questions.

### Do not send 'no changes were made' emails

By default, all customers who enable HRIS Link integration going forward will only receive success and error notifications. These trigger every 15 minutes, regardless of whether or not the integration made any changes within Greenhouse Recruiting.

If your organization would only like to receive success and error messages from the HRIS Link integration when changes are made or attempted in Greenhouse Recruiting, it’s now possible to toggle a setting to silence the 'No Changes' email notifications.

Any existing customers with the integrations already enabled who would like to silence the 'No Changes' notifications should [contact Greenhouse Technical Support](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058320292) to request this change to their HRIS Link configuration.

**Example —** No changes email notification:

  * **Subject** _:_ HRIS Link: Job/Office/Department/User import completed successfully with no changes


  * **Body** _:_ No changes to Jobs/Offices/Departments/Users were made since the previous integration run.



### Switch from without job requisitions enabled to with job requisitions enabled

HRIS Link job import supports importing jobs from your HRIS both [with job requisitions enabled](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4403889907355) and [without job requisitions enabled](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4403988430235).

As your organization grows and scales, you may find you need to switch from without job requisitions to with job requisitions enabled for a variety of reasons:

  * Your organization may begin to utilize one requisition to many openings (1:many);
  * Your recruiting processes may evolve over time;
  * You may see the need for evergreen roles in your departments.



To switch from without job requisitions enabled to with job requisitions enabled, take these steps:

  1. Confirm you've enabled job requisitions in your HRIS.
  2. Check out the HRIS Link job import report specifications here: [Set up HRIS Link job import with 'job requisitions' enabled](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4403889907355). Construct your new job import report based on the specs.
  3. Reach out to [Greenhouse Technical Support](https://support.greenhouse.io/direct) with your updated report. Greenhouse Technical Support will pause your HRIS Link integration and switch your configuration from without job requisitions to with job requisitions enabled.
  4. Greenhouse Technical Support will confirm when your HRIS Link configuration has been updated and the integration successfully runs.



### Frequently asked questions

#### What happens to the hiring manager or the sourcer with the 'append hiring team' configuration option?

Since the hiring manager and sourcer role don't require a "responsibility" assignment in Greenhouse Recruiting, the _Append Hiring Team_ configuration option will keep the Hiring Managers that are assigned on the Greenhouse Recruiting job and add the new hiring managers (from the report) to the hiring team that was not assigned previously on the job in Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### Can I remove Hiring Team members with the 'append hiring team' configuration option?

No, the append hiring team feature does not remove users from the Greenhouse Recruiting hiring team.

#### Does Greenhouse Recruiting open previously closed jobs automatically?

No, Greenhouse Recruiting requires that a user manually opens the job posting.

#### Does HRIS Link support requisition management on HRIS platforms?

Currently, HRIS Link doesn't support requisition management. HRIS Link requires opening IDs to operate. Using HRIS Link with requisition management mode on your HRIS could cause unexpected integration behavior.

#### When closing a job, what happens to active candidates on the job?

Since a candidate can be placed on more than one job post, the candidate will stay active even though the associated job is closed.

#### Can we obtain enough information via a WD report in order to open/close on the opening level?

Greenhouse Recruiting doesn't monitor opening-level statuses. The integration closes all openings if the status of a job in a WD report is _closed_.

**Note:** If a job is open in the HRIS but closed in Greenhouse Recruiting when an integration message is sent, the job will stay closed in Greenhouse Recruiting, but a notification will be sent to the organization. Jobs cannot be automatically re-opened with an HRIS Link integration.

# Assign job-based permission on future jobs

Job-based permissions determine the level of access an individual user has on a job. For example, a user could be a Job Admin: Approver to be given access to approve offers on specific jobs.

While Job Admin levels are created on the Configure page, individual permissions are assigned to each user. 

In some cases, you may want to assign permission to a user for all future jobs. This process is used when a user should be automatically assigned access based on a specific office or department combination, and you don't want to create an [automated permission rule](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/22567258374171).

#### In this article

  * Assign job-based permission for all future jobs
  * Assign job-based permission for future jobs in a specific office or department



### Assign job-based permission for all future jobs

Navigate to **Configure** > **Users** and choose the user from the list. 

Click **Add** in the _Job-Based Permissions_ section.

**Note:** Job-based permissions can only be assigned to Job Admins.

Click the **edit** icon  in the _Future Jobs_ section at the top of the page.

Select the new permission from the dropdown menu and click **Save**.

The new permission will now display in the _Future Jobs_ box in the user's permissions.

### Assign job-based permission for future jobs in a specific office or department

Changing the All Future Jobs menu will automatically apply that permission for all future jobs. However, by first choosing an Office or Department in the filters at the top of the page, the selected job admin level will be assigned to the combination selected in the filters.

For example, choosing New York before assigning a future job permission will only apply that Job Admin permission level to jobs created in the New York Office.

# TLS certificate update

### **What is the exact nature of the change?**

Starting July 30th, 2021, the TLS certificates served by Greenhouse API endpoints will drop the DST Root CA X3 from their chain of trust. Refer to this [Let’s Encrypt article](https://letsencrypt.org/2020/12/21/extending-android-compatibility.html) for additional details. Specifically, the new certificates will be using the “alternative chain” provided by Let’s Encrypt.

### **Why is this change being made?**

We are making this change to preserve compatibility with the greatest number of clients. The current, default chain will stop working with clients using OpenSSL versions older than 1.1.0 once the DST Root CA X3 certificate expires.

### **Which endpoints are affected?**

The following endpoints will be affected:

  * api.greenhouse.io
  * api.eu.greenhouse.io
  * api.us.greenhouse.io
  * harvest.greenhouse.io
  * harvest.eu.greenhouse.io
  * harvest.us.greenhouse.io
  * boards-api.greenhouse.io



### **Will my client be compatible with the new certificates?**

The following platforms trust the new certificate, ISRG Root X1:

  * Windows >= XP SP3 (assuming Automatic Root Certificate Update isn’t manually deactivated)
  * macOS >= 10.12.1
  * iOS >= 10 (iOS 9 does not include it)
  * iPhone 5 and above can upgrade to iOS 10 and can thus trust ISRG Root X1
  * Android >= 7.1.1 (but Android >= 2.3.6 will work by default due to our special cross-sign)
  * Mozilla Firefox >= 50.0
  * Ubuntu >= xenial / 16.04 (with updates applied)
  * Debian >= jessie / 8 (with updates applied)
  * Java 8 >= 8u141
  * Java 7 >= 7u151
  * NSS >= 3.26



### **How can I be sure that my client is compatible?**

Make a request to <https://certificatetest.greenhouse.io>. Incompatible clients will receive a certificate validation error.

### **My client is not compatible, how can I fix this?**

Apply the latest software updates to your platform. Alternatively, add the [ISRG Root X1](https://letsencrypt.org/certs/isrgrootx1.pem) certificate to your trust store. The specifics vary by platform.

# Is it possible to un-merge candidate profiles?

It is not**** possible to un-merge any candidate profiles once they've been merged—whether automatically through Auto-merge or manually from a Duplicate tag.

All of the information from the secondary profile would be deprecated. However the resume / cover letter should still be found on the merged profile under the **Documents** section of the candidate profile.

If two profiles are merged that are not true duplicate candidates, the best resolution is to retrieve the resume / cover letter and re-create the candidate profile manually.

# Enable Business Intelligence Connector

**Permissions:** Basic and above who can manage and configure BIC

**Product tier:** Available for Plus and Pro subscription tiers

Business Intelligence Connector provides additional insight into an organization's Greenhouse data and is designed for companies with robust analytics and business intelligence requirements.

You need to enable Business Intelligence Connector in order to receive your data.

#### In this article

  * Before you begin
  * Enable Business Intelligence Connector
    * for S3
    * for Redshift
  * Use Business Intelligence Connector



### Before you begin

You need to be a Greenhouse Recruiting user who can [manage and configure BIC](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201122629).

Next, decide whether to use Amazon S3 or Redshift to receive your data. Business Intelligence Connector will perform a nightly ETL to the method of your choosing.

**Tip** : Check out [Redshift vs. S3](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405633343259) to see which might best serve your organization's needs.

### Enable Business Intelligence Connector

When you're ready, log in to Greenhouse Recruiting and navigate to **Configure** > **Dev Center** > **Business Intelligence Connector**.

Choose your ETL method.

You can enable Business Intelligence for S3 or for Redshift.

#### For S3

To enable Business Intelligence Connector for S3, click**Configure** beside S3.

Choose the AWS region for your organization from the dropdown.

Enter your S3 bucket name, and click **Next**.

Click **Copy** **bucket** **policy** , then paste the policy to your S3 console.

**Tip** : Read more about using bucket policies with your S3 console in the [AWS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/add-bucket-policy.html).

# Essential report best practices

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Essential reports in Greenhouse Recruiting offer key insights into the health of your job pipelines, the efficiency of your hiring teams, and the diversity of your talent pool.

To stay on top of your data to promote reporting accuracy, your organization can employ a few best practices to drive data integrity and resolve inaccurate hiring data.

#### In this article

  * Review permission levels for all users
  * Review company metadata
  * Stay on top of key data within your jobs and candidates
  * Deactivated users



### Review permission levels for all users

User permissions or the permission policies set by your organization can affect the data you see within essential reports. Users are only able to report on data they have permission to view. 

For example, when you [email a report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003338503) to another person, Greenhouse Recruiting will first check the recipient's permissions to see if they are allowed to access the report.

If the specified user cannot access data in the report (like private candidate data), the report will not be sent. If a recipient doesn't have access to a particular job in the report, that information will be redacted.

Go through the **Users** tab and make sure that each user only has as much access as they need. You can always [export the list](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200521129), if that is helpful. 

Make sure Site Admins are limited as much as possible. Assign [job-based permissions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040181991) to users as needed. 

### Review company metadata

#### Audit all custom data in custom options

Under **Configure** > **Custom Options** , you will see all the data your organization can customize. Make sure you have limited these fields to the correct information you want to be measuring.

**Review source list:** Make sure you don't have any duplicate sources and you have hidden any default sources you don't use.

**Review custom candidate, job, and offer fields:** Review your [custom fields](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360001421452) and clean-up any your team doesn't need or use. Make sure they are all collecting the correct type of data (i.e. Currency type for Salary).

**Review any additional custom data:** Determine what other data your organization has customized and audit for any unneeded or duplicative fields.

### Stay on top of key data within your jobs and openings

#### Accurate open dates

Inaccurate open dates can cause discrepancies in reports, particularly for the [time to hire per job report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/204635705-Time-to-hire-per-job-report). Make sure accurate open dates are maintained at the job and opening level. [Learn more](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/7992568877595#h_01GA6X3GBN0TVWGTZD151VW6EG).

#### Accurate application dates

If you add a candidate to Greenhouse Recruiting after you've already started considering them, backdate their application date. Accurate application dates on candidate touchpoints ensure your pipeline reports have integrity. [Learn more](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/7992568877595#h_01GA503WWZENN0HHX2ZZXMHE1R).

#### Accurate offer dates

When hiring a candidate, double-check the opening you're hiring them against has the correct open date. Hires against inaccurate job and opening open dates can impact your [time to hire per job report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/204635705).

If the candidate's offer is updated in Greenhouse Recruiting on a different day than the actual offer was accepted or rejected, you should adjust those dates to reflect reality. Accurate offer dates will improve your organization's reporting. [Learn more](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/7992568877595#h_01GA5044XKC59KC7BRANW1ZJM2).

### Deactivated users

Once a user is [deactivated](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115004791523) in Greenhouse Recruiting, [scheduled report emails](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003711906) set up on their accounts will no longer be sent as previously configured.

If the recurring reports were sent using the **Email Report** or **Schedule Report** features, users can save the historical reports to their individual accounts to maintain their expected schedule moving forward.

Deactivated users previously marked as the **Primary recruiter** on their assigned jobs will also be moved to the **Secondary** **recruiter** column within returned report data due to their inactive user status.

**Learn more reporting best practices**

[Comparing](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/213332286)[ cohort, activity, and snapshot reports](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/213332286)

[Maintain accurate hiring data](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/7992568877595)

[Identify and correct inaccurate hiring data](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/16711979322907)

[Troubleshoot a report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/13710986142107)

[Filter reports by relative dates](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115001839603)

# Monster organic job posts

**Permissions:** Site Admin

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

**Note:** If you are interested in enabling paid job ads through Monster, please [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360035440531).

Greenhouse Recruiting offers the ability to post free job ads on several partner boards, including Monster. These free ads can help expand your reach and allow you to access more candidates at no additional cost to your organization.

Unlike other free external job boards such as [Glassdoor or Indeed](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002006126), which are enabled on a per-job basis through the _Job Post Edit_ page, Monster organic job posts are handled at the organization level in Greenhouse Recruiting. Monster organic posts will either be On/Off for every job that is currently live on your job board.

#### In this article

  * Enable Monster organic job posts
  * Update or delete a job post on Monster



### Enable Monster organic job posts

To enable Monster organic job posts, click the **Configure** icon in the top-right corner of the page and select **Job Boards & Posts** from the left-side panel.

Locate the job board where you want to set up the integration. Click the **Ellipsis** icon beside the job board and select **Edit Board Settings** from the dropdown menu.

On the _Edit Your Job Board_ page, scroll to **Allow candidates to apply directly from Monster Organic** and select **Yes**.

Scroll to the bottom of the page and click **Save** when finished.

Once enabled, all live job posts associated with the job board will be sent to Monster. Candidates applying through these job posts will be added to Greenhouse Recruiting with **Monster** in the source field.

**Note:** Once a job post is published, Greenhouse Recruiting sends the job post information to Monster within 3 – 4 hours. From there, it can take up to 48 hours for the data to be processed and the job post to appear on Monster's website.

### Update or delete a job post on Monster

To edit the content of a job post on Monster or remove it entirely from Monster's network, [edit](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002791566) or [delete](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360023264611) the job post on Greenhouse Recruiting. Your changes will sync with Monster the next time Monster receives updates from Greenhouse Recruiting.

# PingOne integration

**Permissions:** Basic users or above, who can manage and configure SSO

**Product tier:** Available for Plus and Pro subscription tiers

PingOne is a best-in-class Identity-as-a-Service (IDaaS) offering for organizations that prefer a more hands-free approach to identity and access management (IAM) for their customers and workforce.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with PingOne allows your organization to use PingOne to enable Single Sign-On (SSO) in your Greenhouse Recruiting account. 

#### In this article

  * Add and Configure Greenhouse Recruiting to PingOne Account with ACS URL
  * Enable SSO in Greenhouse Recruiting



### Add and Configure Greenhouse Recruiting to PingOne Account with ACS URL

Navigate to your PingOne dashboard and click the **My Applications** tab. From the  _My Applications_ page, click **Add Application** > **Search Application Catalog**. 

From the  _Application Catalog_ page, search for  _Greenhouse_. From the  _Greenhouse Software_ panel, click **Setup**. 

On the subsequent page, fill out your SSO information. In the following fields, replace `${acs_token}` with your [company-specific details](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040753811#h_3def9176-6aeb-4e59-856b-bb717d9f708e): 

  * ACS URL
  * Entity ID



**Note:** You can find your ACS URL in Greenhouse Recruiting under **Configure** > **Dev Center** > **Single Sign-On**.

You do not need to upload any metadata or certificates. You also do not need to fill in any fields that are not pre-populated. 

On the next page, the values under the  _Identity Bridge Attribute or Literal Value_ must match exactly what is in the screenshot below. If the fields pre-populate with values such as `SCIM.something.FirstName`, this information is incorrect and must be replaced with `Email`, `First Name`, and `Last Name` as shown below. 

Click **Save & Publish **to complete the configuration for PingOne. 

### Enable SSO in Greenhouse Recruiting

For organizations enabling PingOne with an ACS URL, once you have added Greenhouse Recruiting to PingOne and gathered the necessary information, follow the steps [outlined here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040753811#h_f09c04a3-d9f6-408e-be4b-58970c73a993) to finish enabling Single Sign-On in Greenhouse Recruiting.

_**Note:** If you opt to upload your PingOne XML metadata file, the following values must be set manually in Greenhouse Recruiting: _

  * _Entity ID / Issuer: Set this to the same value configured in PingOne (this will default to recruiting/greenhouse.io)_
  * _Name Identifier Format: Set this to`urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent`_



See additional notes below:

  * All users MUST log in through PingOne once SSO is enabled. Users will not be able to log in via the standard Greenhouse Recruiting login screen anymore, even if they already have passwords.
  * Your users will access Greenhouse Recruiting via the custom URL, which will use the company subdomain that you entered (i.e. https://my-company.greenhouse.io), if applicable.
  * If a new user has a PingOne account but not a Greenhouse Recruiting account, Greenhouse Recruiting will create a Greenhouse Recruiting user account for them automatically the first time they log in via PingOne. The user account will be created with Basic permissions. Administrators can still invite users and change permissions in Greenhouse Recruiting using our existing process.
  * Data will be unaffected. Your users will still have access to all of their existing jobs, scorecards, interviews, etc. PingOne only changes the way users log in.

# Set primary job post

**Permissions:** Site Admin, and Job Admin who can create, edit, and delete job posts

**Product tier:** Available for Plus and Pro subscription tiers

Primary job posts allow your organization to choose which job post should be used to automatically populate certain tokens and fields throughout the Greenhouse Recruiting platform, including:

  * Populating the `{{JOB_NAME}}` token in emails*
  * Selecting the job post sent in [automated job post request emails](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360052440032)
  * Populating the Job Details tab in [interview kits](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002226826)*
  * Linking from [scheduled social media posts](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002226806-Post-to-Social-Media-Account-from-Greenhouse-Recruiting#h_c3cbac56-09b0-4ffc-bb26-8d47e13ed744)



**Note** : *This only applies if the candidate did not apply through a job post. If the candidate applied through a job post, the `((JOB_NAME}` email token and the **Job Details** tab are populated by information from the job post through which the candidate applied.

#### In this article

  * Set primary job post manually
  * Set primary job post automatically by default logic



**Note:** Organizations with an Core subscription cannot edit the primary job post selection.

### Set primary job post manually

To set the primary job post for a job, navigate to the job (**Jobs** > select a single **Job**) and click the **Job Setup** tab. Click **Job Posts** on the left.

Under the _Primary_ column, click the button to the right of the job post you wish to set as primary for the job.

**Note:** Job Admins without the permission stripe 'Can create, edit, and delete job posts' can see which post is selected as primary, but cannot edit the selection.

### Set primary job post automatically by default logic

If a job currently has no posts and you create a new post for the job, Greenhouse Recruiting automatically assigns that post as primary. If you create additional posts for the job later, you can manually edit which post is marked as primary by following the steps above.

For existing jobs with job posts created before the release of this feature, Greenhouse Recruiting uses the following logic to set the primary job post automatically:

  * If any live, external job posts exist, the oldest one is marked as the primary job post. If no posts match this criteria, move to the next bullet.
  * If any offline, external job posts exist, the oldest one is marked as the primary job post. If no posts match this criteria, move to the next bullet.
  * If any live, internal job posts exist, the oldest one is marked as the primary job post. If no posts match this criteria, move to the next bullet.
  * If any offline, internal job posts exist, the oldest one is marked as the primary job post. If no posts match this criteria, move to the next bullet.
  * If none of the above options exist, no primary job post is set automatically.



If someone [deletes the job post](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360023264611) marked as primary, Greenhouse Recruiting uses the logic outlined above to automatically set a new primary job post.

# Headhuntr.io integration

Headhuntr.io's platform leverages AI and candidate intelligence to assist recruiters in finding, evaluating, and contacting top talent quickly and effectively.

Headhuntr.io's integration with Greenhouse Recruiting enables the automatic transfer of potential, qualified, and interested candidates sourced in Headhuntr.io to Greenhouse Recruiting. This seamless integration helps to streamline and keep track of communication between candidates and the hiring team throughout the recruiting process.

#### In this article

  * Enable the Headhuntr.io integration
    * Create a Harvest API key
    * Create web hooks
    * Retrieve Greenhouse Recruiting user ID
  * Use the Headhuntr.io integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



### Create a Harvest API key

To enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Headhuntr.io integration, you'll need to create a Harvest API key. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the Headhuntr.io integration.

#### Credentials

In the Create New Credential box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type** : Harvest
  * **Partner** : Headhuntr.io (optional)
  * **Description** : Headhuntr.io Harvest API Key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Headhuntr.io integration:

**Applications**

  * GET: Retrieve Application
  * PATCH: Update Application



**Candidates**

  * GET: Retrieve Candidate
  * GET: List Candidates
  * PATCH: Edit Candidate
  * POST: Add Candidate
  * POST: Add Note
  * POST: Add Attachment
  * POST: Add Application
  * POST: Add Education
  * POST: Add Employment
  * POST: Add Prospect



**Departments**

  * GET: List Departments
  * GET: Retrieve Department



**Jobs**

  * GET: List Jobs
  * GET: Retrieve Job



**Job posts**

  * GET: List Job Posts
  * GET: Retrieve Job Post
  * GET: List Job Posts for Job
  * GET: Retrieve Job Post for Job



**Job stages**

  * GET: List Job Stages
  * GET: List Job Stages for Job
  * GET: Retrieve Job Stage



**Sources**

  * GET: List Job Stages



**Prospect pool**

  * GET: List Prospect Pools
  * GET: Retrieve Prospect Pool



**Users**

  * GET: List Users



When finished, navigate to Headhuntr.io and paste your Harvest API key into the ATS configuration wizard.

### Create web hooks

After you share your Harvest API key, Headhuntr.io will provide you with a secret key to be used to create web hooks in Greenhouse Recruiting. Use the secret key to create fourteen (14) webhooks for the integration.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360005574531) to create your web hooks. Use the values listed below to configure the web hooks:

**Name** |  **When** |  **Error recipient email** |  **Disabled**  
---|---|---|---  
Headhuntr.io-Candidate Hired |  Candidate has been hired |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io-Candidate Stage Change |  Candidate has changed stage |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io-Candidate/Prospect Rejected |  Candidate or Prospect rejected |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io-Candidate/Prospect Unrejected |  Candidate or Prospect unrejected |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io-Candidate/Prospect Updated |  Candidate or Prospect updated |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io-Candidate Deleted |  Delete Candidate |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io-Prospect Created |  Prospect Created |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io-Candidate Merged |  Merged Candidate |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io-Job Created |  Job Created |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io-Job Deleted |  Job Deleted |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io- Job Post Created |  Job Post Created |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io- Job Post Deleted |  Job Post Deleted |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io-Job Post Updated |  Job Post Updated |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
Headhuntr.io-Job Updated |  Job Updated |  ats@headhuntr.io |  No  
  
### Retrieve Greenhouse Recruiting user ID

Finally, Headhuntr.io will require a Greenhouse recruiting ID for all the users of the company who will be using the integration. The user ID is required to associate the user with the data sent via the integration. Follow the steps [in this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/10765948752027) to retrieve your user IDs. The User ID from the downloaded file can be used to complete the user mapping step of the configuration on Headhuntr.io.

### Use the Headhuntr.io integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

After enabling the integration, you can search and shortlist candidates for a requisition in Headhuntr.io. You can select the candidates at any stage of the requisition pipeline and select **Export to ATS**.

Once the export button is clicked, you'll receive an email with the details about the export. For all candidates exported, an export flag will appear with the label _ATS Exported_ and the corresponding date when the export happened.

If a single job is selected while exporting, the candidates will be added to Greenhouse Recruiting as candidates. If no job or multiple jobs are selected, exported candidates will be added to Greenhouse Recruiting as prospects. 

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [support@headhuntr.io](mailto:support@headhuntr.io).

# Rejection reasons overview

**Permissions:** \--

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

A rejection reason is a configurable field when rejecting a candidate or prospect from a job and is categorized into four main types:

  * We rejected them
  * They rejected us
  * Security concern
  * None specified



Capturing structured data around why a candidate or prospect was ultimately rejected from a job can impact the way your organization analyzes its recruiting efforts by revealing any potential trends that are keeping you from making a hire.

**Example** : Your organization is having trouble making a hire for a job despite having many candidates who entered the late stages of your interview plan.

Use the [Rejection Reasons report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/203941409-What-is-the-Rejection-Reasons-report-How-do-I-use-it-) to see why candidates might have declined an offer. If the reason is _**Didn't like offer**_ , this might be an indicator that your team needs to reevaluate overall compensation for the role. However, if the reason is "lacking skills and qualifications," it may be valuable to rethink your interview plan.

In addition to customizable rejection reasons, Greenhouse Recruiting provides your organization with the following default rejection reasons:

**Default rejection reason** | **Reason type**  
---|---  
Duplicate | We rejected them  
Lacking skill(s)/qualification(s) | We rejected them  
Not a cultural fit | We rejected them  
Other (add notes below) | We rejected them  
Preferred another candidate | We rejected them  
Spam | We rejected them  
Didn't like offer | They rejected us  
Other | They rejected us  
Wasn't available | They rejected us  
Wasn't interested | They rejected us  
None specified | None specified  
Fraud concerns identified | Security concern  
Irregular application activity | Security concern  
Other | Security concern  
Suspicious interview behavior | Security concern  
  
Follow the links below to learn more about how to use, customize, and leverage rejection reasons in your organization:

  * [Reject a candidate or prospect](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025225732)
  * [Create a custom rejection reason](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025225032)
  * [Best practices: Customize rejection reasons](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000769051)

# day100 integration

day100's integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows you to seamlessly use the two products together to add smart human insights powered by day100 to your candidate pipeline at any point in your recruiting process.

#### In this article

  * Enable the integration
  * Use the integration



### Enable the integration

To enable the integration, follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923) to retrieve your API key from your day100 representative and set up the assessment stage in your interview plans.

Once you've set up your interview plans and configured your take-home test, you can send the test to candidates.

### Use the integration

Once the integration is enabled for your organization, you can add the day100 assessment as an interview stage.

You can send an assessment to a candidate by selecting the**Send Test** button next to the interview stage.

After it's been sent, the assessment's status will display in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Once the candidate has submitted their test, the interview kit will contain a link to view the submitted test on the day100 platform. To see a candidate's results in day100, click **View Report**.

The integration returns the following information:

  * **View Report** : Click to open the candidate's profile on day100 and display the complete information collected and analyzed by day100.
  * **Score** : This is the overall MatchFit score of the candidate based on the day100 assessment.
  * **Culture Fit Score** : This is the culture fit portion of the MatchFit score.
  * **Skills Fit Score** : This is the skills fit portion of the MatchFit score.
  * **day100 MatchFit rank** : This is the rank of the candidate on day100 based on their score, as compared to the baseline answers you supplied, where the rank can be: Exceptional fit, Good fit, Average fit and Below Average fit.

# VentureFizz integration

VentureFizz is the leading employer branding and recruiting website focused on venture-backed tech companies. # Duplicate email template

**Permissions:** \--

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Greenhouse Recruiting currently does not have direct functionality to duplicate an existing email template.

However, even without this direct functionality, Greenhouse Recruiting users can still **manually** duplicate the contents of an email template. In this article, we'll cover how to manually duplicate an email template that you own.

**Note** : The following steps can be performed for organization-wide templates by a user with **Site Admin** permission levels, or **Job Admin** permission levels with the additional user-specific permission Can manage company email and social media templates.

Click the **Configure** icon  on your navigation bar and click **Email Templates** on the left.

Click the **Edit** icon  inline with the email template that should be _duplicated._

Navigate to the _Body_ of the email template and click **Ellipsis** icon > then click the **Source Code** icon **< >** on the toolbar. Copy the contents.

**Note** : We recommend copying the source code in order to preserve any specific formatting that is used in the original template.

With the source code for the original email template copied, return to the _Email_ _Templates_ page and click **\+ New**.

Configure any details for the new email template, then scroll to the _Body_ of the email template and click the **Ellipsis** icon > then select the **Source** **Code** icon **< >** on the toolbar.

Paste the copied contents in the provided field.

Click **Save** when finished.

The original email template is now duplicated and saved in your new email template!
zoom-integration:
<!-- source: https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360042222612-Zoom-integration -->

# Zoom integration

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Zoom is the leader in modern enterprise video communications, with an easy cloud platform for video and audio conferencing, collaboration, chat, and webinars across mobile devices, desktops, telephones, and room systems.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Zoom allows you to add Zoom links to interviews directly within Greenhouse Recruiting as part of your scheduling workflow.

#### In this article

  * Set up the integration
  * [Use the integration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360042222612#h_1949bf45-a942-43fb-b4c0-5b0f147a6a71)
    * Schedule an interview with Zoom
    * Send an interview invite to a candidate
  * [Troubleshoot the integration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360042222612#h_01HHJ1E6T2P1Z6K1KA6NRZ6VCM)
  * Disconnect the integration



### Set up the integration

**Note:** This integration only needs to be set up once for your entire organization, but it must be completed by someone with a Zoom Admin account. Once enabled, the integration is available to everyone in your Greenhouse Recruiting environment who can schedule interviews.

To set up the integration, log in to Greenhouse Recruiting and click **Integrations** on your navigation bar.

Search for _Zoom_ , and select it from the list of results. Click **Connect**.

Next, enter your Zoom Admin credentials, and sign in to authorize the integration.

**Note:** For you to authorize the Zoom integration, Greenhouse Recruiting must be approved in your organization's [Zoom App Marketplace](https://marketplace.zoom.us/). If it isn't already, your organization's Marketplace Administrator can approve the app in the Zoom Admin portal. [Learn more](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/13295386332827).

Once complete, the Zoom integration is enabled and can be used by anyone in your Greenhouse Recruiting environment when scheduling interviews.

The following default settings can't be edited for this integration:

  * All Zoom meeting IDs are generated randomly.
  * All Zoom meeting IDs include a password.



**Tip** : If your Zoom host uses Zoom's Personal Meeting ID (PMI) feature, two different meeting IDs might be shown on the calendar event. Interviewers and candidates could click either link to connect to the meeting. To avoid confusion, we recommend that your Zoom hosts not use a Personal Meeting ID (PMI) when scheduling a meeting. [Learn more](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362843-What-is-Personal-Meeting-ID-PMI-and-Personal-Link-#h_27cabbf1-3eaa-44fd-8ead-81b2a848a8ea) about deactivating PMI on Zoom.

**Note:** If the person who connected the Zoom integration leaves your organization or their Zoom Admin account is downgraded, people in your organization will encounter an error when attempting to schedule with this integration. To resolve this, the Zoom integration should be disconnected by a Site Admin, and then reconnected by someone with a valid Zoom Admin account.

### Use the integration

#### Schedule an interview with Zoom

**Tip:** Organizations using the [Calendly integration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029649991) can schedule Zoom meetings through Calendly. This allows for added functionality, like [Zoom's alternative host feature](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/208220166-Alternative-host).

To schedule an interview using the Zoom integration, navigate to a candidate profile and click **Schedule Interview**.

**Note:** If you're scheduling back-to-back interviews and want to use the same Zoom meeting link for all interviews, click **Schedule All**. This way you can create a single Zoom meeting link which will be added to each of the interviews you schedule for the candidate. If you prefer to create separate Zoom meeting links for each interview, schedule the interviews one at a time.

Next, select the details for the interview date, time, and interviewers, then click **Schedule and Continue** at the bottom-right of the page.

**Tip** : For more details on scheduling, check out [Schedule an interview.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360045420091)

Edit the invite description or select an interviewer invite template. The name of the Zoom meeting will match the subject line of the interviewer invite unless the subject line is blank,__ in which case Zoom will name it _Zoom Meeting_. Zoom meeting titles will render interview tokens such as `{{INTERVIEW_NAME}}` and `{{CANDIDATE_NAME}}` unless you uncheck _Send an email update to all interviewers_.

Next, click **Add Video Conferencing** on the left.

Select **Zoom** from the __ dropdown, then select the person who should host the meeting. You can choose between yourself, any people listed as interviewers for the event, or any people listed as coordinators on the job.

**Note** : It isn't possible to edit the meeting host once the interview is scheduled. If you need to change the meeting host later, delete and reschedule the interview.

When finished, click **Send Invites**. A unique Zoom meeting link will be generated and automatically added to the body of the interviewer invite.

**Note:** If you're scheduling multiple interviews with **Schedule All** , a single Zoom meeting link will be generated and shared across all selected interviews.

Greenhouse Recruiting will send a calendar invite to the interviewers including the unique Zoom video conferencing link.

You can also copy the Zoom meeting link directly from the interview on the candidate's profile if needed.

**Tip** : Follow your usual process to update an interview if you need to edit, cancel, or delete an existing interview scheduled with Zoom. Just keep the Zoom meeting link in the body of the event, and send updates to all guests. While the date and time won't be updated in Zoom when rescheduled, the meeting will be ready whenever the interviewer joins regardless of what scheduled time is displayed in Zoom.

**Note** : Canceling or deleting an interview in Greenhouse Recruiting that contains a Zoom meeting link doesn't deactivate the meeting or remove the meeting from your organization's Zoom account.

The following information is sent to Zoom when scheduling is complete:

  * Host name
  * Start time
  * Duration of the meeting
  * Subject line of the interviewer invite



#### Send an interview invite to a candidate

**Note:** A candidate won't be notified of a scheduled interview unless you send an interview confirmation.

Once an interview is scheduled, click **Send Interview Confirmation** at the bottom of the page [interview confirmation email](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360015975112) to the candidate.

**Note** : By default, this email uses the _Default Candidate Interview Confirmation Message_ [template](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002573326).

The Zoom video conferencing link will be automatically added to the body of the email and is also included in the calendar file attachment. Don't edit or remove the Zoom link, or your candidate will have trouble connecting to your interview.

**Tip** : Your Zoom host's settings determine if the candidate can join the meeting before the host.

Your organization should consider enabling the [Embed passcode in the invite link for one-click join](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360060396571-Embed-passcode-in-invite-link-for-one-click-join) setting on Zoom Admin settings. This will ensure candidates can join meetings without entering a Zoom meeting passcode.

### Troubleshoot the integration

#### Unable to set up the Zoom integration

If you're unable to set up the Zoom integration on Greenhouse Recruiting, first ensure you're a Zoom Admin. Only Zoom Admin can enable the integration for your organization.

Next, ensure the Greenhouse Recruiting app is approved in your Zoom marketplace. Log in to your Zoom Admin portal, and click **Advanced.**

Click **App** **Marketplace** , and search for Greenhouse.

Click **Who** **Can** **Install** and add yourself or another Admin to the list of people who can integrate Zoom with Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### Error connecting to Zoom, refresh or contact a site admin

If you receive the error "Error connecting to Zoom, refresh or contact a site admin" when trying to schedule with Zoom, it typically indicates that the Zoom Admin who connected the integration is either no longer a Zoom Admin or has had their permissions changed in Zoom. 

To resolve this issue, have a Zoom Admin at your organization [disconnect](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360042222612#h_5d2151bf-4c09-443b-bdc7-fdc88c2ad8b8) and then [reconnect the integration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360042222612#h_f9cc0535-e625-4216-a659-d6c4381df2fd) in Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### I am not recognized as a Zoom user

If you attempt to schedule an interview and receive an error "Not recognized as a Zoom user" when choosing yourself or another team member as a host, this typically indicates that the primary email address in Greenhouse Recruiting doesn't match the primary email address of the account on Zoom.

To resolve this issue, ensure that your [primary email address](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360034879332) in Greenhouse Recruiting and in Zoom both match. If the issue persists, reach out to Zoom Support.

### Disconnect the integration

**Note** : Only Site Admin can disconnect the Zoom integration for an organization.

To disconnect the integration, click **Integrations** on your navigation bar and select**Zoom.**

Click **Disconnect**.

Once complete, people at your organization won't be able to use the integration to create Zoom meeting links going forward. However, any interviews already scheduled will retain valid Zoom meeting links.

<!-- source: https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/7987443593499-Manage-custom-user-fields -->

# Manage custom user fields

**Permissions:** Site Admin

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Custom user fields are a type of custom option that allow you to add your own unique labels to user profiles. Custom user fields give you more control over how you categorize your users and assign user permissions. This makes your bulk permissions management more efficient.

**Example:** Imagine your organization introduced a policy that only users who are Directors should be assigned as hiring managers on jobs in Greenhouse Recruiting.

You could add a custom user field for "Seniority" and include "Director" as an option. After assigning the value of "Director" to the appropriate users, you could then filter by "Director" on the _Users_ page. You could then use bulk editing to change that user's permissions to **Job Admin: Hiring Manager** on their assigned jobs.

#### In this article

  * Create a custom user field
  * Edit or archive a custom user field
  * Assign a custom field to a user
  * Manage custom user fields in bulk



### Create a custom user field

Go to the _Custom Options_ page. _(**Configure** icon  > **Custom Options**)_

Find the _Company Custom Fields_ section, then click **Users**.

On the _Manage User Attribute Fields_ page, click **Add Field**.

#### 

Add a field name, then select a field type from the dropdown.

Field types for custom user fields include:

  * Single select
  * Multi select
  * Yes/No
  * User



You can also add a description of the field and make the field required by clicking the checkbox next to **Required**.

When you finish, click **Save**. 

### Edit or archive a custom user field

Custom fields can be modified by clicking the Edit icon. This will update the label for the field across Greenhouse.

If you no longer need the field, it can be archived. Archived fields no longer show up when creating new users, and can't be modified for existing users.

Archived fields can be restored under the Archived tab on the custom fields page.

### Assign a custom field to a user

Go to the _Users_ page. _(**Configure** icon  > **Users**)_

Select a user from the list.

Scroll down to the _Custom fields_ section. Each custom field you create will appear here. 

Click on the dropdown under a field name to add or edit the value. Click the **X** to remove the value.

When you finish, click **Save user details**.

#### Manage custom user fields in bulk

Yes. You can manage custom fields in bulk with the [_Users_](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#users) and [_Custom Fields_](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#custom-fields) endpoints of our Harvest API or with [HRIS Link](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058975731).

# Slack integration

**Permissions:** Basic and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

With Slack, you get real-time communication features like messaging and calls, a searchable index of all your files and conversations, and integrations with a growing number of handy bots and apps. With all your work in a single place, you can quickly access the context, people, and tools you need to work productively with your team. Now everyone can finally be on the same page and get their work done.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Slack allows you to receive important Greenhouse Recruiting notifications directly in a Slack channel of your choosing.

#### In this article

  * Enable the Slack integration
  * Use the Slack integration with Greenhouse Recruiting  

    * New candidate and approval notifications
    * @mention notifications
    * Manage scorecard-related Slack notifications for other users
    * Slack notification examples
    * Update or disconnect Slack integration



### Enable the Slack integration

To enable the Slack integration, log in to Greenhouse Recruiting and select your initials from the top-right. Click **Account** **Settings** from the dropdown, then click **Add to Slack**.

Sign into Slack using your organization's Slack URL and login information.

**Note:** If you see an error message that the integration is not supported by your team, contact your Slack administrator to adjust your team's integration settings.

Next, select which channel should receive the notification.

**Note** : You can only select one channel for Slack notifications.

**Tip:** Greenhouse Recruiting strongly suggests choosing Slackbot as the channel. Slackbot sends the message to you privately, rather than through an entire channel. However, if you want your notifications to be more visible, you can choose a private or public channel in which you have permission to post.

While Greenhouse Recruiting automatically strips out private information before posting to a public channel, remember that notifications to public or private channels might allow other members of your Slack team to see information that they wouldn't normally have access to in Greenhouse Recruiting, such as approval status, candidate status, or other notifications.

For example, if you are a Job Admin and enable notifications to a Slack channel with non-admins, those users may be able to see sensitive information intended only for your position.

When finished, click **Allow** to authorize the integration.

You'll receive an email confirmation and a notification message in the selected Slack channel confirming the integration was added.

### Use the Slack integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

#### New candidate and approval notifications

Once you connect your Slack account, you can control the notifications from the integration by clicking the **Edit** button in Greenhouse Recruiting under _Account_ _Settings_.

The Slack integration allows you to set different configurations based on the types of notifications that may be relevant to your hiring process – such as notifications for new applications, referrals, or approvals. You can set the following notifications for Slack:

  * New applicant
  * New internal applicant
  * New referral
  * New agency submission
  * New scorecard
  * Scorecard reminder
  * Approval request
  * Approved to start recruiting
  * Offer fully approved
  * @mentions



**Note:** Basic users can only enable scorecard reminder messages on jobs where they are scheduled to conduct interviews.

To enable a notification for all jobs, click **Turn all on** next to the section.

To configure notifications for a specific job, select it from the dropdown menu at the top of the window and select the checkboxes for each notification.

When finished, click **Save**.

#### @mention notifications

After you enable the Slack integration, you can be notified anytime a teammate [@mentions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360013153651) you in a candidate note or scorecard.

To turn on this feature, click the @mentions toggle in the Slack integration section of your _Account_ _Settings_.

Now, every time you're @mentioned, you'll receive a Slack notification a preview of the relevant scorecard or note, and a link to the candidate's scorecard or profile (based on where you were tagged).

If you were @mentioned on a candidate or scorecard where you aren't assigned the correct permission, you won't be able to access that information.

**Note:** In addition to a Slack notification, users will continue to receive an email notification for each @mention. This email notification can't be deactivated.

### Manage scorecard-related Slack notifications for other users

Job Admin and Site Admin can manage [scorecard reminders](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360047691292-Scorecard-Reminder-Notification) and [new scorecard](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029087331-New-Scorecard-Notification) Slack notifications on behalf of recipients on individual jobs, provided the recipients have enabled the Slack integration for their Greenhouse Recruiting account.

These notifications are managed on a per-job basis under **Jobs** > **Job** **name** > **Job Setup** > **Notifications**.

To update the notification settings for another user, click **Configure** next to the type of notification.

Turn on the **Turn on Slack notifications** toggle and click **Save**.

#### Slack notification examples

When a candidate-related action occurs and triggers a Slack notification, you will receive a message in Slack containing the candidate's name and a link to their profile.

If you've opted to receive approvals notifications in Slack, any job or offer approval that requires your attention appears with buttons that allow you to approve or reject without ever leaving Slack.

If the approvals are sent to any channel other than Slackbot, any private fields are stripped out to prevent unintentionally sharing sensitive information with all channel members.

**Note:** The first time you approve a job or offer, you'll be prompted to click an additional link in Slack to re-authorize your account. This authentication allows Greenhouse Recruiting to confirm you have permission to take action on the approval.

### Update or disconnect Slack integration

To update or edit your Slack integration settings, log in to Greenhouse Recruiting and select your initials at the top-right > select **Account** **Settings** From the dropdown. 

To remove the integration entirely, click **Disconnect** beside the Slack integration.

If you want to update the settings, notifications, or channels for the current integration, click **Edit.**

To remove the integration from your entire organization, a Slack administrator will need to deactivate the integration from your team's Slack preferences.

Any users with the integration enabled will receive two emails the next time a notification is triggered — one email alerting them the integration has been deactivated, and one email with the new candidate notification information.

# DataGrail integration

DataGrail helps Greenhouse Recruiting customers comply with Europe’s (GDPR), California’s (CCPA), Nevada’s (SB 220), and similar privacy regulations. The regulations require on-demand access and deletion of a requester's personal data -- particularly anything that may be associated with an email address -- across all first and third-party/external business systems.

Greenhouse Recruiting’s integration with DataGrail allows Greenhouse customers the ability to request and delete personal data. DataGrail also allows for the unification of communication preferences via a Preference Card that integrates with all the leading communication systems.

#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API Key for the DataGrail integration
    * Credentials
    * Permissions
  * Use the DataGrail integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional support



### Create a Harvest API Key for the DataGrail integration

To configure the Greenhouse Recruiting / DataGrail integration, you'll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the credentials and permissions below are selected when configuring the DataGrail integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** DataGrail
  * **Description:** DataGrail Harvest API Key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the DataGrail integration:

**Users**

  * GET: List Users



**Applications**

  * DELETE: Delete Application
  * GET: Retrieve Application
  * GET: List Applications



**Candidates**

  * DELETE: Delete Candidate
  * GET: Retrieve Candidate
  * GET: List Candidates
  * PUT: Anonymize Candidate



### Use the DataGrail integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

After the integration is configured, your team that handles Privacy Requests can request a candidate's record from Greenhouse Recruiting to process a candidate's privacy request. Because this action is handled through the API, the team won't need to log into Greenhouse Recruiting to get information about the candidate's record.

If any additional action is needed from a Greenhouse user, the privacy team should consult with the Greenhouse Admin.

### Additional support

Contact [support@datagrail.io](mailto:support@datagrail.io) for troubleshooting assistance for this integration.

# Cancel or reschedule a self-scheduling request

**Permissions:** Site Admin, and Job Admin who can email candidates/prospects

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

After a self-scheduling request [has been sent](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4409534677915), you can easily cancel or delete it on the candidate's profile in Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### In this article

  * Cancel a pending self-schedule request
  * Delete a self-scheduled interview
  * Candidate self-rescheduling
  * Additional resources



### Cancel a pending self-schedule request

If a candidate has been sent a self-schedule request but has not yet completed it, you can easily remove the request by clicking **Cancel self-schedule request**.

**Note:** Canceling a pending request won't remove the request from the candidate's inbox. Instead it will deactivate the link so the candidate won't be able to complete the self-schedule request.

### Cancel a self-scheduled interview

Once a self-schedule request is completed by the candidate, the interview will appear on the candidate's profile.

To reschedule or cancel the interview, click the **Ellipses** icon next to the scheduled interview and choose **Reschedule** from the list.

On the scheduling page, choose a new time or select **Delete Interview** to cancel it entirely.

If the candidate should complete a new self-schedule request, cancel and delete the interview, then send them a new self-schedule request using the steps outlined [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4409534677915). If you don't cancel the interview before deleting it, it will still show up on the candidate's calendar.

[Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200241969) for more information on deleting interviews.

### Candidate self-rescheduling

After a candidate receives a self-schedule request, they can use the same link to update their self-schedule time, up to 24 hours before the scheduled interview.

### Additional resources

  * [Candidate self-scheduling setup](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4409526364443)
  * [Send a self-schedule request](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4409534677915)

# I'm Site Admin. Why can't I see certain candidates or data? 

The Site Admin user permission level has the highest level of access, with the ability to make changes that impact your entire company's Greenhouse Recruiting configuration. However, even Site Admin users do not automatically have access to all data in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Each user account is assigned a [user permission level](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360039614171) (**Basic** , **Job Admin** , and **Site Admin**), which is a blanket set of access applied to their whole account. These permissions are required for each user account.

However, **user-specific permissions** are optional assignments that give the users access to specific information.

If you can't see a certain candidate or piece of data as a Site Admin, it's likely that you haven't been assigned the user-specific permission.

  * If you aren't able to access certain candidates as a Site Admin, you might not have the user-specific permission **Can create and view private candidates**.
  * If you can't view certain data on candidate profiles (such as the **Private** tab) you might not have the user-specific permission **Can see private notes, salary info, manage offers, request approval, and approve jobs/offers**.



You can check the permissions assigned to your account by following the steps [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360020855632).

**Note:** You aren't able to edit your own permissions. If you require an update of your permissions, you'll need to [reach out to your In-House Contacts](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360021238012) and have them make the change.
