# Trello integration

**Permissions:** Owners

**Product tier:** Available for all Greenhouse Welcome and Greenhouse Onboarding tiers

Trello is a web-based project management application from Atlassian. When integrated with Greenhouse Onboarding, any [onboarding tasks](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000525691) that are assigned to Trello will be added as a card to your kanban board automatically via email.

**Note:** Check out [this guide](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022405211) for more information on how to assign Greenhouse Onboarding tasks to Trello and other third-party systems.

#### In this article

  * Retrieve your Trello board email
  * Enable Trello in Greenhouse Onboarding



### Retrieve your Trello board email

Greenhouse Onboarding uses a Trello board's email address to automatically add cards to the board when you generate a task in Greenhouse Onboarding. To enable Trello as a [third-party task system](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022403771), your organization will need to provide Greenhouse Onboarding with this email.

**Note** : Any Greenhouse Onboarding user in your organization can create cards on a Trello board via email as long as they have the Trello board's email address.

Navigate to your Trello board and click the **three dots** icon on the right.

Under  _Menu_ , select **Email-to-board**.

****

In the  _Add cards via email_ window, copy the email address listed as **Your email address for this board**.

You'll use this email address to connect your Trello board as a third-party task system in Greenhouse Onboarding.

### Enable Trello in Greenhouse Onboarding

Once you've copied your Trello board's email address, navigate back to Greenhouse Onboarding.

From your Greenhouse Onboarding homepage, click **Settings**.

On the  _Settings_ page, navigate to **Company Info** > **3rd-Party Task Systems**.

On the _3rd-Party Task Systems_ page, click **Add New**.

In the _Add New Task System_ window, give your third-party task system a **name** and select Trello from the **System** dropdown.

Next, paste your Trello board email address in the **Email Address** field.

Greenhouse Onboarding allows tokens to be inserted into tasks, which can reveal personally identifiable information. Because of this, you'll want to explicitly define the fields from Greenhouse Onboarding that Trello can view.

Use the **Viewable Fields (Optional)** menu to select which of your fields Trello can view. If a task with a non-viewable token is assigned to Trello, Greenhouse Onboarding will block Trello from viewing the information.

Click **Save and Close**.

Your Trello board will be added as a third-party task system in Greenhouse Onboarding. Repeat the above steps for any additional Trello boards that you need to connect to Greenhouse Onboarding.

You can now [assign tasks](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022405211) to your connected Trello board.

# Auto-advance for prospect post

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above, who have access to CRM

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

With Auto-Advance, your organization can set up Application Rules so that, based on a prospect's answer to a prospect post question, they will be automatically advanced to a specified stage in the prospect pool.

**Example:** For the question, "In what cities are you available to work?" you can configure an Auto-Advance rule so candidates who answer "Chicago" are automatically moved to the stage "Based Locally." 

#### In this article

Required setup

Create a new auto-advance rule

And/or rules

### Required setup

Before you can create an Auto-Advance Application Rule for a prospect post, you'll need to have a [configured prospect post](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360028950972) with [custom application questions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029264971). 

**Note:** Auto-Advance can be configured only for the following question types:

  * Yes/No
  * Single select
  * Multi select



### Create a new auto-advance rule

Navigate to the CRM page and click **Configure CRM**. (**CRM** >**Configure CRM**) 

Navigate to the _Prospect Posts_ panel, click the **Ellipsis icon** next to the prospect post and choose **Manage Rules**.

Click **Add a Rule**.

Select a question and one or more answers in the top half of the box. If a prospect chooses the answer you selected, they'll be eligible for the role. 

Note: If your question isn't in the dropdown menu, it might not be the right question type. See Required setup for more information.

Click **Auto-Advance** in the Then section and choose the correct stage. The prospect will be automatically moved to that stage when they qualify for the rule.

Click **Save** when you're finished. 

### Rules with more than one criteria

You can enhance the power of Auto-Advance Application Rules by defining more complex triggers and answers. These are commonly known as AND/OR conditions. To learn more about using AND/OR conditions, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/203105595#h_01ECK29NWK2JRM6Y82N69ZSEAB).

# Glossary: Report metrics

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Report metrics allow you to track activity pertaining to candidate status and offer status over time using [Report Builder](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000954692).

Report metrics may appear on trend, multi-metric, pipeline history, current pipeline, and pipeline activity reports built using Report Builder. You can read more about these template types [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050783391).

To determine which report template to use, check out the table below:

**Metric** | **Description** | **Appears on**  
---|---|---  
Active candidates | The number of candidates who are considered active on a particular job | Multi-metric report  
Candidates added | The number of candidates who applied or were submitted by a user (i.e. via referral) during a given period of time (regardless if they are "credited" as the source) | Trend, Multi-metric reports  
Candidates entered | The number of candidates who were moved into a stage in the interview pipeline during a given period of time | Pipeline activity report  
Candidates exited | The number of candidates that were moved out of a stage (not including rejections) in the interview pipeline during a given period of time | Pipeline activity report  
Candidates hired | The number of candidates that were hired during a given period of time | Trend, Multi-metric reports  
Candidates interviewing | The number of candidates with any interviews scheduled during a given period of time | Pipeline activity report  
Candidates rated | The number of candidates with any scorecards submitted during a given period of time | Pipeline activity report  
Candidates reached | The total number of candidates (who applied during a given period of time) that ever reached that specific stage | Pipeline history report  
Candidates rejected | The number of candidates that were rejected during a given period of time | Trend, Multi-metric, and Pipeline activity reports  
Close date | The date the final opening on the job was closed | Multi-metric report  
Current candidates | The number of candidates currently in a specific stage | Current pipeline report  
Default offer approvers | The users listed on the job's Offer Approvals: Extend offers to candidates chain | Multi-metric report  
Department | The department to which the job is assigned | Multi-metric report  
Hiring managers | The job's assigned hiring managers, per the Hiring Team page | Multi-metric report  
Interviews created | The number of interviewer invites that were created / sent during a given period of time | Pipeline activity report  
Job approvers: Start recruiting | The users listed on the job's Job Approvals: Approvals to start recruiting chain | Multi-metric report  
Job approvers: Official job approval | The users listed on the job's Job Approvals: Official Job Approval chain | Multi-metric report  
Job custom field | Custom fields created to capture job-specific data in a standardized format. | Multi-metric report  
Job ID | The unique identifier Greenhouse Recruiting uses to track the job; also used in Harvest API and Job Board API | Multi-metric report  
Job post ID | The unique identifier Greenhouse Recruiting uses to track the job's Job Post; also used in Harvest API and Job Board API | Multi-metric report  
Latest offers accepted | The number of offers (most recent version) candidates accepted during a given period of time | Trend, Multi-metric reports  
Latest offers created | The number of offers (most recent version) created during a given period of time | Trend, Multi-metric reports  
Latest offers extended | The number of offers (most recent version) sent to candidates through Greenhouse during a given period of time | Trend, Multi-metric reports  
Latest offers outstanding | The number of offers (most recent version) that were unresolved (neither accepted nor rejected) during a given period of time | Trend, Multi-metric reports  
Latest offers rejected | The number of offers (most recent version) candidates rejected during a given period of time | Trend, Multi-metric reports  
New candidates (last 7 days) | Any candidates who were added to a job in the previous 7 days from when a report is generated | Multi-metric report  
Number of interviews | The number of specific interviews that took place during a given period of time | Pipeline activity report  
Offer custom field | Custom fields created to capture offer-specific data in a standardized format | Multi-metric report  
Office | The office to which the job is assigned | Multi-metric report  
Open date | The date the job was opened | Multi-metric report  
Openings | The number of active openings on the job | Multi-metric report  
Opening custom field | Custom fields created to capture opening-specific data in a standardized format. | Multi-metric report  
Opening IDs | The Opening IDs associated with all active openings on the job | Multi-metric report  
Primary coordinator | The user listed as the job's responsible coordinator, per the Hiring Team page | Multi-metric report  
Primary recruiter | The user listed as the job's responsible recruiter, per the Hiring Team page | Multi-metric report  
Prospects added | The number of prospects who were submitted to the system by a user (via prospect plugin or bulk import) during a given period of time | Trend, Multi-metric reports  
Referrals hired | The number of referrals that have been hired during a given period of time | Trend, Multi-metric reports  
Referrals submitted | The number of referrals a user has submitted during a given period of time | Multi-metric report  
Requisition ID | The req ID assigned to the job by your internal team | Multi-metric report  
Scorecards submitted | The number of total scorecards submitted during a given period of time | Pipeline activity report  
Secondary coordinator | Any users listed on the job's Hiring Team page as coordinators who are not the responsible coordinator | Multi-metric report  
Secondary recruiter | Any users listed on the job's Hiring Team page as recruiters who are not the responsible coordinator | Multi-metric report  
Sourcers | The job's assigned sourcers, per the Hiring Team page | Multi-metric report  
Status | The status of the job (_Open_ , _Closed_ , _Draft_) | Multi-metric report

# Leap integration

Leap is a professional networking platform that enhances the job-seeking process for Gen-Z students and graduates, and the hiring process for employers. Leap’s solutions are centered around speed, inclusivity, and transparency, while also providing companies with the powerful tools they need in order to perform, manage, and support their recruitment efforts. 

Leap includes features like an automated job search, application, and candidate ranking system, interest-based communities, and student profiles that showcase personality and chemistry fit.

Greenhouse Recruiting’s integration with Leap allows you to not only source candidates from their unique and exclusive talent pool of Gen-Z students, but also ensures that reaching these highly sought-after, qualified candidates is faster than ever before.

#### In this article

  * Locate your job board URL 
  * Generate a job board API key
  * Finish setup in Leap
    * Add the Greenhouse Recruiting integration to an existing Leap account

    * Finishing setup if you don't already have a Leap account

    * Use the Leap integration to import jobs from Greenhouse Recruiting

  * Additional resources



### Locate your job board URL 

To make your open jobs available to Leap, you’ll need to send your job board URL.

To locate a job board URL, click the **Configure** icon  and select**Job Board & Posts** on the left side of the page.

Select the **Ellipsis** icon  next to your job board and click **Edit Board Settings**.

Scroll to the **URL** field and **copy** the URL and send to [Leap.](https://joinleap.io/)

**Note:** For a more detailed walkthrough of how to locate your job board URL and for setting up a Job Board API key for a partner, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888210160155).

### Generate a job board API key 

Next, you’ll need to create a Job Board API key for Leap.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888210160155) and use the information below when creating your API key:

  * **API Type:** Job Board
  * **Description:** Leap Job Board API Key



[Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888210160155) for more detailed information on setting up a Job Board API key for a partner. 

### Finish setup in Leap

To finish setup, you'll need to enter your **Job Board API key** and **Job Board URL** into your Leap account. The steps to finish this configuration are different based on whether or not you already have a Leap account:

  * Finishing setup if you don't already have a Leap account
  * Add the Greenhouse Recruiting integration to an existing Leap account



#### Finishing setup if you don't already have a Leap account

Create a new**Business Account** within [Leap.](https://joinleap.io/) From the listed options in the external ATS tools selection, select **Greenhouse Recruiting**

Select **Click here to integrate with Greenhouse** from the listed posting options.

**Note:** To learn more on posting jobs to Leap by scraping your jobs only, click here.

Enter your Greenhouse Recruiting Job board name and Job Board API key and press **Submit** to save your credentials.

#### Add the Greenhouse Recruiting integration to an existing Leap account

Click your profile picture on the top right part of the screen and select **Settings.**

Click **External ATS** from listed tabs and select **Greenhouse Recruiting** from the dropdown.

Select **Integrate with Greenhouse.**

Enter your job board API key and job board name and **Submit**.

After submitting your credentials, your Greenhouse Recruiting and Leap accounts should be successfully linked.

You can now select any of your jobs from Greenhouse to be posted on Leap by navigating to the **Jobs** tab and click **New Job Post** to get started.

#### Use the Leap integration to import jobs from Greenhouse Recruiting

To scrape jobs from Greenhouse Recruiting to post to Leap, follow the steps outlined above and select **Scrape job.**

Select the number of jobs you want to import from Greenhouse Recruiting.

Once you've outlined the quantity of jobs, select the specific job(s) you wish to post and click **Confirm Job Selection.**

Once confirmed, successful job imports will display a success message and all the applications to this job post will also be pushed to your Greenhouse Job Board.

### Additional resources

For additional information on the integration not covered here, reach out to [support@joinleap.co.](mailto:support@joinleap.co)

# HireQuotient integration

HireQuotient develops business skills assessments that can be tailored to the industry context and specific job roles. They create realistic mini job simulations to test a candidate's ability to execute the tasks expected in the role, enabling hiring teams to efficiently screen out unsuitable candidates with minimal time and effort. Just as coding tests have become well-established in tech hiring, HireQuotient plays a similar role for business skills across the organization.

For some job families, HireQuotient offers off-the-shelf content that can be deployed immediately. HireQuotient’s technology platform enables organizations to automatically tailor questions to the exact job scope and ensure that only relevant skills are tested.

HireQuotient's integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows you to seamlessly add HireQuotient's assessment to a job's interview plan.

#### In this article

  * Set up the HireQuotient integration
  * Use the HireQuotient integration
  * Additional resources



### Set up the HireQuotient integration

First, you’ll need to get your API key from HireQuotient API key by following the below steps:

  1. In HireQuotient, navigate to the Greenhouse tab and click **Connect.**
  2. Click **Click to Show** to reveal the API key.

After retrieving your HireQuotient API key, follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923) to share the API key with Greenhouse and add the assessment stage to your interview plans.

# BrightHire integration

BrightHire is the #1 Interview Intelligence platform and the preferred partner to Greenhouse.

Greenhouse and 200+ other enterprises trust BrightHire to transform their interview process, raising quality of hire, improving candidate experience, and saving teams thousands of hours - all powered by market-leading interview AI. 

BrightHire’s end-to-end platform equips hiring teams with powerful tools for exceptional hiring, such as smart job descriptions and interview plans, live interview guides, automated interview notes and highlights, tools to streamline and enhance each hiring decision, AI interviewer coaching, and market-leading talent insights to drive continuous excellence. 

The BrightHire/Greenhouse integration allows users to seamlessly schedule and launch interviews, sync interview notes to your candidate records, and fill out Scorecards.

#### In this article

  * Get started
    * Step 1: Create a new user for the integration and add it to BrightHire
    * Step 2: Create a Harvest API Key for the Greenhouse/BrightHire Integration
    * Step 3: Complete your Greenhouse Integration
    * Step 4: Complete your settings and create the interview webhook
    * Step 5: Create Data Retention webhook
    * (optional) Configure opt-in message for the integration
  * Using the BrightHire integration 
  * Additional resources



### Get started

Before you get started, open the [Greenhouse Integration Page](https://app.brighthire.ai/settings/greenhouse) in BrightHire and log in to Greenhouse Recruiting.

To set up the integration, you'll need to make sure your account has the right permissions:

  * **Can manage ALL organization's API credentials**
  * **Manage and configure webhooks**



Learn more about user permissions [here.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201122629)

### Step 1: Create a new user for the integration and add it to BrightHire

To use the BrightHire integration, you'll need an integration user to help automate some of the actions taken by the interaction:

  * In Greenhouse, click **Configure** in the upper right-hand corner.
  * Navigate to **Users** on the left-hand panel, and click **\+ New Users**.
  * Type the following email address into the field, replacing <company-name> with your company's name. 
    * [`<company-name>@greenhouse.brighthire.ai`](<company-name>@greenhouse.brighthire.ai)
  * Click **Site Admin**.
  * Uncheck **Send invitation email**.
  * Click **Save**.



Your settings should look like this:

  * Locate and click on the **< company-name>@greenhouse.brighthire.ai** user in the **Users** list.
  * Locate the **Host (Domain)** and **Admin User ID** in the URL



  * Navigate to the[ BrightHire/Greenhouse Integration Page](https://app.brighthire.ai/settings/greenhouse) you opened at the beginning.
  * Enter the **Host (Domain)** and **Admin User ID** into the input box.



### Step 2: Create a Harvest API Key for the Greenhouse/BrightHire Integration

A Harvest API key ensures that BrightHire and Greenhouse are properly connected.

  * Click on **Configure** in the upper right-hand corner of Greenhouse.
  * Navigate to **Dev Center** on the left-hand panel.
  * Click **API Credential Management**.
  * Click **Create New API Key**
  * Give your API key a name and select **Harvest** from the _Type_ dropdown menu.
  * Click **Manage Permissions**.
  * On the _Manage API Key Permissions_ page, click **Select All**. When finished, click **Save**.



Your Harvest API key for the Greenhouse/BrightHire integration is created and configured. You can navigate back to the BrightHire open tab, and enter this API key into the API Key input box, then click **Save**.

You can read more about Harvest API for partner integrations [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883).

### Step 3: Complete your Greenhouse integration

Make the following updates in BrightHire:

  * Check **Enabled**.
  * Click **Save**



The **Integration Status** at the top should display a green checkmark. If not, an error message should appear. You can follow the instructions or contact support for additional steps.

__

### Step 4: Complete your settings and create the interview webhook

After your integration status is connected, you'll need to create an interview webhook for the integration. Based on the features you're using, you may also need to create the Data Retention webhook for your integration.

  * Navigate to your[ BrightHire settings](https://app.brighthire.ai/settings/greenhouse) page and generate a webhook signature key.



  * Navigate to **Greenhouse** > **Configure** > **Dev Center** > **Webhooks** > **Webhooks**
  * Enter a name for your new webhook - `brighthire-interview`
  * Go to **When** and select **Interview Deleted**
  * Copy the webhook URL from BrightHire and paste it into the **endpoint URL** field
  * Copy the generated key and paste it into the **Secret Key** field
  * Toggle **Disabled** to **No**
  * Click **Create Webhook**



### Step 5: Create Data Retention webhook

**Note:** This step is required if you're using the Data Retention feature.

  * Navigate to **Greenhouse** > **Configure** > **Dev Center** > **Webhooks** > **Webhooks**
  * Enter a name for your new webhook - `brighthire-candidate-anonymized`
  * Go to **When** and select **Candidate Anonymized**
  * Copy the webhook URL from [BrightHire](https://app.brighthire.ai/settings/greenhouse) and paste it into the **endpoint URL** field
  * Copy the generated key and paste it into the **Secret Key** field
  * Toggle **Disabled** to **No**
  * Click **Create Webhook**



**Note:** To automate this, check “If the candidate’s data is anonymized in Greenhouse” on this[ page](https://app.brighthire.ai/settings/data-retention) in BrightHire (**Configure** > **Compliance** > **Data Retention**).

Congratulations! Your BrightHire/Greenhouse Integration is complete!

### (optional) Configure opt-in message for the integration

By default, an opt-out email is automatically sent to candidates before each interview. 

If you prefer to turn the email off and build the disclosure into your organization's language, Brighthire offers the option to include a dedicated opt-out link.

If you're interested in an opt-out link, reach out to [support@brighthire.ai ](mailto:support@brighthire.ai)to request the link. [Read more in their support center here. ](https://help.brighthire.ai/en/articles/5403608-candidate-opt-out-of-recording)

**Note:** You must log into your BrightHire account to view the article's contents. 

### Using the BrightHire integration 

After BrightHire confirms your integration is enabled, you're ready to use Greenhouse Recruiting with the magic of BrightHire! First, download the [BrightHire Chrome Extension](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/brighthire-extension/mbokiighkhdopgedihndpibkincpcgan?hl=en&authuser=0).

Any interview scheduled through Greenhouse Recruiting with a phone number or video conferencing link in the event or invitation is accessible with BrightHire. If BrightHire is scheduled to join, your interview will be recorded and transcribed, and all your AI notes will be auto-generated and emailed to you at the completion of your interview. 

To place a phone call from Greenhouse Recruiting candidate page, click the ‘Call with BrightHire’ button next to a candidate's phone number to launch the BrightHire interview assistant and fire off a call to the candidate.

With either of these options, BrightHire will pull the candidate's phone number, name, custom questions, and position from Greenhouse Recruiting into BrightHire.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, check out [Using BrightHire with Greenhouse for Interviewers](https://help.brighthire.ai/en/articles/4606106-using-greenhouse-with-brighthire-for-interviewers) or [BrightHire's help center](http://help.brighthire.ai/). 

You can also reach out to [support@brighthire.ai](mailto:support@brighthire.ai) for assistance with the integration.

# User-specific permissions for Site Admins

**Permissions:** —

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

User-specific permissions are extra permissions granted to a user in addition to those included in that user's permission level (Basic, Job Admin, Site Admin). This article will cover the different user-specific permissions associated with the Site Admin permission level.

For more information about the user-specific permissions for the other permission levels, click the links below: 

  * [Permissions for Basic users](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360020860672)
  * [User-specific permissions for Job Admins](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/205614645)



### 

By default, Site Admins are given permission to add referrals and share public job posts, view and manage assigned jobs, and manage all jobs and user permissions. 

Site Admins can also be assigned the following optional user-specific permissions:

**Permission** | **Description**  
---|---  
Can edit another user's advanced permissions | This permission allows the user to [configure the user-specific permissions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360020849292) for other users in the organization. A user with this permission cannot configure their own user-specific permissions.  
Can create and override default approval flows | If your organization has any approval flows configured, this permission allows the user to create and circumvent any of those processes. This permission should be granted judiciously.   
Can see EEOC and demographic reports | If your organization collects EEOC or custom demographic data, this permission allows the user to view your organization's [EEOC](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/204636035) and demographic reports.  
Can create and view private candidates | This permission allows the user to create and view private candidates on all non-confidential jobs. When granted, the user will have additional functionality when adding a candidate.   
Can bulk edit jobs |  This permission allows the user to perform a single action to edit multiple jobs at the same time. For more information on bulk editing jobs, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/sections/360000690511-Edit-Existing-Job).  
  
**Note:** This permission is available only for Plus and Pro subscription tiers.  
Can see private notes, salary info, manage offers, and approve jobs/offers | This permission allows the user to view information under the **Private** tab on a candidate's profile. This includes private notes, salary, offer details, etc. This permission also allows the user to create and edit candidate offers, create and edit offer templates, and to be added as an approver for jobs and/or offers.   
Can upload e-Signature agreements | This permission allows users to [upload e-signature agreements](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/27637882883995), which can be sent to candidates at any time during the hiring process, excluding the offer stage.  
Can view and edit details on the billing page | Gives access to the [billing page](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/30383521759259), which includes details about your organization's relationship with Greenhouse, including contact details and your assigned account team.  
Can manage sandbox configurations |  This permission allows the user to manage [sandbox sync](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/14111892585627), which mirrors data from your production environment to your linked sandbox environment. When granted, the user can enable or disable sandbox sync and configure its schedule, including the day of the week and weekly cadence. Sandbox sync is managed from the production environment. **Note:** This permission is available only for the Pro subscription tier.

# Casium Assessment integration

Casium is the strategic immigration partner for people and talent teams, combining licensed attorneys with industry-leading technology. Casium Immigration Assessments are where that partnership begins. We provide deeply researched analysis along with an attorney-led strategic consultation that helps employers understand and prepare for the potential immigration pathways of their foreign nationals.

Casium’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows you to request an Immigration Assessment directly from your Greenhouse Recruiting account. 

Casium Immigration Assessments are informational and solely for the purposes of immigration planning. Assessments do not determine hiring eligibility or work authorization. Information from the assessment may not be used as the sole basis for hiring or rejection decisions.

#### In this article

  * Enable the integration
  * Using the integration
  * Additional resources



### Enable the integration

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923) to retrieve your API key from your Casium representative and add the ‘Casium’ assessment stage in your interview plans. 

Once the Casium integration is enabled for your organization, you will be able to add the Casium immigration assessment as an interview stage.

### Using the integration

You can send an assessment form to a candidate by selecting the**Send test to candidate** button next to the interview stage. 

After clicking **Send test to candidate** , you will need to select **Who should grade it**. There is no grading involved with Casium Immigration Assessments. Instead, the user you select under **Who should grade it** , will be the user who receives confirmation that the assessment has been completed.

After clicking **Send Test** , the candidate will receive an email from Casium inviting them to complete the Casium Immigration Assessment form.

After the assessment form has been sent to the candidate, the assessment’s status will display in Greenhouse Recruiting as **Awaiting candidate’s submission**.

Once the candidate has submitted the assessment form, Casium will process the candidate’s responses and produce the Casium Immigration Assessment. Once this is completed, the grader that was selected will receive an email confirming that the test has been submitted. **Click the link** in the email to be taken to the Interview Kit in Greenhouse Recruiting.

In the Interview Kit, click **View Report** to schedule a consultation with Casium to review the candidate’s assessment. 

In addition, you can also view the candidate page in Greenhouse Recruiting and see that the assessment has been completed. Click **Go to test** , and this will also take you to schedule a consultation with Casium to review the candidate’s assessment.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [connect@casium.com](mailto:connect@casium.com).

# Organize your welcome experience pages

**Permissions:** Owners and Coordinators

**Product tier:** Available for Greenhouse Welcome and Greenhouse Onboarding subscription tiers

Once you've created your organization's various welcome experience pages, you can organize these pages into one welcome experience presentation for your new hires.

In addition, you can use specific pages to generate customized welcome experiences for new hires across your organization, based on their department, location, employment status, and other criteria.

#### In this article

  * Organize welcome experience pages
  * Filter welcome experience pages by rules
  * Additional resources



### Organize welcome experience pages

From your Greenhouse Onboarding homepage, navigate to **Settings**.

On the  _Settings_ page, navigate to **Welcome Experience** > **Pages**.

Under  _Welcome Experience Pages_ , you'll see each of your organization's existing welcome experience pages listed. Each square displays the page title and any assigned page rules, if applicable.

Published pages display a green dot in the upper-left corner, while unpublished articles will have a red dot.

**Note:** Learn how to edit, assign rules, and publish welcome experience pages with our [Welcome experience overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360013327271).

To organize and rearrange your welcome experience pages for your **default welcome experience** , click and hold the page icon and drag to your desired position.

Be aware that new hires will see default welcome experience pages **and** welcome experience pages with rules that match their location, department, employment status, or other criteria.

You'll need to filter welcome experience pages configured with rules in order to manage welcome experiences specific to new hires with different departments, locations, employment statuses, or other criteria.

**Note:** Pages without rules will surface for all welcome experiences.

### Filter welcome experience pages by rules

Use the provided filter panel to manage welcome experience pages that have been assigned page rules. Welcome experience pages can have assigned rules based on a new hire's department, location, employment status, or other criteria.

You can make multiple filter selections across and within each field. Pages matching the criteria you've selected will auto-populate below.

**Note:** When filtering by rules, pages without rules won't display in the list but will appear in the final welcome experience. You can [preview your welcome experiences](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360013105212) based on these rules to ensure that each experience looks correct.

### Additional resources

  * [Welcome experience overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360013327271)
  * [Customize welcome experience pages](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360013105452)

# Naukri integration

Naukri’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting simplifies the process of posting open requisitions to seamlessly flow from the external ATS system into Naukri. Recruiters can effortlessly collect applications from Naukri and smoothly transfer them to Greenhouse, streamlining the entire recruitment lifecycle.

By eliminating the need of logging into Naukri separately to consolidate applications, Greeenhouse Recruiting's integration with Naukri allows recruiting teams to conveniently manage the entire hiring cycle within Greenhouse, ensuring a cohesive and efficient process.

#### In this article

  * Enable the Naukri / Greenhouse Recruiting integration
    * Create a Harvest API key
    * Create a webhook
    * Create a custom source
  * Use the Naukri integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
    * Create a job in Greenhouse
    * Post jobs to Naukri
    * View candidate data in Greenhouse Recruiting
    * Send candidate feedback to Naukri
  * Additional resources



### Enable the Naukri / Greenhouse Recruiting integration

**Note:** To use the Naukri integration, clients will need a paid Naukri login subscription, as well as the integration module which has an additional cost. For pricing, [contact Naukri](https://www.naukri.com/).

#### Create a Harvest API key 

To configure the Greenhouse Recruiting / Naukri integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key. 

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the Naukri integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Naukri or Unlisted Vendor
  * **Description:** _Naukri Harvest API Key_



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Naukri integration:

**Applications**

  * GET: Retrieve Application
  * PATCH:Update Application
  * POST: Add Attachment to Candidate



**Candidates**

  * GET:Retrieve Candidate
  * POST:Add Candidate
  * POST:Add Note
  * POST:Add Email
  * POST:Add Attachment
  * POST:Add Application



**Jobs**

  * GET:Retrieve Job
  * PATCH: Update Job
  * POST: Create a New Job



**Job Posts**

  * GET: Retrieve Job Post for Job
  * GET: List Job Posts for Job



**Note:** Additional permissions are available and are subject to business parameters that may vary from client to client.

When finished, click **Save**.

#### Create a custom source 

Candidate applications imported to Greenhouse Recruiting by the Naukri integration will need to be attributed to a new [custom source](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200721664).

To create a new custom source, click the **Configure** icon  on your navigation bar, then click **Custom Options** on the left.

On the subsequent page, click **Sources** under the _Company Metadata_ section.

On the _Manage Sources_ page, click the **Create New Source** button.

Use the subsequent dialog box to select the [sourcing strategy](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360004175751) **3rd party boards** and **Naukri** for the name of the source.

Click **Create Source** when finished.

### Use the Naukri integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

With the Naukri integration, information is synced between using [application fields](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360001421452) configured on your application forms in Greenhouse Recruiting. Additionally, Naukri supports [custom job field](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202609855) syncing and will assist with field configuration at initial integration setup. 

To use the Naukri integration successfully, it's recommended to keep your job and application fields static as changes or additions of new required fields may affect integration functionality. 

**Note:** [Candidate fields](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202609675) capturing candidate personal information, employment history, and education background are currently supported by the Naukri / Greenhouse Recruiting integration. 

After using the integration, you may decide you want to share more info between Greenhouse Recruiting and Naukri.

Additional fields list can be shared/mapped if requested/required. Availability will be determined by Naukri based on varied cross mapping and technical feasibility. 

If you would like additional information transferred over, reach out to Naukri Customer Success with a list of items to request. 

#### Create a job

To use the Naukri integration, you'll need to create a new job (_Add_ > **Create a job**) or [modify an existing one](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/16118462399771). 

#### 

Follow the steps outlined in [this guide](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200668380) to create a new job in Greenhouse Recruiting. Use the steps below to modify existing jobs with Naukri integration functionality. 

#### Post jobs to Naukri

After creating a new job or to modify an existing job to start sending jobs to Naukri, open the **Job Info** tab in the job. (**Jobs** > _Select job from list_ > **Job Setup** > **Job Info**)

Toggle **Yes** on the _Edit Job Info_ page to **Send to Naukri**. 

Add relevant data on Naukri dependant fields as [custom job fields](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202609855) for experience, salary, and department. Work with the Naukri team to complete full setup of these fields. 

#### Returning Job URL to Greenhouse

If there are issues syncing your fields or returning Job URL created for the integration, users will encounter a _You do not have any credits left to post a job_. error surfaced in-app. 

#### View candidate data in Greenhouse Recruiting

To view candidates imported from Naukri, access the **Candidates** tab from your personal dashboard. Use the Source filter to search and select candidates associated with Naukri as their source. 

#### Send candidate feedback to Naukri

Naukri captures the first candidate status change during [Application Review](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4401963991707) and syncs back to the candidate application within the Naukri portal, increasing recruiter efficiency. 

Actioning candidates also trains the _Intelligent Layer_ to predict and share more accurate recommendations on the candidate profile using their application details and submitted feedback. to provide a skills percentage score indicating a candidate being either a High, Medium, or Low Match for your open positions.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to the Naukri team at [amplify@zwayam.com](mailto:amplify@zwayam.com).

# Save and email a report

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

The Report Builder gives your organization the flexibility it needs to customize and run reports so you can find and evaluate your data easily. Once you've run an [essential report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360034704071) or created a [custom report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050317592) in Greenhouse Recruiting, you can save your report for future reference or email the report to share it with your teammates.

#### In this article

  * Save a report
  * Email a report
  * Schedule a recurring report email
    * Delete a scheduled report email



### Save a report

To [save a report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003218066), click **Save** at the top right of the  _Reports_ page (for essential reports) or the _Custom Report_ page (for custom reports).

**Note:** You can also save **custom reports** as a [template](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5676138233115). When saving your report, click **Save > Save as template**.

Give your report a unique name. Click **Save** when you're finished.

You can find your saved report by navigating to **Reports > My reports**.

### Email a report

**Note:**

  * When a recipient opens a report from an emailed or scheduled link, they may see a default report name in Greenhouse (even if the sender saved it with a custom name). The report data and filters are the same.
  * The emailed report will only include data that the selected recipient has permission to view in Greenhouse Recruiting.



To email a report to your teammates, click **Share** at the top right of the  _Reports_ page (for essential reports) or the  _Custom Report_ page (for custom reports).

In the _Email Report_ box, select an email recipient, then enter your email's subject line and message.

When finished, click **Email Report**.

Your recipients will receive an email containing the report data, a link to view the report in Greenhouse Recruiting, and a downloadable .csv version of the report.

### Schedule a recurring report email

You can also schedule a report email to send to yourself or your teammates at a regular cadence.

Click **Schedule** at the top right of the  _Reports_ page (for essential reports) or the _Custom Report_ page (for custom reports).

In the _Schedule report_ box, provide the following details:

  * Report name
  * Email recipient(s)
  * Subject line
  * Email message



Next, specify when and how often you'd like recipients to receive your report. Your options will vary depending on the frequency (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, quarterly) you select for your scheduled email.

Click **Schedule report** when you're finished.

Recipients will receive an email containing the report data, a link to view the report in Greenhouse Recruiting, and a downloadable .csv version of the data at the time you've scheduled.

#### Delete a scheduled report email

To delete a scheduled report email, open your saved report and click **Edit Schedule** on the _Reports_ or _Custom Reports_ page.

In the  _Edit schedule_ box, click **Delete schedule**.

# OfferUp integration

OfferUp is the largest mobile marketplace for local buyers and sellers in the U.S. With the launch of OfferUp Jobs, we are changing how companies attract talent in their communities by providing a simple and trusted experience on our iOS and Android apps. Our goal is to be the connective tissue for all things local commerce whether that's hiring a new team member or buying a new couch. OfferUp was founded in 2011 and has grown to serve local markets across the U.S., with more than 1 in 6 adults using OfferUp in 2023.

Greenhouse Recruiting offers the ability to post free job advertisements on many job boards, including OfferUp. These free ads can help expand your sourcing, allowing you to access more candidates at no additional cost to your organization.

Unlike posting to other job boards which are determined on a job post by job post basis, the OfferUp integration is configured on the organization-level, meaning all of your live job posts will automatically sync to OfferUp’s job board once enabled.

#### In this article

  * Enable OfferUp organic job posts
  * Edit or delete a job post on OfferUp
  * Additional resources



### Enable OfferUp organic job posts

To enable OfferUp organic job posts, click the **Configure** icon on your navigation bar, then click **Job Boards & Posts** on the left.

Click the **Ellipsis** icon beside your job board and select **Edit Board Settings** from the dropdown.

Scroll to _Allow candidates to apply directly from_ _OfferUp_ and select **Yes**.

When finished, click **Save**.

Once enabled, all live job posts from the job board you selected will be sent to OfferUp.

**Note:** Your job post must have a location selected under Job Setup > Job Posts, or the job post will not sync.

Candidates applying through these job posts will be added to Greenhouse Recruiting with OfferUp as the source.

**Note:** Once a job post is published, Greenhouse Recruiting sends the job post information to OfferUp within 3 – 4 hours. From there, it can take up to 48 hours for the data to be processed and the job post to appear on OfferUp’s job board.

### Edit or delete a job post on OfferUp

To edit the content of a job post or remove it entirely from the OfferUp job board, [edit or delete the job post](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002791566-Edit-external-job-post) on Greenhouse Recruiting.

Your changes will sync with OfferUp the next time OfferUp receives updates from Greenhouse Recruiting.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [support@offerup.com](mailto:support@offerup.com).

# Business Intelligence Connector FAQ

**Permissions:** –

**Product tier:** Available for Plus and Pro subscription tiers

[Business Intelligence Connector](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360017503272) is designed for companies with robust analytics requirements that prefer a flexible, hands-on approach to analyzing their data.

We've collected answers to some common questions about Business Intelligence Connector.

#### In this article

  * **Getting started**
    * Which companies are successful with Business Intelligence Connector?
    * How do I enable Business Intelligence Connector?
    * What can I do with Business Intelligence Connector?
  * **Technical details**
    * What data is included?
    * Can I choose which data appears?
    * Who hosts the data?
    * When is the data updated?
    * Can I modify the data?
    * Can I manage access to the data?
    * Is data backed up?
    * Can I access data through S3 instead of Redshift?
    * I'm in the EU. Is there anything I should know?
  * **Troubleshooting**
    * I reset my Redshift password. Why can't I access my data?
    * Why is my data not showing up in Business Intelligence Connector?
    * Who should I contact if I need help?



### Getting started

#### Which companies are successful with Business Intelligence Connector?

Our most successful Business Intelligence Connector organizations have an established goal for how they want to use their Greenhouse data to drive their organization's goals. 

This often includes having a perspective about the KPIs and recruiting data before purchasing Business Intelligence Connector. In most cases, these organizations have a data analyst or business intelligence resource who is prepared to dedicate significant time to using the data sent with Business Intelligence Connector. 

In some cases, these customers are already exporting Greenhouse Recruiting data and spending significant time manipulating it to create unique reports for their Greenhouse Recruiting goals, such as metrics over time, department-level views, and so on.

#### How do I enable Business Intelligence Connector?

Check out [Enable Business Intelligence Connector](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405507275547) for detailed instructions.

#### What can I do with Business Intelligence Connector?

If you don't have an established goal with Business Intelligence Connector, that's okay! Because it's your organization's data, you can use it however you see fit. Here's a list of the most common uses of Business Intelligence Connector:

  * Understand the impact of recruiting efforts, communicate progress, diagnose bottlenecks, drive decision-making, and predict future performance.
  * Access most of your raw recruiting data, including some additional data that is not easily available in Greenhouse applications. 
  * Create a variety of visualizations (such as trends over time, pie charts, bar graphs, and so on)
  * Slice and dice data with a variety of filters (for example, department, office, recruiter)



### Technical details

#### What data is included with Business Intelligence Connector?

Business Intelligence Connector offers a wide variety of Greenhouse Recruiting and Greenhouse Onboarding data. Check out our [Guide to Business Intelligence Connector](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360001892012) for an overview of the data you can expect to see.

#### Can I choose which data appears in Business Intelligence Connector?

With Business Intelligence Connector, you can [choose whether to include PII data or Greenhouse Onboarding data in your nightly ETL](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4409350482843). Beyond this, you should use your data development tool to manage permission to your data.

#### Who hosts the data?

With Redshift, Greenhouse hosts the data in our Amazon Redshift instance and will provide your organization with credentials to access your data. With S3, your organization hosts and controls all the data in your own database. [Learn more](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405633343259).

#### When is the data updated? 

Data is synced to Amazon Redshift or S3 each night and should be complete by 10am ET | 14:00 UTC. Data will show results from the end of the previous day.

You can sign up for a completion [notification](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4409350482843) so you know exactly when the data has loaded for your organization each day.

#### Can I modify the data in Business Intelligence Connector?

Business Intelligence Connector data is a read-only export of data. For any changes to data, update it in Greenhouse Recruiting or Greenhouse Onboarding.

#### Can I manage access to data in Business Intelligence Connector?

With Business Intelligence Connector, you can [choose some optional tables in your nightly ETL](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4409350482843). Beyond this, you should use your data development tool to manage access and permission to your data.

#### Is the data in Business Intelligence Connector backed up?

We don't create backups of Business Intelligence Connector data because Greenhouse Recruiting data is already backed up and retained for 30 days.

#### Can I access the files through my own S3 bucket instead of Redshift?

Yes, you can [configure Business Intelligence Connector to connect to an Amazon S3 bucket](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405507275547) that you create and manage. Your organization can then access your S3 bucket to download your files locally daily after the transfer to Amazon Redshift completes.

#### I'm in the EU. Is there anything I should know?

If you're working out of the [EU silo](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360056365191) on Greenhouse Recruiting, you'll only be able to access your data through the Amazon S3 option. Greenhouse does not offer Redshift in the EU silo. [Learn more](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405507275547).

### Troubleshooting

#### I reset my Redshift password. Why can't I access my data?

If you [generate a new password](https://support.greenhouse.io/knowledge/articles/4405507275547/en-us?brand_id=2395&return_to=%2Fhc%2Fen-us%2Farticles%2F4405507275547#h_01GKHVEW8KRSFF5N25B6Z660CE) for Redshift on Business Intelligence Connector, you won't be able to access your data until the next Business Intelligence Connector refresh. Data is refreshed every 24 hours.

#### Why is my data not showing up in Business Intelligence Connector?

If you're seeing mismatched data between Greenhouse and Business Intelligence Connector, try the following:

  1. Verify the time that the new data was entered. Since data is refreshed nightly, trying to view data in Business Intelligence Connector on the same day it was entered in Greenhouse Recruiting or Greenhouse Onboarding isn't possible. 
  2. Check [status.greenhouse.io](https://status.greenhouse.io/) to see if there's a current incident impacting updates.
  3. Verify with your development team that everything is functioning correctly with your data development tool and storage method.
  4. If you're still having issues, contact [Greenhouse Technical Support](https://support.greenhouse.io/direct). 



#### Who should I contact if I need help?

**Issue** | **Contact**  
---|---  
An error or technical issue in Greenhouse Recruiting or Greenhouse Onboarding | [Greenhouse Technical Support](https://support.greenhouse.io/direct)  
An organizational issue with your Greenhouse Recruiting or Greenhouse Onboarding instance (such as data being entered incorrectly) | Your organization's [Site Admin](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360021238012)  
An error or technical issue with your data development tool | Your internal IT department or the support team for your data development tool  
Enabling Business Intelligence Connector | Coordinate with the data analysts at your organization and use [Enable Business Intelligence Connector](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405507275547).  
  
**Learn more**

[Enable Business Intelligence Connector](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405507275547)

[Guide to Business Intelligence Connector](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360001892012)

# Wuhu integration

Wuhu allows companies to find qualified candidates and candidates to find qualified opportunities, fast. By integrating your Greenhouse account, Wuhu can automatically post open jobs directly to candidates that match your position, alerting the candidate to apply. The integration also allows for an application to automatically push to your Greenhouse job posting, once a connection is made from a candidate.

#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API key for the Wuhu integration
  * Enable the Wuhu integration
  * Use the Wuhu integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
    * Sync job posts
    * Sync candidate applications
  * Additional resources



### Create a Harvest API key for the Wuhu integration

To configure the Greenhouse Recruiting / Wuhu integration, you'll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the credentials and permissions below are selected when configuring the Wuhu integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Wuhu
  * **Description:** Wuhu Harvest API key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Wuhu integration:

**Applications**

  * Select all



**Candidates**

  * Select all



**Job** **posts**

  * Select all



**Jobs**

  * Select all



**Users**

  * Select all



When finished, copy your API key to a secure location in order to enable the integration in the next step.

### Enable the Wuhu integration

To enable the Wuhu integration, you can either provide your API key to your Wuhu onboarding team, or you can navigate to [Wuhu](https://app.wuhu.guru) > **Account** > **Manage** > click **Greenhouse** integration, then paste the API key.

### Use the Wuhu integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

Once enabled, Wuhu will fetch all open, active job posts in your Greenhouse Recruiting account, and create job postings for them in Wuhu.

#### Sync job posts

Wuhu syncs jobs from your Greenhouse Recruiting account every hour automatically to create new job postings, archive job postings that are no longer active, and unarchive postings that are reactivated in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Here is an example of what a job posting could look like based on the title, location, and description:

If you need to refresh your job postings sooner than every hour, navigate to Wuhu > Company > and click **Sync with ATS**.

#### Sync candidate applications

After making a Wuhu Candidate Connection, you can either download a ._csv_ of all candidate profile information to manually upload to Greenhouse Recruiting via the [Bulk Import Tool](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360053674012), or you can export the profile to Greenhouse Recruiting by clicking **Export Profile to ATS** on the candidate profile. This will sync the candidate's information and resume to the associated job posting.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [support@wuhu.guru](mailto:support@wuhu.guru).

# Greenhouse training guide for interviewers

#### Congratulations on starting your journey with Greenhouse!

We've designed a training guide that will help introduce Greenhouse Recruiting to people at your organization who will act as interviewers in the hiring software.

# Draup for Talent integration

Draup for Talent is an AI-driven, talent intelligence platform helping global enterprises make better, data-driven talent decisions. By using artificial intelligence and big data to analyze millions of data points about talent and the talent ecosystem, Draup provides users with actionable insights to help them with:

  * Workforce Planning: Build strategic workforce plans to meet talent requirements for today and tomorrow.
  * Recruitment: Hire a diverse and skilled workforce with data-backed recruitment insights. Bypass talent shortages with targeted talent acquisition. Build your workforce with diversity at the core.
  * Reskilling and Upskilling: Future-proof your workforce with smart insights into talent gaps for reskilling your existing team. Stay ahead of talent shortages.



Draup’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows you to export candidate information from Draup and transform it into detailed prospects or candidate profiles within Greenhouse.

These profiles encompass insights such as professional and educational backgrounds. Streamline your candidate management workflow by harnessing the integration capabilities of Draup with Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### In this article

  * Set up the Draup integration
    * Create an Ingestion API key
    * Provide your key to Draup and complete setup
  * Use the Draup integration
    * Add candidates to Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



### Set up the Draup integration

#### Create an Ingestion API key

To integrate with Draup, you’ll need to create an Ingestion API key and provide it to Draup.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888200444571) for more information on creating an Ingestion API key. Once the key is created, provide it to Draup so they can complete integration setup. 

#### Provide your key to Draup and complete setup

After creating your Ingestion API key, you'll need to add it to Draup as a next step. [Navigate to Draup](https://draup.com/platformlogin/) and from the top right dropdown menu, select **Apps & Integrations**. 

Search and select _Greenhouse_ from the available listings and then, click **Contact Us** to submit your request and share the generated Ingestion API key.

Upon receiving the key, the Draup team will contact you as soon as the key is integrated into Draup. Once you receive the confirmation, you can effortlessly export the shortlisted prospects or candidates pool from Draup's projects to Greenhouse by following the outlined steps below.

### Use the Draup integration

#### Add candidates to Greenhouse Recruiting

After the Draup integration is completely enabled, you'll be able to export candidates from Draup to Greenhouse Recruiting.

You can choose the profile type for exporting to Greenhouse, such as Prospects or Candidates. It also enables you to include previously exported profiles added by you in the project. This option lets you add them as new profiles.

To add a candidate, click **Export to Greenhouse** from the export options of a project. This option opens a modal displaying the number of profiles and the project’s name.

**Prospects** : You can add the profiles as [prospects](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/206729066) in a prospect pool. A prospect pool is a larger group of available prospects, such as talent for the upcoming year. You can search for prospect pools using the search box. As you type in the search box, matching prospect pools are suggested. The profiles are exported to the default pool when no pools are created.

**Candidates** : You can search for jobs and select them for exporting the candidates. As you type in the search box, matching jobs are suggested. Please note that the modal notifies you to create a job if there isn’t one already. 

After exporting the profiles, the modal navigates you back to the project details page with a success notification on the export. Draup sends you an email on export completion.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, contact [support@draup.com](mailto:support@draup.com) or refer to our support page regarding [Greenhouse Recruiting](https://talent.support.draup.com/support/solutions/articles/33000284624-greenhouse).

# 'Do not email' candidate tag

**Permissions:** Site Admins or Job Admins with the permission to email candidates

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

The 'Do Not Email' tag prevents emails from being sent to a specific candidate. This tag can be applied manually to the candidate on their profile, or applied automatically if emails are bounced from the candidate's address - for example, situations where the email address no longer exists or the candidate has blocked your organization's email address. 

To mark a candidate as 'Do Not Email,' go to their profile, click the ellipses icon, and select the option to block emails. 

When a candidate won't receive emails, the 'Do Not Email' tag appears on their profile and the email will be marked as undelivered in their activity feed. When an email can't be delivered to a candidate because it was bounced, the tag will automatically be added to their profile. 

You can remove the 'Do not email' tag under the ellipses menu. 

**Note:** Removing the tag only allows you to send emails to the candidates. If the candidate has blocked emails from your organization, they will still not be delivered.

# Hirevue integration

The right data to make the right hire. HireVue’s AI-powered platform pinpoints and validates the skills that drive job success. 

Hire quickly and more efficiently while better engaging candidates.

Easily integrate HireVue and Greenhouse to:

  * Remove manual tasks and hiring friction, creating capacity for recruiters to focus on high-value activities.
  * Digitize your hiring process and bring structure and consistency to video interviews.
  * Engage top talent quickly and keep them moving through your hiring process 24/7/365.
  * Look beyond resumes and job applications to consistently evaluate all candidates on the things that predict job success.



HireVue’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows you to seamlessly add HireVue assessments or interviews to a job's interview plan.

#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API key
  * Enable the HireVue integration
  * Use the HireVue integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



### Create a Harvest API key

To configure the HireVue integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key. 

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the HireVue integration.

#### **Credentials**

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** HireVue or Unlisted Vendor
  * **Description:** HireVue Harvest API Key



#### **Permissions**

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the HireVue integration: 

  * **Jobs**
    * GET: Get Hiring Team
  * **Users**
    * GET: Retrieve User
  * **Applications**
    * GET: Retrieve Application 
  * **Candidates**
    * GET: Retrieve Candidate 



### Enable the HireVue integration

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163696923) to retrieve your API key from your HireVue representative and add the assessment stage in your interview plans. 

There are two available stages for HireVue integration. Customers must confirm with HireVue which specific stage should be enabled for their organization: **HireVue [new - EU/AU]** or **HireVue [new - US]**.

Once you’ve set up your interview plans and configured your take home test, you’ll be able to send the test to candidates.

### Use the HireVue integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

Once the HireVue integration is enabled for your organization, you will be able to add the HireVue assessment as an interview stage.

To create available assessments to select in Greenhouse, first create the appropriate Job Templates in the HireVue platform. 

Set up the stages and types of assessments/interviews that will be used to evaluate candidates for your job or jobs. If using multiple stages you will select Manual as the advancement option as secondary stages are triggered from status changes within Greenhouse. There will be an additional step to set up secondary stages as available assessment packages in Greenhouse. 

If you will be using multiple stages in your HireVue workflows, then you will need to set up some dummy templates to be place holders for additional stages. These packages will be used across templates. During initial setup, create as many dummy stages as you think you might leverage in a workflow. Typically, this is no more than 2-3 stages. The naming convention of the job templates should be HireVue-STAGE-X, where X is the stage number, such as 2 or 3.

You will be all set to select packages in Greenhouse.

You can send an assessment to a candidate by selecting the**Send Test** button next to the interview stage.

**Note:** When you send a test in Greenhouse Recruiting, the instructions are actually sent by HireVue.

#### Send candidates automatically when they reach a stage in the Interview Plan in Greenhouse

You can optionally automate this integration by sending candidates to HireVue automatically when they reach a stage in the Interview Plan in Greenhouse.

Set up stages for HireVue by selecting the HireVue stage(s). Rename the secondary stage if using multiple stages. Select the test that will be sent to the candidate.

Once your job is created, you can set up Stage Transition rules if you wish to automate sending the Assessment/Interview.

After it has been sent, the assessment’s status will display in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Once the candidate has submitted their test, the Interview Kit will contain a link to view the submitted test in the HireVue application. 

To see a candidate’s results in HireVue, click **View** **Report** .

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to HireVue Customer Success Director or [Contact our HireVue support team](https://HireVuesupport.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) 24/7.

# JobStash integration

JobStash’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows users to streamline their hiring processes by seamlessly connecting Greenhouse’s applicant tracking system with JobStash’s candidate due diligence tools. This integration enables users to automatically retrieve candidate information, add candidate tags, and manage applications efficiently.

#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API Key in Greenhouse
  * Find your User ID in Greenhouse
  * Configure Greenhouse integration in JobStash
  * Create webhooks in Greenhouse
  * Use the JobStash integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional Resources



### Create a Harvest API Key in Greenhouse

To configure the JobStash integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key. 

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the permissions below are selected when configuring the JobStash integration. Copy the API key, you’ll need to paste it into JobStash in the next step.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner****:** JobStash or Unlisted Vendor
  * **Description:** JobStash Harvest API Key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the JobStash integration: 

  * **Applications**
    * GET: Retrieve Application
  * **Candidates**
    * GET: Retrieve Candidate
    * GET: List Candidates
  * **Tags**
    * PUT: Add a Candidate Tag
    * POST: Add New Candidate Tags



### Find your User ID in Greenhouse

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/10765948752027-Find-your-Greenhouse-Recruiting-user-ID) to find the user ID of your Greenhouse account.

### Configure Greenhouse integration in JobStash

Navigate to <https://jobstash.xyz/>

Click **Connect Wallet**.

Sign in with your preferred wallet app and click **ATS Settings.**

Select **Greenhouse.**

Click **Save ATS Selection.**

Insert the Harvest API Key generated in the previous [step](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1d5o9QLGKP1gvTfqFMeMHcg3BRDUuOKqenDQQEzV2Qfc/edit#heading=h.2xcytpi) in the **API Token** field.

Enter the user ID from the previous [step](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1d5o9QLGKP1gvTfqFMeMHcg3BRDUuOKqenDQQEzV2Qfc/edit#heading=h.6f59u7sl7ni2) in the **User Id** field.

Click **Register**.

Click **Retrieve Tokens.**

Keep the tab open. We will need it in the next step.

### Create webhooks in Greenhouse

To integrate JobStash with Greenhouse Recruiting, you’ll need to create two webhooks. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163727003) to create your webhook. Use the values listed below to configure the webhook:

#### Webhook 1: Application Created

  * **Name** : JobStash Application Created Webhook
  * **When** : Candidate has submitted application
  * **Endpoint URL** : Application Created Webhook URL
  * **Secret Key** : Use the “Application Created Token”
  * **Error recipient email** : [webhooks@jobstash.xyz](mailto:webhooks@jobstash.xyz)



#### Webhook 2: Candidate Hired

  * **Name** : JobStash Candidate Hired Webhook
  * **When** : Candidate has been hired
  * **Endpoint URL** : Candidate Hired Webhook URL
  * **Secret Key** : Use the “Candidate Hired Token”
  * **Error recipient email** : [webhooks@jobstash.xyz](mailto:webhooks@jobstash.xyz)



### Use the JobStash integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

No further action is required to use the JobStash integration. 

For every candidate JobStash sees as a match, you will find Candidate tags (under Additional details) powered by JobStash’s candidate data.

### Additional Resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [support@jobstash.xyz](mailto:support@jobstash.xyz)

A detailed video tutorial of the steps described in this article can be found [here](https://www.loom.com/share/b03228089ee34bca9aa79ef1bf175ec4).
