# Refapp integration

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Refapp is a digital and automated reference checking tool that gives recruiters and hiring managers full control of their reference checks. Refapp's vision is reference checks of the future – to digitize, streamline and increase the validity of the reference check.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Refapp allows you to seamlessly add Refapp's digital reference check to a job's interview plan.

#### In this article

  * Enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Refapp integration
  * Configure project templates in Refapp
  * Add Refapp stage to a job's interview plan
  * Configure the Refapp stage
  * Send and review a Refapp test in Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Additional resources



### Enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Refapp integration

To enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Refapp integration, contact Refapp's support at [support@refapp.com](mailto:support@refapp.com) to request an API key for your integration. Once you have received your API key, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/direct) to open a ticket with Greenhouse Technical Support.

There are two available stages for the Refapp integration: Refapp and Refapp [Sec]. You'll need to let Greenhouse Technical Support know which stage to enable. Reach out to your Refapp onboarding team if you're not sure which stage your organization will use.

**Note** : Don't send your API key in the initial ticket to Greenhouse Technical Support. If needed, Greenhouse Technical Support will respond with a [ SendSafely](https://www.sendsafely.com/about/) link for you to securely share the API key.

Wait for a confirmation email from Greenhouse Technical Support. You may be required to verify your account before you can proceed.

Greenhouse Technical Support will provide a [SendSafely](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/) link where you can enter your API key. Once Greenhouse Technical Support configures your API key, they'll send a confirmation email.

### Configure project templates in Refapp

Before you add the Refapp stage in Greenhouse Recruiting, you need to configure some settings in Refapp. Go into your Refapp profile and set up at least one project template.

In the project template you select and edit which questionnaire to send out to the referees and what the communication with both candidates and referees will look like.

#### 

After you have saved your project template, you need to go into Company settings and go to the Integrations tab. In the integration settings, make sure 'Include user selection in template choice' is selected and add the users that will work with Refapp reference checks from within Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### 

### Add Refapp stage to a job's interview plan

Once the Greenhouse Recruiting / Refapp integration is enabled for your organization, you will be able to add Refapp as an interview stage.

To add the Refapp stage stage to an existing job, navigate to your job (via **Jobs** > **Job** **Name**) and click **Job** **Setup**.

Select **Interview** **Plan** on the left side of the page and click **\+ Add a Stage**.

Select the Refapp stage on the next window. When you're finished, click **Add** to apply the stage to the job's interview plan.

#### 

### Configure the Refapp stage

After the Refapp stage has been added to the job's interview plan, you'll need to configure the stage. To configure the Refapp stage settings, hover over the stage and click the **Edit** icon.

#### 

In the _Refapp Test to Send Candidate_ section, select the **Test** from the dropdown menu. These aren't really tests, but options for reference checking based on the project templates you've created in Refapp and the recruiting users that have been configured. Choose the project template that is linked to your name.

#### 

Assign at least one Greenhouse Recruiting user to grade / review the submitted reports. When you're finished, click **Save**.

**Note** : All configuration for the reference check will need to be done in Refapp via Project Templates.

### Send and review a Refapp test in Greenhouse Recruiting

When candidates are moved into the Refapp interview stage, Greenhouse Recruiting will display a **Send** **Test** link.

**Note** : When you click to send a reference check from inside Greenhouse Recruiting, the e-mails will actually be sent by Refapp.

#### 

After it has been sent, an assessment's status will display in Greenhouse Recruiting.

#### 

Once the reference checking is completed (all referees have submitted their answers), the interview kit will contain a link to view the finished report in the Refapp application.

#### 

Click **View** **Report** to see the finished reference report in Refapp.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to Refapp Support at [support@refapp.com](mailto:support@refapp.com). You can also visit Refapp's resources at [Refapp Support](https://support.refapp.com/) for frequently asked questions and guides on how to configure and use the tool.

# Offer exceptions using custom opening field

**Permissions:** Job Admin who can manage custom fields and edit offer approvals; Site Admin who can create and override default approval flows

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Offer exceptions give your team the ability to set allowed ranges for salary, stock options, or any other numeric custom fields, and then require additional approvals if an offer is created outside the allowed range. 

**Example:** Let's say you can hire as many sales executives as you want, but their salary must fall between $50,000–$60,000. If you want to offer a salary of $65,000 to one candidate, Greenhouse Recruiting will trigger additional approvers — maybe the CFO and CEO — to sign off on the offer before you can extend it.

Offer exceptions can be configured either so the offer is checked against a custom job field, or so the offer is checked against a custom opening field. To learn more about tracking exceptions against a custom job field, please [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/204168849). 

In this article, we will cover how to enable offer exceptions using a custom opening field through the steps below.

#### In this article

  * Create custom opening field
  * Create custom offer field
  * Configure offer exception approvals on job
  * Use offer exceptions



### Create custom opening field

To begin setting up offer exceptions, click the **Configure** icon  in the upper-right corner, then navigate to **Custom Options** in the left panel. 

From the  _Custom Options_ page, click **Openings** under the  _Company Custom Fields_ section. 

From the _Custom Fields: Openings_ page, click **Add Field**. 

On the _New Opening Field_ page, give your field a name. This field appears on the _Manage Openings_ dialog window for each of your jobs, and will be used to set the range for the salary, stock options, and so on allowed to be granted in a candidate offer on that job.

Once you have given your custom opening field a name, use the _Field Type_ dropdown to choose either **Currency range** or **Number range** , depending on which is more relevant for your use case. 

**Note:** Offer exceptions work only if your custom opening field has a field type of **Currency range** or **Number range**. If your field is created as any other type, you must delete the custom opening field and create a new custom opening field set to one of the appropriate types before you can configure offer exceptions. 

We recommend checking the boxes marked **Required** and **Changes to this field require reapproval** to ensure the values entered cannot be changed by users wishing to avoid additional approvals. 

Click **Save** at the bottom of the _New Opening Field_ dialog box when finished. 

When a user adds an opening to a job, they'll be required to enter a salary range (or other numeric range) to be checked when a new offer is created for a candidate. 

**Note:** If you leave the left box blank, the minimum value will be 0, and if you leave the right box blank, there will be no maximum. Please check with your Finance department before offering a salary of infinity dollars.

This new custom opening field also appears for existing openings, but won't contain values unless a user navigates to the job's _Approval Details_ page to edit the opening and add values to the field. 

### Create custom offer field

To create a corresponding custom offer field, navigate to the **Configure** icon  in the upper-right corner, then click **Custom Options** in the left panel.

From the  _Custom Options_ page, click **Offers** under the  _Company Custom Fields_ section. 

From the _Custom Fields: Offers_ page, click **Add Field**. 

On the _New Offer Field_ page, give your custom offer field a name. This field appears in the _Create Offer_ dialog box when drafting an offer for a candidate. Once you've given your custom offer field a name, click the **Track this field for exceptions** link.

**Note:** A custom offer field can be configured to track for exceptions only when the custom offer field is first created. It is not possible to edit an existing custom offer field to be used for tracking exceptions.

A  _Select the range field to check against_ dropdown appears. Click the dropdown to select the custom opening field created in the previous step. 

**Note:** If the custom opening field you previously created does not appear in the dropdown, the custom opening field likely was created with a type other than **Currency range** or **Number range**. In order to configure the custom offer field to track against the custom opening field, you must delete the previously created custom opening field and re-create it with an appropriate type. A custom field's type cannot be changed once the field is created. 

Finish configuring your new custom offer field as desired, then click **Save** at the bottom of the page when finished. 

### Configure offer exception approvals on job

Next, you will configure the approvals chain to be executed if a user creates a candidate offer that falls outside the allowed range for that opening. 

To do this, navigate to an existing job, then click the **Approvals** tab. Confirm the custom opening field has a range entered; if no range is entered yet, click the **Edit Job & Openings **button at the top right of the page. 

On the  _Job Info_ page, find the  _Openings_ section and enter the range to be checked against in your custom opening field. Click **Save Changes** at the bottom right of the page when finished. 

Once you have confirmed the custom opening field has a range, locate the  _Offer Approvals_ section at the bottom right of the page, then click the **Pencil** icon  to edit. 

Click **Add Approval Step**. 

Add the approver(s) who should be required when an out-of-range offer is created. Check the box for **Required ONLY if offer fields are out of range**. This ensures this step of the approvals chain is activated only if the offer is out of range. 

Click **Save** when you are finished.

Confirm your offer approvals chain looks as intended, then click **Done** to save your changes. 

### Use offer exceptions

When creating an offer for an opening, any fields outside that opening's approved range are highlighted in yellow to draw attention to the range violation. 

If any fields are outside the approved range, the offer exception step of the offer approvals chain is activated. When the user creating the offer requests approval, Greenhouse Recruiting triggers the job's standard offer approvals chain and includes the offer exception step.

The user(s) required to issue Offer Exception offer approvals then receive an _Offer Approval Requested_ email, which indicates the range violation.

# Schedule with Outlook

**Permissions:** **Job** **Admin** and above  
  
**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

To schedule with Outlook, you'll set up the interview details in Greenhouse Recruiting then download a file and finalize the scheduling on Outlook.

**Note** : The calendar you plan to schedule from should be associated with your Greenhouse Recruiting account. For guidance on adding an email address to your account, visit [Add or edit a user email address](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360034879332).

Navigate to the candidate's profile and click **Schedule Manually** next to the appropriate interview.

From the _Scheduling for candidate_ page, click the **Settings** icon  and ensure _Outlook_ is the selected calendar.

If another calendar (or no calendar) is selected, click the _Calendar Type_ dropdown and select _Outlook_. Click **Save** when finished.

Enter your interview information, including the date, time, and interviewers. Once all information has been added, click **Schedule and Continue**.

On the subsequent page, confirm the interview details are correct, then click **Download .ics File**.

The calendar file is downloaded to your computer and can be opened in Outlook. When viewed in Outlook, the event's guest list will include the interviewers you added, as well as your organization's [Greenhouse Recruiting calendar email address](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050154551).

**Note:** Be sure not to remove the [Greenhouse Recruiting calendar email address](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050154551) from the event. If this email address is removed from the guest list, Greenhouse Recruiting will not receive information about the event, and the interview will not appear on the candidate's profile.

Make any necessary adjustments to the event in Outlook, and then click **Send** to send the invitation to all interviewers, as well as to the Greenhouse Recruiting calendar.

If you need to make updates to the event later, navigate to the event in your Outlook calendar, enter your changes, and then click **Send updates to all**. Sending the updates to all guests ensures the Greenhouse Recruiting calendar receives the changes so the changes can be synced to the candidate's profile.

### Updating an event scheduled with Outlook

When you update an interview in Outlook, the changes sync back to Greenhouse only if the original calendar event remains intact and connected.

For updates to sync back to Greenhouse, the following must be met:

  * The interview is scheduled through Greenhouse
  * The Outlook event originally linked to the Greenhouse interview is edited directly using the existing calendar event
  * The event is not deleted and recreated
  * The event organizer remains the same



### Additional resources

  * [I use Outlook. How does "Schedule All" work?](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201317195)
  * [Why doesn’t my Outlook for Mac calendar pre-populate with Greenhouse Recruiting's scheduling email address?](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200241989)

# Error when uploading spreadsheet for bulk import

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above who can access CRM

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

In some cases, you may receive an error when uploading a spreadsheet for a [candidates](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360053674012) or [prospects](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/203871039) bulk import.

#### In this article

  * Common bulk import errors
  * Additional resources



### Common bulk import errors

The most likely cause for bulk import errors is multiple email addresses being entered into one row's **Email** column on your _.csv_ import file.

Additionally, special characters such as accent marks within the spreadsheet can also cause bulk import errors.

If errors persist despite no multiple email addresses or visible special characters, your spreadsheet may contain invalid UTF-8 characters which can be invisible when viewing the document. These invalid characters may have been inadvertently copied over when creating your spreadsheet, resulting in the error.

To resolve a potential invalid UTF-8 character error, you may:

  * Copy the entire list over to [Google Sheets](sheets.google.com) or to a text editor. Use their editing tools to remove all formatting, and upload the spreadsheet again.
  * Or manually retype the data within the fields, and upload the spreadsheet again.

With these changes, we aim to give interviewers more flexibility in formatting candidate feedback, as well as to simplify the process of submitting scorecards.

_**Note:** Any current or previous candidates sourced by these partners will be categorized under the updated strategy on sourcing reports. _

Bubblesort | Prospecting | Agency  
  
### **Integrations**

### **Bug Fixes**

  * In Greenhouse Recruiting, we resolved an issue where users received an error when attempting to use the  _Candidates who applied during a specific date range_ filter on the [Pipeline History and Pass-through Rates report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/204636795). 
  * We also resolved an issue where attempting to delete a child department and reassign all jobs within the child department to its parent department resulted in an error. We apologize for the inconvenience this might have caused your team.

We released an update to prevent this workflow from occurring in the future, and apologize for the trouble this caused.

# Resume personalization token

**Permissions:** Job admins and above with CRM access and a Sourcing Automation sea

**Product tier:** Available for the Plus and Pro subscription tiers

The **resume personalization token** helps you save time and create more relevant outreach by automatically pulling key details from a prospect’s resume—like their job title, experience, or skills—directly into your outreach messages. Just insert it into your message, and AI will take care of the rest.

### How it works

When a message contains a resume personalization token, the system automatically reviews your message, assesses the prospect's resume, finds relevant information and inserts it into your message automatically. This makes your outreach feel personal—without having to scan the resume yourself.

You can add a resume personalization token when you create or edit a step of a engage campaign. First, scroll down to the editor, then select "Insert token.

Next, select "Resume personalization" from the menu.

Add the token as part of a sentence.

When your engage campaign reaches your personalized step, the token will automatically complete this sentence with context from the prospect's resume. At this point, you'll review, and then approve or edit the suggestion.

### Don’t see the token in your list?

If you don’t see the resume personalization option, it may need to be turned on by your account admin.  
  
Your admin can enable the resume personalization token in**Configure > AI tools**. Once they toggle it on, you’ll be ready to automatically personalize your campaign.

# Candidate doesn't receive emails when moved to a stage with a stage transition rule

# Reschedule or cancel an interview

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

If an interview needs to be rescheduled or canceled, you can either reschedule/cancel in Greenhouse Recruiting (if you are using Google Calendar), or on your own calendar. 

Reschedule an interview

Delete an interview

Modify an interview on an external calendar

### Reschedule an interview

Navigate to the candidate's profile and find the interview under the Stages tab and click **Reschedule** next to the interview. Then, in the scheduling window, update the interview details on the left side of the page and click **Schedule and Continue**.

Confirm the interview details to make sure they are correct. If everything looks good, click **Update Interviews**.

**Note:** If you wish to notify the interviewers of the change by email, be sure the box for **Send an email update to all interviewers** is checked.

### Delete an interview

Open the interview in the Stages tab, click the Ellipses icon, and choose **Reschedule** from the list.

On the calendar page, click the **Delete Interview** button in the bottom left corner of the page.

### Modify an interview on an external calendar

Alternatively, you can edit or cancel an interview directly from your external calendar.

To ensure that the updates are sent to Greenhouse Recruiting seamlessly, make sure your organization's [Greenhouse calendar email address](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360050154551) is included as a guest on the event, and that the Interview Kit URL is still included in the description of the event.

Apply your changes, and then send the updated event to all guests. Greenhouse Recruiting will receive the update through the calendar email address and will apply the changes to the candidate's profile after a short delay. 

_**Note:** If you make changes to a scheduled interview, candidates will not receive updates through changes to the calendar event. _

_If you need to modify an interview through an external calendar, make sure to send an updated interview confirmation email to the candidate with the changes._

# Cezanne HR integration

Cezanne HR is leading the way in delivering smart, sophisticated and cost-effective Cloud HR software to mid-sized businesses worldwide. Quick to deploy, easy to manage, and impressively flexible, Cezanne HR's comprehensive HR suite covers the complete employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through to payroll and performance.

Greenhouse Recruiting’s integration with Cezanne HR allows you to automatically add candidates to your Cezanne system when they are hired in Greenhouse Recruiting. In this article, we will cover:

#### In this article

  * Retrieve Cezanne HR's endpoint URL and secret key
  * Set up the Endpoint URL and Secret key
  * Create a webhook
  * FAQs
  * Additional resources



### Retrieve Cezanne HR's endpoint URL and secret key

Before enabling the Greenhouse Recruiting / Cezanne HR integration, you need two pieces of information to create the webhook in the next step:

  * **Cezanne HR’s Endpoint URL**
  * **Cezanne HR’s Secret Key**



To retrieve this information, navigate to **Cezanne HR****Greenhouse integrations**.

From this page, copy the **Endpoint URL**(listed in the _Subdomain_ field) and **Secret key** and store them in a safe location. 

If these settings have not been set up yet, please follow the steps below to configure both fields.

#### Set up the Endpoint URL and Secret key

For this integration to pull successful candidates into Cezanne HR, you will need to ensure an 'Enter a New Starter' or 'Enter a New Starter (Without Absences)' Process is active 

For more information about how to set up these processes, see: [Enter a New Starter Process](https://support.cezannehr.com/en/support/solutions/articles/15000007796-new-starter-process).

To begin, navigate to **Administration** **Setup & Security** **Integrations** **Greenhouse**.

The _Details_ screen configures the subscription to Greenhouse and some of the details for a successful candidate's New Starter Process Task.

  1. Click **Add New**.
  2. **Subdomain** : Enter your company's Subdomain (e.g., _CezanneHR_). This field can be anything you want but will need to match the relevant field in Greenhouse and contain URL friendly characters.
  3. **Secret Key** : Enter a Secret Key. This will be used to setup the Greenhouse Recruiting webhook. This field can be anything you want but will need to match the Secret Key in Greenhouse Recruiting and must be secure.
  4. **New Hire Administrator** : Search for a HR Professional User to be the person responsible for the New Starter Process. They will be sent the tasks to complete a successful candidate's New Starter Process.
  5. **New Hire Default Company** : Search for the Company Code the successful candidate will be hired into.
  6. Click **Save**.



### Create a webhook

To integrate Cezanne HR with Greenhouse Recruiting, you'll need to create a webhook. Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163727003) to create your webhook. Use the values listed below to configure the webhook(s).

  * **Name** : _Cezanne HR Integration_
  * **When** : Candidate has been hired
  * **Endpoint URL** : `https://w3.cezanneondemand.com/CezanneHR/api/v4/greenhouse/Webhook/cezannegreenhouse`
  * **Secret Key** : The secret key retrieved from Cezanne HR in the previous step



That's it! Your Greenhouse Recruiting account and Cezanne HR account can now talk to each other. These settings dictate the execution of the Cezanne HR webhook once the Cezanne HR user transitions the candidate into an appropriate application stage for a given job.

### FAQs

**Does the Greenhouse Recruiting / Cezanne HR integration have a cost?**

The integration is available to all Cezanne HR customers and there is no additional cost.

**Why hasn’t my New Starter Process Task been created?**

The New Stater Process will not be created if any of the Greenhouse webhook details and Cezanne Integration details do not match but will still be created without a deployment or employment record if the department or company cannot be found.

Solution:

  * Check the _Subdomain_ is entered correctly in the _Endpoint URL_ field in Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Check the Secret Key has been entered correctly
  * Check that **No** has been checked under **Disabled**
  * Check the candidate's Application Status in Greenhouse is _Candidate has been hired_



**Why hasn’t the successful candidate’s Employment Details been created in Cezanne HR?**

Employment Details will not be created if:

**The Company is now inactive or has been deleted.**

Solution:

  * Add the Employee details in the process.
  * To prevent this from happening for any other successful candidates, change the Default Company in the Integration screen to one that is active.



**The Company Code has been changed.**

Solution:

  * Add the Employee details in the process.
  * Manually update the Company Code to the current code in the Integration screen.



**Why hasn’t the successful candidate’s Deployment Record been created in Cezanne HR**

A Deployment record will not be automatically created in the process if no Department has been entered in Greenhouse.

Solution:

  * The New Hire Administrator will have to add the Deployment details in the process.
  * Enter a Department in Greenhouse that matches an active Org Unit in Cezanne.



**Why hasn’t the successful candidate’s Position Title been filled in Cezanne HR?**

No Position Title will be entered on the Deployment Details tab in the New Starter Process if:

  * The Internal Job Name in Greenhouse does not match an active Position Title in Cezanne.
  * There are more than one active Position Titles in Cezanne that match the Internal Job Name in Greenhouse.



Solution:

  * The New Hire Administrator will have to add an active Position to the candidate's Deployment record in the process.
  * To prevent this from happening again for any other successful candidates, ensure the Internal Job Name in Greenhouse matches an active Position in Cezanne.



**Why hasn’t the successful candidate’s Address been filled in in Cezanne HR?**

The address is not filled in if there's no address in Greenhouse or if the address filled in was not recognized by Cezanne.

Solution:

  * Change the address in the Personal Information tab in the process.
  * Ensure there is a recognizable street address, house name, and/or postcode.



### Additional resources

Please contact [support@cezannehr.com](mailto:support@cezannehr.com) for troubleshooting assistance regarding the integration.

# UKG Ready by Tavio integration

Tavio is an integration-as-a-service provider that works with HR vendors to provide standard integrations.

Tavio's integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows your organization to seamlessly add new hires from Greenhouse Recruiting to UKG Ready.

#### In this article

  * Set up the integration
    * Create a webhook
    * Create custom job fields
    * Enable in UKG Ready
  * Use the integration
  * Additional resources



### Set up the integration

**Note** : To use this integration, you need to be a Tavio customer.

#### Create a webhook in Greenhouse Recruiting

To set up the integration, first create a webhook. Follow the steps [in this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163727003) to create the webhook. Use the values listed below to configure the webhook:

  * **Name** : Tavio integration
  * **When** : Candidate has been hired
  * **Endpoint** **URL** : Paste the URL that will have been provided to you by the Tavio integration manager
  * **Secret** **Key** : Tavio
  * **Error** **receipt** **email** : Enter the email that you would like to use for error notifications



Click **Create webhook,** and you'll see a success message.

If the webhook fails, contact your Tavio integration manager.

#### Create custom job fields

Next, create custom job fields in Greenhouse Recruiting for the integration. Follow the steps [in this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202609855) to create your custom job fields, and use the settings below to configure the fields:

**Custom job field name** | **Definition** | **Settings**  
---|---|---  
UKG Job Title | The title of the job, which will automatically update from UKG. |  **Field type** : Single-select **Values** : Enter "UKG."  
Hourly Rate | The hourly rate to pay hourly employees. |  **Field type** : Number  
Employee Type | The type of employee, like exempt, consultant, or full-time, which will automatically update from UKG. |  **Field type** : Single-select **Values** : Enter "UKG."  
Supervisor | The ID of the supervisor, which will automatically update from UKG. |  **Field type** : Single-select **Values** : Enter "UKG."  
Pay Type | How the employee is paid, which will automatically update from UKG. |  **Field type** : Single-select **Values** : Enter "UKG."  
  
**Note** : If a similar field already exists in your Greenhouse Recruiting environment, reach out to your Tavio integration manager for help.

#### Enable in UKG Ready

Log in to UKG Ready as an admin to add a new user.

Create a new user with a strong password. The user must have API access. Include "integration" in the name to easily distinguish it from other general users.

Next, navigate to **Settings** > **Global** **Setup** > **Company** **Setup** > **Login** **Config** , then scroll to _API Keys_ at the bottom-right. Copy the API key to a secure location for user in a later step.

Next, navigate to **Settings** > **Global** **Setup** > **Company** **Setup** > **Company** **Info** , and scroll to find _Company Short Name_ and _Company ID_. Copy this number. If yours isn't listed, reach out to the UKG Ready HelpDesk.

Copy and save your user information, API key, company short name, and company ID. Share them in a document or secure email with your Tavio integration manager.

### Use the integration

#### Fields synced from UKG Ready to Greenhouse Recruiting

Once enabled, the following fields sync to Greenhouse Recruiting from the values in UKG Ready:

**UKG Ready field** | **Greenhouse Recruiting field**  
---|---  
Cost Center 10 | UKG Job Title  
Cost Center 1 | Department  
Cost Center 2 | Office  
Employee type | Employee type  
Manager ID | Supervisor  
Pay type | Pay type  
  
#### Fields synced from Greenhouse Recruiting to UKG Ready

Once enabled, when a candidate is marked as hired in Greenhouse Recruiting, candidate information will automatically be sent to Tavio, and the candidate will be processed into UKG Ready within 15 minutes. The following fields are synced from Greenhouse Recruiting to UKG Ready:

**Greenhouse Recruiting field** | **UKG Ready field**  
---|---  
First name | First name  
Last name | Last name  
Address line 1 | Address line 1  
Address line 2 | Address line 2  
City | City  
Zipcode | Zip  
Phone - home | Home phone  
Phone - mobile | Mobile phone  
Email address - personal | Primary email  
Start date | Started  
Hourly rate | Rate (hourly)  
Salary | Amount  
  
To re-sync a candidate to UKG Ready due to an error or change in status, unhire the candidate in Greenhouse Recruiting then hire them again.

### Additional resources

Contact [support@tavio.io](mailto:support@tavio.io) for troubleshooting assistance regarding the integration.

# Sourcing Automation & LinkedIn RSC demo

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above with CRM access, a Sourcing Automation seat, and LinkedIn RSC

**Product tier:** Available for the Plus and Pro subscription tiers

If your organization has the Greenhouse Sourcing Automation add-on, you can integrate with LinkedIn Recruiter System Connect (RSC) to combine your LinkedIn sourcing efforts and your Sourcing Automation outreach campaigns. Use this integration to make your sourcing workflows more effective, reach prospects quicker, and send InMail messages directly within Greenhouse.

In this walkthrough demo, we'll cover how to: 

  * Set up Sourcing Automation campaigns
  * Add prospects from LinkedIn and LinkedIn RSC to your campaigns
  * Use the Greenhouse Recruiting Chrome extension and email lookup credits
  * Send InMail messages to prospects from within Greenhouse



### Frequently asked questions

#### Do email lookups occur automatically?

Yes. When you add a LinkedIn prospect to the Greenhouse Recruiting Chrome extension or import a prospect from LinkedIn RSC, Greenhouse performs an email lookup automatically.

#### When will lookup credits be used?

When you add LinkedIn or LinkedIn RSC prospects to a campaign pool or the Greenhouse Recruiting Chrome extension, you'll use one lookup credit any time a valid, non-public email address is found.

You won't be charged a lookup credit if Greenhouse parses a public email address or if no email is found during the lookup.

Learn more about how [Greenhouse allocates and charges lookup credits](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/6018927588635).

#### Are InMail messages delivered to prospects automatically?

No, InMail messages aren't delivered automatically.

Greenhouse creates a task in your campaign pool reminding you to send an InMail message. You can copy templates, add personalization, and deliver the message without leaving your Sourcing Automation workflow.

#### How soon do prospect responses to InMail messages sync to Greenhouse?

InMail responses from prospects may take up to one hour to sync with your activity feed in Greenhouse Recruiting.

  * [LinkedIn RSC and Sourcing Automation FAQ](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9617629277723)
  * [Greenhouse Recruiting Chrome extension for Sourcing Automation](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/8302875133083)
  * [Understanding lookup credits](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/6018927588635)

# View and manage Sourcing Automation seats

**Permissions:** Site Admin, Job Admin with CRM access and a Sourcing Automation seat 

**Product tier:** Available for the Plus and Pro subscription tiers

**Learn more about Sourcing Automation**

[Overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5131929423643)

[Email authentication](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5131512808091)

[Create and manage campaign pools](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5045604930843)

[FAQ](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5224485120411)

#### In this article

  * View seats
  * Add seat users
  * Edit seat users
  * Remove seat users



### View seats

You can view your organization's seats from the CRM dashboard _._

To access the dashboard, click **CRM** from your Greenhouse Recruiting _navigation bar_. 

The _Seats_ panel is located on the right side of the CRM page. Click the **arrow icon** to view all Sourcing Automation seats. 

The _Seats_ page shows the number of users currently assigned to a seat and the total number of seats granted to your organization. 

**Note** : It's not possible to add or remove the number of seats granted to your organization. Please contact your Account Manager for further assistance. 

There are two types of seats:

  * **Admin:** Admin seat users have access to Sourcing Automation with an _additional permission_ to configure seats for other users in the organization.
  * **Standard:** Users with a standard seat can access Sourcing Automation but cannot configure seats for themselves or other users. 



Your organization's Site Admin(s) can also manage seats without needing an admin seat. 

### Add seat users 

**Note** : Only a Site Admin and/or users with an Admin seat can grant feature access to other users. 

To add a user, click **Assign new seat**. 

A row will appear in the panel. Type the **user's name** in the search bar, then select their name from the dropdown.

# Immutable field key overview

An immutable field key is generated each time you create a new [custom option](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/10978274576667) in Greenhouse Recruiting. This key enables downstream apps, like HRIS and other integrations, to detect the presence of your custom fields in exported data.

#### In this article

  * Find an immutable field key
  * Use an immutable field key



### Find an immutable field key

When you create a new custom option in Greenhouse Recruiting, an immutable field key is automatically generated.

**Note** : It isn't possible to manually name or edit your immutable field key.

To find an immutable field key, navigate to **Configure** > **Custom** **Options** > then select the type of company metadata, like candidate or offer fields.

Find your custom field in the list, and click on it to view details.

The immutable field key is listed at the bottom of the details page.

### Use an immutable field key

You can use immutable field keys for a variety of use cases.

  * Use [HRIS Link](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360059216471) with immutable field keys to match custom options in Greenhouse Recruiting to custom options in your HRIS.
  * Use integrations like [BambooHR](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201177624) and [Outmatch](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360056120912) which require immutable field keys to help the integration run.

# Business Intelligence Connector update – December 14, 2022

We're making updates to the Business Intelligence Connector schema on Wednesday, December 14, 2022.

[Download the latest schema (_.sql_)](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/article_attachments/10595161408411/schema20221214_.sql).

#### In this update

  * Overview of changes
    * Custom referral question table update
    * New custom user fields table



### Overview of changes

#### Custom referral question table update

The `referral_question_custom_fields` table will receive an update to make it consistent with all other custom field tables in our schema:

  * Currently, the `user_id` column on the table is of datatype `integer`. In order to support large ids, we'll change this to datatype `bigint`.



#### New custom user fields table

We're also adding a new table to accommodate [custom user fields](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/7626796336283). The `user_attribute_custom_fields` table will be in a similar format to all other custom fields in our schema. Check out the new table below:
    
    
    CREATE TABLE user_attribute_custom_fields (  
         user_id bigint,  
         custom_field character varying,  
         float_value double precision,  
         date_value date,  
         display_value character varying(1024),  
         unit character varying,  
         min_value numeric,  
         max_value numeric,  
         user_id_value bigint,  
         created_at timestamp without time zone,  
         updated_at timestamp without time zone,  
         key character varying(1024),  
         text_value character varying(16384)  
    );  
      
    ALTER TABLE ONLY user_attribute_custom_fields  
         ADD CONSTRAINT user_attribute_custom_fields_user_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id);  
    ALTER TABLE ONLY user_attribute_custom_fields  
         ADD CONSTRAINT user_attribute_custom_fields_user_id_value_fk FOREIGN KEY (user_id_value) REFERENCES users(id);

The primary differences between the `user_attribute_custom_fields` table and the other custom field tables include the following:

  * The first column indicates a `user_id`. This refers to the user to which the custom field value is attached. This is analogous to the `job_id` column in the `job_custom_fields` table or the `candidate_id` column in the `candidate_custom_fields` table.
  * The `user_id` column that would normally hold values for user value types has been renamed `user_id_value`.



**Example**

If you were to create a custom user field called Supervisor to select a user's supervisor from a list of users, the `user_id` column would contain the ID of the supervisee while the `user_id_value` column would contain the ID of the supervisor.

# Create a schedule for campaign pool messages

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above with CRM access and a Sourcing Automation seat

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro) with the Sourcing Automation add-on

Campaign-level schedules allow Sourcing Automation users to create one consistent delivery schedule for all messages in a [campaign pool](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5045604930843). Every campaign step message, regardless of the configured sender, will send according to the time zone and daily schedule set at the campaign level.

When you configure a campaign-level schedule for your campaign pool, this schedule will replace each step sender’s schedule in their personal [Sourcing Automation account settings](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5769727776795).

**Note:** Campaign-level schedules are **turned****off** by default in each campaign pool. Follow the steps below to turn on and begin using a campaign-level schedule for your campaign pool.

#### In this article

  * Configure a campaign-level schedule
  * Additional resources



### Configure a campaign-level schedule

**Note:** Campaign-level schedules can be configured by Sourcing Automation admins, campaign pool owners, and Sourcing Automation users [granted edit access](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5045604930843-Create-and-manage-campaign-pools) by a campaign pool owner.

Open the Sourcing Automation [campaign pool](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5045604930843) where you'd like to create a campaign-level schedule.

On your c _ampaign pool_ page, open the **Settings** tab.

Navigate to the **Schedule** tab in _Campaign pool settings_.

Click the toggle to **Enable campaign-level scheduling**.

When you first turn on campaign-level scheduling, the new schedule uses the following default settings:

  * Monday-Friday, 9am-8pm
  * The campaign pool owner's timezone, configured in [account settings](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5769727776795)



Click **Edit schedule** to update the timezone and daily schedule hours for sending messages from this campaign pool.

Click **Add time range** to create a delivery schedule for any day that doesn't currently have one.

Update the **From** and **To** fields with the start and end times for the time range in which you'd like to send prospect messages that day.

Click **X** to remove the time range.

You can also create multiple schedules for each day. Click **Add another** to set an additional time range for delivering prospect messages on the same day.

Once you're ready, click **Save changes** to complete your campaign-level schedule.

### Additional resources

  * [Create and manage campaign pools](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5045604930843)
  * [Campaign pool default settings](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5077296122907)
  * [Sourcing Automation account settings](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5769727776795)

# Release Notes: 2022 - October 21

Greenhouse Software regularly releases new product features, updates, and improvements. You can stay up to date with what's new at Greenhouse by following our [release notes](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200929955).

#### This week's releases

  * Greenhouse Recruiting
  * CRM & Events
  * API
  * HRIS Link
  * BI Connector
  * Integrations
  * Bug fixes



### Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Improved customization and filtering for user accounts

Custom user fields provide flexibility by allowing you to filter users by user fields (rather than job attributes) and apply bulk permissions. These new fields also allow for more efficient user and permissions management, reducing the number of user-by-user permissions assignments.

Learn more and check out our walkthrough video [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/7626796336283).

### CRM & Events

#### Enhancements to the Greenhouse Recruiting Chrome extension

The following features are now available within the extension:

  * Users with a Sourcing Automation seat can further streamline their recruiting efforts by adding **personalization** to the first email step
  * Prospects can be added to the extension using the additional web scrappers, AngelList and Indeed



Read more about these new features [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4947637389083).

#### Copy a campaign pool

Customers with a Sourcing Automation seat can copy steps from an existing campaign pool, reducing effort and providing the ability to use campaigns that have proven success rates.

Read more: [Create and manage campaign pools](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5045604930843)

### API

We've updated the [Users endpoints](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#users), which now include the ability to create and update **User Attributes**(also known as User Fields). 

### HRIS Link

HRIS Link user import now supports assigning users to departments or offices. Additionally, HRIS Link supports custom user fields, allowing you to maintain user information unique to your organization!

Read more: [Import user accounts with HRIS Link](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058975731)

#### Improved HRIS Link API capabilities

HRIS Link's API key configuration now includes the Harvest API endpoint **DELETE: Destroy openings**.

Read more: [HRIS Link changelog](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4406914314651)

### BI Connector

Greenhouse is making updates to the Business Intelligence Connector schema on **November 2, 2022.**[Click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9735118779419) for additional details and the latest schema file.

### Integrations

**Candidate testing** : [Equalture](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/9130202640283) is a Dutch HR company that provides every candidate with an equal opportunity to showcase their talents and potential. Equalture developed a set of neuroscientific assessments, that measure cognitive abilities and behavioural traits, allowing you to evaluate candidates based on data instead of a gut feeling.

### Bug fixes

  * Users who added their name to the _People to Notify_ subscribe list were not receiving the email notification when new hires were added to Greenhouse Onboarding.
  * The interview kits weren't displaying a quick link to the take-home test.
  * When a job was updated using the ` PATCH: Edit Openings` endpoint, it didn't trigger an update for the `Job Updated` webhook, resulting in inconsistent statuses.

# Arbeitnow organic job posts

**Permissions:** Site Admin

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Greenhouse Recruiting offers the ability to post free job ads on several partner boards, including [Arbeitnow.](https://arbeitnow.com/) These free ads can help expand your reach and allow you to access more candidates at no additional cost to your organization.

Unlike other free external job boards such as Indeed, which are enabled on a per-job basis through the _Job Post Edit_ page, Arbeitnow job posts are handled at the organization level in Greenhouse Recruiting. Arbeitnow posts will either be on or off for every job that is currently live on your job board.

#### In this article

  * Enable Arbeitnow organic job posts
  * Update or delete a job post on Arbeitnow



### Enable Arbeitnow organic job posts

To enable Arbeitnow organic job posts, click the **Configure** icon in the top-right corner of the page and select **Job Boards & Posts** from the left-side panel.

Locate the job board where you want to set up the integration. Click the **Ellipsis** icon beside the job board and select **Edit Board Settings** from the dropdown menu.

On the _Edit Your Job Board_ page, scroll to **Allow candidates to apply directly from Arbeitnow** and select **Yes**.

Scroll to the bottom of the page and click **Save** when finished.

Once enabled, all live job posts associated with the job board will be sent to Arbeitnow. Candidates applying through these job posts will be added to Greenhouse Recruiting with **Arbeitnow** in the source field.

**Note:** Once a job post is published, Greenhouse Recruiting sends the job post information to Arbeitnow within 3 – 4 hours. From there, it can take up to 48 hours for the data to be processed and the job post to appear on Arbeitnow's website.

### Update or delete a job post on Arbeitnow

To edit the content of a job post on Arbeitnow or remove it entirely from Arbeitnow's network, [edit](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002791566) or [delete](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360023264611) the job post on Greenhouse Recruiting. Your changes will sync with Arbeitnow the next time Arbeitnow receives updates from Greenhouse Recruiting.

# Report dashboards overview

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

#### Quick, easy answers to hiring's biggest questions

Report dashboards offer instant answers to the most important questions about your jobs, candidates, and recruiting processes. # Why aren't all tokens coming through on an offer document?

If your offer letters don't substitute the offer token for the expected offer value, it's likely that the text in the offer document isn't being recognized as a token. To resolve this issue, follow the steps below.

**1\. Delete the token and spaces around it:** open the original [offer template](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/6459061824155) document and delete the token and the spaces before and after the token. 

**2.** **Manually retype the token** and spaces around it.

**Tip** : Don't copy/paste the token from the _Offer Templates_ page in Greenhouse Recruiting.

**3\. Save and[re-upload](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/6459061824155) the template **to Greenhouse Recruiting. You can then create a new offer version for your candidate, which will allow you to generate a new offer document using the updated template.

### Other reasons the tokens aren't generating

#### Custom tokens

If the tokens still aren’t generating, the problem may be caused by permission levels or limitations around custom offer tokens. For more information, review [Create custom tokens for email and offer templates.](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200871485#h_01H3CWABD8D9KZYFREFB3F52DV)

#### Docusign tokens

If your organization uses the [Docusign integration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/205633569), the unique Docusign tokens will verify only if the offer template is tested by a user with the Docusign integration connected.

Ensure your Docusign integration is connected, then [re-upload the offer template](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/6459061824155) and try again.

# Hiringcue integration

Hiringcue.com is an automated solution to streamline the reference-checking process. Hiringcue's solution aims to bring about an automated experience to the tedious, time-consuming task of checking references. It takes less than 60 seconds to check references with Hiringcue versus the hours on the phone, trying to make contact with referees. After the reference check is complete, users receive a reference report that pinpoints all essential information. Our platform creates a less time-consuming and cost-effective experience for companies. 

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Hiringcue allows all users that have an account configured both for Greenhouse Recruiting and Hiringcue, to have access to automated reference checks through Greenhouse Recruiting. The automated reference checks are Hiringcue's responsibility, however, users can opt-in by starting those using Greenhouse's platform only.

**Note:** To successfully use this integration, you'll need to have user accounts in both Greenhouse Recruiting and Hiringcue.

In this article

  * Generate an API key in Hiringcue
  * Enable the Greenhouse/ Hiringcue integration
  * Add the Hiringcue stage to a job's interview plan
  * Select the assessment you want to use from Hiringcue
  * Send and review the test
  * Frequently asked questions
  * Additional support



### Generate an API key in Hiringcue

Log in to your Hiringcue account to generate an API key. Make sure your Greenhouse Recruiting and Hiringcue accounts are using the same email to avoid issues when generating the API key.

Navigate to your **Profile,** scroll down to the bottom, then click on the button **Generate API**. Hiringcue will generate an API key that will be linked to your account.

Copy this value to be used in Greenhouse Recruiting.

**Note:** If you require assistance, contact your Hiringcue representative at [Miguel.seleiro@twoimpulse.com](mailto:miguel.seleiro@twoimpulse.com) or [support@hiringcue.com.](mailto:support@hiringcue.com)

### Enable the Greenhouse/ Hiringcue integration

Once you have generated your API key, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us) to open a ticket with Greenhouse and request that they finish the setup for the integration. 

**Note** : Do not send your API key in the initial ticket. If needed, Greenhouse Technical Support will respond with a [SendSafely](https://www.sendsafely.com/about/) link for you to securely share the API key.

Wait for a confirmation email from Greenhouse Technical Support. You may be required to verify your account before you can proceed.

If they need your API key, Greenhouse Technical Support will provide a[SendSafely link](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/)where you can enter your API key. Once Greenhouse Technical Support has been notified that you’ve entered your API key, they will send a confirmation email.

### Add the Hiringcue stage to a job's interview plan

Once the Greenhouse/**** Hiringcue integration is enabled for your organization, you will be able to add the Hiringcue assessment interview stage to an [interview plan](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002194903).

### Select the assessment you want to use from Hiringcue

Once the stage has been added to the job's interview plan, click **Edit Interview.**

Select the assessment or survey you want to send candidates. 

**Note:** If you want to preview the surveys, view them in your Hiringcue account under **Library**.

After selecting the appropriate assessment, scroll down to the bottom of the page and assign at least one Greenhouse Recruiting user to grade/review submitted assessments. When finished, click **Save**.

**Note:** Assessment configuration (including the branding or email template) is configured in Hiringcue.

### Send and review the test

When candidates are moved into the Hiringcue interview stage, Greenhouse will display a **Send Test** link.

**Note** : When you send a test from Greenhouse Recruiting, the interview instructions are sent by Hiringcue.

Confirm the grader for the assessment and click Send Test.

The assessment's status will display in Greenhouse Recruiting.

Once the candidate has submitted their test, their score will be visible in their interview plan. Select the stage name to view additional details about the assessment. 

Click **View Report** to see the full results in Hiringcue. Each report is linked to a generated token when the reference check is completed. Reports can be shared with other users that do not have an account in Greenhouse Recruiting or Hiringcue by copying the link and pasting it into a new tab/window:

The **View Report** link allows you to see the test results on Hiringcue**.** You can review the candidate's full assessment by scrolling on this page.

To close the report, close the page that opened after clicking **View Report**.

**Note:** Depending on the notification settings you have set up in Greenhouse Recruiting, you might also receive an email notification when an assessment finished.

### Frequently asked questions

**How can I edit the email address I have entered for my candidate?**

If the candidate has not received an email due to an incorrect email address, delete the previous request for references and create a new one with the correct/updated email address in Hiringcue.

You can do this when you log into the Hiringcue platform and receive an automatic reimbursement for the credit used upon deleting the initial request.

**My candidate hasn't received email from Hiringcue**

Ensure that your candidate has checked their spam/junk folders for any correspondence from Hiringcue. If there are no results, verify the candidate's email. If the email address is valid, contact the Hiringcue support team.

**How can I track the progress of a reference?**

All reference checks have a Lifecycle that logs all activity associated with a reference request. These checks include updates on your own activity, as well as that of the candidate and reference provider.

This process also tracks and records all automated reminder emails that are sent. To see the Lifecycle, click on pending requests. This page also includes a list of users and their assessment status.

**Do I have to have an account with Hiringcue to use the Greenhouse Recruiting integration?**

Yes, you must have an account with Hiringcue to use this integration.

**When using the integration, I see an error that the request cannot be completed. What's going on?**

When there are problems with the integration, there is a generic message that pops out advising that the request was not completed and therefore reference check could not be initiated.

In that situation, check your Hiringcue account and make sure you have at least one credit to use on the assessment.

**Is there any place where I can check more FAQ content?**

Check out Hiringcue's support site [here](https://hiringcue.com/faq-hiringcue-automate-reference-checking/.).

### Additional support

Contact [miguel.seleiro@twoimpulse.com](mailto:miguel.seleiro@twoimpulse.com) or [support@hiringcue.com](mailto:support@hiringcue.com) for troubleshooting assistance regarding the integration.

# CalendarHero (previously Zoom.ai) integration

CalendarHero empowers recruiters and hiring managers to hire top candidates faster by making Greenhouse Recruiting's information easily accessible during the candidate interview process.

As a user, you can schedule meetings automatically with contacts from Greenhouse Recruiting and conveniently access candidate information directly in your inbox or chat platform to help simplify meeting preparation for busy recruiters and hiring managers.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with CalendarHero allows you to seamlessly add meeting scheduling automation to your recruiting workflow for screening calls or group interviews, and automatically log meeting details in the Greenhouse Recruiting stage and Activity Feed. Simplify interview preparation by viewing candidate insights, including a direct link to a candidate's profile in Greenhouse Recruiting, via meeting briefs, emails, Slack, or CalendarHero's People Insights feature.

#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API key for the CalendarHero integration
  * Use the CalendarHero integration  

    * Access Greenhouse Recruiting information on CalendarHero
    * Use CalendarHero + Greenhouse Recruiting on Slack
    * CalendarHero meeting briefings
    * People Insights 
  * Additional resources



### Create a Harvest API key for the CalendarHero integration

To configure the Greenhouse Recruiting / CalendarHero integration, you'll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the credentials and permissions below are selected when configuring the CalendarHero integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** CalendarHero (optional)
  * **Description:** CalendarHero Harvest API key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the CalendarHero integration:

**Candidates**

  * GET: List candidates
  * POST: Add note



**Scheduled interviews**

  * GET: List interviews for application
  * GET: List interviews
  * DELETE: Delete a scheduled interview
  * POST: Create a scheduled interview



**Jobs**

  * GET: List jobs



**Job** **stages**

  * GET: List job stages



**Users**

  * GET: List users



Once complete, your Harvest API key for the Greenhouse Recruiting / CalendarHero integration is created and configured. Provide your Harvest API key to your CalendarHero onboarding team so they can finish setting up the integration.

### Use the CalendarHero integration

#### Access Greenhouse Recruiting information on CalendarHero

Once CalendarHero is integrated with Greenhouse Recruiting, CalendarHero automatically syncs key candidate information from Greenhouse Recruiting to CalendarHero so that users can begin to automate meeting scheduling with these contacts.

Greenhouse Recruiting remains 'the source of truth' so any updates made in Greenhouse Recruiting will also reflect in CalendarHero!

**Note** : It may take up to 15 minutes for Greenhouse Recruiting information to initially sync with CalendarHero.

#### Use CalendarHero + Greenhouse Recruiting on Slack

By adding the CalendarHero meeting assistant to a chat app such as Slack, users can schedule meetings with Greenhouse Recruiting candidate information without having to leave the app:

#### CalendarHero meeting briefings

To keep users on top of their schedules and simplify meeting preparation, CalendarHero sends automated pre-meeting briefings to users in their preferred email platform or chat app. CalendarHero supports several apps, including Outlook, Gmail, Microsoft Teams, and Slack.

The meeting briefings include pertinent meeting details and a link to the candidate's record in Greenhouse Recruiting. The candidate link takes users to Greenhouse Recruiting information such as a cover letter or resume.

#### People Insights

To simplify candidate research, users can also use the unique CalendarHero feature: people insights. When using this feature in a chat app like Slack or Microsoft Teams, users can ask, “Who is [candidate's name]?” to their CalendarHero meeting assistant.

In response, CalendarHero will automatically share available information from Greenhouse which can include candidate insights such as status, position, and links to resumes, and cover letters. In addition, CalendarHero can provide a brief meeting history as well as publicly available information such as related websites and social media profiles.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [hello@calendarhero.com](mailto:hello@calendarhero.com).

**Permissions:** Site Admin who can edit another user's advanced permissions

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Job Admin levels are defined sets of permissions that are granted to Job Admin users on a per-job basis, and permission stripes are the individual permissions that can be assigned to or removed from each Job Admin level. In this article, we will discuss the implications of the **Can email candidates / prospects** permission stripe.

To learn more about configuring Job Admin levels and view a full list of available permission stripes, see the following articles:

  * [Create new Job Admin level](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/207813806)

# Use LinkedIn with Greenhouse Recruiting

**Permissions:** –

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Greenhouse Recruiting allows you to harness the reach of professional social media networks like LinkedIn in your recruitment efforts.

Check out all that you can accomplish when LinkedIn and Greenhouse Recruiting work together:

Job posts and applications

  * LinkedIn Apply Connect
  * LinkedIn Limited Listings
  * LinkedIn Apply
  * Use tracking links on LinkedIn for a single job post
  * LinkedIn job wrapping for tracking multiple job posts
  * Allow candidates to apply with LinkedIn Apply
  * Add Apply with LinkedIn to your job board



Prospect and candidate management

  * LinkedIn Recruiter System Connect (RSC)
  * Connect your Greenhouse Recruiting and LinkedIn user accounts



On **January 1, 2026** , LinkedIn will require organizations using Apply Connect and Limited Listings include a company email address. To add yours, go to **Configure** > **Job boards and posts**. Then, scroll to "Global Partner settings" to add a company email address.

### LinkedIn Apply Connect

LinkedIn Apply Connect is an integration provides a fast and seamless experience for Greenhouse customers posting jobs to LinkedIn. 

Apply Connect combines LinkedIn Limited Listings and LinkedIn Apply under a single integration. 

Read more about [LinkedIn Apply Connect](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/17073067102747) here.

### LinkedIn Limited Listings

In addition to [free job posts](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405801275931) on sites like Indeed, you can post your entire job board on LinkedIn for free using [LinkedIn Limited Listings](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/20140604045900-18216445-linkedin-s-limited-listings-sample-job-aggregation/). While these free posts won't show up as prominently as ads purchased directly with LinkedIn, they will expand your reach and allow you to access an additional subset of candidates at no additional cost to your organization.

Unlike other free external job boards, LinkedIn Limited Listings are managed at the organization-level, meaning the free posts will either be on or off for every job that's live on your job board. 

Check out these additional considerations when using LinkedIn Limited Listings:

  * LimitedIn Limited Listings only appear in searches after relevant LinkedIn job slots and posts, and not in the recommendations throughout the site. This means that they're only visible to the subset of members who are actively looking for jobs.
  * You aren't able to manage Limited Listings in RSC, meaning that you won't have access to job analytics, suggested matches, or people who have viewed the job.
  * LinkedIn Limited Listings can't be sponsored across the site.



Learn how to [enable LinkedIn Limited Listings](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/206285655).

### LinkedIn Apply

LinkedIn Apply is an integration that allows candidates to apply directly through LinkedIn without having to visit your company's careers page.

To enable this feature, you need to provide LinkedIn with your job board's URL token and a job board API key from Greenhouse Recruiting.

To learn more about Apply Setup (outside of [LinkedIn Apply Connect](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/17073067102747)) click [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115005389566).

### Use tracking links on LinkedIn for a single job post

If you're planning to post an open job on LinkedIn through a paid ad, you need to create unique URLs for the application so you can track LinkedIn as the source for candidates.

Once a job has been opened, and the job post for the position has been created and made live, you can [generate a unique URL](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003322143) to track the candidate's source.

Learn more about [creating tracking links](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115004649886) for paid job posts.

### LinkedIn job wrapping for tracking paid posts

If you don't want to create a tracking link in Greenhouse Recruiting every time you post a job ad on LinkedIn, you can talk to your LinkedIn relationship manager about LinkedIn job wrapping.

LinkedIn job wrapping can be used for free by all Greenhouse customers.

In order to implement job wrapping, you need to provide your LinkedIn relationship manager with a unique tracking code.

To learn more, see how to [generate a unique tracking code LinkedIn job wrapping](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/205423745).

### Add Apply with LinkedIn to your job board

**Note** : This feature is only available to organizations that have a LinkedIn Recruiter contract or a company account with active job slots.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Apply with LinkedIn allows candidates to automatically import personal information from their LinkedIn profiles and to auto-fill applications on a job board.

If a candidate begins an application that's been posted to LinkedIn with a paid job slot but doesn't submit the application, LinkedIn records those as Apply Starters in LinkedIn Recruiter so you can reach out to them proactively.

To learn more, check out to [enable Apply with LinkedIn on Greenhouse Recruiting](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201794284).

### LinkedIn Recruiter System Connect (RSC)

For members of your team who use LinkedIn Recruiter, we've built the LinkedIn Recruiter System Connect (RSC) integration, allowing you to leverage Recruiter features directly in Greenhouse Recruiting.

LinkedIn RSC helps you to seamlessly source and manage candidate information across Greenhouse Recruiting and LinkedIn Recruiter in one platform.

**Note** : This integration isn't available for LinkedIn Recruiter Lite accounts.

With LinkedIn RSC, you're able to match, sync, and view LinkedIn profiles in Greenhouse Recruiting, as well as send and view InMail right from the candidate profile.

Check out all the features available with [LinkedIn RSC](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115005678563). Learn more about how to set up the integration [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115005678103).

### Connect your Greenhouse Recruiting and LinkedIn user accounts

You can link your personal Greenhouse Recruiting account to your personal LinkedIn account, allowing you to share post jobs with your professional network. You can also schedule reoccurring posts to regularly source from your LinkedIn network.

Learn more about how to [connect your Greenhouse Recruiting and LinkedIn user accounts](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002226806).

# New internal applicants notification

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Configuring a notification list allows your organization to automate internal communication to select team members when a job receives a new internal applicant. Once configured, any user added to the new internal applicant notification list will receive an email notification per new internal applicant.

**Note** : This notification is for new _internal_ applicants only. You can add users to the [new applicants](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360028659832) notification list to receive notifications for external applicants.

#### In this article

  * Add users to the notification list for new internal applicants
  * Remove users from the notification list for new internal applicants



### Add users to the notification list for new internal applicants

To add users to the notification list for new internal applicants, click**Jobs** from the navigation bar and select a job from the list.

Click**Job Setup** and navigate to **Notifications** on the left.

Scroll to _Candidate Notifications_ and click **Configure** beside _New Internal Applicants_.

**Note** : The text of the email notification for new internal applicants cannot be edited.

Click the _Participants_ dropdown and select the appropriate user. You can select a person by name, or you can select the [hiring managers](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360016572311) listed on the job's hiring team, the candidate's recruiter, and / or the candidate's coordinator.

**Note** : Only users who have appropriate permissions on the job populate in the dropdown.

Repeat as necessary for other people who should be notified when the job receives a new internal applicant.

When finished, click **Save**.

All selected users will receive an email for every new internal applicant on the job with relevant contact and application information.

To remove users from the new internal applicant notification list, navigate to the name of a user listed in the provided field and click **X** to the right of their name.

Repeat as necessary for other users and click **Save** when finished.

# Talegent integration

Talegent provides analytically informed and bias-free solutions for identifying the best talent by leveraging an engaging candidate experience that optimizes your existing talent pool. With best-in-class predictive analytics tools, Talegent provides fast and effective talent measurement solutions that can be fully integrated with Greenhouse Recruiting.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Talegent enables you to seamlessly use the two products together to add an assessment to your interview pipeline.

#### In this article

  * Enable the Talegent integration
  * Use the Talegent integration
    * Add the Talegent assessment stage
    * Configure the assessment stage
    * Send the Talegent assessment
    * Review the assessment results



### Enable the Talegent integration

Contact Talegent to request your Talegent API key at [clientsupport@talegent.com](mailto:clientsupport@talegent.com).

Once you've received your API key, fill out the form at [www.greenhouse.io/asksupport](http://support.greenhouse.io/direct) or _[click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/requests/new)_ to open a ticket.

**Note** : Don't send the API key in this initial email. Greenhouse Technical Support will respond with a [SendSafely link](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/) for you to securely share your API key.

Click **Add** **Stage**.

Select Talegent, and click **Add**.

# Request candidate availability with Google Calendar

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

The request candidate availability feature simplifies the scheduling process and reduces the need to navigate between multiple calendars when coordinating interviews.

#### In this article

  * Send a candidate availability request
  * Suggest interview times for a candidate
  * Candidate response to a request



### Send a candidate availability request

You can only request a candidate's availability after that candidate has progressed to a stage with a scheduled interview component, for instance, the preliminary phone screen, phone interview, or face to face stages.

**Note** : You can only request availability on a candidate's current stage, not future ones.

To request a candidate's availability, open the **Stages** tab on their candidate profile and choose **Request Availability** under the list of tasks.

Finisht the steps on the pop-up window to write the email and suggest any potential times for the candidate. The body of the email will be drawn directly from your **Candidate Availability Request Message** template.

When you're ready, click **Send email**.

**Tip** : Organizations with Advanced or Pro subscription tiers can automate this process with [candidate availability request rules](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360048178672).

### Suggest interview times for a candidate

Suggesting interview times for the candidate allows you to send potential interview slots to candidates based on your interviewers' schedules. By providing these suggestions, you can more easily find a convenient interview time for the candidate and your team. 

Click and drag on the calendar to add a suggested time. To compare availability, select interviewers in **View interviewer calendars**. Their events are color-coded so you can find open times quickly.

**Note** : To see a colleague's calendar, you need to have the Google Calendar permission 'Make changes to events' on their calendar. [Learn more](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022161532).

If you need to remove a selection, click **X** in the upper-right of the box to delete it.

Use the navigation arrows at the top-right to view different weeks on the interviewer's calendar.

### Candidate response to a request

A candidate availability request email includes a link to allow the candidate to see your message and suggested times, and input their availability.

The suggested times you selected will be indicated on the calendar. The candidate can use click-and-drag to indicate when they are free for an interview.

After the candidate sends their availability, the person who initially sent the candidate availability request will be notified via email that it's time to schedule the interview.

Navigate to the candidate's profile to review your suggested times and those submitted by the candidate. Compare the availabilities to find the most convenient time.

When ready, click **Schedule Interview**.
