# Test Partnership integration

Test Partnership provides valid, reliable and engaging psychometric tests that include a series of gamified assessments. By combining the latest technology with cutting-edge science, Test Partnership's assessments quickly and accurately measure the essential psychological traits which underpin performance at work. Test Partnership’s offering includes ability tests, personality questionnaires, situational judgment tests, skills tests and gamified assessments.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Test Partnership allows you to seamlessly add Test Partnership’s assessment to a job's interview plan.

In this article:

#### In this article

  * Enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Test Partnership integration
  * Add Test Partnership stage to job’s interview plan
  * Configure Test Partnership stage
  * Send and review the test
  * Additional resources



### Enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Test Partnership integration

To start, contact your Test Partnership representative ([info@testpartnership.com](mailto:info@testpartnership.com)) to receive your API key. When contacting Test Partnership, please ask them to extend your API token expiry. Once you have received your API key from Test Partnership, fill out the form at [www.greenhouse.io/asksupport](http://support.greenhouse.io/direct) or [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/requests/new) to open a ticket.

**Note** : Do not send the API key in this initial email.

The Greenhouse Technical Support team will respond with a [SendSafely link](https://www.sendsafely.com/howitworks/) for you to enter your API key. A notification will be sent to the Greenhouse Technical Support team after you have entered your API key and they will email you to confirm that your API key has been set up in your account and your integration is enabled.

**Note:** To verify your identity, the Greenhouse Technical Support team might request you provide a [Support Verification Code](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360022771952) before adding the API key to your organization's account.

### Add Test Partnership stage to job’s interview plan

Once the Greenhouse Recruiting / Test Partnership integration is enabled for your organization, you are able to add the Test Partnership assessment as an Interview stage.

To do this for an existing job, navigate to a job (**Jobs** >**Job Name**) and click **Job Setup** from the left-side navigation bar.

From the _Job Setup page_ , navigate to **Interview Plan** on the left-hand panel.

Click **Add Stage**.

From the _Add Stage_ dialog box, select the **Test Partnership** stage.

When finished, click **Add** to apply the stage to the job's interview plan.

The Test Partnership stage is now added to the interview plan for the job.

### Configure Test Partnership stage

To configure the tests, you need to log into your [Test Partnership client portal](https://tptests.com/client) and **create (or edit an existing)** Project.

For guidance on creating Projects, please contact Test Partnership support [(info@testpartnership.com](mailto:info@testpartnership.com)). Important steps of setting up a Project include:

  * Picking an assessment
  * Picking a norm group
  * Picking email to options
  * Editing the email template



Once your Project is set up in the Test Partnership client portal, you can select it in Greenhouse Recruiting.

**Note** : Keep in the mind all configurations of the assessment itself, such as norm group, test type, and email template, will need to be done in your Test Partnership client portal. Make sure you have configured the stage in your Test Partnership client portal before you send the test to the candidate.

### Send and review the test

  1. When a candidate progresses to the _Test Partnership_ stage, a **Send Test** appears on their candidate profile for you to send the Test Partnership assessment.
  2. After you click **Send Test** , use the provided dropdown menu to choose the **Project** that you previously set up in your Test Partnership client portal.
  3. Next, enter the **email address** to which you want to send the test invite email (typically this is the candidate’s personal email address but sometimes clients prefer to send the email to an internal admin address and forward it on to the candidate. It is up to you).
  4. Click **Send Test** to send the test to the candidate.



**Note** : When you send a test from Greenhouse Recruiting, the test instructions are actually emailed by Test Partnership. After the candidate has completed their test, their results will be available immediately in your Test Partnership client portal but may take up to one hour to appear in Greenhouse Recruiting.

To view the candidate’s Test Partnership stage score, navigate to their **profile** and click on the **Test Partnership** stage.

On this page, you can also click **View Report**. This downloads a PDF test result report.

### Additional resources

Please contact [info@testpartnership.com](mailto:info@testpartnership.com) for troubleshooting assistance regarding the integration.

**Tip** : We recommend testing this integration process with a sample candidate, using your email address as the sample candidate’s email. This allows you to see the candidate journey end-to-end and understand the process. Contact Test Partnership if you wish to walk through this process on the phone.

# Quinto integration

Quinto is a collaborative platform for building job descriptions that drive great performance. Quinto includes everything you need to accelerate the process of creating and validating accurate, consistent, and actionable descriptions.

Quinto’s integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows users to push jobs posts from Quinto to Greenhouse.

#### In this article

  * Create a Harvest API key
  * Set up the integration
  * Use the Quinto integration with Greenhouse Recruiting
    * Push a Quinto job post to Greenhouse
    * Edit the job post in Greenhouse
  * Additional resources



### Create a Harvest API key

To configure the Quinto integration, you’ll need to create a Harvest API key. 

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that all permissions are selected when configuring the Quinto integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API Type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Quinto or Unlisted Vendor
  * **Description:** Quinto Harvest API Key



#### Permissions

Select the **Select all** checkbox at the top of the list to ensure all available permissions are selected for the Quinto integration. 

### Set up the integration

  1. Click the gear icon on the top right of your screen.
  2. Select **General administration** in the drop-down.
  3. Click **Integrations** under Account in the side menu.
  4. Click the **ATS** tab.
  5. Click the **Greenhouse** tile.



  6. Paste the Harvest API key in the **Token** field.
  7. Click **Authorize**.



  
  


### Use the Quinto integration with Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Push a Quinto job post to Greenhouse

  1. Click the gear icon on the top right of your screen.
  2. Select **General administration** in the drop-down.
  3. Navigate to **Content** > **Jobs**.
  4. Click the name of the job in the table.
  5. Click the **Job post** tab.
  6. Click **Greenhouse** on the top right of the page.
  7. Click **Send to Greenhouse**. The job post should be created in Greenhouse within a few seconds.



**Note:** Resending the same job post will create a second job post in Greenhouse. The original job post won’t be overwritten.

  8. Click Send.



#### Edit the job post in Greenhouse

In Greenhouse, navigate to the job post you pushed from Quinto. You’ll see the content built by Quinto in the job description and you can click the pencil to edit the post and make any changes.

### Additional resources

Check out [this article](https://help.quinto.work/hc/job-description-vs-job-post) to learn more about customizing the Quinto job post layout.

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [support@quinto.work](mailto:support@quinto.work) or visit [help.quinto.work](https://help.quinto.work/hc/?l=en)

# Fraud Detection setup

**Permissions:** Site Admin

This guide explains how to turn on Fraud Detection by office or department, control access to fraud reports, and manage GDPR-related compliance settings. For rollout, coordinate with TA, Legal, and Security to [align security controls with the candidate experience](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/44681941657243). 

#### In this article

  * Fraud detection setup
  * Permissions setup
  * GDPR compliance
  * Additional resources



### Fraud detection setup

Fraud reports are only available for jobs associated with an office or department where Fraud Detection is enabled. Site Admins must turn this on before you can run a report for a candidate

**Note:** Read more about fraud reports [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/42738009117467).

Offices and departments are selected on the Real Talent configuration page. _(**Configure** > **Real Talent** > **Fraud**.)_

Use scroll down to the Fraud Detection settings and click Edit. Pick which offices and departments can use this feature. Remember, a job needs to be part of an enabled office and department for the reports to work.

**Tip:** When implementing Fraud Detection for the first time, begin with a small group of users in a specific office or department to test your settings and workflows before expanding access across the organization.

### Permissions setup

Job admins can be given two levels of permission to access fraud reports:

  * Can view fraud reports: The user can see the results of existing fraud reports.
  * Can run fraud reports: The user can run new fraud reports. 



In order to access fraud reports in the Security Screening tab of a candidate’s profile, you must have the necessary permissions enabled..

Update these permissions under Job Admin Permission levels (link). (Configure > Permissions > See and manage Job Admin levels)

### GDPR compliance

If your organization is subject to GDPR, you can manage compliance through data retention and candidate packet settings.

To control deletion of Fraud Detection signal data, add or update a [data retention rule](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360002418112-Configure-a-data-retention-rule) within the GDPR section of your Privacy & Compliance settings, by selecting Fraud Report under the 'Data to be Deleted' menu.

To support candidate data access requests, Fraud Detection can be added to candidate packets. [add link]

### Additional resources

  * [Fraud detection](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/42738009117467)

# MyGreenhouse Quick Apply

**Permissions:** Site admin

**Product tier:** Available to all product tiers

Quick Apply helps your organization connect with motivated candidates by reducing friction in the application process. Instead of starting from scratch each time, job seekers can use their MyGreenhouse profile to autofill key information. This streamlined experience encourages more completed applications, supports repeat engagement across your roles and helps ensure interested candidates don’t drop off due to lengthy forms.

#### In this article

  * [Overview](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/28688386131739#h_01JC6TBJTP8VCD2BRC08VRKAYX)
  * How Quick Apply works
  * Turn on Quick Apply



#### Overview

Quick Apply allows candidates to autofill Greenhouse-hosted job applications using information saved in their MyGreenhouse profile, making it faster and easier to apply. 

When enabled, an **Autofill with Greenhouse** button appears on your job posts. First-time users are prompted to create a free, password-free MyGreenhouse account where they can store their resume and basic details for future applications.

By reducing application friction, Quick Apply helps increase completed applications and supports repeat engagement across your roles.

#### How Quick Apply works

Quick Apply saves job seekers time by adding their information to their MyGreenhouse account so they can autofill future applications. Candidates can add as much, or as little, information to their profile as they'd like, including:

  * Name and contact
  * Education
  * Employment history
  * Online profiles
  * Self-identification information _(voluntary)_



When your organization enables Quick Apply, candidates will see an "Autofill with Greenhouse" button when they view your job applications.  


On their first visit, selecting this button prompts candidates to create a free MyGreenhouse account. To keep applying for jobs easy and streamlined, MyGreenhouse is password-free. Candidates simply sign in with a code sent to their email. 

Once signed in, candidates complete their Quick Apply profile by adding their resume and personal details.

  
After creating their Quick Apply profile, candidates select "Autofill with Greenhouse" on Greenhouse-hosted job applications to complete them with the click of a button, which increases the likelihood that they'll apply for your roles.

#### Turn on Quick Apply

Go to **Configure** , then **MyGreenhouse**. Scroll to "Quick Apply." Click "Preview" to understand what candidates will see on your job posts when you turn on Quick Apply. When you're ready, toggle Quick Apply on. Changes will apply instantly.

# Business Intelligence Connector overview

**Permissions:** –

**Product tier:** Available for Plus and Pro subscription tiers

#### Advanced discovery and analytics

Business Intelligence Connector is designed for companies with robust analytics requirements that prefer a flexible, hands-on approach to analyzing their data. You can [use Business Intelligence Connector](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405507275547) to perform complex reporting analyses that existing Greenhouse Recruiting or Greenhouse Onboarding reports don't allow, such as combining your recruiting data with data from other sources.

#### In this article

  * Overview and highlights
  * Resources



### Overview and highlights

#### All of your data, all of the time

While Greenhouse Software has built-in [reports](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000954692) to help most customers understand their hiring processes, some organizations employ specialized data analysts to run unique reports for their organization, or to combine Greenhouse data with data from other sources.

Business Intelligence Connector is specifically designed for advanced reporting needs and delivers your organization's Greenhouse data in nightly ETLs. 

#### How it works

With Business Intelligence Connector, we'll export all of your Greenhouse Recruiting or Greenhouse Onboarding data nightly to a standard storage location on the Amazon cloud, using either [S3 or Redshift](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4405633343259). Your organization can decide which method is preferred.

# Spark Hire integration

Spark Hire is an easy-to-use video interviewing platform that makes the hiring process more accurate, collaborative, and enjoyable for everyone involved.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Spark Hire allows your organization to add a Spark Hire video interviewing stage to your job's interview plan.

#### In this article

  * [Enable the integration](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/205405739#h_01H5G40GTEZH9T3C82TTM0RMWD)
  * Use the integration
    * Add Spark Hire video stage
    * Configure your Spark Hire video interview
    * Send and review a Spark Hire video interview
  * Additional resources



### Enable the integration

**Note** : Anyone in your organization who wants to use this integration should retrieve their own API key from Spark Hire and enable the integration in their own Greenhouse Recruiting user account.

To enable the integration, first retrieve an API key in your Spark Hire account.

Log in to Spark Hire and click your **Name** > **Settings** on the navigation bar.

Click **Integrations** under the _User_ section.

Scroll to the Greenhouse banner, and click **Activate Integration**.

Your API key is shown on the subsequent page. Click **Copy** to save the API key for use in the next step.

Next, with your key copied, log in to your Greenhouse Recruiting account and click **Integrations** on the navigation bar.

Search for and click **Spark Hire** from the results.

Click **Connect**.

Enter the API Key you copied from Spark Hire and click **Save**.

The Spark Hire integration is now enabled for you to use.

### Use the integration

#### Add Spark Hire video interview stage to an interview plan

After the integration is enabled, you can add the Spark Hire video interview stage on your job. [Learn more](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115002194903-Interview-plan-overview) about adding job stages.

#### Configure your Spark Hire video interview

Once the stage has been added to the job, navigate to your job > **Job** **Setup** > **Interview** **Plan** > and click the **Edit** icon  beside the Spark Hire stage.

Scroll to _Spark Hire Test to Send Candidate_ to manage the following settings:

  * Test name
  * Type
  * Interview questions set
  * Expiration date



Next, scroll to _Graders and Notifications_ and select at least one person to grade the interview.

When finished, click **Save**.

**Note** : Any configuration of the available assessment options, including the email template, needs to be performed in Spark Hire.

#### Send and review a Spark Hire video interview

When candidates are moved into the Spark Hire interview stage, you can click **Send Test** to send the Spark Hire assessment to your candidate.

**Note** : When you send a test from Greenhouse, the interview instructions are actually sent by [Spark Hire](https://www.sparkhire.com/).

The status of the assessment will be viewable in Greenhouse Recruiting on the candidate's profile.

After the candidate responds to the assessment, your graders will be notified by email, and the candidate's profile will indicate the status of the assessment has been updated.

**Note:** The status can take up to an hour to update in Greenhouse Recruiting after the candidate submits the completed assessment in Spark Hire.

From the candidate's scorecard, click the **View Report** link to view the submitted assessment in Spark Hire.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [Spark Hire support](https://support.sparkhire.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).

# Single sign-on (SSO) overview

**Permissions:** \--

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

Greenhouse Recruiting provides your users with the ability to sign in via Single Sign-On (SSO). With SSO enabled, your users will be able to access your organization’s Greenhouse Recruiting account through your Identity Provider (IdP) of choice. 

**Tip** : Check out [Troubleshoot single sign-on (SSO)](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/13852839325083) for help with common errors.

### Which SSO providers are compatible with Greenhouse? 

Some IdPs, such as [Okta](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201804115), [Onelogin](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201368479), [Google](https://support.google.com/a/answer/6363766?hl=en), and [Microsoft Entra ID](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360004745971) offer preconfigured integration options with Greenhouse.

We are also able to integrate with any other SAML2.0-compliant IdP. We integrate often with other IdPs, such as [ADFS](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/209926626) and PingIdentity.

### What will the process look like? 

A user with the developer permission **Can manage and configure SSO** will enable Single Sign-On directly in your Greenhouse Recruiting account. To see a step-by-step guide of this process, please [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040753811). 

Initially, your organization will _**soft-enable**_ SSO. This will put your Greenhouse Recruiting account in a hybrid state in which users can log in either using SSO or through the regular Greenhouse Recruiting login page using an email address and password. This allows your organization to test SSO without disturbing the workflow of your users. 

Once your organization has confirmed SSO is behaving as expected, you can flip the switch to _**hard-enable**_ SSO. At that point, your users will only be able to log in using SSO and can't use Greenhouse Recruiting username and password. If someone selects another SSO option, they'll be redirected to the correct login page. 

### What information do I need to get started? 

**Preconfigured IdP:**

Our support site includes customized instructions for integrating with several IdPs, including: 

  * [Azure Active Directory (Azure AD)](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360004745971)
  * [Okta](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201804115)
  * [OneLogin](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201368479)
  * [Google Apps](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115000410566)



Once you have configured Greenhouse Recruiting within your IdP, [click here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040753811#h_f09c04a3-d9f6-408e-be4b-58970c73a993) to continue the process of enabling SSO within Greenhouse Recruiting. 

**Other IdPs:**

Follow the steps provided [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040753811#h_3def9176-6aeb-4e59-856b-bb717d9f708e) to generate your ACS URL in Greenhouse Recruiting. Once you have obtained the ACS URL, you will add the Greenhouse Recruiting application to your IdP. 

  * **Assertion Consumer URL:** https://app.greenhouse.io/*/users/saml/consume 
  * **Entity ID:** greenhouse.io



Greenhouse Recruiting will expect the following attributes in your SAML Response: 

  * User.FirstName (must be the user’s first name)
  * User.LastName (must be the user’s last name)
  * nameID (must be the user's email address) 



_**Note:** If your organization uses the _[_Employee ID log-in method_](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360041038871) _, the SAML Response from your IdP must also include a User.EmployeeID value. The Employee ID log-in method requires an Pro subscription._

Once you have configured your IdP, follow the steps provided [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040753811#h_f09c04a3-d9f6-408e-be4b-58970c73a993) to complete enabling SSO within Greenhouse Recruiting. This process will require you to provide the following information from your IdP:

  * Single Sign-On URL 
  * Single Log-Out URL 
  * IdP Certificate Fingerprint



### Important things to note

There are a few things to be aware of before configuring SSO for your account.

**Provisioning Users**

When a user who does not already exist in your Greenhouse Recruiting account logs in for the first time via SSO, we will create a new user for them, and we will give them Basic permissions. You can update those permissions later within Greenhouse Recruiting if needed.

**Duplicate Users**

Users who have existing Greenhouse Recruiting accounts need to log in via SSO using their existing Greenhouse Recruiting email address. If a user logs in with an email address that we do not recognize, we will create a new account for them, which could lead to users having multiple Greenhouse Recruiting accounts.

To prevent that issue, if your users’ SSO email addresses do not match their Greenhouse Recruiting email addresses, be sure to add and verify their SSO email addresses to Greenhouse Recruiting before they attempt to log in via SSO. 

If any members of your team inadvertently create duplicate Greenhouse Recruiting user accounts, please [open a ticket with our Technical Support team](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/requests/new) for assistance in resolving the issue. 

**Passwords Deleted**

Once SSO is hard-enabled for your organization's Greenhouse Recruiting account, we will delete your users' Greenhouse Recruiting passwords, so that they can only log in via SSO. This means once SSO is hard-enabled, we are unable to revert your account back to soft-enabled SSO or non-SSO logins without all of your users needing to reset their passwords.

**Google+**

Users will not be able to log in via Google+ once SSO is enabled in either the soft-enabled or hard-enabled state.

**Deactivating Users**

Deactivating a user in your IdP does not deactivate their user account in Greenhouse Recruiting. We will require a user to log back in only when their Greenhouse Recruiting session ends, and a session can last for up to 30 days. This means even if a user account is deactivated in your IdP, the user potentially could remain logged into Greenhouse Recruiting and still have access to your organization's recruiting data. 

To prevent users from logging into Greenhouse Recruiting after they leave your company, we recommend [deactivating the user account in Greenhouse Recruiting](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115004791523) every time you deactivate a user in your IdP. Greenhouse Recruiting user accounts also can be deactivated using the [PATCH: Disable User endpoint](https://developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html#patch-disable-user-v2) in our Harvest API.

### Greenhouse Mobile

No further configuration is necessary for Greenhouse Mobile once SSO is hard-enabled. Users can access the app from unsupervised devices and we will provide a Greenhouse Recruiting session for any user/device that can log into the IdP and provide a valid SAML Response. 

Once SSO has been hard-enabled, users can log into the Greenhouse Mobile app using SSO by entering their email address on the login screen. After they have submitted their email address, we will identify them as a user from your company and redirect them to your SSO login page.

# Best practices: candidate tags

Our search functionality makes it easy to find candidates within your account. You can search within custom fields, perform full text searches for all fields, and when you want to narrow down the list of candidates even further — [candidate tags](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360045893411) may be the answer.

Candidate tags are an extremely useful tool to help segment candidates outside of existing fields. In this article we’ll cover some best practices when using candidate tags, and we'll provide various use-cases you may find helpful.

### In this article:

  * Curating and controlling candidate tags
  * Auto-tags



### Curating and controlling candidate tags

Before creating candidate tags, it's important to review the search filters currently available on the **Candidates** tab. A candidate tag is extremely useful to help categorize a group of candidates who currently cannot be grouped through the basic search filters. In this respect, candidate tags are most useful when stacked on top of other searches to help narrow down candidates even further.

It is important to be particular about which candidate tags you create. Having too many candidate tags will result in clutter and the inability to group candidates effectively.

Limiting which users can create candidate tags will help create a logical curated list. To restrict these permissions, make sure only certain users have the user-specific permission **Manage company metadata**.

You can think about tags as a way to group candidates based on certain skills or experience. For example, an advertising company may want to know if a candidate has consumer experience. Any type of specific consumer experience you come across on a resume, you could label with a broad "Consumer Experience" tag.

Or alternatively, use tags to identify candidates who did well during the interview but did not get the job. For instance, perhaps you have a strong candidate who didn’t get hired because they were beat out by a better candidate or were a good fit for a different role. This would be a great situation to tag the candidate as a "Silver Medalist" so they are easy to find when that position opens up again.

### Auto-tags

The [auto-tagging](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000060551) feature allows you to filter candidates by their answer to a question on the job application. For example, if you ask "Do you have more than 5 years of C++ experience?" on the application, you can then automatically tag that candidate based on their response to that question. Once the candidate submits the application they’ll automatically be tagged with the chosen tag, in this case maybe the tag is "C++ Expert" for a candidate who answered "Yes, I do have more than 5 years of C++ experience."**  
**

Some other examples of auto-tags could include: language proficiency, authorized to work in the US, coding / technical language, school / university for college recruiting, desired department, a seasonal intern — the list goes on and on! Read more about auto-tagging here: [auto-tag](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360000060551).

# Best practices for writing survey questions

**Permissions:** Site Admin

**Product tier:** Available for new subscription tiers (Core, Plus, and Pro)

The [candidate survey](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360029861512) lets you customize your questions so you can collect the feedback you want from your candidates.

By following these best practices for writing survey questions, you can design a survey that encourages accurate and meaningful responses that demonstrate how the candidate experience affects your hiring goals.

#### In this article

  * Use clear language
  * Ask a specific question
  * Ask one question at a time
  * Ensure questions are relevant to all respondents
  * Additional resources



### Use clear language

Good survey questions avoid jargon and use simple, straightforward language that can be easily understood. This ensures the data you collect is reliable and consistent across all candidates.

**Bad:**_The company's EVP aligned with my career aspirations._**  
**

This question uses jargon: EVP (employee value proposition) isn’t a common term. Candidates are unlikely to be familiar with it, so they may not know how to accurately answer.

**Good** : _The reputation of [organization name] is part of why I decided to apply._**  
**

This is a clearly written question that any candidate would be able to understand and answer accurately. _  
_

### Ask a specific question

Survey questions should be specific and precise. Writing a focused question ensures that candidates interpret the question only one way, which allows candidates to respond consistently.

**Bad** : _The organization’s recruiting process is strong._

This question doesn’t address a specific aspect of the recruiting process, so you wouldn’t know whether the candidates' answers indicated that your recruiters were well informed, or the process was too slow, and so on. There’s no way to meaningfully assess responses because the question isn’t specific enough.

**Good** : _The recruiter explained what to expect before each interview._

A better question addresses a specific aspect of the recruiting process, so respondents know exactly what to evaluate when answering.

### Ask one question at a time

Asking only one question at a time is another way to ensure that candidates can answer accurately and provide you with meaningful data. It's natural to want to group two related topics, but doing so can prevent candidates from responding accurately. 

**Bad** : _The recruiter knew a lot about the company and the job opening._

How should a candidate answer if the recruiter knew a lot about the company, but not about the job opening? It may be difficult to determine which aspect of your hiring process needs to be improved when your question includes more than one topic.

**Good** : Instead, break the question into two separate questions that can be answered individually:

  * _The recruiter knew a lot about the company_
  * _The recruiter knew a lot about the job opening_



Here, it's clear what the candidate is evaluating, making your data easier to interpret.

### Ensure questions are relevant to all respondents

If candidates encounter a question that doesn’t apply to them, they may be tempted to choose a random answer that would then dilute other candidates’ valid responses.

To ensure you’re collecting reliable and meaningful data, ensure that all survey questions are relevant to your survey audience.

**Bad** : _My recruiter was knowledgeable about programming languages._

This question is unlikely to be relevant to everyone who receives a survey, unless you’ve narrowed your audience so every single job opening and recruitment process is related to programming languages.

**Good** : _My recruiter was knowledgeable about the job’s responsibilities._

A more general question is more likely to be relevant to all survey respondents.

### Additional resources

For more help writing strong survey questions, check out our [Sample survey questions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/20996918310555).

# HRIS Link and ISUs (integration system users)

**Permissions:** Site Admin who can edit another user's advanced permissions

**Product tier:** Available for Pro subscription tier with HRIS Link add-on

HRIS Link requires two ISUs to function:

  1. An ISU in your HRIS platform that has full access to [your import report](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360055282972) and its fields;
  2. And an [ISU in Greenhouse Recruiting](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360060056451).



HRIS Link uses the ISU from your HRIS platform to access your report, and it uses the Greenhouse Recruiting ISU to import and update jobs, offices, departments, and users.

#### In this article

  * Frequently asked questions



### Frequently asked questions

#### What are the impacts of updating or changing the HRIS ISU password?

The HRIS Link integration could fail to update jobs, offices, departments, or users as expected.

HRIS Link doesn't automatically stop running when ISU errors are encountered. As a result, if your organization has a lock-out setting on the ISU in your HRIS platform, the ISU would become locked out, and your team would need to work with the Greenhouse Technical Support team to pause your HRIS Link integrations to allow your HRIS platform to reset the ISU lock-out.

#### Should I use the same Greenhouse Recruiting ISU for all my HRIS Link imports?

It's not required, but it is recommended to use the same ISU for your HRIS Link integrations.

#### Can my organization use a different Greenhouse Recruiting ISU for each HRIS Link import?

Yes, each HRIS Link integration is configured individually, and each HRIS Link integration could have distinct ISUs.

#### Should my organization leverage the same Greenhouse Recruiting ISU as HRIS Link for our different [custom option sync](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360002158492-Custom-options-sync-overview) integrations?

We don't recommend that you leverage the same ISU for your custom option sync integration as HRIS Link. This configuration could cause downstream errors for integrations if your organization updates ISU credentials regularly.

Currently, the [custom option sync](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360002158492-Custom-options-sync-overview) integration is configured to automatically pause when ISU credentials are failing, whereas the HRIS Link integration will continue to poll the report and alert your team of the error. As a result, it's possible the HRIS Link integration could cause ISU lock-out issues for your credentials.

#### What's the best practice if my organization's ISU gets locked out?

Reach out to the [Greenhouse Technical Support](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360058320292) team and ask them to pause your HRIS Link integration while you correct the login issue.

**Note** : When reaching out to Greenhouse Technical Support, let the team know if your organization will be generating a new ISU so that Greenhouse Technical Support can provide a secure file transfer method for the ISU password.

# Prospect pool activity report

**Permissions:** Job Admin and above who have access to CRM

**Product tier:** Available for Plus and Pro subscription tiers

Prospect pools and stages are a valuable way to categorize your prospects and indicate where they are in your prospecting process. These categories make it easier to deliver the right message to the right person and track the outcomes of your efforts for constant improvement.

With the prospect pool activity report, you can understand all of the activity that's occurred in a prospect pool within a given period of time, including the number of prospects to enter a specific stage, remain in stages, move out of stages, as well as the number of prospects that were either stopped being considered as a prospect or converted to a candidate while in specific stages.

#### In this article

  * Prospect pool activity report
  * Prospect pool activity report filters



### Prospect pool activity report

To create a prospect conversion report, click **Reports** on your navigation bar.

Click **Essential Reports** on the left.

Scroll to the _Assess Your Prospecting Efforts_ (CRM) section, and click **Prospect****Pool Activity**.

The prospect pool activity report will generate.

The prospect pool activity report includes the following columns:

  * **Entered Stage** represents how many prospects entered that specific prospect stage during the given period of time.
  * **Remained in Stage** represents how many prospects remained in that specific prospect stage during the given period of time.
  * **Moved out of Stage** represents how many prospects were moved out of that specific prospect stage in the given period of time.
  * **Stopped Considering** represents how many prospects were marked as “no longer consider” when they were in that specific prospect stage.
  * **Converted to Candidate** represents how many prospects were converted to candidates when in that specific prospect stage.



### Prospect pool activity report filters

Click **Filters and more** to adjust the filters on your report.

The prospect pool activity report can be filtered by the following:

  * Job
  * Job status
  * Department
  * Office
  * User
  * Hiring team role
  * Custom job field
  * Prospect pool
  * Prospect stage
  * Activity date
  * Include prospects on no jobs
  * Include migrated candidates



**Note** : By default, the activity date for the report is set to the current year.

# Release Notes: March 2025

Greenhouse Software regularly releases new product features, updates, and improvements. You can stay up-to-date by following our [release notes](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200929955) or checking out the [latest feature releases](https://www.greenhouse.com/greenhouse-latest-features) page.

#### This month's releases

  * Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Business Intelligence Connector
  * Integrations
  * Bug fixes



### Greenhouse Recruiting

#### Design Studio

Organizations can now update their job boards’ look and feel—colors, fonts, layout, and more—without needing design or engineering support. Use the live preview to see changes as you make them, and apply updates to one or multiple boards at once to stay consistent across locations or brands. This gives you more control over branding, with less back-and-forth.

Design Studio is available to all customers for external job boards; internal board customization is available on Advanced and Expert tiers.

Try Design Studio under **Configure** > **Job Boards & Posts** > **Design Studio.**

#### Use AI to quickly find the right filters in Report Builder

If you're on the Advanced or Expert tier, you can now type a prompt in the filters section of Report Builder and let AI suggest the filters you need so you can get the data you're looking for faster.

Read more about AI report filters [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/34881092882459-Use-AI-to-get-suggestions-for-report-filters).

#### Personalize campaign emails with AI

You can now use a new token in Greenhouse Sourcing Automation campaign emails to automatically generate a personalized sentence based on each candidate’s resume. This helps you add context and relevance at scale, without writing each message from scratch, so your outreach feels more thoughtful and tailored from the first touchpoint.

Read more about Greenhouse Sourcing automation [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5131929423643).

#### Assign recruiters and coordinators for applications

Organizations can now assign a recruiter and coordinator to each individual application, rather than being limited to one assignment per job.

This gives teams more flexibility to reflect how work is divided, especially when candidates apply to multiple roles.

We've also updated the [Visual Pipeline](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/4874727408795) so you can filter by application-level recruiter or coordinator, making it easier to track ownership and progress across busy jobs.

You can read more about assigning recruiters and coordinators to candidates [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360040346551).

#### Interviewer limits

You can now set daily and weekly interview limits to help prevent burnout and balance interview load across your team. These limits make it easier to avoid over-scheduling and support a smoother, more sustainable interview experience for everyone involved.

Interview limits can be set individually on the Edit User page or for multiple users at once using a bulk action.

Read more about interviewer limits [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/33994471979419).

#### Scheduled Take Home Tests

You can now schedule Take Home Tests to be sent at a specific time, giving you more control over timing and coordination. Whether you're using built-in tests or a partner integration, the in-app experience mirrors how you schedule emails, so it’s easy to set up and ensures candidates receive tests at the right moment.

Read more about setting up take home tests for candidates [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200887825).

#### Improved interviewer search

We’ve overhauled the "select interviewer by tag" window to make it easier to find the right people during scheduling.

The new search experience is more intuitive and now includes department, office, job title, and custom user fields filters. Whether you're scheduling for a specific team or across locations, this update helps you move faster with more precision.

#### Hide department name on Greenhouse-hosted job boards

If department names aren’t helpful to candidates or don’t reflect how you group roles, you can now hide them from job listings on Greenhouse-hosted boards without custom CSS. Organizations can now stop these department names from displaying under Job Board Settings.

Read more about setting up your job boards [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360062032092).

### Business Intelligence Connector

On March 19, 2025, we added a new `preferred_name` column to the `candidates` table.

Read more about the changes [here](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/34191521007387-Business-Intelligence-Connector-update-February-19-March-19-2025).

### Integrations

  * **Optimization:** [MHAYA.ai](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/33954922668571) is a patented talent-to-opportunity matching engine that transforms talent acquisition by enabling organizations to achieve recruitment up to 3X faster.
  * **Job board:** [Hire Intelligence](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/33040968861723) is a global job distribution and analytics tool that allows companies to optimize their recruitment marketing spend and manage their jobs on Indeed and hundreds of other job boards as well as on social media channels like LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, all in one platform.



### Bug fixes

  * Fixed an issue where updating a value on a custom field was redirecting users to a different field after it was saved.

# Approvals FAQ

Approvals give your organization more control over when jobs can be opened and when offers can be generated and sent to candidates.

This article provides answers to frequently asked questions about using [approvals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/sections/17982241029531).

#### In this article

  * How do I set up approvals?
  * What’s the difference between one-stage and two-stage job approvals?
  * How do I add a user as an approver?
  * How can I use a custom job field to add an approver?
  * Can I change the approval process for a specific job?
  * What happens if a user who’s named as an approver is out of office?
  * What happens if I change an approver before the approval process ends?
  * A job field was edited on an open job, but the approval didn't retrigger. Why?



#### How do I set up approvals?

To start using approvals, go to **Configure** > **Approvals**. New approval processes apply to future jobs only. They don’t affect active or closed jobs.

#### What’s the difference between one-stage and two-stage job approvals?

[One-stage job approvals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025756071-One-stage-vs-two-stage-job-approvals#h_d69b6401-9559-4e8e-ab05-f5bf1479385d) require approval to start recruiting for a job. [Two-stage job approvals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025756071-One-stage-vs-two-stage-job-approvals#h_2deb3cc5-4433-4950-894f-e61004d4eddb) require approval both to start recruiting for a job and also to send an offer to a candidate.

#### How do I add a user as an approver?

To add an approver to a default approval process, go to **Configure** > **Approvals**. Click **Add approval step** , then select a user or [custom job field](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202609855) from the dropdown and click **Save**.

**Note:** Only the following users can be selected as approvers:

  * Site Admins with the user-specific permission **Can see private notes, salary info, manage offers, and approve jobs/offers**
  * Job Admin with the permission stripe **Can view and edit private job fields and approve/request approval on jobs on All Future Jobs**



[Learn more](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201093674) about approval permissions.

#### How can I use a custom job field to add an approver?

Also known as [role-based approvals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/19316003622427), you can use a custom job field to adjust approvers on a per-job basis.

The custom job field acts like a placeholder in the default approvals process, giving you the flexibility to adapt the approvals process for each job.

To start, create a [custom job field](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/202609855) with the **Field type** set to "User."

**Note:** Only users with the appropriate [approval permissions](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/201093674) will be displayed on the dropdown list.

Click the checkbox next to **Use for job approvals** and/or **Use for offer approvals**. You'll also be asked to give the field a name.

Your new custom field will appear whenever you [create a new job](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200668380), and you'll be prompted to select a specific user from the field's dropdown list. The user you choose is automatically added to the approvals process on the new job anywhere the custom job field is listed.

**Example:** Imagine you want every new job to be approved by the job’s department manager, Marianne, before recruiting can start. Instead of adding Marianne to your default approvals process, you create and select a custom job field named “Department manager.” When you create a new job, you select Marianne from the "Department manager" dropdown list. 

#### Can I change the approval process for a specific job?

Yes. You can override the default approval process set for your organization in order to tailor the process to a specific job. Changes made at the job level won’t affect your organization’s default approval configuration.

#### What happens if a user who’s named as an approver is out of office?

If someone named as an approver is unable to act on an approval, a Site Admin can approve on their behalf.

#### What happens if I change an approver before the approval process ends?

Approval steps that have been completed on a job won’t change. The previous approver’s name will still appear in the _Job Approvals_ section, along with the date of their approval. This provides documentation for the rest of the team.

Approval steps that haven’t been completed will use the new approver.

#### A job field was edited on an open job, but the approval didn't retrigger. Why?

Approvals will retrigger only if the open job is using [two-stage approvals](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360025756071).

# HR Drone integration

HR Drone is an innovative web platform and mobile app that streamlines the hiring process for companies and job seekers alike. HR Drone gives you access to a large pool of professionals open to new job opportunities and saves you time by surfacing matching profiles for each job.

HR Drone's integration with Greenhouse Recruiting allows users to source, access, engage, and track candidates from HR Drone.

#### In this article

  * Set up the integration
  * Use the integration



### Set up the integration

To set up the integration, first log in to HR Drone, and go to the **Extensions** page. Click **Connect** on the Greenhouse Recruiting section.

On the next page, authorize the integration by logging into your Greenhouse Recruiting account.

Enter your Greenhouse Recruiting user email and click **Next** **step**. Enter your Greenhouse Recruiting password, then click **Authorize**.

### 

Next, navigate to the **My** **jobs** page and click **Create** **new**.

Fill out your job information.

On the third step, add the Greenhouse Recruiting job dashboard URL to the _Application_ _link_ field, and click **Publish**.

**Tip** : To find your job's dashboard link, navigate to the job in Greenhouse Recruiting. The job's dashboard page will show a URL on your browser like `https://app.greenhouse.io/sdash/2947282`.

That's it! The HR Drone integration is configured and ready to use.

### Use the integration

When a candidate applies for your job on HR Drone, the candidate's first name, last name, LinkedIn profile, and email address will be added as a candidate to the corresponding job in Greenhouse Recruiting. You can also optionally sync portfolio and additional information about the candidate.

### Additional resources

For additional information not covered here, reach out to [support@hrdrone.am](mailto:support@hrdrone.am).

# Mindsight integration

Mindsight is a Brazilian company specializing in psychometric tests and organizational psychology. Mindsight's goal is to facilitate the decision-making process about people management processes using methods of organizational psychology and artificial intelligence.

Greenhouse Recruiting's integration with Mindsight allows you to seamlessly add Mindsight's assessments to a job's interview plan.

#### In this article

  * Enable the Mindsight integration
    * Create a Harvest API key for the Mindsight integration
    * Create custom candidate fields in Greenhouse Recruiting
  * Use the Mindsight integration
    * Add the Mindsight stage to your job's interview plan
    * Set up stage transition rule to automatically notify candidates
    * Send and review the Mindsight test
  * Additional resources



### Create a Harvest API key for the Mindsight integration

To configure the Greenhouse Recruiting / Mindsight integration, you'll need to create a Harvest API key.

Follow the steps in [this article](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/5888163769883) to create the key, and verify that the credentials and permissions below are selected when configuring the Mindsight integration.

#### Credentials

In the _Create New Credential_ box, make the following selections:

  * **API type:** Harvest
  * **Partner:** Mindsight (optional)
  * **Description:** Mindsight Harvest API key



#### Permissions

Verify that the following permissions are selected for the Mindsight integration:

**Candidates**

  * GET: Retrieve candidate
  * GET: List candidates
  * PATCH: Edit candidate



When finished, click **Update**.

Your Harvest API key for the Greenhouse Recruiting / Mindsight integration is created and configured. Provide your Harvest API key to your Mindsight onboarding team so they can set up the integration.

### Create custom candidate fields in Greenhouse Recruiting

The Greenhouse Recruiting / Mindsight integration requires you to create five (5) custom candidate fields.

To create a custom candidate field, click the **Configure** icon  on your navigation bar and then click **Custom Options** on the left.

Under _Company Custom Fields_ , click **Candidates**.

Click **Add Field**.

Enter the following details for your new field:

  * **Field Name:**_Mindsight - Perfil - Data de finalização_
  * **Field Type:** Date



When finished, click **Save.**

Repeat the steps above to create four additional custom candidate fields, using the following details:

**Field Name** | **Field Type**  
---|---  
_Mindsight - Raciocínio_ | Number  
_Mindsight - Social_ | Number  
_Mindsight - Motivacional_ | Number  
_Mindsight – Fit Cultural_ | Number  
  
After creating all five (5) custom candidate fields, click one of the newly created custom candidate fields to edit it.

Copy the _Immutable Field Key_ and save the information for a later step.

Repeat this process and copy the Immutable Field Key for each of the other five (5) custom candidate fields created.

Once you've collected the immutable field keys for all five (5) custom candidate fields, provide them to your Mindsight onboarding team.

### Add the Mindsight stage to a job's Interview Plan

Once the Greenhouse Recruiting / Mindsight integration is enabled for your organization, you will be able to add the Mindsight assessment as an Interview stage.

To do this for an existing job, navigate to a job (**Jobs** > **Job** **name**) and select **Job Setup**.

Click **Interview** **Plan** on the left, then click **\+ Add a Stage**.

Select **Take Home Test** in the _Add Stage_ window. Click **Add** to place the stage in the job's interview plan.

**Note:** If needed, you can edit the name of that stage. For clarity, we recommend naming it "Mindsight Assessments."

After the stage is added to your interview plan, click the **Edit** icon to configure the email template.

Select the sender that candidates should see they receive the e-mail. Typically, companies use a “no-reply” address for this step.

Enter the **Subject** field for the email.

Update the**Email Body** with information about your assessment process. To make sure the integration works smoothly, verify that the email body contains an assessment link for candidates. If needed, you can use the example below:

Dear {{CANDIDATE NAME}},

You are receiving this email because you signed up for {{JOB_NAME}} at {{COMPANY}}. We are very happy with your application to be part of our team!

This stage of the selection process consists of some tests so that we can get to know you better. It is an opportunity to be evaluated beyond your resume and to help us understand which position fits you best. We have put together some tips to help you do your best:

Be who you are and as frank as possible; your degree of transparency is essential to finding the role which is best suited to you; 

  * Take the test in a quiet environment;
  * Keep in mind that some of the tests may take longer than others, so evaluate the estimated time so you do not run into any difficulties. The duration of each test will be displayed on the access page;
  * Ensure you have a stable internet connection while completing the tests;
  * Very important: you will only have one chance to perform each test individually; this means that it is not possible to pause them once you start.



Click here to start testing.

If you have any questions or problems, please contact [Mindsight Help Center](https://candidato.mindsight.com.br/hc/pt-br).

Good luck!

In your email body, create a hyperlink on the sentence "Click here to start testing" according to the assessments you aim to send for your candidates. Based on your type of assessment, you can choose from the following five options:

Assessment Type | URL  
---|---  
Sending **only** Organizational Culture Assessment | [https://app.mindsight.com.br/api/v1/integrations/gh/register/30/{{APPLICATION_ID}}?utm_source=gh_redirect_email&candidate_id={{CANDIDATE_ID}}&candidate_name={{CANDIDATE_NAME}}&candidate_email={{CANDIDATE_EMAIL_ADDRESS}}&stage=ocp_stage](https://app.mindsight.com.br/api/v1/integrations/gh/register/30/%7b%7bAPPLICATION_ID%7d%7d?utm_source=gh_redirect_email&candidate_id=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_ID%7d%7d&candidate_name=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_NAME%7d%7d&candidate_email=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_EMAIL_ADDRESS%7d%7d&stage=ocp_stage=)  
Sending **only** Learning Agility Assessment | [https://app.mindsight.com.br/api/v1/integrations/gh/register/30/{{APPLICATION_ID}}?utm_source=gh_redirect_email&candidate_id={{CANDIDATE_ID}}&candidate_name={{CANDIDATE_NAME}}&candidate_email={{CANDIDATE_EMAIL_ADDRESS}}&stage=nexa_stage](https://app.mindsight.com.br/api/v1/integrations/gh/register/30/%7b%7bAPPLICATION_ID%7d%7d?utm_source=gh_redirect_email&candidate_id=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_ID%7d%7d&candidate_name=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_NAME%7d%7d&candidate_email=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_EMAIL_ADDRESS%7d%7d&stage=nexa_stage=)  
Sending Organizational Culture, Learning Agility **and** Abilities Assessment | [https://app.mindsight.com.br/api/v1/integrations/gh/register/30/{{APPLICATION_ID}}?utm_source=gh_redirect_email&candidate_id={{CANDIDATE_ID}}&candidate_name={{CANDIDATE_NAME}}&candidate_email={{CANDIDATE_EMAIL_ADDRESS}}&stage=complete_stage_with_nexa](https://app.mindsight.com.br/api/v1/integrations/gh/register/30/%7b%7bAPPLICATION_ID%7d%7d?utm_source=gh_redirect_email&candidate_id=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_ID%7d%7d&candidate_name=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_NAME%7d%7d&candidate_email=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_EMAIL_ADDRESS%7d%7d&stage=complete_stage_with_nexa)  
Sending Organizational Culture **and** Abilities Assessment | [https://app.mindsight.com.br/api/v1/integrations/gh/register/30/{{APPLICATION_ID}}?utm_source=gh_redirect_email&candidate_id={{CANDIDATE_ID}}&candidate_name={{CANDIDATE_NAME}}&candidate_email={{CANDIDATE_EMAIL_ADDRESS}}&stage=complete_stage](https://app.mindsight.com.br/api/v1/integrations/gh/register/30/%7b%7bAPPLICATION_ID%7d%7d?utm_source=gh_redirect_email&candidate_id=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_ID%7d%7d&candidate_name=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_NAME%7d%7d&candidate_email=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_EMAIL_ADDRESS%7d%7d&stage=complete_stage)  
Sending **only** Abilities Assessment | [https://app.mindsight.com.br/api/v1/integrations/gh/register/30/{{APPLICATION_ID}}?utm_source=gh_redirect_email&candidate_id={{CANDIDATE_ID}}&candidate_name={{CANDIDATE_NAME}}&candidate_email={{CANDIDATE_EMAIL_ADDRESS}}&stage=default_stage](https://app.mindsight.com.br/api/v1/integrations/gh/register/30/%7b%7bAPPLICATION_ID%7d%7d?utm_source=gh_redirect_email&candidate_id=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_ID%7d%7d&candidate_name=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_NAME%7d%7d&candidate_email=%7b%7bCANDIDATE_EMAIL_ADDRESS%7d%7d&stage=default_stage)  
  
Since you are adding your own assessment link, you'll need to deactivate the default Greenhouse Recruiting submission link. Scroll down on the page and turn off the toggle in the **Link for candidates to submit tests** field.

Update the following settings at the bottom of the page:

  * If needed, you can assign the **candidate's recruiter** as the grader in the _Graders and Notifications_ section
  * Uncheck **Requires scorecards to be submitted** in the _Additional Settings_ section



Click **Save**. You'll be redirected to the _Interview Plan_ for the job. You can click and drag your Mindsight stage to the correct part of the interview plan.

### Set up stage transition rule to automatically notify candidates

If you'd like to automatically send the Mindsight assessment to candidates when they're moved into the stage, you can set up a [stage transition rule](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/360053129752).

To create a new stage transition, select the _Stage Transitions_ tab on the left panel and click **Create a Rule.**

Configure the rules as needed and click **Save**.

  * **Stage:** Your Mindsight integration stage
  * **Action:** Send Take Home Test
  * **User credited with this action:** The user who moved the candidate
  * **When to send:** Immediately



**Note:** You can modify the action, user credited, and when to send fields as needed.

### Send and review the Mindsight test

If you've set up a stage transition, after candidates are moved into the Mindsight interview stage, they will automatically receive the assessments by email.

Once a candidate has submitted their test, you can view the candidate's results. To review a candidate's test, navigate to their profile on the job via **Jobs** > **Job** **name** >**Candidates**.

To view all candidates who have submitted a test, click **Profile** **Details** on the left > **Custom** **field** to select a Mindsight field. After selecting the field, enter the range of grades you would like to analyze in the corresponding number field.

The _Candidates_ page will filter the list of candidates to show only those who match the criteria you entered. Click the candidate profile you wish to review. The candidate's results will be displayed under the **Details** tab.

### Additional resources

For additional information or troubleshooting not covered here, reach out to [suporte@mindsight.com.br](mailto:suporte@mindsight.com.br) or [click here](http://bit.ly/Support-Mindsight) to visit the Mindsight Help Center.
